translations.translation: 一(个)；每一(个)；(同类事物中)任一个

sentence_examples.en: I have a dog.
sentence_examples.zh: 我有一只狗。

sentence_examples.en: She is an actress.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一名女演员。

sentence_examples.en: Could you give me an orange?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能给我一个橙子吗？

translations.translation: 离弃，丢弃；遗弃，抛弃；放弃

sentence_examples.en: The hikers had to abandon their climb when a storm rolled in.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨来袭时，徒步者不得不放弃攀登。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to abandon her old car and buy a new one.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定放弃旧车，买了一辆新车。

sentence_examples.en: The project was abandoned after the team ran out of funding.
sentence_examples.zh: 在团队资金耗尽后，该项目被放弃。

translations.translation: 腹，下腹(胸部到腿部的部分)

sentence_examples.en: He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen after the fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 他摔倒后腹部感到一阵剧痛。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor used a stethoscope to listen to his abdomen.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生用听诊器听他的腹部。

sentence_examples.en: She does sit-ups to strengthen her abdomen.
sentence_examples.zh: 她做仰卧起坐来加强腹部。

sentence_examples.en: We must abide by the rules of the competition.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须遵守比赛规则。

sentence_examples.en: Employees are required to abide by company policies.
sentence_examples.zh: 员工必须遵守公司政策。

sentence_examples.en: Children sometimes struggle to abide by strict rules at school.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们有时很难遵守学校的严格规则。

translations.translation: 能力；本领；才能；专门技能，天资

sentence_examples.en: She has the ability to speak three languages.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有说三种语言的能力。

sentence_examples.en: Developing strong problem-solving abilities takes time.
sentence_examples.zh: 培养强大的解决问题的能力需要时间。

sentence_examples.en: Her ability to stay calm under pressure helped her during the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在压力下保持冷静的能力在面试中帮助了她。

translations.translation: 有(能力、知识等)做某事，有本事的

sentence_examples.en: She is able to speak three languages.
sentence_examples.zh: 她能说三种语言。

sentence_examples.en: He was able to finish the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 他设法按时完成了这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: If you study hard, you'll be able to pass the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你努力学习，你就能通过考试。

translations.translation: 反常的，不正常的，不规则的

sentence_examples.en: Her blood test showed abnormal results.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的血液检查结果异常。

sentence_examples.en: An abnormal heartbeat can be a sign of a medical condition.
sentence_examples.zh: 异常的心跳可能是某种疾病的信号。

sentence_examples.en: The weather this week is abnormal for the season.
sentence_examples.zh: 这周的天气对这个季节来说很异常。

sentence_examples.en: The captain welcomed everyone aboard the cruise ship.
sentence_examples.zh: 船长欢迎大家登上邮轮。

sentence_examples.en: We were aboard the plane when the doors closed.
sentence_examples.zh: 机舱门关上时，我们已经登上了飞机。

sentence_examples.en: All passengers must be aboard the bus by departure time.
sentence_examples.zh: 所有乘客必须在发车时间前登上公交车。

sentence_examples.en: The government plans to abolish the death penalty.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府计划废除死刑。

sentence_examples.en: Many people want to abolish outdated customs.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人想要废除过时的风俗。

sentence_examples.en: The committee voted to abolish the redundant regulation.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会投票废除了冗余的法规。

sentence_examples.en: Opportunities abound in this city for young professionals.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座城市对年轻专业人士来说机会很多。

sentence_examples.en: Rumors abound about the upcoming merger.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于即将进行的合并，谣言四起。

sentence_examples.en: Butterflies abound in the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园里蝴蝶成群，数量很多。

sentence_examples.en: There were about twenty people at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议上大约有二十人。

sentence_examples.en: This book is about the history of science.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书是关于科学史的。

sentence_examples.en: I'm about to leave the house.
sentence_examples.zh: 我就要出门了。

sentence_examples.en: The painting hangs above the fireplace.
sentence_examples.zh: 画挂在壁炉上方。

sentence_examples.en: Please follow the above-mentioned guidelines.
sentence_examples.zh: 请遵循上述指南。

sentence_examples.en: The helicopter hovered above the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 直升机在城市上空盘旋。

translations.translation: 到国外，在国外；在传播，在流传

sentence_examples.en: She studied abroad for a year after college.
sentence_examples.zh: 她大学毕业后在国外留学一年。

sentence_examples.en: He plans to work abroad next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 他计划明年在国外工作。

sentence_examples.en: The news spread abroad quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 消息很快传遍海外。

translations.translation: 突然的,出其不意的；(行为等)粗鲁无礼的

sentence_examples.en: The bus made an abrupt stop.
sentence_examples.zh: 公交车突然急停。

sentence_examples.en: Her reply was abrupt and blunt.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的回答既突然又直白。

sentence_examples.en: The discussion took an abrupt turn when the topic changed.
sentence_examples.zh: 话题一变，讨论突然转向。

translations.translation: 缺乏，不存在；缺席，不在；缺席的时间

sentence_examples.en: There was an absence of evidence in the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告中缺乏证据。

sentence_examples.en: Her absence from the meeting was noted.
sentence_examples.zh: 她缺席了会议。

sentence_examples.en: The absence of sunlight made the room gloomy.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间因为缺少阳光而显得昏暗。

translations.translation: 缺席的；缺乏的,不存在的;心不在焉的

sentence_examples.en: The student was absent from class today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天这名学生缺席了课堂。

sentence_examples.en: She seemed emotionally absent during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议中显得情绪上有些心不在焉。

sentence_examples.en: His name was absent from the guest list.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的名字没有出现在宾客名单上。

translations.translation: 绝对的，完全的；确实的，肯定的

sentence_examples.en: The project requires absolute secrecy.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目需要绝对的保密。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke with absolute certainty that she was right.
sentence_examples.zh: 她说话时对自己是对的充满了绝对的信心。

sentence_examples.en: The absolute value of -7 is 7.
sentence_examples.zh: -7 的绝对值是 7。

translations.translation: 吸收(水、光、蒸汽等）；使全神贯注

sentence_examples.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

sentence_examples.en: The sponge can absorb a lot of oil.
sentence_examples.zh: 海绵能吸收大量油。

sentence_examples.en: Students absorb new information better when it's presented clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 当信息讲解清晰时，学生更容易吸收新信息。

sentence_examples.en: The sculpture has an abstract form that evokes motion.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕塑具有抽象的形状，能唤起运动感。

sentence_examples.en: The abstract of the report explains the purpose and methods.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告的摘要解释了研究的目的和方法。

sentence_examples.en: The editor abstracted the key facts from the interview notes.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑从采访笔记中提取了要点。

translations.translation: 荒谬的，荒诞的，荒唐可笑的；不合理的

sentence_examples.en: The idea that humans can fly without any assistance is absurd.
sentence_examples.zh: 认为人类在没有任何帮助的情况下就能飞行的想法很荒谬。

sentence_examples.en: It's absurd to spend that much on a used car.
sentence_examples.zh: 花那么多钱买一辆二手车真是荒唐。

sentence_examples.en: The movie's plot was so absurd that I couldn't take it seriously.
sentence_examples.zh: 那部电影的情节太荒诞了，我根本无法认真对待。

sentence_examples.en: There is an abundance of fruit at the market today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天市场上的水果很多。

sentence_examples.en: We have an abundance of time to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们有充足的时间来完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The garden shows an abundance of colorful flowers in spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 春天的花园里有大量五彩缤纷的花朵。

translations.translation: 大量(充足)的；(in)丰富(富裕)的

sentence_examples.en: There is abundant rainfall this year, which helped the crops grow.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年降雨充足，这有助于作物生长。

sentence_examples.en: The region has abundant natural resources, including oil and minerals.
sentence_examples.zh: 该地区自然资源丰富，包括石油和矿产。

sentence_examples.en: Jobs are abundant in the city, offering many opportunities.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这座城市，工作机会很多。

sentence_examples.en: The company fired him for abusing company resources.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司因滥用公司资源而解雇了他。

sentence_examples.en: Classroom rules prohibit verbal abuse.
sentence_examples.zh: 课堂规则禁止语言辱骂。

sentence_examples.en: Corruption is an abuse of power that harms citizens.
sentence_examples.zh: 贪污是对权力的滥用，伤害了公民。

translations.translation: 学院的，大学的；学术性的；理论的

sentence_examples.en: The university offers an academic program in environmental science.
sentence_examples.zh: 这所大学提供环境科学的学术项目。

sentence_examples.en: Her article examines academic theories in linguistics.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的文章研究语言学中的学术理论。

sentence_examples.en: Many students prefer practical courses over strictly academic ones.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多学生更喜欢实用课程，而不是纯粹的学术课程。

translations.translation: (高等)专科院校；学术社团,协会，研究院

sentence_examples.en: She studied painting at a local art academy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在当地的艺术学院学习绘画。

sentence_examples.en: The academy announced a new research grant for climate studies.
sentence_examples.zh: 该研究院宣布了一项用于气候研究的新资助计划。

sentence_examples.en: She was elected to the academy as a member.
sentence_examples.zh: 她被选入该学术团体成为成员。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy will accelerate economic growth.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策将加速经济增长。

sentence_examples.en: The car accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in under five seconds.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车在不到五秒内从0加速到60英里/小时。

sentence_examples.en: We need to accelerate development to meet the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了赶上截止日期，我们需要加快开发进度。

sentence_examples.en: She speaks with a strong Scottish accent.
sentence_examples.zh: 她说话带着浓重的苏格兰口音。

sentence_examples.en: The word banana has the accent on the second syllable.
sentence_examples.zh: 单词 banana 的重音在第二个音节。

sentence_examples.en: In pronunciation, you should place the accent on the stressed syllable.
sentence_examples.zh: 在发音时，你应将重音放在重读音节上。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to accept the job offer after the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在面试后决定接受这份工作。

sentence_examples.en: He couldn't accept the gift because he already had one.
sentence_examples.zh: 他因为已经有一个，不能接受这份礼物。

sentence_examples.en: The committee accepted his proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会接受了他的提议。

translations.translation: 接受，接收，验收，接纳；承认，认可

sentence_examples.en: Her acceptance of the job offer came yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 她昨天接受了那份工作录用通知。

sentence_examples.en: Her acceptance of the award was gracious.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对奖项的接受很大方。

sentence_examples.en: We have to wait for final acceptance before signing the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 在签署合同前，我们必须等待最终的批准。

translations.translation: 进入；接入；到达；享用权；入口

sentence_examples.en: Gaining access to the building requires a security card.
sentence_examples.zh: 进入大楼需要一张安保卡。

sentence_examples.en: The library offers remote access to its databases.
sentence_examples.zh: 该图书馆为其数据库提供远程访问。

sentence_examples.en: You can access the files online with your username.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以用用户名在线访问这些文件。

translations.translation: 附件,附属品;(为全套衣服增加美感的)服饰

sentence_examples.en: A scarf can be a simple accessory that completes a look.
sentence_examples.zh: 围巾可以成为完成造型的简单配饰。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a necklace as a stylish accessory for the evening.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把项链作为晚上的时尚配饰。

sentence_examples.en: Belts and scarves are common accessories.
sentence_examples.zh: 腰带和围巾是常见的配饰。

translations.translation: 意外遭遇,事故；意外(因素)

sentence_examples.en: There was a car accident on the highway this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天早上高速公路上发生了一起车祸。

sentence_examples.en: It was just an accident; no one was seriously injured.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只是一起事故，没有人严重受伤。

sentence_examples.en: She broke her arm in a bicycle accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在一次自行车事故中摔断了手臂。

translations.translation: 偶然的；意外的；无意中的

sentence_examples.en: The spill was accidental; no one meant to knock over the cup.
sentence_examples.zh: 洒出是偶然的；没有人故意打翻杯子。

sentence_examples.en: The scientist made an accidental discovery while researching another topic.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家在研究另一个课题时偶然发现了一个新的现象。

sentence_examples.en: There was accidental damage to the painting during transport.
sentence_examples.zh: 运输过程中画作遭到了意外损坏。

sentence_examples.en: The critics acclaimed the new film for its innovative storytelling.
sentence_examples.zh: 评论家因其创新的叙事手法高度评价了这部新电影。

sentence_examples.en: The play received widespread acclaim from critics.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部话剧受到评论界广泛的赞誉。

sentence_examples.en: She has earned acclaim for her research in neuroscience.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在神经科学研究方面赢得了赞誉。

translations.translation: 向…提供住处；对...予以照顾性考虑

sentence_examples.en: The hotel can accommodate up to 200 guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店最多可容纳200名客人。

sentence_examples.en: We will do our best to accommodate your dietary restrictions.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将尽力满足您的饮食要求。

sentence_examples.en: The conference center can accommodate multiple events at once.
sentence_examples.zh: 该会议中心可以同时承办多场活动。

sentence_examples.en: We need to find affordable accommodation for our trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要为这次旅行找一个负担得起的住宿。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel offers comfortable accommodation with breakfast included.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店提供舒适的住宿，包含早餐。

sentence_examples.en: There are many accommodations in the city to choose from.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个城市有许多住宿可供选择。

translations.translation: 陪伴，陪同；伴随，和...一起发生，伴奏

sentence_examples.en: She agreed to accompany her friend to the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 她同意陪同她的朋友去面试。

sentence_examples.en: The song is accompanied by a gentle guitar.
sentence_examples.zh: 这首歌由一把轻柔的吉他伴奏。

sentence_examples.en: Laughter accompanied the announcement.
sentence_examples.zh: 宣布时，笑声伴随而来。

translations.translation: 实现(计划等)；达到(目的)；完成(任务)

sentence_examples.en: She managed to accomplish her goal before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在截止日期前设法实现了目标。

sentence_examples.en: They accomplished the task after a long week of work.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过一周的努力，他们完成了这项任务。

sentence_examples.en: This plan is designed to help you accomplish more with less effort.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个计划旨在帮助你用更少的努力完成更多任务。

sentence_examples.en: The host accorded us a hearty welcome.
sentence_examples.zh: 主人热情地欢迎了我们。

sentence_examples.en: The two sides reached an accord.
sentence_examples.zh: 双方达成了一项协议。

sentence_examples.en: The plan is in accord with international standards.
sentence_examples.zh: 该计划符合国际标准。

sentence_examples.en: The policy was implemented in accordance with the new regulations.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策是按照新规定执行的。

sentence_examples.en: There is close accordance between the two data sets.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两组数据之间存在高度的一致性。

sentence_examples.en: We must act in accordance with the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须按照合同执行。

sentence_examples.en: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 据天气预报，今晚会下雨。

sentence_examples.en: According to my sister, the concert starts at 7 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 据我姐姐说，音乐会在晚上7点开始。

sentence_examples.en: According to the report, the project is on track.
sentence_examples.zh: 据报告，该项目按计划推进。

translations.translation: 相应地，照着办，按照；于是，因此

sentence_examples.en: The project ran over schedule, so we updated the timetable accordingly.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目进度超出计划，因此我们相应地更新了时间表。

sentence_examples.en: The data showed a decline, so we adjusted our strategy accordingly.
sentence_examples.zh: 数据呈现下降趋势，因此我们相应地调整了策略。

sentence_examples.en: If the customer asks for changes, please respond accordingly.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果客户提出变更，请相应地作出回应。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a detailed account of the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对事故作了详细的叙述。

sentence_examples.en: I opened a new bank account last week.
sentence_examples.zh: 我上周开了一个新的银行账户。

sentence_examples.en: He couldn't account for his lateness.
sentence_examples.zh: 他无法解释自己的迟到。

sentence_examples.en: The accountant prepared the quarterly financial statements for the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 会计师为公司准备了季度财务报表。

sentence_examples.en: She trained as an accountant and now works for a multinational firm.
sentence_examples.zh: 她接受了会计培训，现在在一家跨国公司工作。

sentence_examples.en: The accountant noticed an error in the tax report and corrected it.
sentence_examples.zh: 会计师发现税务报告中的一个错误并进行了纠正。

sentence_examples.en: Dust accumulates on the shelves after a long winter.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过漫长的冬天，尘土会在架子上积累。

sentence_examples.en: If you save a little money every month, it will accumulate into a substantial amount.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你每月存一点钱，时间久了就会积累成一笔可观的金额。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd began to accumulate near the stage as the concert started.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会开始时，观众开始在舞台附近聚集。

sentence_examples.en: The accuracy of the GPS data is crucial for navigation.
sentence_examples.zh: GPS数据的准确性对导航至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: To ensure accuracy, verify your measurements twice.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了确保准确性，请将测量结果核对两次。

sentence_examples.en: We are improving the accuracy of our spelling checker.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们正在提高拼写检查器的准确性。

translations.translation: 正确无误的；准确的，精确的

sentence_examples.en: Her measurements were accurate, which helped the team finish on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的测量很准确，这帮助团队按时完成。

sentence_examples.en: It's important to have accurate data before making a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 在做决定之前拥有准确的数据很重要。

sentence_examples.en: The report provides an accurate summary of the findings.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告提供了研究结果的准确摘要。

sentence_examples.en: The manager accused him of stealing company funds.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理指控他窃取公司资金。

sentence_examples.en: Don't accuse people without solid evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 在没有确凿证据的情况下，不要指责他人。

sentence_examples.en: He was accused of the crime by the police.
sentence_examples.zh: 他被警方指控犯下罪行。

translations.translation: 惯常的；习惯的，适应的(一般作表语)

sentence_examples.en: She is accustomed to waking up early.
sentence_examples.zh: 她已经习惯早起。

sentence_examples.en: We are accustomed to the cold winters in this region.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们已经习惯了本地区的寒冷冬天。

sentence_examples.en: I am not accustomed to such loud noises.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不习惯这么吵的声音。

sentence_examples.en: My back aches after a long day at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 工作一整天后，我的背部酸痛。

sentence_examples.en: Her feet ache from standing all day.
sentence_examples.zh: 她整天站着，脚酸痛。

sentence_examples.en: I ache to see you again.
sentence_examples.zh: 我真想再见到你。

sentence_examples.en: She achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她实现了成为医生的梦想。

sentence_examples.en: The project achieved its main milestone last month.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目在上个月实现了主要里程碑。

sentence_examples.en: We hope to achieve success through collaboration.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们希望通过合作取得成功。

sentence_examples.en: Citric acid is found in citrus fruits.
sentence_examples.zh: 柠檬酸存在于柑橘类水果中。

sentence_examples.en: Acid rain can damage buildings and plants.
sentence_examples.zh: 酸雨会损坏建筑和植物。

sentence_examples.en: A strong acid reacts vigorously with metals.
sentence_examples.zh: 强酸会与金属发生剧烈反应。

translations.translation: 承认；接受；告知(信件等的)收到；答谢

sentence_examples.en: I must acknowledge my mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 我必须承认我的错误。

sentence_examples.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this package.
sentence_examples.zh: 请确认收到此包裹。

sentence_examples.en: The company acknowledges the contributions of its volunteers.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司对志愿者的贡献表示肯定。

sentence_examples.en: I want to acquaint you with the basics of the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想让你了解这个项目的基础要点。

sentence_examples.en: She quickly became acquainted with the new software.
sentence_examples.zh: 她很快熟悉了新软件。

sentence_examples.en: The trainer will acquaint you with the safety rules.
sentence_examples.zh: 培训师将向你介绍安全规则。

translations.translation: 认识，相识，了解；相识的人，熟人

sentence_examples.en: I ran into an old acquaintance at the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在图书馆遇到了一位老相识。

sentence_examples.en: She's barely more than an acquaintance, not a close friend.
sentence_examples.zh: 她只是个熟人，谈不上亲密朋友。

sentence_examples.en: The party had several acquaintances from his previous job.
sentence_examples.zh: 聚会上有他以前工作中的几位熟人。

translations.translation: 获得；学到(知识等)；养成(习惯)

sentence_examples.en: She hopes to acquire new skills by taking online courses.
sentence_examples.zh: 她希望通过参加在线课程获得新技能。

sentence_examples.en: Over time, he acquired a better understanding of the topic.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，他对这个主题有了更好的理解。

sentence_examples.en: She acquired the habit of reading before bed.
sentence_examples.zh: 她养成了睡前阅读的习惯。

translations.translation: 取得，学到，养成(习惯)；获得的东西

sentence_examples.en: The acquisition of new language skills takes time and practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 掌握新语言技能需要时间和练习。

sentence_examples.en: The company announced the acquisition of a smaller rival.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司宣布收购了一家小型竞争对手。

sentence_examples.en: Her rapid acquisition of the habit surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她迅速养成这个习惯，让大家感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The farm spans 120 acres.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个农场占地120英亩。

sentence_examples.en: They bought an acre of land by the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在河边买了一英亩的土地。

sentence_examples.en: The property is two acres.
sentence_examples.zh: 这处地产有两英亩。

sentence_examples.en: The acrobat performed a stunning balance routine on the high wire.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名杂技演员在高空钢丝上表演了一段惊人的平衡动作。

sentence_examples.en: Every show features a different acrobat with a unique specialty.
sentence_examples.zh: 每场演出都会有一位不同的杂技演员，专长各异。

sentence_examples.en: She trained as an acrobat from a young age.
sentence_examples.zh: 她从小就接受杂技训练。

sentence_examples.en: She walked across the street to reach the store.
sentence_examples.zh: 她走过街道去那家商店。

sentence_examples.en: A bridge spans across the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 一座桥横跨这条河。

sentence_examples.en: The apartment building is across from the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 公寓楼就在公园对面。

sentence_examples.en: If you smell smoke, act quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你闻到烟味，请迅速采取行动。

sentence_examples.en: The Freedom of Information Act allows citizens to request records.
sentence_examples.zh: 《信息自由法》允许公民请求获取记录。

sentence_examples.en: The first act ends with a cliffhanger.
sentence_examples.zh: 第一幕以悬念结束。

translations.translation: 行动，动作；作用；运转；行为；战斗

sentence_examples.en: The action she took surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她所采取的行动让大家吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: We need more action, not just words.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要更多的行动，而不仅仅是空谈。

sentence_examples.en: The rescue team took immediate action.
sentence_examples.zh: 救援队立即采取了行动。

translations.translation: 启动，激活；驱动，驱使；使开始起作用

sentence_examples.en: Please activate your account by clicking the link in the email.
sentence_examples.zh: 请通过点击邮件中的链接来激活你的账户。

sentence_examples.en: You must activate the device before you can use it.
sentence_examples.zh: 在使用设备之前，必须先激活设备。

sentence_examples.en: The feature will activate automatically after the update.
sentence_examples.zh: 更新后该功能会自动启用。

translations.translation: 活跃的，敏捷的，积极的；在活动中的

sentence_examples.en: She leads an active life, always cycling and hiking.
sentence_examples.zh: 她过着活跃的生活，总是骑车和远足。

sentence_examples.en: The active volcano threatens nearby towns.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座活跃的火山威胁着附近的城镇。

sentence_examples.en: He tries to stay active by exercising every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 他每天早晨通过锻炼来保持活跃。

sentence_examples.en: There is a lot of activity in the market today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天市场很热闹。

sentence_examples.en: Regular physical activity can improve your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的体育活动可以提升你的健康。

sentence_examples.en: The app records your activity throughout the day.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个应用程序会记录你一天中的活动。

sentence_examples.en: The actor thanked the audience after the show.
sentence_examples.zh: 演出结束后，演员向观众致谢。

sentence_examples.en: She wants to become an actor when she grows up.
sentence_examples.zh: 她长大后想成为一名演员。

sentence_examples.en: The actor wore a disguise to avoid being recognized.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位演员戴着伪装以避免被认出。

sentence_examples.en: The award went to a famous actress for her performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个奖项颁给了那位因其出色表演而闻名的女演员。

sentence_examples.en: She trained at a drama school and became an actress.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在戏剧学校接受训练后成为了一名女演员。

sentence_examples.en: The actress spoke about her role in an interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位女演员在采访中谈到了她的角色。

translations.translation: 实际的；现实的，真实的，目前的

sentence_examples.en: The actual cost turned out to be higher than we expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 实际成本比我们预期的要高。

sentence_examples.en: Please bring the actual document, not a copy.
sentence_examples.zh: 请带来原件，而不是复印件。

sentence_examples.en: In actual use, this method is simple and effective.
sentence_examples.zh: 在实际使用中，这种方法简单有效。

translations.translation: 剧烈,敏锐的；成锐角的；尖的，高音的

sentence_examples.en: She felt acute pain in her knee after the fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她摔倒后膝盖感到剧烈的疼痛。

sentence_examples.en: An acute angle is less than 90 degrees.
sentence_examples.zh: 锐角的度数小于90度。

sentence_examples.en: She has an acute sense of smell.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有敏锐的嗅觉。

translations.translation: 使适应，使适合；改编；改写

sentence_examples.en: The author adapted the novel into a screenplay.
sentence_examples.zh: 作者把这部小说改编成了电影剧本。

sentence_examples.en: Children must adapt to a new school after moving.
sentence_examples.zh: 搬家后，孩子们必须适应新学校。

sentence_examples.en: Plants adapt to different amounts of sunlight.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物会根据日照量调整生长以适应环境。

sentence_examples.en: Please add more sugar to the tea.
sentence_examples.zh: 请再给茶里加些糖。

sentence_examples.en: She added her suggestion to the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把她的建议加入到报告中。

sentence_examples.en: I would like to add that this plan needs approval.
sentence_examples.zh: 我还想补充一点，这个计划需要批准。

sentence_examples.en: The game is designed to addict players to its rewards.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款游戏的设计让玩家沉迷于奖励。

sentence_examples.en: She became an addict after years of drinking.
sentence_examples.zh: 她多年酗酒后成为成瘾者。

sentence_examples.en: The rehab center helps addicts break free from their dependencies.
sentence_examples.zh: 康复中心帮助成瘾者摆脱对物质的依赖。

translations.translation: 加，加法；附加部分，增加(物)

sentence_examples.en: In addition to his regular job, he volunteers at the shelter.
sentence_examples.zh: 除了他的常规工作，他还在庇护所做志愿者。

sentence_examples.en: The new wing is an addition to the hospital.
sentence_examples.zh: 新翼楼是医院的附加部分。

sentence_examples.en: We studied addition in math class.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在数学课上学习了加法。

sentence_examples.en: We need additional time to complete the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要额外的时间来完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: There was an additional charge for shipping.
sentence_examples.zh: 还需收取额外的运费。

sentence_examples.en: Please provide any additional information in the form.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在表格中提供任何补充信息。

translations.translation: 向...致词；在信封上写姓名

sentence_examples.en: Please update your address on the form.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在表格上更新你的住址。

sentence_examples.en: The mayor gave an address to the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 市长向全城发表了致辞。

sentence_examples.en: Please address the envelope to Dr. Kim.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在信封上把收件人写成金博士。

translations.translation: 充足的，足够的；适当的，胜任的

sentence_examples.en: The funds are adequate to cover the project costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 资金足以覆盖项目成本。

sentence_examples.en: The facilities are adequate for all participants.
sentence_examples.zh: 设施足以满足所有参与者的需求。

sentence_examples.en: Her answer was adequate.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的回答是合格的。

sentence_examples.en: The label will adhere to the box if the surface is clean.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果表面干净，标签就会粘在盒子上。

sentence_examples.en: We must adhere to the safety guidelines at all times.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须始终遵守安全规定。

sentence_examples.en: He adheres to his principles, even when it's difficult.
sentence_examples.zh: 即使很困难，他也坚持遵循自己的原则。

translations.translation: (to)(时间上)紧接着的；邻近的，毗邻的

sentence_examples.en: The library is adjacent to the school.
sentence_examples.zh: 图书馆紧邻学校。

sentence_examples.en: The two events were adjacent in time, with only a fifteen-minute gap.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个事件在时间上紧接着发生，只相隔约十五分钟。

sentence_examples.en: We sat in adjacent seats during the performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在演出期间坐在相邻的座位上。

translations.translation: 形容词的，用作形容词的

sentence_examples.en: An adjective is a word that describes a noun.
sentence_examples.zh: 形容词是用来描述名词的词。

sentence_examples.en: In the sentence 'The sky is blue,' blue is an adjective.
sentence_examples.zh: 在句子 'The sky is blue' 中，blue 是一个形容词。

sentence_examples.en: The term 'adjective' can be used attributively, as in 'adjective ending'.
sentence_examples.zh: 术语'adjective' 可以作定语使用，例如在 'adjective ending' 中。

sentence_examples.en: The new wing adjoins the existing building.
sentence_examples.zh: 新翼与现有建筑毗连。

sentence_examples.en: Our house adjoins a park, so we hear birds every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的房子紧邻公园，因此每天早晨都能听到鸟鸣。

sentence_examples.en: The two museums adjoin, sharing a common entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两座博物馆毗连，共用一个入口。

sentence_examples.en: Please adjust the chair to fit your height.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把椅子调到合适的高度。

sentence_examples.en: She adjusted the thermostat to make the room warmer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把恒温器调到让房间暖和。

sentence_examples.en: After moving to a new city, he had to adjust to the new culture.
sentence_examples.zh: 搬到一个新城市后，他不得不适应新的文化。

translations.translation: 施行，实施；掌管，料理...的事务；给予

sentence_examples.en: The nurse will administer the vaccine to the patient tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士今晚将给患者注射疫苗。

sentence_examples.en: The principal administers the school's budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 校长负责管理学校的预算。

sentence_examples.en: The judge administers justice impartially.
sentence_examples.zh: 法官公正地审理案件。

translations.translation: 经营，管理；行政，行政机关，管理部门

sentence_examples.en: The administration of the school handles enrollment and student records.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校的行政部门负责招生和学生档案管理。

sentence_examples.en: Public administration studies how governments run programs and services.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共管理研究政府如何运行各项计划和公共服务。

sentence_examples.en: She works in administration, coordinating schedules and resources.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在行政部门工作，协调日程和资源。

translations.translation: 钦佩,赞赏,羡慕；称赞,夸奖

sentence_examples.en: I admire people who stay positive.
sentence_examples.zh: 我钦佩那些保持积极态度的人。

sentence_examples.en: She admires his talent.
sentence_examples.zh: 她钦佩他的才华。

sentence_examples.en: We admire the way you handle difficult problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们钦佩你处理困难问题的方式。

translations.translation: 允许进；承认；入场费，入会费，入场券

sentence_examples.en: The museum charges admission.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆收取入场费。

sentence_examples.en: Her admission of fault surprised the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 她承认错误让团队感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: We bought admission tickets online for the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在网上购买了入场券。

translations.translation: 承认，供认；准许…进入，准许...加入

sentence_examples.en: She admitted that she was wrong.
sentence_examples.zh: 她承认自己错了。

sentence_examples.en: The museum admits visitors from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆从9点到5点允许参观者进入。

sentence_examples.en: The club admitted him as a member.
sentence_examples.zh: 俱乐部批准他成为会员。

sentence_examples.en: An adolescent often goes through many changes during puberty.
sentence_examples.zh: 青少年在青春期通常会经历许多变化。

sentence_examples.en: The school offers counseling for adolescent students.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校为青少年学生提供咨询服务。

sentence_examples.en: Adolescent behavior can be unpredictable.
sentence_examples.zh: 青少年行为可能难以预测。

translations.translation: 采用，采取(态度等)；选定；收养

sentence_examples.en: The government decided to adopt a zero-emission policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府决定采用零排放政策。

sentence_examples.en: The company adopted a new marketing strategy.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司采用了新的营销策略。

sentence_examples.en: They decided to adopt a child.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们决定收养一个孩子。

translations.translation: 崇拜,敬慕,爱慕；非常喜欢

sentence_examples.en: I adore my grandmother for her kindness.
sentence_examples.zh: 我很崇敬我的祖母，因为她很善良。

sentence_examples.en: The children adore their new puppy.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们很喜欢他们的新小狗。

sentence_examples.en: She adores sunny mornings and walks in the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 她很喜欢晴朗的早晨和在公园散步。

translations.translation: 成年的，充分长成的，成熟的

sentence_examples.en: An adult should be responsible for their actions.
sentence_examples.zh: 成年人应该为自己的行为负责。

sentence_examples.en: The content is intended for adult readers.
sentence_examples.zh: 内容仅供成年人阅读。

sentence_examples.en: He became an adult at eighteen.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在18岁时成为成年人。

sentence_examples.en: The army made an advance after dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 部队在黎明后前进了一段距离。

sentence_examples.en: We need to advance the project to the next stage.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要把项目推进到下一个阶段。

sentence_examples.en: He asked for an advance on his salary.
sentence_examples.zh: 他请求预支工资。

translations.translation: 超前的；高级的；开明的；前进的

sentence_examples.en: This is an advanced course for college students.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是面向大学生的高级课程。

sentence_examples.en: The software includes advanced features.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款软件包含了高级功能。

sentence_examples.en: He has an advanced understanding of physics.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对物理学有深入的理解。

translations.translation: 优点，长处，有利条件；利益，好处

sentence_examples.en: Knowing the local language gives you a big advantage when traveling.
sentence_examples.zh: 懂当地语言在旅行时会带来很大的优势。

sentence_examples.en: The device has several advantages over the old model.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款设备相较于旧型号有几个优势。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy works to our advantage.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项新政策对我们有利。

sentence_examples.en: With the advent of smartphones, information is available anywhere.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着智能手机的到来，信息随时随地可得。

sentence_examples.en: The advent of the internet changed how we communicate.
sentence_examples.zh: 互联网的到来改变了我们的沟通方式。

sentence_examples.en: The advent of spring brings longer days and warmer weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 春天的到来带来更长的白昼和更温暖的天气。

sentence_examples.en: They set off on an adventure through the countryside.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们踏上了乡间的冒险。

sentence_examples.en: She wants to seek an adventure outside her routine.
sentence_examples.zh: 她想在日常之外寻求冒险。

sentence_examples.en: They decided to adventure into the mountains despite the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管下雨，他们决定大胆进入山中探险。

sentence_examples.en: An adverb modifies a verb, an adjective, or another adverb.
sentence_examples.zh: 副词修饰动词、形容词或另一个副词。

sentence_examples.en: In the sentence 'She sings beautifully,' 'beautifully' is an adverb.
sentence_examples.zh: 在句子 'She sings beautifully' 中，'beautifully' 是一个副词。

sentence_examples.en: Some adverb examples include 'quickly', 'very', and 'almost'.
sentence_examples.zh: 一些副词的例子包括 'quickly'、'very' 和 'almost'。

translations.translation: 逆的，相反的；敌对的；不利的；有害的

sentence_examples.en: Adverse weather conditions forced the match to be postponed.
sentence_examples.zh: 恶劣的天气条件迫使比赛推迟。

sentence_examples.en: The treatment can have adverse effects for some patients.
sentence_examples.zh: 治疗可能对部分患者产生不良反应。

sentence_examples.en: Prolonged exposure to loud noise can have adverse health effects.
sentence_examples.zh: 长期暴露在高强度噪音下会对健康产生不利影响。

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to advertise its new product on TV.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划在电视上为新产品做广告。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to advertise the sale by posting signs around the mall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定通过在商场周围张贴海报来宣传促销。

sentence_examples.en: The student advertised the club during lunch break.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生在午休时宣传了社团。

translations.translation: 劝告，忠告，(医生等的)意见

sentence_examples.en: She gave me some good advice about study habits.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给了我一些关于学习习惯的好建议。

sentence_examples.en: After listening to his advice, I started saving money.
sentence_examples.zh: 在听取他的建议后，我开始存钱。

sentence_examples.en: I followed the doctor's advice and took the medicine.
sentence_examples.zh: 我遵循医生的建议，按时吃药。

sentence_examples.en: During a power outage, it's advisable to conserve energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 停电期间，建议节约用电。

sentence_examples.en: It is advisable to consult a doctor if the symptoms persist.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果症状持续，建议咨询医生。

sentence_examples.en: If you're unsure how to handle the form, it's advisable to ask for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不确定如何填写表格，最好寻求帮助。

translations.translation: 忠告，劝告，建议；通知，告知

sentence_examples.en: I advise you to bring a jacket.
sentence_examples.zh: 我建议你带上外套。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor advised him to rest for a few days.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生建议他休息几天。

sentence_examples.en: She advised me to check the weather before leaving.
sentence_examples.zh: 她建议我在离开前查看天气。

sentence_examples.en: She is a strong advocate for renewable energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是可再生能源的坚定倡导者。

sentence_examples.en: They advocate for universal healthcare.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们倡导全民医疗保健。

sentence_examples.en: The lawyer will advocate on behalf of the client.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师将代表客户进行辩护。

sentence_examples.en: We hired a helicopter for an aerial tour of the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们租了一架直升机进行城市空中游览。

sentence_examples.en: The film features aerial shots of the coast.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影有海岸线的空中镜头。

sentence_examples.en: The damaged aerial kept the TV from getting a strong signal.
sentence_examples.zh: 损坏的天线让电视信号变弱。

sentence_examples.en: The aeroplane landed safely at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 这架飞机在黎明时安全着陆。

sentence_examples.en: An aeroplane crossed the sky above the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 一架飞机从城市上空掠过。

sentence_examples.en: The aeroplane took off smoothly after boarding.
sentence_examples.zh: 登机后，这架飞机平稳起飞。

sentence_examples.en: The gallery features a minimalist aesthetic that emphasizes light and space.
sentence_examples.zh: 画廊呈现出一种极简美学，强调光线与空间。

sentence_examples.en: Her aesthetic sense guides her choices in fashion and interior design.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的审美品味影响着她在时尚和室内设计上的选择。

sentence_examples.en: The movie's aesthetic is deliberately nostalgic.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影的美学风格刻意带有怀旧感。

sentence_examples.en: I have a few affairs to take care of before the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 在会议前我有几件事需要处理。

sentence_examples.en: The charity dinner was a pleasant social affair.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次慈善晚宴办得很成功，是一次愉快的社交活动。

sentence_examples.en: She was involved in a romantic affair with her colleague.
sentence_examples.zh: 她和同事有一段婚外情。

sentence_examples.en: The weather can affect your mood.
sentence_examples.zh: 天气会影响你的情绪。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy will affect many workers.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策将影响许多工人。

sentence_examples.en: Her affect showed that she was genuinely excited.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的情感表现出她真的很兴奋。

translations.translation: 爱，喜爱；爱慕之情；感情；疾病，不适

sentence_examples.en: Her affection for her parents remained steady even in difficult times.
sentence_examples.zh: 即使在困难时期，她对父母的感情也保持稳定。

sentence_examples.en: He showed affection by bringing flowers.
sentence_examples.zh: 他带花来表达爱意。

sentence_examples.en: The dog's affection was evident as it wagged its tail.
sentence_examples.zh: 狗狗摇着尾巴，显出它对主人的喜爱。

sentence_examples.en: The university affiliated with a regional hospital to share research resources.
sentence_examples.zh: 这所大学与区域医院结成附属关系，以共享研究资源。

sentence_examples.en: The company opened a new affiliate in Tokyo to handle distribution.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在东京设立了一家新的分公司来负责分销。

sentence_examples.en: The nonprofit affiliates with several community groups to coordinate services.
sentence_examples.zh: 该非营利组织与若干社区团体建立了合作关系，以协调服务。

translations.translation: 断言，坚持声称；肯定；证实,确认

sentence_examples.en: The scientist affirmed the findings after additional tests.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过额外测试，科学家证实了这些发现。

sentence_examples.en: She affirmed her commitment to the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她重申了自己对该项目的承诺。

sentence_examples.en: The contract affirms the terms of the agreement.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同确认了协议的条款。

translations.translation: 富裕的，富有的，丰富的，富饶的

sentence_examples.en: The affluent neighborhood has several parks and high-end shops.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个富裕的社区有几个公园和高档商店。

sentence_examples.en: Many affluent families prioritize their children's education.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多富裕家庭把子女的教育放在首位。

sentence_examples.en: The town has remained affluent due to a strong local economy.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于当地经济强劲，这个城镇一直保持富裕。

translations.translation: 担负得起(损失、费用、后果等)，买得起

sentence_examples.en: I can't afford a new car right now.
sentence_examples.zh: 我现在买不起一辆新车。

sentence_examples.en: We can't afford to take that risk.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们承担不起那样的风险。

sentence_examples.en: She saved enough money to afford a vacation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她存够钱去度假。

translations.translation: 害怕的，恐惧的；犯愁的，不乐意的

sentence_examples.en: I'm afraid of heights.
sentence_examples.zh: 我害怕高处。

sentence_examples.en: She is afraid to speak in public.
sentence_examples.zh: 她害怕在公众场合说话。

sentence_examples.en: He is afraid of making mistakes.
sentence_examples.zh: 他害怕犯错。

sentence_examples.en: We took a break after finishing the assignment.
sentence_examples.zh: 完成作业后，我们休息了一会儿。

sentence_examples.en: She arrived after the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议结束后才到达。

sentence_examples.en: The movie starts after the credits.
sentence_examples.zh: 电影在片尾字幕后开始。

sentence_examples.en: I like to read a book in the afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢在下午读书。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting is scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议安排在明天下午。

sentence_examples.en: We usually have a nap in the afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常在下午午睡。

sentence_examples.en: We discussed the plan, and afterward we decided to wait for more information.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们讨论了计划，随后决定再等一些信息。

sentence_examples.en: She finished her homework and afterward went to a friend's house.
sentence_examples.zh: 她完成作业后，随后去朋友家。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting started late, and afterward many people left early.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议开始得晚，之后很多人提前离开。

translations.translation: 再次，另一次；重新；除此，再，更，还

sentence_examples.en: I will try again tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我明天再试一次。

sentence_examples.en: Could you say that again?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？

sentence_examples.en: They started again after the interruption.
sentence_examples.zh: 中断后他们又开始了。

translations.translation: 对着，逆；反对；违反；紧靠着；对比

sentence_examples.en: She sat against the wall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她靠着墙坐着。

sentence_examples.en: They voted against the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们投票反对该提案。

sentence_examples.en: The odds were against him.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的胜算对他不利。

sentence_examples.en: What is your age?
sentence_examples.zh: 你多大了？

sentence_examples.en: This coin dates from the Bronze Age.
sentence_examples.zh: 这枚硬币来自青铜时代。

sentence_examples.en: I hope I age gracefully.
sentence_examples.zh: 我希望自己能优雅地变老。

translations.translation: 代理(处)；代办处；[美](政府的)机关，厅

sentence_examples.en: She works at a government agency in the capital.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在首都的一家政府机关工作。

sentence_examples.en: The ad agency designed a new campaign for the product.
sentence_examples.zh: 广告代理公司为这款产品设计了一个新广告活动。

sentence_examples.en: We contacted a travel agency to book our trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们联系了一家旅行社来预订行程。

sentence_examples.en: The committee reviewed the agenda before the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会在会议前审阅了议事日程。

sentence_examples.en: She keeps a detailed agenda in her notebook.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在笔记本里记录了一份详细的议事日程。

sentence_examples.en: The agenda for the week includes several important items.
sentence_examples.zh: 本周的议事日程包含几项重要事项。

translations.translation: 代理人；代理商；产生作用的人或事物

sentence_examples.en: The travel agent helped us book our flights.
sentence_examples.zh: 旅行社代理人帮我们订了机票。

sentence_examples.en: She acted as the agent for the company in negotiations.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在谈判中担任公司的代理人。

sentence_examples.en: Exercise is a powerful agent for improving mental health.
sentence_examples.zh: 锻炼是改善心理健康的有力因素。

translations.translation: 加重(剧),使恶化；激怒,使恼火

sentence_examples.en: Skipping his medicine could aggravate his illness.
sentence_examples.zh: 不按时吃药可能会使病情恶化。

sentence_examples.en: The loud construction noise aggravated my headache.
sentence_examples.zh: 喧闹的施工声让我的头痛加重。

sentence_examples.en: Arguing with him will aggravate the situation.
sentence_examples.zh: 与他争吵只会使局势恶化。

translations.translation: 好斗的，有进取心的，敢作敢为的

sentence_examples.en: The company took an aggressive approach to marketing this quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在本季度的市场推广方面采取了积极进取的策略。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to be too aggressive in negotiations.
sentence_examples.zh: 谈判时要小心，别太过强硬。

sentence_examples.en: Her aggressive stance on climate policy drew both supporters and critics.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在气候政策上的强硬立场吸引了支持者，也引来批评者。

translations.translation: 摇动(液体)；使焦虑不安；困扰；鼓动

sentence_examples.en: Agitate the solution for 30 seconds to ensure the dye is evenly distributed.
sentence_examples.zh: 将溶液搅拌30秒，以确保染料均匀分布。

sentence_examples.en: The loud noise agitated the baby.
sentence_examples.zh: 巨响让婴儿感到焦躁不安。

sentence_examples.en: Activists tried to agitate voters to support the bill.
sentence_examples.zh: 活动家试图煽动选民支持该法案。

translations.translation: (常和一般过去时的动词连用)以前，…前

sentence_examples.en: I started learning English two years ago.
sentence_examples.zh: 我两年前开始学英语。

sentence_examples.en: We moved here three months ago.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们三个月前搬到了这里。

sentence_examples.en: That happened a long time ago.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是很久以前的事。

translations.translation: (精神或肉体的)极大痛苦，创伤

sentence_examples.en: She cried out in agony after the fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她摔倒后痛苦地喊叫。

sentence_examples.en: The patient endured years of agony before the operation.
sentence_examples.zh: 病人在手术前承受了多年的痛苦。

sentence_examples.en: He waited in agony for the test results.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在等待化验结果时痛苦不堪。

translations.translation: 答应，赞同；适合，一致；商定，约定

sentence_examples.en: I agree with you about the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我同意你对这个计划的看法。

sentence_examples.en: They agreed on a date for the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们就会议日期达成了一致。

sentence_examples.en: We couldn't agree on the contract terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们无法就合同条款达成一致。

translations.translation: 符合的,一致的；欣然同意的；令人愉快的

sentence_examples.en: The terms of the contract seem agreeable to both parties.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同条款对双方都很可接受。

sentence_examples.en: She is an agreeable person who gets along with everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是个和人相处融洽、让人愉快的人。

sentence_examples.en: If you're agreeable, we can start the meeting now.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你同意，我们现在就开始会议。

translations.translation: 协定,协议；契约；达成协议；同意，一致

sentence_examples.en: We reached an agreement after hours of negotiation.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数小时的谈判，我们达成了一项协议。

sentence_examples.en: The agreement will come into effect next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 该协议将于下个月生效。

sentence_examples.en: She nodded in agreement.
sentence_examples.zh: 她点头表示同意。

sentence_examples.en: Agriculture plays a crucial role in feeding the nation.
sentence_examples.zh: 农业在养活国家方面起着至关重要的作用。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer studied sustainable agriculture to protect soil health.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民学习可持续农业以保护土壤健康。

sentence_examples.en: Many countries invest in agricultural research to improve crop yields.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多国家投资农业研究以提高作物产量。

sentence_examples.en: The car ahead slowed down.
sentence_examples.zh: 前面的车减速了。

sentence_examples.en: We are ahead of schedule, so we can take a longer break.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的进度比计划提前，因此可以多休息一会儿。

sentence_examples.en: She kept one step ahead of her rivals.
sentence_examples.zh: 她一直领先对手一步。

sentence_examples.en: The organization provides financial aid to students.
sentence_examples.zh: 该组织向学生提供经济援助。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse gave first aid to the injured.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士为伤者提供急救。

sentence_examples.en: Volunteers aid in the relief effort.
sentence_examples.zh: 志愿者在救援行动中提供帮助。

sentence_examples.en: Her aim is to become a doctor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的目标是成为医生。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy aims at reducing emissions.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策旨在减少排放。

sentence_examples.en: The hunter aimed the rifle at the target.
sentence_examples.zh: 猎人把步枪瞄准目标。

sentence_examples.en: The air in the city often feels stuffy.
sentence_examples.zh: 城市的空气常常感觉闷。

sentence_examples.en: Open the window to let fresh air in.
sentence_examples.zh: 打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。

sentence_examples.en: We need to air the room to remove the smell.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要把房间通风以去除异味。

sentence_examples.en: The air-conditioning in this classroom is too cold.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个教室的空调太冷了。

sentence_examples.en: We upgraded the air-conditioning system last year to save energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们去年升级了空调系统以节省能源。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel offers air-conditioning in every room.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店为所有房间提供空调。

sentence_examples.en: The aircraft landed safely after the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 风暴过后，飞机安全降落。

sentence_examples.en: The pilot inspected the aircraft before takeoff.
sentence_examples.zh: 起飞前，飞行员检查了这架飞机。

sentence_examples.en: Military officials monitored the aircraft's flight path.
sentence_examples.zh: 军方官员监控这架飞机的飞行路径。

sentence_examples.en: The airline announced new routes for the summer.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家航空公司宣布了夏季的新航线。

sentence_examples.en: I booked a ticket with a major airline.
sentence_examples.zh: 我订了一家大型航空公司的机票。

sentence_examples.en: The airline route from Tokyo to Seoul is popular among travelers.
sentence_examples.zh: 从东京到首尔的航线很受旅客欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: I will meet you at the airport.
sentence_examples.zh: 我会在机场接你。

sentence_examples.en: The airport security was thorough but efficient.
sentence_examples.zh: 机场安检既严格又高效。

sentence_examples.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达机场。

translations.translation: (教堂、教室、戏院等里的)过道，通道

sentence_examples.en: The bride walked down the aisle.
sentence_examples.zh: 新娘沿着教堂的过道走向仪式台。

sentence_examples.en: I grabbed a snack from the grocery aisle.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在超市的货架之间的过道里拿了点零食。

sentence_examples.en: Please don't block the aisle when you leave the theater.
sentence_examples.zh: 离开剧院时请不要挡住过道。

sentence_examples.en: The loud alarm woke me up at 6 a.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 响亮的警报把我在早上6点吵醒了。

sentence_examples.en: Her sudden scream caused alarm among the passengers.
sentence_examples.zh: 她突如其来的尖叫让乘客们感到惊慌。

sentence_examples.en: The strange noise alarmed the security guard.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个陌生的声音让保安感到担忧。

translations.translation: (同一表演者的)唱片;集邮册,相册

sentence_examples.en: I listened to the new album by my favorite artist all weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我整个周末都在听我最喜欢的艺术家的新专辑。

sentence_examples.en: She kept the photos from the trip in an album on the shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把旅途中的照片放在架子上的相册里。

sentence_examples.en: He bought a stamp album to start collecting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他买了邮票册，准备开始收集。

translations.translation: 酒精，乙醇；含酒精的饮料

sentence_examples.en: Alcohol can be found in beer, wine, and spirits.
sentence_examples.zh: 啤酒、葡萄酒和烈酒都含有酒精。

sentence_examples.en: Drinking too much alcohol is bad for your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 过量饮酒对健康有害。

sentence_examples.en: Some medicines contain small amounts of alcohol.
sentence_examples.zh: 一些药物含有少量酒精。

sentence_examples.en: Stay alert while cycling on busy streets.
sentence_examples.zh: 在繁忙的街道上骑车时要保持警觉。

sentence_examples.en: She is an alert student who notices details.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是个机警的学生，能注意到细节。

sentence_examples.en: The notice will alert residents to the power outage.
sentence_examples.zh: 通知将提醒居民停电。

sentence_examples.en: An alien landed near the forest and waved.
sentence_examples.zh: 一名外星人降落在森林附近并挥手致意。

sentence_examples.en: The new student felt like an alien in the crowded classroom.
sentence_examples.zh: 新来的学生在拥挤的教室里像个外国人。

sentence_examples.en: That theory is alien to my way of thinking.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个理论与我的思维方式格格不入。

sentence_examples.en: The two twins look alike.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对双胞胎看起来很像。

sentence_examples.en: The two houses are alike in size.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两所房子的大小很相似。

sentence_examples.en: The children dressed alike for the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们在聚会上穿得很像。

translations.translation: 活着的；存在的；活跃的；(to)敏感的

sentence_examples.en: The patient is still alive after the operation.
sentence_examples.zh: 手术后患者仍然活着。

sentence_examples.en: The room was alive with laughter and music.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间里充满了笑声和音乐。

sentence_examples.en: We must stay alive to new opportunities.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须对新的机会保持警觉。

sentence_examples.en: All the guests arrived on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 所有客人都按时到了。

sentence_examples.en: The soup is all gone.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤都喝光了。

sentence_examples.en: All are welcome to join.
sentence_examples.zh: 欢迎所有人参加。

sentence_examples.en: Police allege that the suspect was involved in the robbery.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方指称嫌疑人参与了抢劫。

sentence_examples.en: The report alleges that the project costs more than planned.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告称该项目的花费比计划多。

sentence_examples.en: They allege that the new measure will reduce traffic.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们声称新措施将减少交通拥堵。

sentence_examples.en: A short break can alleviate the stress of a long day.
sentence_examples.zh: 短暂休息可以缓解一天的压力。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor prescribed medicine to alleviate his pain.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生给他开药来缓解他的疼痛。

sentence_examples.en: New policies aim to alleviate traffic congestion in the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策旨在缓解城市交通拥堵。

sentence_examples.en: The two countries formed a military alliance to counter the common threat.
sentence_examples.zh: 两国为对抗共同威胁而结成军事同盟。

sentence_examples.en: A strategic alliance between the firms boosted their market reach.
sentence_examples.zh: 两家公司的战略联盟扩大了它们的市场覆盖。

sentence_examples.en: In history, marriages were used to forge political alliances between families.
sentence_examples.zh: 历史上，婚姻常被用来缔结家族之间的政治联盟。

sentence_examples.en: The university will allocate funds for scholarships next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学将为来年的奖学金分配资金。

sentence_examples.en: Managers must allocate workloads fairly among their staff.
sentence_examples.zh: 管理者必须在员工之间公平分配工作量。

sentence_examples.en: We need to allocate time for planning before the project begins.
sentence_examples.zh: 在项目开始前，我们需要为规划阶段分配时间。

translations.translation: 允许，准许；承认；给予；(for)考虑到

sentence_examples.en: The gate will allow two visitors at a time.
sentence_examples.zh: 大门一次允许两位访客进入。

sentence_examples.en: Her parents allow her to stay up late on weekends.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的父母允许她在周末熬夜。

sentence_examples.en: The budget allows for future expansion.
sentence_examples.zh: 预算为未来扩张留出空间。

translations.translation: 补贴，津贴；零用钱；减价，折扣；允许

sentence_examples.en: My monthly allowance helps me save for books.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的月津贴帮助我为买书存钱。

sentence_examples.en: The company provides a housing allowance for interns.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司为实习生提供住房津贴。

sentence_examples.en: The dealership offered a $1,000 trade-in allowance.
sentence_examples.zh: 经销商提供了1000美元的置换津贴。

sentence_examples.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.
sentence_examples.zh: 青铜是铜和锡的合金。

sentence_examples.en: Manufacturers use alloys to increase strength and reduce weight.
sentence_examples.zh: 制造商使用合金以提高强度并降低重量。

sentence_examples.en: They alloyed copper with zinc to make brass.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们把铜和锌合成为黄铜。

sentence_examples.en: The United States and its allies conducted a joint military drill.
sentence_examples.zh: 美国及其盟友进行了联合军事演练。

sentence_examples.en: Japan is an ally of the United States.
sentence_examples.zh: 日本是美国的盟友。

sentence_examples.en: The two companies decided to ally with each other to bring cutting-edge technology to market.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两家公司决定彼此结盟，将前沿技术推向市场。

sentence_examples.en: I almost forgot my keys at home.
sentence_examples.zh: 我差点把钥匙忘在家里。

sentence_examples.en: It's almost dinner time.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在差不多到晚饭时间了。

sentence_examples.en: She almost finished the report before the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议前几乎完成了报告。

sentence_examples.en: She felt alone in the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在人群中感到孤独。

sentence_examples.en: He lived alone after the breakup.
sentence_examples.zh: 分手后他独自生活。

sentence_examples.en: They traveled alone across the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们独自穿越了这个国家。

sentence_examples.en: We walked along the river at sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在日落时沿着河边散步。

sentence_examples.en: She sang along with the pianist.
sentence_examples.zh: 她和钢琴师一起唱歌。

sentence_examples.en: The road runs along the hillside.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条路沿着山坡延伸。

sentence_examples.en: The coach stood alongside the players, offering tips.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练站在球员身旁，提供建议。

sentence_examples.en: She walked alongside him after the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 仪式结束后，她和他并肩走着。

sentence_examples.en: The startup grew alongside other tech companies in the region.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家初创公司与该地区的其他科技公司一起成长。

sentence_examples.en: Please read the paragraph aloud.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把这一段朗读出来。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke the name aloud so everyone could hear.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把名字大声说出来，让大家都听见。

sentence_examples.en: Don't speak aloud in the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 在图书馆里不要大声说话。

sentence_examples.en: The alphabet has 26 letters.
sentence_examples.zh: 字母表共有26个字母。

sentence_examples.en: She learned the alphabet in first grade.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在一年级学习了字母表。

sentence_examples.en: I need to memorize the alphabet.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要把字母表背熟。

sentence_examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
sentence_examples.zh: 我已经完成了作业。

sentence_examples.en: Have you already eaten dinner?
sentence_examples.zh: 你已经吃过晚饭了吗？

sentence_examples.en: It's already noon.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在已经是中午了。

sentence_examples.en: I like coffee, and I also enjoy tea.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢咖啡，我也喜欢茶。

sentence_examples.en: She is from Canada and also speaks French.
sentence_examples.zh: 她来自加拿大，而且也会说法语。

sentence_examples.en: The restaurant is popular, and it is also expensive.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐厅很受欢迎，而且也很贵。

sentence_examples.en: We need to alter the schedule due to the late start.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于活动开始晚，我们需要调整日程。

sentence_examples.en: The tailor will alter the dress to fit you.
sentence_examples.zh: 裁缝会把这件裙子改得合身。

sentence_examples.en: Her opinion didn't alter after hearing the facts.
sentence_examples.zh: 在听到事实后，她的意见没有改变。

sentence_examples.en: We use an alternate route to avoid traffic.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们为了避免交通拥堵而走绕道。

sentence_examples.en: We will alternate shifts to share the workload.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将轮流换班以分担工作量。

sentence_examples.en: The lights alternate between red and blue.
sentence_examples.zh: 灯光在红色和蓝色之间交替变化。

translations.translation: 二选一；供选择的东西；取舍

sentence_examples.en: If the bus is late, we can take an alternative.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果公交车晚点，我们可以采取一个替代方案。

sentence_examples.en: We need an alternative energy source to power the fleet.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要一种替代能源来为车队供能。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor offered an alternative to surgery for some patients.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生为部分患者提供了手术的替代方案。

sentence_examples.en: Although it was raining, we still went for a walk.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是去散步了。

sentence_examples.en: Although she studied hard, she didn't pass the test.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管她努力学习，她还是没通过考试。

sentence_examples.en: Although he is young, he is very responsible.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管他很年轻，他很有责任心。

sentence_examples.en: The plane climbed to a higher altitude after takeoff.
sentence_examples.zh: 起飞后，飞机爬升到更高的高度。

sentence_examples.en: The mountain has an altitude of about 4,000 meters.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座山的海拔约4000米。

sentence_examples.en: Pilots monitor altitude to maintain a safe flight height.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞行员会监控高度，以维持安全的飞行高度。

translations.translation: 完全，总之，全部地；总共；总而言之

sentence_examples.en: The event cost about $2,000 altogether.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次活动总共花了大约2000美元。

sentence_examples.en: Altogether, this project has been a success.
sentence_examples.zh: 总体来说，这个项目取得了成功。

sentence_examples.en: There were seven people at the party altogether.
sentence_examples.zh: 派对上总共有七个人。

sentence_examples.en: The frame is made of aluminum, which is lightweight and strong.
sentence_examples.zh: 车架由铝制成，轻便且坚固。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a roll of aluminum foil for the kitchen.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一卷铝箔用于厨房。

sentence_examples.en: Many cans are made from aluminum to reduce weight.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多易拉罐都是铝制的，以减轻重量。

translations.translation: 总是，无例外地；永远，始终

sentence_examples.en: I always drink water after waking up.
sentence_examples.zh: 我醒来后总是喝水。

sentence_examples.en: She always helps her neighbors.
sentence_examples.zh: 她总是帮助邻居们。

sentence_examples.en: Always wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
sentence_examples.zh: 骑自行车时请始终戴头盔。

translations.translation: 业余(水平)的(运动员、艺术家等)

sentence_examples.en: She is an amateur painter who loves landscapes.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位热爱风景画的业余画家。

sentence_examples.en: The amateur photographer captured a stunning sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位业余摄影师拍下了一张惊艳的日落照片。

sentence_examples.en: The competition is open to amateurs.
sentence_examples.zh: 比赛对业余选手开放。

sentence_examples.en: The magician's tricks amaze the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 魔术师的把戏让观众惊叹。

sentence_examples.en: The results amazed the scientists.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果让科学家们惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: Her kindness never fails to amaze me.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的善良总是让我惊讶。

translations.translation: 大使；特使，(派驻国际组织的)代表

sentence_examples.en: The ambassador to France will visit next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 驻法国大使将于下周来访。

sentence_examples.en: She was appointed ambassador to the United Nations.
sentence_examples.zh: 她被任命为驻联合国大使。

sentence_examples.en: He serves as his country's ambassador, promoting cultural exchange.
sentence_examples.zh: 他担任本国的大使，推动文化交流。

translations.translation: 引起歧义的，模棱两可的，含糊不清的

sentence_examples.en: The instructions were ambiguous, so I wasn't sure what to do.
sentence_examples.zh: 指示含糊不清，因此我不确定该怎么做。

sentence_examples.en: Her answer was ambiguous, leaving us unsure about the next steps.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的回答含糊不清，让我们对接下来的步骤感到不确定。

sentence_examples.en: The contract's wording is ambiguous, so a lawyer should review it.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同的措辞含糊不清，应该请律师审查。

translations.translation: 对(权力等)的强烈欲望，野心；雄心

sentence_examples.en: Her ambition to become a doctor drives her to study late every night.
sentence_examples.zh: 她立志成为医生的雄心促使她每天深夜苦读。

sentence_examples.en: Despite many challenges, he pursues his ambition to climb the corporate ladder.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管面临挑战，他仍追求在公司晋升的野心。

sentence_examples.en: Her ambition is not just for power, but to help people.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的雄心不仅仅是为了权力，更是为了帮助他人。

translations.translation: 有抱负的，雄心勃勃的；有野心的

sentence_examples.en: She is ambitious and plans to start her own company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她很有抱负，计划创办自己的公司。

sentence_examples.en: He set an ambitious goal to run a marathon in under three hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 他设定了一个雄心勃勃的目标，要在三小时内完成马拉松。

sentence_examples.en: Ambitious students often study late to improve their skills.
sentence_examples.zh: 有抱负的学生经常熬夜学习以提高技能。

translations.translation: 救护车，救护船，救护飞机

sentence_examples.en: The ambulance arrived within minutes after the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故发生后，救护车在几分钟内到达。

sentence_examples.en: She called an ambulance for the injured man.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为受伤的男子叫来了救护车。

sentence_examples.en: An ambulance can transport patients to the hospital quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 救护车可以迅速将病人送往医院。

sentence_examples.en: The committee voted to amend the constitution.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会投票通过修订宪法。

sentence_examples.en: We should amend the contract before signing.
sentence_examples.zh: 在签署之前，我们应修改这份合同。

sentence_examples.en: The editor amended several paragraphs to fix errors.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑修改了若干段落以纠正错误。

translations.translation: 和蔼可亲的，友善的，亲切的

sentence_examples.en: She has an amiable personality that makes everyone feel welcome.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有一种和蔼可亲的性格，让每个人都感到受欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: The host greeted us with an amiable smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 主人带着和蔼的微笑迎接我们。

sentence_examples.en: Despite the controversy, his amiable nature helped ease tensions during the discussion.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管存在争议，他的友善本性有助于缓和讨论中的紧张气氛。

sentence_examples.en: She found a quiet moment amid the noise.
sentence_examples.zh: 在喧嚣中，她找到了片刻的宁静。

sentence_examples.en: Amid the rain, they continued their walk.
sentence_examples.zh: 在雨中，他们继续散步。

sentence_examples.en: The project progressed amid tight deadlines.
sentence_examples.zh: 在紧迫的截止日期之中，项目取得进展。

translations.translation: 在…之中；在一群(组)之中；于…之间

sentence_examples.en: She stood among the trees.
sentence_examples.zh: 她站在树木之间。

sentence_examples.en: There is a debate among the students.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生之间正在进行辩论。

sentence_examples.en: He divided the prize money among his teammates.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把奖金分给了他的队友。

sentence_examples.en: The amount of rainfall this month was higher than usual.
sentence_examples.zh: 本月的降雨量比平常多。

sentence_examples.en: We need to reduce the amount of sugar in the recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要在配方中减少糖的用量。

sentence_examples.en: All these small savings amount to a lot over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些小的节省长期下来会积累成一笔可观的金额。

translations.translation: 充分的，富裕的；宽敞的，宽大的

sentence_examples.en: There is ample time to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 有充足的时间来完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The report had ample evidence to support the claim.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份报告有充足的证据来支持这一说法。

sentence_examples.en: They rented ample space for the event.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为活动租用了宽敞的场地。

sentence_examples.en: I connected the amplifier to the speakers and turned up the volume.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把放大器接到扬声器上并把音量调高。

sentence_examples.en: The guitarist bought a new amplifier to improve the tone.
sentence_examples.zh: 吉他手买了一台新放大器来改善音色。

sentence_examples.en: A small amplifier can boost weak radio signals.
sentence_examples.zh: 小型放大器可以放大微弱的无线电信号。

translations.translation: 放大，增强；详述，详加解说

sentence_examples.en: The speaker used data to amplify his argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲者用数据来放大他的论点。

sentence_examples.en: She added a brief anecdote to amplify the point.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用一个简短的轶事来进一步阐明要点。

sentence_examples.en: The microphone amplified the sound, making it easier to hear.
sentence_examples.zh: 麦克风把声音放大了，使之更容易听清。

translations.translation: 向…提供娱乐，使…消遣；引人发笑

sentence_examples.en: The comedian's jokes amused the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员的笑话逗笑了观众。

sentence_examples.en: Cartoons can amuse children and adults alike.
sentence_examples.zh: 卡通片可以逗笑儿童和成年人。

sentence_examples.en: We amused ourselves by telling funny stories.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们讲有趣的故事来娱乐自己。

sentence_examples.en: The new device is an analogue of the original model.
sentence_examples.zh: 新设备是原始型号的类似物。

sentence_examples.en: In the lab, researchers compare the analogue with the original compound to study differences.
sentence_examples.zh: 在实验室，研究人员将类似物与原始化合物进行比较，以研究差异。

sentence_examples.en: The chemists synthesized an analogue of the drug to test its safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 化学家合成了该药物的类似物以测试其安全性。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher used an analogy between a roadmap and GPS to explain how routes are planned.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师用路线图和GPS的类比来解释路线如何规划。

sentence_examples.en: She used an analogy of a library to describe how memory stores information.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用图书馆的类比来描述记忆是如何存储信息的。

sentence_examples.en: An analogy can help explain a difficult idea by comparing it to something familiar.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个类比可以通过把困难的概念与熟悉的事物进行比较来帮助解释。

sentence_examples.en: We analyse the data before drawing conclusions.
sentence_examples.zh: 在得出结论之前，我们分析数据。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers analyse the samples to determine their composition.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员分析这些样本以确定它们的成分。

sentence_examples.en: Please analyse the impact of the new policy on the results.
sentence_examples.zh: 请分析新政策对结果的影响。

sentence_examples.en: The analysis of the survey results revealed several key insights.
sentence_examples.zh: 对调查结果的分析揭示了若干关键见解。

sentence_examples.en: A quick analysis shows the project is behind schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 一次快速分析显示该项目落后于进度。

sentence_examples.en: The analyses conducted by different teams produced conflicting conclusions.
sentence_examples.zh: 不同团队所做的分析得出互相矛盾的结论。

sentence_examples.en: Her analytic approach helped her solve the problem quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的分析方法帮助她迅速解决问题。

sentence_examples.en: Analytic thinking breaks complex problems into smaller parts.
sentence_examples.zh: 分析性思维把复杂问题分解成更小的部分。

sentence_examples.en: The analytic method compares data step by step to find patterns.
sentence_examples.zh: 分析方法逐步比较数据以发现规律。

sentence_examples.en: My ancestors lived in this village for generations.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的祖先在这个村庄里居住了好几代。

sentence_examples.en: Birds evolved from a reptile ancestor.
sentence_examples.zh: 鸟类是从一种爬行动物的祖先演化而来。

sentence_examples.en: She traced her family tree to learn about her ancestors.
sentence_examples.zh: 她追溯家谱，想了解她的祖先。

translations.translation: 锚；危难时可依靠的人或物；用锚泊船

sentence_examples.en: The ship dropped anchor to stay in place.
sentence_examples.zh: 船只抛下锚以便留在原地。

sentence_examples.en: She is my anchor during hard times.
sentence_examples.zh: 在困难时，她是我的依靠。

sentence_examples.en: We need to anchor the boat before the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 在暴风来临前，我们需要把船抛锚。

sentence_examples.en: The ancient ruins attract visitors from all over the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 古代遗址吸引着来自世界各地的游客。

sentence_examples.en: Ancient traditions still influence modern festivals.
sentence_examples.zh: 古老的传统仍影响着现代的节日。

sentence_examples.en: She studies ancient languages to understand early texts.
sentence_examples.zh: 她学习古代语言，以理解早期文本。

sentence_examples.en: I bought apples and oranges.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了苹果和橙子。

sentence_examples.en: She is tall and slim.
sentence_examples.zh: 她又高又瘦。

sentence_examples.en: Please wash your hands and come to dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 请洗手，然后来吃晚饭。

sentence_examples.en: She shared a funny anecdote from her trip to Japan.
sentence_examples.zh: 她分享了在日本旅行时的一则有趣轶事。

sentence_examples.en: During the interview, he told a personal anecdote about his first job.
sentence_examples.zh: 在采访中，他讲了一则关于自己第一份工作的个人轶事。

sentence_examples.en: A short anecdote can illustrate the point more clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 一则简短的轶事可以更清楚地说明要点。

sentence_examples.en: The statue in the garden depicts a peaceful angel.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园里的雕像描绘了一位安详的天使。

sentence_examples.en: She's an angel for helping me with my project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在帮我做这个项目时真是个天使。

sentence_examples.en: In many stories, angels watch over people.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多故事里，天使会守护人们。

sentence_examples.en: Her anger showed in her frown.
sentence_examples.zh: 她皱眉时露出了愤怒。

sentence_examples.en: The insult angered him.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个侮辱激怒了他。

sentence_examples.en: Anger can cloud your judgment if you don't calm down.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不冷静下来，愤怒会模糊你的判断。

translations.translation: 钓鱼；(采用各种方法）取得

sentence_examples.en: The angle between the two walls is 90 degrees.
sentence_examples.zh: 两堵墙之间的夹角是90度。

sentence_examples.en: They angled for salmon in the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在河里垂钓鲑鱼。

sentence_examples.en: The journalist angled for an interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 记者设法争取到了一次采访。

translations.translation: 生气的，愤怒的；(天气)风雨交加的

sentence_examples.en: She looked angry when she heard the news.
sentence_examples.zh: 她听到消息时看起来很生气。

sentence_examples.en: Don't provoke him; he gets angry easily.
sentence_examples.zh: 别激怒他；他很容易生气。

sentence_examples.en: The weather was angry that day, with storms and strong winds.
sentence_examples.zh: 那天天气很恶劣，风暴与大风交加。

translations.translation: (尤指心灵上的)极度痛苦，烦恼

sentence_examples.en: Her anguish over losing her job kept her awake at night.
sentence_examples.zh: 她因失去工作而感到极度痛苦，整夜难以入睡。

sentence_examples.en: The mother's anguish grew as she waited for news.
sentence_examples.zh: 等待消息时，母亲的痛苦加剧。

sentence_examples.en: The report described the survivors' anguish after the disaster.
sentence_examples.zh: 报道描述了灾难后幸存者的痛苦。

sentence_examples.en: A dog is a friendly animal.
sentence_examples.zh: 狗是一种友善的动物。

sentence_examples.en: Many animals live in the forest.
sentence_examples.zh: 森林里有很多动物。

sentence_examples.en: Animal welfare is an important issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 动物福利是一个重要议题。

sentence_examples.en: I twisted my ankle while playing soccer.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在踢足球时扭伤了脚踝。

sentence_examples.en: The ankle joint connects the foot to the leg.
sentence_examples.zh: 踝关节把脚和小腿连接起来。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a protective ankle brace during the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在比赛中戴着脚踝护具。

sentence_examples.en: Our wedding anniversary is next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 下周是我们的结婚纪念日。

sentence_examples.en: They celebrated their 10th anniversary with a dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们用一顿晚餐来庆祝他们的十周年纪念日。

sentence_examples.en: This year marks the 50th anniversary of the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年是公司成立50周年纪念日。

translations.translation: 正式宣布；发表；通告；广播（电台节目）

sentence_examples.en: The company will announce its quarterly earnings next Tuesday.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将于下周二公布季度业绩。

sentence_examples.en: The mayor announced a new housing policy at the press conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 市长在新闻发布会上宣布了一项新的住房政策。

sentence_examples.en: We will announce the contest results tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将于明天宣布比赛结果。

sentence_examples.en: The constant tapping annoys me.
sentence_examples.zh: 持续的敲击让我很恼火。

sentence_examples.en: Don't annoy your sister by interrupting.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要打扰你妹妹，打断她会惹恼她。

sentence_examples.en: It annoys me when people are late.
sentence_examples.zh: 人迟到时让我很恼火。

sentence_examples.en: The company holds its annual meeting in December.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在12月举行年度会议。

sentence_examples.en: The area has about 42 inches of annual rainfall.
sentence_examples.zh: 该地区的年降雨量约为42英寸。

sentence_examples.en: The club released its annual last week, a yearbook about the year's events.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个俱乐部上周发行了它的年刊，介绍本年度的活动。

translations.translation: 匿名的，无名的，姓氏不明的

sentence_examples.en: An anonymous donor gave money to the charity.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者向慈善机构捐款。

sentence_examples.en: This letter was sent from an anonymous email address.
sentence_examples.zh: 这封信来自一个匿名的电子邮件地址。

sentence_examples.en: She chose to remain anonymous.
sentence_examples.zh: 她选择保持匿名。

sentence_examples.en: I'll have another cup of coffee.
sentence_examples.zh: 我再来一杯咖啡。

sentence_examples.en: Would you like another?
sentence_examples.zh: 你还要一个吗？

sentence_examples.en: She found another way to solve the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 她找到了另一种解决这个问题的方法。

sentence_examples.en: I know the answer to the question.
sentence_examples.zh: 我知道这个问题的答案。

sentence_examples.en: Please answer the door when someone knocks.
sentence_examples.zh: 有人敲门时，请去开门。

sentence_examples.en: She couldn't answer the teacher's question.
sentence_examples.zh: 她没能回答老师的问题。

sentence_examples.en: An ant is tiny.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只蚂蚁很小。

sentence_examples.en: I saw an ant crawling on the ground.
sentence_examples.zh: 我看到一只蚂蚁在地上爬行。

sentence_examples.en: Ants work together to carry food.
sentence_examples.zh: 蚂蚁会齐心协力搬运食物。

sentence_examples.en: The antenna on the roof helps pick up local TV signals.
sentence_examples.zh: 屋顶上的天线有助于接收本地电视信号。

sentence_examples.en: We replaced the antenna with a better one to improve reception.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们换上了更好的天线来改善接收。

sentence_examples.en: The portable radio has a detachable antenna.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台便携收音机有一个可拆卸的天线。

translations.translation: 预料；期望；预先考虑；抢先；提前使用

sentence_examples.en: We anticipate that the project will be completed on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们预计这个项目会按时完成。

sentence_examples.en: She anticipated the design challenges and prepared alternatives.
sentence_examples.zh: 她预见到了设计方面的挑战，并准备了替代方案。

sentence_examples.en: Parents anticipate the baby's arrival.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母期待着婴儿的到来。

sentence_examples.en: The furniture has an antique look.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件家具看起来很古旧。

sentence_examples.en: She collects antique coins from the 18th century.
sentence_examples.zh: 她收藏18世纪的古钱币。

sentence_examples.en: That vase is an antique.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个花瓶是一件古董。

translations.translation: 挂念，焦虑，焦急，忧虑；渴望，热望

sentence_examples.en: Her anxiety about the upcoming exam kept her awake at night.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对即将到来的考试的焦虑让她整夜未眠。

sentence_examples.en: Many people feel anxiety before public speaking.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人在公开演讲前会感到焦虑。

sentence_examples.en: The ongoing anxiety about money can affect your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 对钱财的持续焦虑会影响你的健康。

translations.translation: 焦虑的，担心的；急于(得到的)，渴望的

sentence_examples.en: I'm anxious about the upcoming exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对即将到来的考试感到很焦虑。

sentence_examples.en: She was anxious to hear back from the university.
sentence_examples.zh: 她急于收到学校的回复。

sentence_examples.en: He looked anxious as he waited for the results.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在等待结果时看起来很焦虑。

translations.translation: (用于否定句、疑问句等)什么,一些;任何的

sentence_examples.en: Do you have any questions?
sentence_examples.zh: 你有什么问题吗？

sentence_examples.en: I don't have any money.
sentence_examples.zh: 我一点钱也没有。

sentence_examples.en: You can take any book you like.
sentence_examples.zh: 你喜欢的任何一本书都可以拿走。

translations.translation: (否定句)任何人；(肯定句)随便哪个人

sentence_examples.en: Anybody can learn to ride a bike with a little practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 只要多练习，任何人都能学会骑自行车。

sentence_examples.en: I didn't see anybody at the park this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天早上我在公园没看到任何人。

sentence_examples.en: If anybody calls, tell them I'll be right there.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果有人打来电话，告诉他们我马上就到。

translations.translation: 不管怎么说，无论如何；不论用何种方法

sentence_examples.en: We were short on time, but we completed the task anyhow.
sentence_examples.zh: 时间紧迫，我们还是把任务完成了。

sentence_examples.en: The plan looked risky, but we proceeded anyhow.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划看起来有风险，但我们还是照办了。

sentence_examples.en: I'll take on the project anyhow, even if it takes longer.
sentence_examples.zh: 即使花费更长时间，我也会接下这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: Did anyone call while I was out?
sentence_examples.zh: 我不在的时候，有人给我打电话吗？

sentence_examples.en: I didn't see anyone at the bus stop.
sentence_examples.zh: 在公交车站我没看到任何人。

sentence_examples.en: Has anyone seen my passport?
sentence_examples.zh: 有没有人看到我的护照？

translations.translation: 任何东西(事物)；无论什么东西(事物)

sentence_examples.en: Is there anything you need from the store?
sentence_examples.zh: 你需要从商店买点什么吗？

sentence_examples.en: I didn’t see anything unusual.
sentence_examples.zh: 我没有看到任何异常的地方。

sentence_examples.en: You can take anything from the menu.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以点菜单上的任何一道菜。

translations.translation: 不管怎么说，无论如何；不论以何种方式

sentence_examples.en: Anyway, let's start the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 不管怎样，我们开始开会吧。

sentence_examples.en: I can't find my keys, but I'll go anyway.
sentence_examples.zh: 我找不到钥匙，但我还是要去那里。

sentence_examples.en: Anyway, what were you saying?
sentence_examples.zh: 不管怎样，你刚才在说什么？

translations.translation: 无论哪里；(用于否定、疑问等)任何地方

sentence_examples.en: I can't find my keys anywhere.
sentence_examples.zh: 我到处都找不到我的钥匙。

sentence_examples.en: Have you been anywhere interesting on your trip?
sentence_examples.zh: 你在旅途中去过什么有趣的地方吗？

sentence_examples.en: I wouldn't go anywhere without my phone.
sentence_examples.zh: 没有手机，我哪儿也不去。

sentence_examples.en: The two rooms are apart from each other.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两间房彼此分离。

sentence_examples.en: You can take the bike apart in just a few minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以在几分钟内把自行车拆开。

sentence_examples.en: Apart from the rain, the picnic went well.
sentence_examples.zh: 除了下雨，野餐进行得很顺利。

sentence_examples.en: I rented a small apartment near the subway.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在地铁站附近租了一套小公寓。

sentence_examples.en: Her apartment has a balcony and a sunny kitchen.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的公寓有一个阳台和一个阳光充足的厨房。

sentence_examples.en: We shared an apartment while studying abroad.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在国外留学时合租了一套公寓。

sentence_examples.en: I would like to apologise for the mistake I made.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想为我所犯的错误道歉。

sentence_examples.en: He apologises to his colleague for the confusion.
sentence_examples.zh: 他为造成的混乱向同事道歉。

sentence_examples.en: If you hurt someone, you should apologise and listen to their feelings.
