sentence_examples.zh: 如果你伤害了某人，你应该道歉并倾听他们的感受。

sentence_examples.en: I owe you an apology for being late.
sentence_examples.zh: 我为迟到向你道歉。

sentence_examples.en: She offered a heartfelt apology for the mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为这个错误真诚地道歉。

sentence_examples.en: His apology helped mend the relationship.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的道歉帮助修复了关系。

sentence_examples.en: The shocking footage appals viewers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这段震撼的画面让观众感到震惊。

sentence_examples.en: The report appalled the committee.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份报告让委员会感到震惊。

sentence_examples.en: The decision to close the hospital appals many residents.
sentence_examples.zh: 关闭医院的决定让许多居民感到震惊。

translations.translation: 器械，器具，仪器；机构，组织

sentence_examples.en: The lab's apparatus controls the temperature and pressure during the experiment.
sentence_examples.zh: 实验室的仪器在实验中控制温度和压力。

sentence_examples.en: A portable medical apparatus was donated to the clinic.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个便携式医疗器械已捐赠给诊所。

sentence_examples.en: The government set up a new apparatus to coordinate disaster response.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府设立了一个新的机构来协调灾害应对。

translations.translation: 表面上的,貌似真实的；显然的,明明白白的

sentence_examples.en: It became apparent that he was not listening.
sentence_examples.zh: 显然他没有在听。

sentence_examples.en: The apparent cause of the accident was a minor brake failure.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故的表面原因是一次小的制动故障。

sentence_examples.en: Her apparent calm hid her anxiety.
sentence_examples.zh: 她表面的冷静掩盖了她的焦虑。

sentence_examples.en: The charity made an appeal for donations.
sentence_examples.zh: 慈善机构发出募捐呼吁。

sentence_examples.en: He decided to appeal the verdict.
sentence_examples.zh: 他决定对判决提起上诉。

sentence_examples.en: The film has wide appeal.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影具有广泛的吸引力。

translations.translation: 出现；出场；问世；仿佛；出版，发表

sentence_examples.en: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨后出现了一道彩虹。

sentence_examples.en: It may appear difficult at first, but with practice it gets easier.
sentence_examples.zh: 一开始它看起来可能很困难，但经过练习它会变得更容易。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy appeared in yesterday's newspaper.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策出现在昨天的报纸上。

translations.translation: 出现，露面；外表；作短暂露面

sentence_examples.en: Her sudden appearance surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她突然露面，大家都吃了一惊。

sentence_examples.en: The product's appearance is important in marketing.
sentence_examples.zh: 产品的外观在市场营销中很重要。

sentence_examples.en: He made a brief appearance on the talk show.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在谈话节目上短暂露面。

sentence_examples.en: The appendix at the end of the book lists additional sources.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书末尾的附录列出额外的来源。

sentence_examples.en: She had her appendix removed.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的阑尾被切除了。

sentence_examples.en: The appendix in the document contains the data tables.
sentence_examples.zh: 文档中的附录包含数据表。

translations.translation: 食欲，胃口；欲望，性欲；爱好，趣味

sentence_examples.en: After the workout, I had a big appetite.
sentence_examples.zh: 锻炼后，我的食欲很大。

sentence_examples.en: He has a healthy appetite for knowledge.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对知识有强烈的求知欲。

sentence_examples.en: The new project gave her an appetite for adventure.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项新项目激发了她对冒险的兴趣。

sentence_examples.en: The audience applauded the speaker for her clear argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 观众为她清晰的论点鼓掌。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd began to applaud as the curtain rose.
sentence_examples.zh: 帘幕升起时，观众开始鼓掌。

sentence_examples.en: We applaud the decision, though we have concerns.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管有顾虑，我们还是赞同这个决定。

sentence_examples.en: The audience erupted in applause at the end of the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会结束时，观众爆发出掌声。

sentence_examples.en: Her presentation earned a round of applause from the panel.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的演讲得到了评审团的一阵掌声。

sentence_examples.en: The plan received widespread applause from critics and supporters alike.
sentence_examples.zh: 该计划受到评论家和支持者的一致掌声。

sentence_examples.en: I ate an apple for breakfast.
sentence_examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一个苹果。

sentence_examples.en: The apple tree in the yard bears fruit every year.
sentence_examples.zh: 院子里的苹果树每年都会结果。

sentence_examples.en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
sentence_examples.zh: 每天一个苹果，医生远离我。

translations.translation: 电器；器械，装置；应用，适用

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new kitchen appliance to help with cooking.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一个新的厨房电器来帮助做饭。

sentence_examples.en: This appliance is not suitable for outdoor use.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个电器不适合在户外使用。

sentence_examples.en: Household appliances can make chores easier.
sentence_examples.zh: 家用电器可以让家务变得更轻松。

translations.translation: 可应用(实施)的；适当的,合适的

sentence_examples.en: This rule is applicable to all employees.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个规则适用于所有员工。

sentence_examples.en: The clause is not applicable to part-time workers.
sentence_examples.zh: 该条款不适用于兼职员工。

sentence_examples.en: We need to determine which laws are applicable in this case.
sentence_examples.zh: 在本案中，需要确定哪些法律适用。

translations.translation: 申请，申请书；应用，实施，实用性

sentence_examples.en: I submitted my college application online yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我昨天在网上提交了我的大学申请。

sentence_examples.en: The main application of this technology is to improve energy efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项技术的主要应用是提高能源效率。

sentence_examples.en: Please complete the job application form before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在截止日期前填写求职申请表。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to apply for an internship before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定在截止日期前申请一个实习机会。

sentence_examples.en: Remember to apply sunscreen before you go outside.
sentence_examples.zh: 出门前记得涂防晒霜。

sentence_examples.en: The school will apply the new policy starting next Monday.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校将从下周一开始执行新政策。

translations.translation: 任命，委派；指定，约定(时间、地点等)

sentence_examples.en: The board will appoint a new CEO next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 董事会将在下个月任命一位新任首席执行官。

sentence_examples.en: She appointed him as the project manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 她任命他为项目经理。

sentence_examples.en: They appointed Friday at 3 p.m. as the time for the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们把周五下午3点定为开会时间。

translations.translation: 约会,约定；任命,委派;委任的职位

sentence_examples.en: I have an appointment with the doctor at 3 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 我下午3点有医生的预约。

sentence_examples.en: Her appointment as director was announced.
sentence_examples.zh: 她被任命为董事。

sentence_examples.en: The new appointment will take effect next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 新的任命将于下月生效。

translations.translation: 对...作出的评价；评价，鉴定，评估

sentence_examples.en: The bank asked for an appraisal of the home's value before approving the loan.
sentence_examples.zh: 银行在批准贷款前需要对房子的价值进行评估。

sentence_examples.en: Her appraisal of the committee's performance was fairly blunt.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对委员会表现的评价相当直白。

sentence_examples.en: We obtained an appraisal of the antique desk from an expert.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们从专家那里获得了这张古董书桌的鉴定。

translations.translation: 为...表示感激，感谢；欣赏，赏识，评价

sentence_examples.en: I really appreciate your help with the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我真的很感谢你在这个项目上的帮助。

sentence_examples.en: We greatly appreciate your consideration of the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们非常感谢您对该提案的关注。

sentence_examples.en: I appreciate the beauty of this painting.
sentence_examples.zh: 我很欣赏这幅画的美。

translations.translation: 接近；途径，入门;方式,方法

sentence_examples.en: The crowd slowly approached the stage.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群慢慢走近舞台。

sentence_examples.en: We need a new approach to solving this problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要解决这个问题的新方法。

sentence_examples.en: The main approach to the building is through the glass doors.
sentence_examples.zh: 进入这座建筑的主要入口是通过玻璃门。

sentence_examples.en: That dress is appropriate for a job interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 那件衣服适合参加工作面试。

sentence_examples.en: It's not appropriate to interrupt the speaker.
sentence_examples.zh: 打断发言人不恰当。

sentence_examples.en: The city appropriated funds for the new park.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府为新公园拨款。

sentence_examples.en: She asked for her supervisor's approval before starting the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在开始这个项目之前请求上司的批准。

sentence_examples.en: The plan awaits approval from the council.
sentence_examples.zh: 该计划正在等待理事会的批准。

sentence_examples.en: There was broad public approval of the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 公众广泛赞同这项新政策。

sentence_examples.en: The board approved the new policy yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 董事会昨天批准了新政策。

sentence_examples.en: The committee approved the proposal after several revisions.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会在几次修改后批准了该提案。

sentence_examples.en: I don't approve of his behavior.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不赞成他的行为。

sentence_examples.en: The approximate distance is 5 kilometers.
sentence_examples.zh: 近似的距离是5公里。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers approximate the population to be around 10,000.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员将人口估算为大约10,000人。

sentence_examples.en: For quick estimates, use an approximate value.
sentence_examples.zh: 在快速估算时，使用一个近似值。

sentence_examples.en: April is the fourth month of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 四月是一年的第四个月。

sentence_examples.en: We usually plant flowers in April.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常在四月种花。

sentence_examples.en: Her birthday is in April.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的生日在四月。

translations.translation: 恰当的，适当的；易于…的，有…倾向的

sentence_examples.en: That is an apt description.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是一个恰当的描述。

sentence_examples.en: Children are apt to imitate adults.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们往往会模仿大人。

sentence_examples.en: He is apt to forget things when he's tired.
sentence_examples.zh: 他累的时候容易忘记事情。

translations.translation: 任意的，任性的，主观的；专断，武断的

sentence_examples.en: The teacher's grading seemed arbitrary, with no clear criteria.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师的评分似乎很随意，没有明确的标准。

sentence_examples.en: They imposed an arbitrary rule that everyone must arrive before 9.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们规定了一条武断的规则，要求每个人在9点前到达。

sentence_examples.en: The questions were presented in an arbitrary order.
sentence_examples.zh: 题目按任意顺序呈现。

sentence_examples.en: The old brick arch spans the street.
sentence_examples.zh: 那座旧砖拱门横跨这条街道。

sentence_examples.en: Visitors walk under the arch at the entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 游客在入口的拱门下拍照。

sentence_examples.en: The bridge arches over the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 桥梁在河上拱起。

translations.translation: 建筑师；设计师；缔造者；创造者

sentence_examples.en: The architect designed a new library with wide windows and an open floor plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位建筑师为新图书馆设计了宽敞的窗户和开放的平面布局。

sentence_examples.en: She wants to become an architect after studying art and math.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在学习艺术和数学后想成为一名建筑师。

sentence_examples.en: The architect collaborated with engineers to ensure the building's safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 建筑师与工程师合作，确保建筑的安全。

translations.translation: 建筑，建筑学；建筑式样或风格，建筑物

sentence_examples.en: The new museum showcases modern architecture inspired by nature.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座新博物馆展示了受自然启发的现代建筑。

sentence_examples.en: She studies architecture at university and hopes to design sustainable buildings.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学学习建筑，希望设计可持续的建筑。

sentence_examples.en: Ancient architecture reveals how past builders used local materials.
sentence_examples.zh: 古代建筑揭示了过去的建筑师如何使用当地材料。

translations.translation: 面积；地区，地域；领域，范围

sentence_examples.en: The living room is a large area with plenty of natural light.
sentence_examples.zh: 客厅光线充足，是一个较大的区域。

sentence_examples.en: The area around the station is under construction.
sentence_examples.zh: 车站周边正在施工。

sentence_examples.en: This area is reserved for storage.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个区域专用于存储。

sentence_examples.en: They like to argue about politics after dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们晚饭后喜欢就政治问题争论。

sentence_examples.en: The lawyer argued the case in court.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师在法庭上为该案辩护。

sentence_examples.en: I won't argue with you about that.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不会就那件事和你争论。

sentence_examples.en: They had an argument about what time to meet.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们就见面的时间发生了争论。

sentence_examples.en: Her argument for the new policy convinced many voters.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对新政策的论点说服了许多选民。

sentence_examples.en: In the debate, the main argument was that education should come first.
sentence_examples.zh: 在辩论中，主要论点是教育应当放在首位。

translations.translation: 出现，发生；(from)由…引起，由…产生

sentence_examples.en: Problems may arise if the system is not updated.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果系统没有更新，可能会出现问题。

sentence_examples.en: The issue arose from a misunderstanding.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题源自一个误解。

sentence_examples.en: New opportunities can arise after the training.
sentence_examples.zh: 培训结束后，可能会出现新的机会。

sentence_examples.en: She studies arithmetic every day to improve her basic math skills.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天练习算术，以提高她的基础数学技能。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher explained that arithmetic is the foundation of all higher-level math.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师解释说，算术是所有高等数学的基础。

sentence_examples.en: In elementary school, students practice arithmetic with addition and subtraction.
sentence_examples.zh: 在小学阶段，学生练习加法和减法等算术运算。

sentence_examples.en: She rested her arm on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把手臂放在桌子上。

sentence_examples.en: The police officer was armed with a pistol.
sentence_examples.zh: 警察手持手枪。

sentence_examples.en: The museum has a display of antique arms.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆展出了古代武器。

sentence_examples.en: The army will deploy troops to the border.
sentence_examples.zh: 军队将向边境部署部队。

sentence_examples.en: The army marched through the valley after sunrise.
sentence_examples.zh: 日出后，军队穿过山谷前进。

sentence_examples.en: She joined the army after graduating from college.
sentence_examples.zh: 她大学毕业后参军。

sentence_examples.en: There were around twenty people at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议上大约有二十人。

sentence_examples.en: There are trees around the house.
sentence_examples.zh: 房子周围有树。

sentence_examples.en: The kids were running around the playground.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们在操场上到处跑。

sentence_examples.en: The alarm clock arouses her from sleep.
sentence_examples.zh: 闹钟把她从睡眠中唤醒。

sentence_examples.en: The campaign is designed to arouse public interest in recycling.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场活动旨在唤起公众对回收的兴趣。

sentence_examples.en: Her comment aroused suspicion among the jurors.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的评论在陪审团中引起了怀疑。

translations.translation: 安排；整理，使有条理，排列，布置

sentence_examples.en: We need to arrange the furniture in the living room.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要把客厅的家具摆放整齐。

sentence_examples.en: She arranged her books by color on the shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把书架上的书按颜色排列。

sentence_examples.en: They arranged a meeting for next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为下周安排了一次会议。

sentence_examples.en: The store offers an array of colorful spring dresses.
sentence_examples.zh: 商店提供了一系列色彩鲜艳的春装。

sentence_examples.en: There is an impressive array of electronics on display.
sentence_examples.zh: 展台上陈列着琳琅满目的电子产品。

sentence_examples.en: The soldiers were arrayed in neat ranks.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵们整齐地列队。

sentence_examples.en: The arrest came after hours of questioning.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数小时的讯问后，嫌疑人被逮捕。

sentence_examples.en: The police arrested the suspect for theft.
sentence_examples.zh: 警察因盗窃而逮捕了嫌疑人。

sentence_examples.en: Her performance arrested everyone's attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的表演吸引了在场所有人的注意。

translations.translation: 到达，到来；到达者，到达物

sentence_examples.en: We were surprised by his arrival.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的到来让我们感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The train's arrival was delayed.
sentence_examples.zh: 火车的到达被延迟了。

sentence_examples.en: The team welcomed the arrival of the new coach.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队欢迎新教练的到来。

translations.translation: 到达；(时间、事件)到来，发生；达到

sentence_examples.en: We will arrive at the station at six.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们六点到达车站。

sentence_examples.en: The train is due to arrive soon.
sentence_examples.zh: 火车很快就要到达。

sentence_examples.en: Summer has arrived.
sentence_examples.zh: 夏天已经到来了。

sentence_examples.en: Don't be so arrogant about your success.
sentence_examples.zh: 别因为自己的成功而这么傲慢。

sentence_examples.en: Her arrogant comment annoyed her colleagues.
sentence_examples.zh: 她那句傲慢的评论惹恼了同事们。

sentence_examples.en: The coach warned him not to act arrogant after winning the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练警告他，赢得比赛后不要表现得傲慢。

sentence_examples.en: He pulled back the bow and released an arrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 他拉弓后射出了一支箭。

sentence_examples.en: The arrow on the sign points to the right.
sentence_examples.zh: 标志上的箭头指向右边。

sentence_examples.en: Follow the arrow to reach the exit.
sentence_examples.zh: 沿着箭头走就能到达出口。

translations.translation: 艺术；技术，技艺；文科，人文科学

sentence_examples.en: Art class starts at 9 a.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 艺术课在上午9点开始。

sentence_examples.en: She practices the art of painting every day.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天练习绘画这门艺术。

sentence_examples.en: He decided to study art and the humanities at university.
sentence_examples.zh: 他决定在大学学习艺术与人文科学。

sentence_examples.en: The surgeon found a blocked artery during the operation.
sentence_examples.zh: 手术中，外科医生发现了阻塞的动脉。

sentence_examples.en: The highway serves as a major artery for the region.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条公路是该地区的主干道。

sentence_examples.en: In biology class, we learned how arteries carry blood away from the heart.
sentence_examples.zh: 在生物课上，我们学习了动脉如何把血液带离心脏。

translations.translation: 文章，论文；条款，条文；物件；冠词

sentence_examples.en: I read a fascinating article about renewable energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 我读了一篇关于可再生能源的精彩文章。

sentence_examples.en: The contract contains several articles that outline the payment terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同包含若干条文，概述了付款条款。

sentence_examples.en: In English, 'a' is an article.
sentence_examples.zh: 在英语里，'a' 是一个冠词。

translations.translation: 善于表达的；有关节相连的

sentence_examples.en: She is an articulate speaker who can explain complex ideas clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位善于表达的演讲者，能够清晰地解释复杂的想法。

sentence_examples.en: He is articulate about his goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在阐述自己的目标时表达得很清楚。

sentence_examples.en: The student articulated his reasoning during the debate.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名学生在辩论中清楚地表达了他的理由。

translations.translation: 人工的，人造的，人为的；假的，做作的

sentence_examples.en: The researchers used artificial lighting to grow the plants.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员使用人工照明来让植物生长。

sentence_examples.en: The flowers in the display looked artificial.
sentence_examples.zh: 展览里的花看起来像人造的。

sentence_examples.en: Some people prefer artificial sweeteners to sugar.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人更喜欢人造甜味剂而不是糖。

translations.translation: 艺术家，美术家；(某方面的)能手

sentence_examples.en: The local gallery features work by a young artist.
sentence_examples.zh: 当地的画廊展出了一个年轻艺术家的作品。

sentence_examples.en: She is a talented artist who paints landscapes.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位才华横溢的艺术家，擅长画风景。

sentence_examples.en: This mural was created by a street artist.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅壁画是由一位街头艺术家创作的。

translations.translation: 艺术(家)的，美术(家)的；善于艺术创作的

sentence_examples.en: She has an artistic eye for color.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在颜色方面有艺术眼光。

sentence_examples.en: This mural shows his artistic talent.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅壁画展示了他的艺术才华。

sentence_examples.en: The room has artistic touches that make it feel special.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个房间有艺术感的点缀，让它显得特别。

sentence_examples.en: As you know, the meeting starts at nine.
sentence_examples.zh: 正如你所知，会议在九点开始。

sentence_examples.en: She is as tall as her brother.
sentence_examples.zh: 她和她哥哥一样高。

sentence_examples.en: He works as a consultant.
sentence_examples.zh: 他以顾问身份工作。

sentence_examples.en: The stairs ascend to the second floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 楼梯通向二楼。

sentence_examples.en: We ascended the mountain by a rocky path.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们沿着岩石小路攀登山峰。

sentence_examples.en: Prices ascend during peak season.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格在旺季上涨。

sentence_examples.en: The reporter tried to ascertain the facts surrounding the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 记者试图查明事件的事实。

sentence_examples.en: We need to ascertain whether the plan is feasible before proceeding.
sentence_examples.zh: 在继续之前，我们需要弄清该计划是否可行。

sentence_examples.en: The inspector aimed to ascertain the source of the leak.
sentence_examples.zh: 检查员旨在查明泄漏的来源。

sentence_examples.en: The fireplace was full of ash.
sentence_examples.zh: 壁炉里满是灰烬。

sentence_examples.en: They kept their grandmother's ashes in an urn.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们把祖母的骨灰放在骨灰盒里。

sentence_examples.en: After the fire, the town was left in ashes and ruins.
sentence_examples.zh: 火灾后，这座城镇只剩下灰烬与废墟。

sentence_examples.en: She felt ashamed after forgetting her friend's birthday.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在忘记朋友的生日后感到惭愧。

sentence_examples.en: He was ashamed to admit he had broken the vase.
sentence_examples.zh: 他为承认自己打碎花瓶而感到羞愧。

sentence_examples.en: The student felt ashamed of lying to the teacher.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个学生因为对老师撒谎而感到惭愧。

sentence_examples.en: The ship finally reached the harbor, and the crew went ashore.
sentence_examples.zh: 船终于靠岸，船员们上岸。

sentence_examples.en: The survivors climbed ashore and reported what happened.
sentence_examples.zh: 生还者们爬上岸，报告了发生的情况。

sentence_examples.en: After the storm, they swam ashore to dry land.
sentence_examples.zh: 风暴过后，他们游到岸上寻求安全。

sentence_examples.en: Please set the papers aside for now.
sentence_examples.zh: 请先把这些纸放到一边。

sentence_examples.en: She stepped aside to let the crowd pass.
sentence_examples.zh: 她走到一边让人群通过。

sentence_examples.en: As an aside, I think the budget needs revising.
sentence_examples.zh: 顺便说一句，我认为预算需要修改。

translations.translation: 问，询问；请求，要求；邀请，约请

sentence_examples.en: She asked me a question about the assignment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她就作业这件事向我提了一个问题。

sentence_examples.en: She asked for permission to leave early.
sentence_examples.zh: 她请求提前离开并得到许可。

sentence_examples.en: They asked us to join them for dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们邀请我们一起吃晚饭。

sentence_examples.en: The baby is asleep in the cradle.
sentence_examples.zh: 宝宝在摇篮里睡着了。

sentence_examples.en: I fell asleep during the movie.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在看电影时睡着了。

sentence_examples.en: The cat is asleep on the windowsill.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只猫在窗台上睡着了。

translations.translation: 样子, 外表, 面貌, (问题等的)方面

sentence_examples.en: The most important aspect of the plan is the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划中最重要的方面是预算。

sentence_examples.en: From every aspect, the project is progressing well.
sentence_examples.zh: 从各个方面来看，该项目都在顺利推进。

sentence_examples.en: The painting has many aspects, such as color, texture, and composition.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画有许多方面，例如颜色、质感和构图。

sentence_examples.en: Many students aspire to attend a prestigious university.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多学生渴望进入一所名校。

sentence_examples.en: She aspires to become a lawyer and help others.
sentence_examples.zh: 她立志成为律师，帮助他人。

sentence_examples.en: I aspire to make a positive impact in my community.
sentence_examples.zh: 我渴望在社区做出积极影响。

sentence_examples.en: The rebel group planned to assassinate the regional governor.
sentence_examples.zh: 反叛集团计划暗杀这位区域长官。

sentence_examples.en: Police arrested a man suspected of trying to assassinate the president.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方逮捕了一名疑似企图暗杀总统的人。

sentence_examples.en: Security footage showed who attempted to assassinate the mayor.
sentence_examples.zh: 监控录像显示出企图暗杀市长的人是谁。

sentence_examples.en: The security guard was assaulted by a patron.
sentence_examples.zh: 一名顾客袭击了安保人员。

sentence_examples.en: The assault happened outside the bar last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚在酒吧外发生了袭击。

sentence_examples.en: He faced charges of assault after the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事发后他因袭击被提起指控。

sentence_examples.en: The manager asked the workers to assemble in the conference room at 9 a.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理要求工人们在上午9点到会议室集合。

sentence_examples.en: We need to assemble the bookshelf before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要在截止日期前把书架组装好。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers assembled data from several studies to support their conclusion.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员汇总了来自几项研究的数据，以支持他们的结论。

translations.translation: 集合；会议；装配；(美)洲议会的众议院

sentence_examples.en: The students gathered for the morning assembly.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生们参加了早上的全体大会。

sentence_examples.en: The assembly of the new computer took two hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 新电脑的装配花了两个小时。

sentence_examples.en: The California Assembly passed the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 加州州议会通过了预算案。

translations.translation: 断言,宣称；坚持；主张（权利、权威等）

sentence_examples.en: She asserted her innocence during the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在采访中坚称自己无罪。

sentence_examples.en: The report asserts that the policy will reduce emissions.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告断言该政策将减少排放。

sentence_examples.en: He asserted his right to free speech.
sentence_examples.zh: 他主张自己享有言论自由的权利。

translations.translation: (为征税)评估(财产、收入)；征税；评价

sentence_examples.en: The town assessor will assess property values for the new tax year.
sentence_examples.zh: 地方评估员将为新税年评估房产价值。

sentence_examples.en: The company hired consultants to assess the risks of the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司雇佣顾问评估该项目的风险。

sentence_examples.en: Before making a decision, you should assess your options.
sentence_examples.zh: 在做决定之前，你应该评估你的选项。

translations.translation: )资产,财产；有价值的物品；天赋

sentence_examples.en: A good education is a valuable asset for any career.
sentence_examples.zh: 良好的教育是任何职业的宝贵资产。

sentence_examples.en: The company lists cash and property as assets on the balance sheet.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在资产负债表上将现金和财产列为资产。

sentence_examples.en: Her ability to speak multiple languages is a valuable asset.
sentence_examples.zh: 她掌握多种语言是一项宝贵的资产。

translations.translation: 派给，分配；选定，指定(时间、地点等)

sentence_examples.en: The teacher will assign homework for tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师会布置明天的作业。

sentence_examples.en: They assigned me to lead the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们指派我负责这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The seats were assigned at the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 典礼上的座位已被分配。

translations.translation: 分配，指派；(指定的)作业，(分派的)任务

sentence_examples.en: I have an assignment due tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我有一项作业要在明天交。

sentence_examples.en: The supervisor assigned me a new assignment.
sentence_examples.zh: 主管给了我一个新的任务。

sentence_examples.en: Please complete the assignment before Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在周五前完成该作业。

sentence_examples.en: The new employees quickly assimilate into the company culture.
sentence_examples.zh: 新员工很快融入公司文化。

sentence_examples.en: Plants assimilate nutrients from the soil through their roots.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物通过根部吸收土壤中的养分。

sentence_examples.en: The country worked to assimilate the immigrant population.
sentence_examples.zh: 国家努力让移民融入社会。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse will assist the doctor during the operation.
sentence_examples.zh: 手术期间，护士将协助医生。

sentence_examples.en: She asked her colleagues to assist with the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她请同事协助这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: Several volunteers assisted at the event.
sentence_examples.zh: 几名志愿者在活动中提供帮助。

translations.translation: 协作; 援助; 帮助

sentence_examples.en: We would appreciate your assistance with this project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将非常感谢您对这个项目的协助。

sentence_examples.en: The charity relied on community assistance to distribute food.
sentence_examples.zh: 该慈善机构依靠社区的援助来分发食物。

sentence_examples.en: They offered financial assistance to students in need.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们向有需要的学生提供经济援助。

sentence_examples.en: My assistant helped me organize the schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的助理帮我整理日程。

sentence_examples.en: The assistant at the information desk answered my question.
sentence_examples.zh: 信息台的助理回答了我的问题。

sentence_examples.en: She works as an assistant to the professor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她担任教授的助理。

sentence_examples.en: Many people associate the word 'green' with environmental friendliness.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人把“绿色”这个词与环保联系在一起。

sentence_examples.en: My business associate will join us for the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的商业伙伴会来参加会议。

sentence_examples.en: The project has several associated risks.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目有若干相关风险。

translations.translation: 联盟，协会，社团；交往，联合；联想

sentence_examples.en: She joined the local association to network with other writers.
sentence_examples.zh: 她加入当地的协会，与其他作家建立联系。

sentence_examples.en: There is a strong association between smoking and lung cancer.
sentence_examples.zh: 吸烟与肺癌之间存在明显的关联。

sentence_examples.en: The association meets every month to discuss community projects.
sentence_examples.zh: 该协会每月举行会议，讨论社区项目。

translations.translation: 假装；假定，设想；承担；呈现，采取

sentence_examples.en: I assumed you would be late.
sentence_examples.zh: 我以为你会迟到。

sentence_examples.en: She assumed a confident posture during the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在面试时表现出自信的姿态。

sentence_examples.en: The company will assume responsibility for the damages.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将承担损害的责任。

translations.translation: 假定，设想；采取；承担；推测；假装

sentence_examples.en: We made the assumption that the meeting would start on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们假设会议会准时开始。

sentence_examples.en: Don't rely on that assumption; confirm the details.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要依赖这个假设，请确认细节。

sentence_examples.en: Her assumption of responsibility impressed everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她主动承担责任让团队印象深刻。

translations.translation: 保证,担保；确信,断言；信心,信念

sentence_examples.en: The company gave assurances that the product would be delivered on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司作出保证，产品会按时交付。

sentence_examples.en: There is no assurance that he will arrive on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 无法保证他会准时到达。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke with assurance during the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在演讲中自信地讲话。

sentence_examples.en: I can assure you that the project will be completed on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我可以向你保证这个项目会按时完成。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher assured the students that the exam would be fair.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师向学生们保证考试会公平。

sentence_examples.en: The manager assured the team that there would be no layoffs.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理向团队保证不会裁员。

sentence_examples.en: The magician's final trick astonishes the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 魔术师的最后一个把戏让观众惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: It would astonish me if he passed the test.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果他通过考试，我会感到很吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: His sudden resignation astonished everyone at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他突然的辞职让在场的每个人都吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: An astronaut trains for years before a space mission.
sentence_examples.zh: 宇航员在执行太空任务前要经过多年的训练。

sentence_examples.en: The astronaut floated in zero gravity inside the space station.
sentence_examples.zh: 宇航员在太空站内的失重环境中漂浮。

sentence_examples.en: She became an astronaut after studying engineering and physics.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在学习工程和物理后成为了一名宇航员。

sentence_examples.en: Astronomy is the science that studies stars, planets, and galaxies.
sentence_examples.zh: 天文学是研究星星、行星和星系的科学。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to major in astronomy at university.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定在大学主修天文学。

sentence_examples.en: The astronomy club meets on weekends to observe the night sky.
sentence_examples.zh: 天文学社在周末聚会，观测夜空。

translations.translation: [表示价格、速度等]以，达；在..方面

sentence_examples.en: The jacket is priced at $45.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件夹克的价格是45美元。

sentence_examples.en: They arrived at the airport early.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们提前到达机场。

sentence_examples.en: The car was traveling at 60 mph.
sentence_examples.zh: 那辆车的时速为每小时60英里。

translations.translation: 运动员，体育家，身强力壮的人

sentence_examples.en: The athlete trained every morning before sunrise.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名运动员每天在日出前训练。

sentence_examples.en: Being an athlete requires dedication and discipline.
sentence_examples.zh: 作为运动员，需要投入和自律。

sentence_examples.en: After years of training, she became a top athlete.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过多年的训练，她成为了一名顶尖运动员。

translations.translation: 大气(层)；空气；气氛，环境；大气压

sentence_examples.en: The restaurant has a warm atmosphere.
sentence_examples.zh: 那家餐厅的氛围很温暖。

sentence_examples.en: The atmosphere in the stadium after the goal was electric.
sentence_examples.zh: 比赛进球后，体育场的气氛异常热烈。

sentence_examples.en: The Earth's atmosphere protects us from harmful radiation.
sentence_examples.zh: 地球的大气层保护我们免受有害辐射。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists study how atoms bond to form molecules.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家研究原子如何结合形成分子。

sentence_examples.en: An atom is the basic unit of matter.
sentence_examples.zh: 原子是物质的基本单位。

sentence_examples.en: The air is mostly made of nitrogen and oxygen atoms.
sentence_examples.zh: 空气主要由氮原子和氧原子组成。

translations.translation: 系，贴，连接；使成为一部分；使依恋

sentence_examples.en: Please attach the invoice to the email before sending.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在发送前把发票附在邮件中。

sentence_examples.en: She attached a new photo to the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在报告中附上了一张新照片。

sentence_examples.en: The children attached themselves to the new teacher.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们很快就对新老师产生了依恋。

sentence_examples.en: The dog will attack if it feels threatened.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果它感到威胁，狗就会攻击。

sentence_examples.en: We plan to attack the project first thing in the morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们计划一大早就着手处理这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: He had a heart attack.
sentence_examples.zh: 他心脏病发作了。

sentence_examples.en: She attained her goal of running a marathon after months of training.
sentence_examples.zh: 她经过数月训练后实现了参加马拉松比赛的目标。

sentence_examples.en: The team attained a new record in the championship.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队在锦标赛中创造了新纪录。

sentence_examples.en: He attained his full potential through hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 他通过努力发挥出全部潜力。

sentence_examples.en: The rescue team attempted to reach the climbers before nightfall.
sentence_examples.zh: 救援队在天黑前设法抵达被困的攀登者。

sentence_examples.en: Her first attempt at baking bread didn't rise.
sentence_examples.zh: 她第一次尝试烤面包没有发起来。

sentence_examples.en: The company made an attempt to reduce costs by outsourcing.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司通过外包来降低成本。

sentence_examples.en: I will attend the meeting at 3 PM.
sentence_examples.zh: 我将于下午3点出席会议。

sentence_examples.en: She attends to her sick mother every afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天下午都在照顾她生病的母亲。

sentence_examples.en: Please attend to the instructions before starting the experiment.
sentence_examples.zh: 在开始实验前，请遵循说明。

translations.translation: 出席；出席人数；护理，照料

sentence_examples.en: Attendance at the meeting is mandatory.
sentence_examples.zh: 参加会议是强制性的。

sentence_examples.en: The class's attendance improved after the reminder.
sentence_examples.zh: 提醒后，班级的出席率有所提高。

sentence_examples.en: The patient needed the nurse's constant attendance.
sentence_examples.zh: 患者需要护士持续的照料。

sentence_examples.en: The flight attendant greeted us as we boarded.
sentence_examples.zh: 登机时，空乘人员向我们打招呼。

sentence_examples.en: An attendant at the hotel helped us with our luggage.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店的服务员帮我们拿行李。

sentence_examples.en: There were attendant costs that came with the upgrade.
sentence_examples.zh: 升级还伴随着一些附带费用。

translations.translation: 注意，注意力；立正；特别照顾；照料

sentence_examples.en: Please pay attention to the safety instructions.
sentence_examples.zh: 请留意安全说明。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse gave the patient her full attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士对病人给予了全部关注。

sentence_examples.en: The soldiers stood at attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵们立正站着。

translations.translation: 态度，看法(to, toward, about)；姿势

sentence_examples.en: She has a positive attitude toward learning new skills.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对学习新技能的态度很积极。

sentence_examples.en: His attitude toward work changed after the promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 晋升后，他对工作的态度改变了。

sentence_examples.en: A good attitude can make a bad day better.
sentence_examples.zh: 积极的态度可以让糟糕的一天变得更好。

translations.translation: (业务或法律事务上的)代理人；辩护律师

sentence_examples.en: The attorney filed a motion with the court.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位律师向法院提交了动议。

sentence_examples.en: She works as an attorney at a large law firm.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在一家大型律师事务所担任律师。

sentence_examples.en: An attorney can help you review the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师可以帮你审查合同。

translations.translation: 引起的注意(或兴趣等),吸引；引起；激起

sentence_examples.en: The new design is likely to attract more customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 新的设计可能会吸引更多的顾客。

sentence_examples.en: The park attracts thousands of visitors each year.
sentence_examples.zh: 公园每年吸引成千上万的游客。

sentence_examples.en: Bright colors attract attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 鲜艳的颜色会引起注意。

translations.translation: 吸引人的，引人注意的；漂亮的，迷人的

sentence_examples.en: The new storefront has an attractive display that draws customers inside.
sentence_examples.zh: 新店面的陈列很有吸引力，能把顾客吸引进来。

sentence_examples.en: She wore an attractive dress that caught everyone's eye.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的连衣裙，吸引了大家的目光。

sentence_examples.en: The job offer is attractive because it offers good pay and opportunities for advancement.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个工作机会很有吸引力，因为它提供不错的薪水和晋升机会。

sentence_examples.en: We attribute the failure to a lack of planning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把失败归因于缺乏计划。

sentence_examples.en: The researchers attribute the anomaly to a measurement error.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员把异常归因于测量误差。

sentence_examples.en: Honesty is a key attribute of a good leader.
sentence_examples.zh: 诚实是一个优秀领导者的关键品质。

sentence_examples.en: The antique vase sold for a high price at the auction.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只古董花瓶在拍卖会上以高价成交。

sentence_examples.en: We attended the charity auction to support the local hospital.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们参加了慈善拍卖会，支持当地医院。

sentence_examples.en: The gallery plans to auction the painting next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 画廊计划下个月把这幅画拍卖。

translations.translation: 听众，观众，读者；见面，会见

sentence_examples.en: The audience clapped at the end of the performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 观众在表演结束时鼓掌。

sentence_examples.en: She prepared her talk to engage the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 她准备演讲以吸引观众。

sentence_examples.en: The author wrote a book that appealed to a wide audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 作者写了一本受到广大读者欢迎的书。

translations.translation: 音频(响)(的)；声音(的)，听觉(的)

sentence_examples.en: The audio quality in this video is excellent.
sentence_examples.zh: 这段视频的音频质量非常好。

sentence_examples.en: I saved the audio file to my computer.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把音频文件保存到电脑上。

sentence_examples.en: Could you increase the audio so I can hear the dialogue clearly?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能把音量调大吗，这样我就能听清对话。

sentence_examples.en: The company will audit its accounts this quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将在本季度对账目进行审计。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to audit a university course for personal interest.
sentence_examples.zh: 她出于兴趣决定旁听一门大学课程。

sentence_examples.en: The firm will audit the annual financial statements next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 该公司将于下月对年度财务报表进行审计。

translations.translation: 观众席，听众席；会堂，礼堂

sentence_examples.en: The auditorium was filled with students for the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会在礼堂举行，礼堂里坐满了学生。

sentence_examples.en: Please silence your phone before entering the auditorium.
sentence_examples.zh: 进入礼堂前请将手机静音。

sentence_examples.en: A volunteer guided us to our seats in the auditorium.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位志愿者把我们带到了礼堂的座位。

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to augment its workforce with 20 new engineers.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划通过增加20名工程师来扩大员工队伍。

sentence_examples.en: The new features augment the software's usability and speed.
sentence_examples.zh: 新功能提升了软件的可用性和速度。

sentence_examples.en: Regular practice can augment your skills over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的练习随着时间可以提升你的技能。

sentence_examples.en: My birthday is in August.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的生日在八月。

sentence_examples.en: We usually go on vacation in August.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常在八月去度假。

sentence_examples.en: August is the eighth month of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 八月是一年中的第八个月。

translations.translation: 姨母，姑母，伯母，婶母，舅母，阿姨

sentence_examples.en: My aunt is coming to visit us this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的阿姨这个周末要来拜访我们。

sentence_examples.en: My aunt gave me some advice about college.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的阿姨给了我一些关于上大学的建议。

sentence_examples.en: I helped my aunt bake cookies for the school fair.
sentence_examples.zh: 我帮我的阿姨为学校义卖烤饼干。

sentence_examples.en: An aural test will help determine your ability to hear faint tones.
sentence_examples.zh: 听力测试将帮助判断你听到微弱音调的能力。

sentence_examples.en: She has strong aural skills and can identify even quick pitch changes.
sentence_examples.zh: 她拥有很强的听觉能力，甚至能辨别快速的音高变化。

sentence_examples.en: The app uses aural cues to guide users through the pronunciation exercises.
sentence_examples.zh: 该应用使用听觉提示来引导用户进行发音练习。

translations.translation: 真的，真正的；可靠，可信的，有根据的

sentence_examples.en: The museum sells authentic artifacts from ancient civilizations.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆出售来自古代文明的真品文物。

sentence_examples.en: This restaurant serves authentic Italian dishes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供正宗的意大利菜。

sentence_examples.en: We should verify that the information is authentic.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们应该核实信息的真实性。

translations.translation: 作者，作家，著作人；创始人，发起人

sentence_examples.en: The author of this book will sign copies at the bookstore.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书的作者将在书店现场签名。

sentence_examples.en: She is a well-known author in science fiction.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是科幻小说界的知名作家。

sentence_examples.en: The author apologized after realizing the mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 作者在意识到错误后道歉。

sentence_examples.en: The city council has the authority to approve building permits.
sentence_examples.zh: 市议会有权批准建筑许可。

sentence_examples.en: He is considered an authority on climate policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 他被认为是气候政策方面的权威。

sentence_examples.en: The authorities warned residents to stay indoors.
sentence_examples.zh: 当局警告居民留在室内。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new auto last week.
sentence_examples.zh: 我上周买了一辆新车。

sentence_examples.en: He fixed the broken headlight on his auto.
sentence_examples.zh: 他修好了自己车上的前灯。

sentence_examples.en: The auto industry is growing rapidly this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年汽车行业增长迅速。

sentence_examples.en: The doors are automatic and open when you approach.
sentence_examples.zh: 门是自动的，靠近时会打开。

sentence_examples.en: The coffee maker has an automatic shut-off after two hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台咖啡机有两小时后自动关机的功能。

sentence_examples.en: Her reaction was almost automatic, like a reflex.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的反应几乎是自动的，像反射一样。

sentence_examples.en: Automation has changed how we manufacture products.
sentence_examples.zh: 自动化改变了我们的产品制造方式。

sentence_examples.en: Many factories are adopting automation to improve efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多工厂正在采用自动化以提高效率。

sentence_examples.en: Students study automation to understand robots and control systems.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生学习自动化，了解机器人和控制系统。

sentence_examples.en: Several regions are seeking greater autonomy from the central government.
sentence_examples.zh: 若干地区正在寻求对中央政府更大的自治权。

sentence_examples.en: The company gives employees a degree of autonomy to manage their own projects.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司给予员工在管理自己项目时一定程度的自治权。

sentence_examples.en: She valued personal autonomy and made her own choices.
sentence_examples.zh: 她重视个人自主权，自己做出选择。

sentence_examples.en: Autumn is my favorite season because of its cool weather and colorful leaves.
sentence_examples.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节，因为天气凉爽，树叶颜色鲜艳。

sentence_examples.en: We enjoy a walk in autumn and watch the leaves fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在秋天散步，看着树叶落下。

sentence_examples.en: In the autumn of his career, he focused on mentoring younger players.
sentence_examples.zh: 在他职业生涯的晚期，他专注于指导年轻球员。

sentence_examples.en: The building has an auxiliary power supply that automatically activates during a blackout.
sentence_examples.zh: 建筑物在停电时会自动启动辅助电源。

sentence_examples.en: Auxiliary staff helped visitors find their way to the exhibit.
sentence_examples.zh: 辅助人员帮助参观者找到展区的位置。

sentence_examples.en: The technician added an auxiliary device to the system to improve stability.
sentence_examples.zh: 技术员向系统中添加了一个辅助设备以提高稳定性。

translations.translation: [一般用于否定句或疑问句中]效用,利益

sentence_examples.en: All their efforts were to no avail.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们的努力都无济于事。

sentence_examples.en: Is there any avail in this plan?
sentence_examples.zh: 这项计划有多少用处吗？

sentence_examples.en: This policy is of little avail to small businesses.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项政策对小型企业几乎没有用处。

translations.translation: (用于物)可用的；可见到的，接受采访的

sentence_examples.en: The new model is now available in stores.
sentence_examples.zh: 新款现在在商店有售。

sentence_examples.en: The software is available for download on our website.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件现已在我们的网站上提供下载。

sentence_examples.en: The spokesperson is available for interviews today.
sentence_examples.zh: 发言人今天有空接受采访。

translations.translation: 林荫路，大街；(比喻)途径，渠道，方法

sentence_examples.en: We walked down the avenue, admiring the trees on both sides.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们沿着这条林荫大道走，欣赏两旁的树木。

sentence_examples.en: This program provides an avenue for students to showcase their work.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目为学生展示他们的作品提供了一个途径。

sentence_examples.en: There are many avenues to success in this field.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这个领域，通往成功的途径有很多。

sentence_examples.en: The average of the test scores was 75.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试分数的平均分是75分。

sentence_examples.en: Her performance was average.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的表现一般。

sentence_examples.en: We averaged the test scores to get the final grade.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把考试分数求平均以得到最终成绩。

translations.translation: 防止，避免 ；转移(目光、注意力等)

sentence_examples.en: Emergency brakes helped avert a disaster.
sentence_examples.zh: 紧急制动帮助避免了一场灾难。

sentence_examples.en: The government introduced policy changes to avert a financial crisis.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府推出政策变革以避免金融危机的发生。

sentence_examples.en: She averted her eyes from the gruesome scene.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把目光从骇人的场景移开。

translations.translation: 航空，航空学；飞机制造业

sentence_examples.en: She studied aviation at college and now works for an airline.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学学习航空专业，现在在一家航空公司工作。

sentence_examples.en: Aviation safety is essential in both commercial and military operations.
sentence_examples.zh: 航空安全在商业和军事行动中都至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: Advances in aviation technology have reduced flight times and fuel use.
sentence_examples.zh: 航空技术的进步缩短了飞行时间并降低了燃料消耗。

sentence_examples.en: To avoid crowds, she shops at the market early.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了避免人群，她在市场一大早就去购物。

sentence_examples.en: Double-check your work to avoid mistakes.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了避免错误，请仔细检查你的工作。

sentence_examples.en: He tried to avoid answering the question.
sentence_examples.zh: 他试图避免回答这个问题。

translations.translation: 等候，期待；(事情等)降临于

sentence_examples.en: We will await your response.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将等待你的回复。

sentence_examples.en: The committee awaits the final report before making a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会在作出决定前等待最终报告。

sentence_examples.en: After the storm, residents awaited news from the authorities.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，居民们曾等待政府的消息。

sentence_examples.en: I stayed awake during the lecture.
sentence_examples.zh: 在讲座期间我一直没睡着。

sentence_examples.en: The loud alarm awakened the baby.
sentence_examples.zh: 响亮的警报把婴儿吵醒了。

sentence_examples.en: She woke up to the truth about the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 她终于醒悟到事件的真相。

sentence_examples.en: The committee will award scholarships to the top students.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会将把奖学金授予成绩最优秀的学生。

sentence_examples.en: She won the Best Actress Award at the festival.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在电影节上获得了最佳女演员奖。

sentence_examples.en: The court awarded damages to the plaintiff.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院判给原告赔偿。

sentence_examples.en: I'm aware of the problem and I'm working on a solution.
sentence_examples.zh: 我知道这个问题，并且正在研究解决办法。

sentence_examples.en: You should be aware of the risks before you proceed.
sentence_examples.zh: 在继续之前，你应该意识到风险。

sentence_examples.en: She wasn't aware that the deadline had been extended.
sentence_examples.zh: 她并不知道截止日期已经延长。

translations.translation: 在远处；离开；渐渐远去；一直；去掉

sentence_examples.en: The station is far away.
sentence_examples.zh: 火车站离这里很远。

sentence_examples.en: Please go away.
sentence_examples.zh: 请走开。

sentence_examples.en: Time has slipped away.
sentence_examples.zh: 时间已经悄悄地溜走了。

sentence_examples.en: Standing near the waterfall gave me a sense of awe.
sentence_examples.zh: 站在瀑布边让我感到敬畏。

sentence_examples.en: The vastness of space fills people with awe.
sentence_examples.zh: 太空的浩瀚让人心生敬畏。

sentence_examples.en: The sight of the ancient cathedral awed the visitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座古老大教堂的景象让游客敬畏。

translations.translation: 极度的，极坏的；威严的，可怕的

sentence_examples.en: The weather today is awful.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天的天气很糟糕。

sentence_examples.en: That movie was awful.
sentence_examples.zh: 那部电影真糟糕。

sentence_examples.en: Traffic was awful this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今早的交通太糟糕了。

translations.translation: 笨拙的；尴尬的；使用不便的；难处理的

sentence_examples.en: The new software has an awkward interface that beginners struggle with.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款新软件的界面对初学者来说很别扭，使用起来很困难。

sentence_examples.en: It felt awkward to speak to my boss about the mistake in front of the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 在全体同事面前和老板谈论这个错误时，感觉很尴尬。

sentence_examples.en: The chair is awkward to sit on because the legs wobble.
sentence_examples.zh: 这把椅子坐起来很别扭，因为椅脚在晃动。

sentence_examples.en: He sharpened the axe before starting to chop the log.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在开始砍原木之前把斧子磨利。

sentence_examples.en: The editor decided to axe several pages from the draft.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑决定把草稿中的几页删掉。

sentence_examples.en: He kept an axe in the garage for firewood.

sentence_examples.en: She bathed her hands in cold water after washing the dishes.
sentence_examples.zh: 洗碗后，她把手浸在冷水里。

sentence_examples.en: Where is the bathroom?
sentence_examples.zh: 卫生间在哪儿？

sentence_examples.en: I need to use the bathroom.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要去卫生间。

sentence_examples.en: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.
sentence_examples.zh: 卫生间在走廊尽头。

translations.translation: 电池(组)；(器具等的)一组，一套；炮兵连

sentence_examples.en: I need to charge the battery in my laptop.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要给笔记本电脑里的电池充电。

sentence_examples.en: The battery fired several rounds during yesterday's drill.
sentence_examples.zh: 炮兵连在昨天的演习中发射了几发炮弹。

sentence_examples.en: The app comes with a battery of features to improve usability.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个应用带有一整套功能以提高易用性。

sentence_examples.en: The army prepared for the battle at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 军队在黎明时为那场战斗做准备。

sentence_examples.en: She has been battling a cold for a week.
sentence_examples.zh: 她已经和感冒斗争了一周。

sentence_examples.en: The two teams battled it out in the final.
sentence_examples.zh: 两队在决赛中展开激战。

sentence_examples.en: The ship entered the bay to take shelter from the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 船驶入海湾躲避风暴。

sentence_examples.en: We rented a cabin near the bay to enjoy the sea view.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在海湾附近租了一间小屋，欣赏海景。

sentence_examples.en: A fishing boat moored in the bay all afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 一艘渔船在海湾里停泊了一整下午。

translations.translation: (就)是，等于；(存)在；到达，来到，发生

sentence_examples.en: Two plus two is four.
sentence_examples.zh: 二加二等于四。

sentence_examples.en: There is a cat on the chair.
sentence_examples.zh: 椅子上有一只猫。

sentence_examples.en: The bus will be here at noon.
sentence_examples.zh: 公交车中午就会到达这里。

sentence_examples.en: We spent the afternoon on the beach, building a sandcastle.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在海滩上度过了一个下午，堆了一个沙堡。

sentence_examples.en: The beach was crowded, so we chose a quiet spot near the dunes.
sentence_examples.zh: 海滩很拥挤，所以我们选择了靠近沙丘的一块安静地方。

sentence_examples.en: We walked along the beach at sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 日落时，我们沿着海滩散步。

sentence_examples.en: The ceiling is supported by a wooden beam.
sentence_examples.zh: 天花板由一根木梁支撑。

sentence_examples.en: A beam of sunlight streamed through the window.
sentence_examples.zh: 一束阳光从窗户照进房间。

sentence_examples.en: She beamed with happiness when she heard the news.
sentence_examples.zh: 听到这个消息时，她露出灿烂的笑容。

sentence_examples.en: I found a bean on the kitchen counter.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在厨房台面上发现了一颗豆子。

sentence_examples.en: She planted a bean in the garden this spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 她今年春天在花园里种了一颗豆子。

sentence_examples.en: We cook beans with rice for a simple meal.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把豆子和米饭一起煮，做成一顿简单的饭。

translations.translation: 忍受,容忍;负担;结果实,生子女

sentence_examples.en: A bear wandered into the campsite by the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只熊走进了河边的营地。

sentence_examples.en: I can't bear this noise.
sentence_examples.zh: 我受不了这个噪音。

sentence_examples.en: The orange tree bears fruit every autumn.
sentence_examples.zh: 橙树每年秋天结果实。

sentence_examples.en: He has a thick beard.
sentence_examples.zh: 他留着浓密的胡须。

sentence_examples.en: I'm growing a beard.
sentence_examples.zh: 我正在留胡须。

sentence_examples.en: He trimmed his beard this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 他今天早上修剪了胡须。

translations.translation: 轴承；忍受；关系，影响；举止；方向

sentence_examples.en: The machine operates smoothly after a new bearing was installed.
sentence_examples.zh: 新轴承安装后，机器运转顺畅。

sentence_examples.en: She carried herself with a calm bearing under pressure.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在压力下保持着从容的举止。

sentence_examples.en: These results have a bearing on the project's direction.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些结果对项目的方向有影响。

translations.translation: 兽,牲畜;凶残的人,举止粗鲁的人

sentence_examples.en: A beast escaped from the zoo last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚有一头野兽从动物园逃走。

sentence_examples.en: He acted like a beast when he was angry.
sentence_examples.zh: 他生气时像个野兽。

sentence_examples.en: Farmers kept beasts of burden such as horses and oxen.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民们饲养像马和牛这样的役畜。

sentence_examples.en: The drum beat kept the tempo steady.
sentence_examples.zh: 鼓点让节奏保持稳定。

sentence_examples.en: She beat her opponent in the final round.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在决赛中击败了对手。

sentence_examples.en: Beat the eggs until they are fluffy.
sentence_examples.zh: 把鸡蛋打至蓬松。

translations.translation: 美的，美丽的；出色的，完美的

sentence_examples.en: The sunset over the ocean was beautiful.
sentence_examples.zh: 海面的日落很美。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a beautiful dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的连衣裙去参加派对。

sentence_examples.en: This is a beautiful example of teamwork and dedication.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是一个展现团队合作与奉献精神的美好例子。

translations.translation: 美，美丽；美人，美丽的事物

sentence_examples.en: She admired the beauty of the sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 她欣赏日落的美丽。

sentence_examples.en: Beauty can be found in small moments.
sentence_examples.zh: 美丽往往藏在那些微小的瞬间里。

sentence_examples.en: The festival celebrated beauty in art and nature.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个节日庆祝艺术与自然之美。

sentence_examples.en: I stayed home because it was raining.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为下雨，我待在家里。

sentence_examples.en: She helped me because I asked for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为我请求帮助，她帮了我。

sentence_examples.en: We left early because the meeting was canceled.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为会议被取消，我们提前离开。

sentence_examples.en: She became famous after her first novel.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在第一本小说出版后成了知名作家。

sentence_examples.en: The weather has become colder as October ends.
sentence_examples.zh: 十月末天气变得更冷了。

sentence_examples.en: This color becomes you.
sentence_examples.zh: 这颜色很衬你。

translations.translation: 床,床位；(苗)床,坛；河床，(湖、海的)底

sentence_examples.en: I crawled into bed after a long day.
sentence_examples.zh: 漫长的一天后，我躺上了床。

sentence_examples.en: The gardener arranged the flower bed for spring planting.
sentence_examples.zh: 园丁为春季种植整理了花坛。

sentence_examples.en: The river bed was dry and sandy after months of little rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 几个月没下雨后，河床干燥，布满沙子。

sentence_examples.en: A bee is gathering nectar from the flowers in the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园里的蜜蜂正在花朵上采集花蜜。

sentence_examples.en: Don't swat at the bee; it won't hurt you if you stay calm.
sentence_examples.zh: 别拍打蜜蜂；如果你保持镇静它也不会伤人。

sentence_examples.en: She's a busy bee at work, always helping others.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在工作中是个忙碌的蜜蜂，总是乐于帮助别人。

sentence_examples.en: I bought some beef for tonight's dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一些牛肉，今晚用来做晚餐。

sentence_examples.en: This beef is tender and flavorful.
sentence_examples.zh: 这块牛肉很嫩，味道鲜美。

sentence_examples.en: We grilled beef skewers for the picnic.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在野餐时烤牛肉串。

sentence_examples.en: I enjoy a cold beer after work.
sentence_examples.zh: 下班后我喜欢喝一杯冰镇啤酒。

sentence_examples.en: Beer is made from barley, hops, water, and yeast.
sentence_examples.zh: 啤酒是用大麦、啤酒花、水和酵母酿造的。

sentence_examples.en: There are stalls selling beer at the festival.
sentence_examples.zh: 节日里有卖啤酒的摊位。

translations.translation: (指时间)在…以前,在..前面，在..之前

sentence_examples.en: She finished her homework before dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在晚饭前完成了作业。

sentence_examples.en: Please arrive before 9 a.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在上午9点之前到达。

sentence_examples.en: He stood before the judge to speak.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在法官面前发言。

sentence_examples.en: Please book your tickets beforehand to avoid delays.
sentence_examples.zh: 请事先预订你的票，以避免延误。

sentence_examples.en: She prepared beforehand and knew exactly what to say.
sentence_examples.zh: 她事先做好了准备，知道该说什么。

sentence_examples.en: We should plan beforehand when organizing an event.
sentence_examples.zh: 在组织活动时，我们应该事先做计划。

sentence_examples.en: She had to beg her boss for a day off.
sentence_examples.zh: 她不得不向老板请求一天假期。

sentence_examples.en: The beggar stood on the street corner, begging for money.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个乞丐站在街角乞讨钱。

sentence_examples.en: I beg you to forgive me.
sentence_examples.zh: 我恳请你原谅我。

sentence_examples.en: I will begin my new project tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我明天将开始我的新项目。

sentence_examples.en: She began learning Spanish last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去年开始学习西班牙语。

sentence_examples.en: We have begun to discuss the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们已经开始讨论这个计划。

translations.translation: 开始，开端；起源，早期阶段

sentence_examples.en: At the beginning of the lesson, the teacher explained the goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这节课的开始，老师解释了目标。

sentence_examples.en: This is only the beginning of a long journey.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只是漫长旅程的开始。

sentence_examples.en: In the beginning, the team faced many challenges.
sentence_examples.zh: 起初，团队面临了许多挑战。

sentence_examples.en: I accepted the award on behalf of the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 我代表团队接受了这个奖项。

sentence_examples.en: We filed the complaint on behalf of the residents to protect their interests.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们代表居民提交了投诉，以维护他们的利益。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor signed the consent form on behalf of the patient.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生代表患者签署了同意书。

translations.translation: 举止,举动,表现;运转,开动

sentence_examples.en: Children are expected to behave in class.
sentence_examples.zh: 课堂上，孩子们被期望端正举止。

sentence_examples.en: Please behave yourself and follow the rules.
sentence_examples.zh: 请自觉守规矩，遵守规则。

sentence_examples.en: After maintenance, the equipment will behave properly.
sentence_examples.zh: 维护后，设备将正常运作。

sentence_examples.en: Her behavior at the meeting surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议上的举止让大家吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: We should reward good behavior in class.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们应该奖励课堂上的良好行为。

sentence_examples.en: The robot's behavior changes when it loses power.
sentence_examples.zh: 机器人断电后，其运转情况会改变。

translations.translation: 在...的背后，(遗留)在..后面；落后于

sentence_examples.en: The cat hid behind the sofa.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只猫藏在沙发后面。

sentence_examples.en: We are behind schedule due to the delay.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于延迟，我们的进度落后于计划。

sentence_examples.en: I'm behind you on this.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这件事上，我支持你。

sentence_examples.en: Every living being needs water to survive.
sentence_examples.zh: 每一个生物都需要水来存活。

sentence_examples.en: She is a kind and thoughtful being.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一个善良而体贴的人。

sentence_examples.en: We should respect every being on this planet.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们应该尊重这个星球上的每一个生命。

translations.translation: 信任，相信，信念；信仰，信条

sentence_examples.en: Her belief in herself grew after she passed the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试后，她对自己的信心增强了。

sentence_examples.en: Many people hold the belief that success comes from hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人坚持认为，成功来自努力。

sentence_examples.en: It is my belief that we should help others.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的信念是，我们应该帮助他人。

sentence_examples.en: I believe you did your best.
sentence_examples.zh: 我相信你已经尽力了。

sentence_examples.en: We believe the plan will work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们相信这个计划会成功。

sentence_examples.en: She believes in a higher power.
sentence_examples.zh: 她相信有一种更高的力量。

sentence_examples.en: The school bell rang to signal the end of class.
sentence_examples.zh: 上课铃声响起，表示下课。

sentence_examples.en: She rang the bell to call the students back.
sentence_examples.zh: 她按响铃把学生叫回来。

sentence_examples.en: The church bell chimed every hour.
sentence_examples.zh: 教堂的钟每小时敲响一次。

translations.translation: 肚子，腹部；(像肚子一样)鼓起的部分，膛

sentence_examples.en: My belly felt full after lunch.
sentence_examples.zh: 午饭后，我的肚子感到很饱。

sentence_examples.en: She rubbed her belly and smiled at the baby.
sentence_examples.zh: 她揉着肚子，笑着看着肚里的宝宝。

sentence_examples.en: The baby kicked in her belly.
sentence_examples.zh: 宝宝在她的肚子里踢了一下。

translations.translation: (to)属于,附属,隶属;应归入(类别,范畴等)

sentence_examples.en: These books belong to the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些书属于图书馆。

sentence_examples.en: That old umbrella belongs to my sister.
sentence_examples.zh: 那把旧雨伞属于我姐姐。

sentence_examples.en: These items belong to the fruit category.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些物品属于水果类别。

translations.translation: 受爱戴的,敬爱的;爱人,被心爱的人

sentence_examples.en: Her beloved grandmother lived nearby.
sentence_examples.zh: 她心爱的祖母住在附近。

sentence_examples.en: He wrote a letter to his beloved.
sentence_examples.zh: 他给心爱的人写了一封信。

sentence_examples.en: The beloved singer performed at the charity concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位受人爱戴的歌手在慈善音乐会上演出。

sentence_examples.en: The notes are listed below.
sentence_examples.zh: 注释如下。

sentence_examples.en: The water level is below the danger mark.
sentence_examples.zh: 水位低于危险线。

sentence_examples.en: Prices are below market value.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格低于市场价。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new leather belt.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一条新的皮带。

sentence_examples.en: She tightened her belt before the hike.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在远足前把腰带系紧。

sentence_examples.en: Don't forget to fasten your seat belt.
sentence_examples.zh: 别忘了系好安全带。

sentence_examples.en: I sat on a park bench to rest.
sentence_examples.zh: 我坐在公园的长凳上休息。

sentence_examples.en: He laid out his tools on the workbench in the garage.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把工具摆在车库的工作台上。

sentence_examples.en: The coach called the players to the bench during the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 比赛中，教练把球员们叫到替补席。

sentence_examples.en: You can bend the wire with pliers.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以用钳子把金属丝弯曲。

sentence_examples.en: She wouldn't bend to his demands.
sentence_examples.zh: 她不会屈从于他的要求。

sentence_examples.en: There is a bend in the road ahead.
sentence_examples.zh: 前方的路有一个弯道。

sentence_examples.en: The cat slept beneath the warm blanket.
sentence_examples.zh: 猫蜷在温暖的毯子下睡觉。

sentence_examples.en: The path is hidden beneath a layer of snow.
sentence_examples.zh: 小路被一层雪覆盖。

sentence_examples.en: They found an old note beneath the floorboards.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在地板下面发现了一张旧纸条。

sentence_examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的运动对你的健康有益。

sentence_examples.en: A balanced diet can be beneficial for weight management.
sentence_examples.zh: 均衡饮食对体重管理有益。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy is beneficial to small businesses.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策对小企业有利。

sentence_examples.en: Regular exercise provides many benefits.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的运动带来许多好处。

sentence_examples.en: A balanced diet benefits your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 均衡饮食有益于你的健康。

sentence_examples.en: People can benefit from the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们可以从新政策中受益。

translations.translation: (病)良性的,(气候)良好的,仁慈的,和蔼的

sentence_examples.en: The tumor was found to be benign, so no surgery was needed.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个肿瘤被发现是良性的，因此不需要手术。

sentence_examples.en: The region enjoys a benign climate that supports year-round farming.
sentence_examples.zh: 该地区气候温和，适宜全年进行农业生产。

sentence_examples.en: Her benign demeanor puts people at ease.
sentence_examples.zh: 她和蔼的举止让人感到放松。

sentence_examples.en: The chair is beside the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 椅子在桌子旁边。

sentence_examples.en: She sat beside me on the bus.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在公交车上坐在我旁边。

sentence_examples.en: Beside his achievements, mine seem small.
sentence_examples.zh: 与他的成就相比，我的显得微不足道。

sentence_examples.en: Besides, I don't have time to finish it today.
sentence_examples.zh: 此外，我今天没时间把它做完。

sentence_examples.en: There is nothing besides this book.
sentence_examples.zh: 除了这本书之外，别无其他。

sentence_examples.en: Who else is coming besides you?
sentence_examples.zh: 除了你之外，还有谁要来？

sentence_examples.en: This is the best movie I've seen this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是我今年看过的最好电影。

sentence_examples.en: Among the students, she plays the piano the best.
sentence_examples.zh: 在同学中，她弹钢琴弹得最好。

sentence_examples.en: She did her best to finish on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她尽了最大的努力按时完成。

sentence_examples.en: I bet he will win the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 我打赌他会赢这场比赛。

sentence_examples.en: She bets on horse racing every weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每个周末都在赛马比赛上打赌。

sentence_examples.en: That was a risky bet.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是一笔冒险的赌注。

translations.translation: 背叛,出卖;暴露,流露,泄露

sentence_examples.en: If you reveal her secret, you betray her.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你揭露了她的秘密，你就背叛了她。

sentence_examples.en: Lying to the team would betray their trust.
sentence_examples.zh: 对团队撒谎会背叛他们的信任。

sentence_examples.en: Her calm demeanor betrayed her nervousness.
sentence_examples.zh: 她冷静的表情暴露了她的紧张。

sentence_examples.en: This coffee tastes better than tea.
sentence_examples.zh: 这杯咖啡比茶更好喝。

sentence_examples.en: She did better on the second exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在第二次考试中表现得更好。

sentence_examples.en: The company wants to better its customer service.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司希望提升其客户服务。

sentence_examples.en: The cafe is between the library and the post office.
sentence_examples.zh: 咖啡馆在图书馆和邮局之间。

sentence_examples.en: There is a path between the two trees.
sentence_examples.zh: 两棵树之间有一条小路。

sentence_examples.en: She must choose between coffee and tea.
sentence_examples.zh: 她必须在咖啡和茶之间做出选择。

sentence_examples.en: Please choose a beverage from the menu.
sentence_examples.zh: 请从菜单中选择一种饮料。

sentence_examples.en: The café offers a variety of beverages, including juice and tea.
sentence_examples.zh: 咖啡馆提供各式各样的饮料，包括果汁和茶。

sentence_examples.en: She ordered a cold beverage to quench her thirst.
sentence_examples.zh: 她点了一杯冷饮以解渴。

sentence_examples.en: Beware of pickpockets in crowded areas.
sentence_examples.zh: 在拥挤的地方要当心扒手。

sentence_examples.en: Beware of phishing emails that ask for your password.
sentence_examples.zh: 当心那些要求你输入密码的钓鱼邮件。

sentence_examples.en: The sign read, 'Beware of dog'.
sentence_examples.zh: 牌子上写着“当心狗”。

sentence_examples.en: The complex instructions at first bewildered me.
sentence_examples.zh: 起初，复杂的指令把我弄糊涂了。

sentence_examples.en: The sudden change in plans bewildered the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划的突然变动让团队感到茫然。

sentence_examples.en: He was bewildered by the tax form's complicated questions.
sentence_examples.zh: 他被税表中的复杂问题弄得不知所措。

translations.translation: 在(或向)...的那边，远于；超出

sentence_examples.en: The town lies beyond the hill.
sentence_examples.zh: 城镇在山丘的另一边。

sentence_examples.en: The road goes beyond the forest.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条路越过森林，继续向前。

sentence_examples.en: This task is beyond my abilities.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项任务超出了我的能力。

sentence_examples.zh: 对传统方法的偏见可能限制创新。

sentence_examples.en: The editor's personal bias influenced the article's selection.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑的个人偏见影响了文章的选题。

sentence_examples.en: If the test isn't properly randomized, it could bias the results.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果测试没有进行适当的随机化，可能会使结果产生偏差。

sentence_examples.en: Many people read the Bible every day.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人每天读圣经。

sentence_examples.en: She keeps a Bible on her shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的书架上放着圣经。

sentence_examples.en: The Bible is divided into the Old Testament and the New Testament.
sentence_examples.zh: 圣经分为旧约和新约。

translations.translation: (有关某一专题的)书目；参考书目

sentence_examples.zh: 教授要求我们整理一份关于可再生能源的参考书目。

sentence_examples.zh: 文章末尾附有所引用作品的书目。

sentence_examples.en: She consulted the bibliography to find more studies on the topic.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在书目中找到了关于该主题的更多研究。

sentence_examples.en: I learned to ride a bicycle when I was seven.
sentence_examples.zh: 我七岁时学会了骑自行车。

sentence_examples.en: She keeps her bicycle in the garage.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把自行车放在车库里。

sentence_examples.en: The city opened a new bicycle path.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座城市新开通了一条自行车道。

translations.translation: 祝愿;命令,吩咐;报价,投标

sentence_examples.en: The manager bid the team to focus on safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理命令团队把注意力放在安全上。

sentence_examples.en: She bid $450 for the antique lamp at the auction.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在拍卖会上为那盏古董灯出价450美元。

sentence_examples.en: I bid you good luck as you start your new job.
sentence_examples.zh: 在你开始新工作时，我祝你好运。

translations.translation: 大的；重要的；宽宏大量的；大受欢迎的

sentence_examples.en: The box is big.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个箱子很大。

sentence_examples.en: That decision could have a big impact.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个决定可能产生重大的影响。

sentence_examples.en: The concert was a big hit.
sentence_examples.zh: 那场音乐会大获成功。

translations.translation: 账单;招贴,广告;(人员,职称等的)表;钞票

sentence_examples.en: Could we split the bill?
sentence_examples.zh: 我们可以把账单分摊吗？

sentence_examples.en: She paid with a five-dollar bill.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用一张五美元的钞票付款。

sentence_examples.en: The bill to fund the project was approved.
sentence_examples.zh: 资助该项目的法案已获通过。

sentence_examples.en: The company earned over a billion dollars last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司去年赚了超过十亿美元。

sentence_examples.en: The population is about eight billion people.
sentence_examples.zh: 全球人口约为80亿人。

sentence_examples.en: A billion seconds ago, life was very different.
sentence_examples.zh: 十亿秒前，生活就完全不同。

sentence_examples.en: We store potatoes in a large bin in the pantry.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把土豆放在储藏室里的一个大箱子里。

sentence_examples.en: Please put the bread in the bread bin on the counter.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把面包放在柜台上的面包箱里。

sentence_examples.en: The bin by the fridge holds onions.
sentence_examples.zh: 冰箱旁的箱子里放着洋葱。

sentence_examples.en: She used rope to bind the crates before shipping.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在运送前用绳子把箱子捆起来。

sentence_examples.zh: 合同约束你必须在截止日期前完成该项目。

sentence_examples.zh: 这本书是用皮革装订的。

sentence_examples.en: She is reading a biography of Nelson Mandela.
sentence_examples.zh: 她正在读纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。

sentence_examples.en: The biography covers the subject's early life, career, and achievements.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部传记讲述了人物的早期生活、职业生涯和成就。

sentence_examples.en: Publishers often release biographies that appeal to general readers.
sentence_examples.zh: 出版社经常出版适合普通读者的传记。

sentence_examples.en: In biology class, we learn about cells and DNA.
sentence_examples.zh: 在生物学课上，我们学习细胞和DNA。

sentence_examples.en: Biology helps scientists explain how living things grow and respond to stimuli.
sentence_examples.zh: 生物学帮助科学家解释生物如何生长以及如何对刺激作出反应。

sentence_examples.en: I want to study biology to become a doctor.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想学习生物学，成为一名医生。

sentence_examples.en: A bird sang from the branch outside the window.
sentence_examples.zh: 窗外的树枝上有一只鸟在唱歌。

sentence_examples.en: In Britain, 'bird' is sometimes used as a casual word for a woman.
sentence_examples.zh: 在英国，'bird' 有时被用作对女人的随意称呼。

sentence_examples.en: She is an early bird who arrives at the office before everyone else.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是个早起鸟，总是在别人之前到达办公室。

translations.translation: 出生，诞生；出身，血统；起源；出现

sentence_examples.zh: 她第一个孩子的出生给全家带来了巨大的喜悦。

sentence_examples.en: Birth records are kept at the city hall.
sentence_examples.zh: 出生记录保存在市政厅。

sentence_examples.en: She comes from noble birth.
sentence_examples.zh: 她出身高贵。

sentence_examples.en: Her birthday is next Saturday.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的生日在下周六。

sentence_examples.en: We threw a surprise party for his birthday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们为他的生日办了一个惊喜派对。

sentence_examples.en: When is your birthday?
sentence_examples.zh: 你的生日是哪一天？

sentence_examples.en: She dunked a biscuit into her tea.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把饼干放进茶里蘸着吃。

sentence_examples.en: This biscuit is crunchy on the outside and soft in the middle.
sentence_examples.zh: 这块饼干外脆内软。

sentence_examples.en: Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
sentence_examples.zh: 你要来块饼干配茶吗？

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to bite your tongue.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心别咬到舌头。

sentence_examples.en: I took a bite of the apple.
sentence_examples.zh: 我咬了一口苹果。

sentence_examples.en: I got a bite on my leg from a mosquito.
sentence_examples.zh: 我腿上被蚊子叮了一口。

sentence_examples.en: The coffee tasted bitter.
sentence_examples.zh: 这杯咖啡尝起来很苦。

sentence_examples.en: The medicine left a bitter aftertaste.
sentence_examples.zh: 这药吃完后留下苦味。

sentence_examples.en: The bitter memories of his childhood haunted him.
sentence_examples.zh: 他童年的痛苦记忆一直困扰着他。

translations.translation: 异乎寻常的，稀奇古怪的

sentence_examples.en: That's a bizarre coincidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是一个异乎寻常的巧合。

sentence_examples.en: He wore a bizarre hat at the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在派对上戴着一顶稀奇古怪的帽子。

sentence_examples.en: The film's bizarre plot confused the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影离奇的情节让观众感到困惑。

sentence_examples.en: The car is black.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车是黑色的。

sentence_examples.en: The night was so black that we couldn't see anything.
sentence_examples.zh: 夜晚太黑，我们什么也看不见。

sentence_examples.en: This book discusses the history of Black communities in the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书讨论了这座城市黑人群体的历史。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher wrote the homework on the blackboard.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师在黑板上写作业。

sentence_examples.en: She erased the writing on the blackboard.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把黑板上的字擦掉。

sentence_examples.en: The classroom has a large blackboard at the front.
sentence_examples.zh: 教室前方有一块大黑板。

translations.translation: 讹诈，敲诈，勒索；胁迫，恫吓

sentence_examples.en: The threatening letter was a clear example of blackmail.
sentence_examples.zh: 这封威胁信是典型的勒索案。

sentence_examples.en: Blackmail is illegal in most countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 在大多数国家，勒索是非法的。

sentence_examples.en: She refused to give in to blackmail and reported it to the police.
sentence_examples.zh: 她拒绝屈从于勒索并向警方报案。

translations.translation: 刀刃，刀片；桨叶；草叶，叶片

sentence_examples.en: Be careful with the blade of the knife; it's extremely sharp.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心这把刀的刀刃，它非常锋利。

sentence_examples.en: The blade of the paddle bent after it hit a rock.
sentence_examples.zh: 桨叶在撞到石头后弯曲了。

sentence_examples.en: The blade of grass swayed in the wind.
sentence_examples.zh: 草叶在风中摇摆。

sentence_examples.en: Don't blame me for the mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 别把这次错误怪在我身上。

sentence_examples.en: She blamed her parents for not supporting her dream.
sentence_examples.zh: 她怪父母没支持她的梦想。

sentence_examples.en: The blame for the failure fell on the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 失败的责任落在团队身上。

sentence_examples.en: The page was blank.
sentence_examples.zh: 这页是空白的。

sentence_examples.en: Please fill in the blank on the form.
sentence_examples.zh: 请填写表格中的空白处。

sentence_examples.en: I wrote my name on the blank line.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在空白行写下了我的名字。

translations.translation: 毯子(可数)；厚厚一层(可数)

sentence_examples.en: I pulled the blanket up to my chin.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把毯子拉到下巴处。

sentence_examples.en: The blanket kept him warm on the cold night.
sentence_examples.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚，毯子让他保持温暖。

sentence_examples.en: A thick fog blankets the city in the early morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 清晨，浓雾笼罩着这座城市。

translations.translation: 一阵(风);爆炸冲击波;管乐器声

sentence_examples.zh: 突然的一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

sentence_examples.en: The blast from the explosion shattered the windows.
sentence_examples.zh: 爆炸产生的冲击波震碎了窗户。

sentence_examples.en: The trumpet's blast echoed through the hall.
sentence_examples.zh: 小号的轰鸣声在大厅里回响。

sentence_examples.en: The blaze in the fireplace warmed the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 壁炉里的火焰把房间暖和起来。

sentence_examples.en: The sunset was a blaze of orange and pink.
sentence_examples.zh: 日落是一片橙色和粉色的光辉。

sentence_examples.en: Her eyes blazed with anger.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的眼睛里燃烧着愤怒的火光。

sentence_examples.zh: 今年的就业市场看起来很黯淡。

sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，城镇陷入荒凉的寂静。

sentence_examples.en: He faced a bleak future.
sentence_examples.zh: 他面临着没有希望的未来。

sentence_examples.zh: 如果你切伤了手指，它会出血。

sentence_examples.zh: 我清洗伤口后，伤口又开始流血。

sentence_examples.en: He bled heavily after the injury.
sentence_examples.zh: 受伤后他大量流血。

sentence_examples.en: Blend the tomatoes and herbs in a blender until smooth.
sentence_examples.zh: 把番茄和香草放进搅拌机，搅拌至光滑。

sentence_examples.en: This coffee is a blend of beans from Brazil and Colombia.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是一种来自巴西和哥伦比亚豆子的混合咖啡。

sentence_examples.en: Her voice blends with the choir.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的声音与合唱队融为一体。

sentence_examples.en: A priest will bless the new church during the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 仪式上，牧师会为新教堂进行祝福。

sentence_examples.en: We bless our meals before eating.
sentence_examples.zh: 吃饭前，我们会为这顿饭祝福。

sentence_examples.en: My grandmother always says God bless you when I sneeze.
sentence_examples.zh: 我打喷嚏时，奶奶总会对我说“上帝保佑你”。

sentence_examples.en: She is blind.
sentence_examples.zh: 她看不见。

sentence_examples.en: The accident blinded him.
sentence_examples.zh: 那场事故让他失明。

sentence_examples.zh: 我把百叶窗拉下来挡住太阳。

sentence_examples.zh: 我为这个项目切了一块木头。

sentence_examples.en: Our apartment is on this block.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的公寓就在这个街区。

sentence_examples.en: The road was blocked by a fallen tree.
sentence_examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了路。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor drew a sample of blood for the test.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生为化验抽取了血液样本。

sentence_examples.en: She has many blood relatives in her extended family.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的大家族里有许多血缘亲戚。

sentence_examples.en: He donated blood to the local blood bank.
sentence_examples.zh: 他向当地的血液银行捐献了血液。

sentence_examples.en: The child had a bloody nose after the fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子摔倒后鼻子流血。

sentence_examples.en: The kitchen knife was bloody after the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故后，厨房里的刀子上满是血迹。

sentence_examples.en: The movie had bloody scenes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影有很多血腥场面。

sentence_examples.en: The cherry trees are in full bloom.
sentence_examples.zh: 樱花树正处于盛花期。

sentence_examples.en: If the weather stays warm, the roses will bloom soon.
