sentence_examples.en: The cherry trees blossom in spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 樱花树在春天开花。

sentence_examples.en: The blossoms last for two weeks.
sentence_examples.zh: 花期大约持续两周。

sentence_examples.en: Her career is blossoming after a new opportunity.
sentence_examples.zh: 在新的机会到来后，她的事业开始蓬勃发展。

translations.translation: 女衬衣，短上衣，宽阔的罩衫

sentence_examples.en: She wore a white blouse to the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去面试时穿了一件白色的女衬衫。

sentence_examples.en: The blouse hung loosely over her jeans.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件女衬衫宽松地垂在她的牛仔裤上。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a silk blouse for the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为晚会买了一件丝绸衬衫。

sentence_examples.en: The wind blew the papers off the desk.
sentence_examples.zh: 风把桌上的纸吹走了。

sentence_examples.en: She blew out the candles after singing 'Happy Birthday'.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在唱完生日歌后把蜡烛吹灭了。

sentence_examples.en: They blew up the balloons for the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为派对把气球吹起来。

translations.translation: 蓝色的;青灰色的；沮丧的,阴郁的

sentence_examples.en: The sky is blue.
sentence_examples.zh: 天空是蓝色的。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a blue dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在聚会上穿了一条蓝色的连衣裙。

sentence_examples.en: I'm feeling blue today.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今天感到沮丧。

sentence_examples.en: The architect presented the blueprint for the new library.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位建筑师展示了新图书馆的蓝图。

sentence_examples.en: We need to follow the blueprint to finish the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要按照蓝图在规定时间内完成项目。

sentence_examples.en: The designers blueprinted a new layout for the exhibition.
sentence_examples.zh: 设计师们为展览绘制了新的布局蓝图。

translations.translation: (因无知等而)犯大错;踉踉跄跄地走

sentence_examples.en: I blundered into the meeting and forgot the agenda.
sentence_examples.zh: 我踉跄地闯进了会议，忘记了议程。

sentence_examples.en: Sending the confidential email to the wrong person was a real blunder.
sentence_examples.zh: 把机密邮件发给错误的人真是一个大错。

sentence_examples.en: He blundered through the presentation, mispronouncing several names.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在演讲中磕磕绊绊，读错了几个名字。

sentence_examples.en: Her blunt honesty surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的直率让大家都吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: The knife is blunt and needs sharpening.
sentence_examples.zh: 这把刀钝了，需要磨快。

sentence_examples.en: Constant criticism can blunt your enthusiasm.
sentence_examples.zh: 持续的批评会削弱你的热情。

sentence_examples.en: There was a blur in the corner of the photo.
sentence_examples.zh: 照片角落有一个模糊的区域。

sentence_examples.en: The rain blurred the letters on the sign.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨水把标牌上的字母弄得模糊。

sentence_examples.en: She accidentally blurred the image while cropping.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在裁剪时不小心把图像模糊了。

sentence_examples.en: She blushed when he complimented her.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在他夸奖她时脸红了。

sentence_examples.en: A light blush spread across her cheeks.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的脸颊上泛起一抹淡淡的红晕。

sentence_examples.en: Don't blush, it's just a joke.
sentence_examples.zh: 别脸红，那只是个玩笑。

sentence_examples.en: I used a rough wooden board as a makeshift shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把一块粗糙的木板当作临时的架子。

sentence_examples.en: We will board the plane at gate 12.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将在12号登机口登机。

sentence_examples.en: The school board approved the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校董事会批准了新政策。

sentence_examples.en: She likes to boast about her achievements.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢夸耀自己的成就。

sentence_examples.en: He boasted about his scores to everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 他向每个人吹嘘他的分数。

sentence_examples.en: That boast about his wealth annoyed his friends.
sentence_examples.zh: 他关于自己财富的自夸让朋友们恼火。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们乘船穿过湖面。

sentence_examples.zh: 在平静的水面上，船轻轻摇晃。

sentence_examples.en: She rented a boat for the afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 她租了一艘船度过一个下午。

translations.translation: 身体,本体;主体;尸体;物体;(一)群,批,堆

sentence_examples.zh: 她每天锻炼以保持身体健康。

sentence_examples.en: The car's body was damaged in the crash.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故中车身受损。

sentence_examples.en: The student body voted to change the rule.
sentence_examples.zh: 全体学生投票决定修改规则。

sentence_examples.en: Bring the water to a boil before you add the pasta.
sentence_examples.zh: 在加入意大利面之前，把水煮沸。

sentence_examples.en: Turn up the heat and let the soup boil for ten minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 调大火，让汤煮沸十分钟。

sentence_examples.en: She boils eggs every Sunday.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每个星期日都煮鸡蛋。

translations.translation: 大胆的,勇敢的;冒失的;黑体的,粗体的

sentence_examples.zh: 她下了一个大胆的决定，创办自己的公司。

sentence_examples.en: He wore a bold red jacket to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 他穿着一件大胆的红色外套去参加聚会。

sentence_examples.en: The headline is in bold.
sentence_examples.zh: 标题是粗体字。

sentence_examples.zh: 我拧紧自行车车把上的螺栓，防止它摇晃。

sentence_examples.zh: 她离开家前把门闩上。

sentence_examples.en: The gate is secured with a sturdy bolt.
sentence_examples.zh: 大门用一个结实的闩锁固定。

sentence_examples.en: The police found a bomb under the bridge.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方在桥下发现了一枚炸弹。

sentence_examples.en: The plane bombed the coastal town at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机在黎明时分轰炸了沿海城镇。

sentence_examples.en: The comedian bombed on stage last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位喜剧演员昨晚在舞台上表演惨淡。

translations.translation: 结合(物),粘结(剂),联结;公债,债券,契约

sentence_examples.zh: 额外的资金为项目带来了一股推动力。

sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一双新的靴子来远足。

sentence_examples.zh: 她昨天从图书馆借了一本书。

sentence_examples.zh: 她惊讶地把手按在胸口。

sentence_examples.zh: 我的老板今天批准了这个项目。

sentence_examples.zh: 我没有费心去读那封电子邮件。

sentence_examples.zh: 我在商店买了一个玻璃瓶来装水。

sentence_examples.zh: 她把自制柠檬水装进干净的瓶子里。

sentence_examples.en: We need a bottle of olive oil.

sentence_examples.zh: 杯子的底部有污渍。

sentence_examples.zh: 篱笆标示了田地的边界。

sentence_examples.zh: 这道篱笆标记着两块地产之间的边界。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们走到森林的边界就折返了。

sentence_examples.en: Please stay within your personal boundaries.
sentence_examples.zh: 请保持在你的个人边界内。

sentence_examples.zh: 她向主人鞠躬以示感谢。

sentence_examples.zh: 射箭手拉起弓，瞄准靶子。

sentence_examples.zh: 她在礼物上系了一个蓝色蝴蝶结。

sentence_examples.en: He's a brilliant young scientist who has won several awards.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是一位才华横溢的年轻科学家，已获得多项奖项。

sentence_examples.en: The brim of her hat shaded her face.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的帽沿遮住了脸。

sentence_examples.en: She adjusted the brim of her hat to see better.
sentence_examples.zh: 她调整帽沿以便看清楚。

sentence_examples.en: There was a small chip on the brim of the hat.
sentence_examples.zh: 帽沿上有一小块缺口。

translations.translation: 拿来，带来；产生，引起；使处于某状态

sentence_examples.en: Please bring your assignment to class.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把作业带到课堂上。

sentence_examples.en: New evidence might bring about a breakthrough in the case.
sentence_examples.zh: 新的证据可能为案件带来突破。

sentence_examples.en: Cold weather can bring on a sore throat.
sentence_examples.zh: 寒冷的天气可能引发喉咙痛。

translations.translation: 轻快的;生气勃勃的;兴隆的

sentence_examples.en: The brisk wind cooled us down on the hike.
sentence_examples.zh: 徒步时，轻快的风让我们感到凉爽。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a brisk nod and walked to the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 她干脆利落地点了点头，走向门口。

sentence_examples.en: Business is brisk at the market today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天市场上的生意很兴隆。

translations.translation: 易碎的；脆弱的；冷淡的；(声音)尖利的

sentence_examples.en: The glass vase is brittle and can break easily.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个玻璃花瓶很易碎，容易碎裂。

sentence_examples.en: Her bones have become brittle from years of illness.
sentence_examples.zh: 多年疾病让她的骨头变得脆弱。

sentence_examples.en: The relationship between them is brittle and could break after one argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们之间的关系很脆弱，一次争吵就可能破裂。

translations.translation: 宽的,广阔的;广大的;宽宏的,豁达的

sentence_examples.en: The road is broad and smooth.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条路又宽又平滑。

sentence_examples.en: She has a broad knowledge of world history.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对世界历史有广泛的知识。

sentence_examples.en: He gave a broad smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 他露出灿烂的笑容。

sentence_examples.en: The TV station will broadcast the news at 7 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 电视台将在晚上7点播出新闻。

sentence_examples.en: The company is planning a live broadcast of the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司正在计划对会议进行现场直播。

sentence_examples.en: This channel broadcasts children's programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个频道播出儿童节目。

sentence_examples.en: Please grab a brochure from the information desk to learn about our programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在信息台拿一份小册子，了解我们的项目。

sentence_examples.en: The conference brochure lists speakers, schedules, and session topics.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议小册子列出了演讲者、日程和议题。

sentence_examples.en: We mailed a brochure to prospective clients last week.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们上周把小册子寄给了潜在客户。

translations.translation: 青铜；青铜色，古铜色；青铜制品，铜牌

sentence_examples.en: The statue is made of bronze.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕像是青铜制成的。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a bronze bracelet that caught the light.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戴着一只青铜手镯，在灯光下闪闪发光。

sentence_examples.en: He won a bronze medal in the race.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在比赛中获得了铜牌。

translations.translation: [常用于否定句或疑问句]容忍

sentence_examples.en: We walked along the brook by the meadow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们沿着草地边的小溪走着。

sentence_examples.en: Children played by the brook after school.
sentence_examples.zh: 放学后，孩子们在小溪边玩耍。

sentence_examples.en: I cannot brook any more delays.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不能再容忍任何拖延。

sentence_examples.en: I swept the kitchen floor with a broom.
sentence_examples.zh: 我用扫帚清扫厨房地面。

sentence_examples.en: The broom is by the closet.
sentence_examples.zh: 扫帚放在壁橱旁边。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a new broom to sweep the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一把新扫帚来打扫房间。

sentence_examples.en: My brother and I share a birthday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的兄弟和我同一天生日。

sentence_examples.en: She treats him like a brother.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把他当成兄弟一样对待。

sentence_examples.en: He joined the church and became a brother to many.
sentence_examples.zh: 他加入教会，成为许多人的兄弟。

sentence_examples.en: Her brow furrowed as she read the note.
sentence_examples.zh: 她读着便条时，眉头紧皱。

sentence_examples.en: He wiped sweat from his brow.
sentence_examples.zh: 他擦去额头上的汗水。

sentence_examples.en: A furrow appeared in his brow.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的眉头上出现了一道皱纹。

sentence_examples.en: The cat has brown fur.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只猫有棕色的毛皮。

sentence_examples.en: He painted the door brown.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把门漆成棕色。

sentence_examples.en: There is a brown stain on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有一块棕色的污渍。

translations.translation: 随意翻阅，浏览；(牛、羊等)吃草

sentence_examples.en: I like to browse the latest articles online in the morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢在早上上网浏览最新文章。

sentence_examples.en: She sat in the library, browsing through the catalog for a reference.
sentence_examples.zh: 她坐在图书馆里翻阅目录寻找参考书。

sentence_examples.en: Cattle browse on the meadow, eating grass.
sentence_examples.zh: 牛群在草地上吃草。

sentence_examples.en: She got a bruise on her arm after the fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她跌倒后手臂上出现了一个青肿。

sentence_examples.en: If you bump into the table, you might bruise your shoulder.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你撞到桌子，可能会挫伤肩膀。

sentence_examples.en: The athlete had a bruise on his knee after the slide.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名运动员在滑倒后膝盖上出现了一个青肿。

sentence_examples.en: I used a stiff brush to clean the kitchen floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 我用一把硬毛刷清洁厨房地板。

sentence_examples.en: The artist chose a fine brush for painting.
sentence_examples.zh: 画家选用一支细画笔进行绘画。

sentence_examples.en: He brushed past me in the hallway.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在走廊里从我身边擦过去。

sentence_examples.en: The hike was brutal in the heat.
sentence_examples.zh: 在炎热的天气里，这次徒步异常艰难。

sentence_examples.en: The exam was brutal.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试异常艰难。

sentence_examples.en: He faced brutal criticism after his speech.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲之后，他遭到了严厉的批评。

sentence_examples.en: The soup started to bubble as it warmed on the stove.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤在炉子上加热时开始冒泡。

sentence_examples.en: A bubble floated to the surface of the pond.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个气泡浮到池塘表面。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd bubbled with excitement at the news.
sentence_examples.zh: 消息传来时，人群兴奋地沸腾起来。

sentence_examples.en: I filled the bucket with water.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把水桶装满了水。

sentence_examples.en: Please bring the bucket from the shed.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把水桶从棚子里拿来。

sentence_examples.en: We used a bucket to carry water from the well.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用水桶从井里提水。

sentence_examples.en: The plant has a new bud at the tip of the stem.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物茎尖长出了一个新芽。

sentence_examples.en: Tree buds are swelling in early spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 树上的花苞在早春膨胀。

sentence_examples.en: The plant will bud soon.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物很快就会发芽。

sentence_examples.en: We need to set a budget for the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要为这个项目设定预算。

sentence_examples.en: The city is cutting the budget for public services this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府今年在削减公共服务预算。

sentence_examples.en: I budget $200 for groceries each month.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每月为杂货设定 200 美元的预算。

sentence_examples.en: We went to the hotel breakfast buffet.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们去了酒店的早餐自助餐。

sentence_examples.en: The buffet offered a wide range of dishes.
sentence_examples.zh: 自助餐提供了丰富的菜肴。

sentence_examples.en: Guests serve themselves at the buffet.
sentence_examples.zh: 客人们在自助餐处自助取餐。

sentence_examples.en: A bug crawled across the kitchen counter.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个臭虫爬过厨房台面。

sentence_examples.en: There is a bug in the software that causes it to crash.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款软件有一个小毛病，会导致它崩溃。

sentence_examples.en: The investigators bugged the room to listen in.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查人员在房间里安装了窃听器以监听。

sentence_examples.en: They plan to build a new library next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们计划明年建一座新图书馆。

sentence_examples.en: We need to build up our savings before the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 在出行前，我们需要积累一定的储蓄。

sentence_examples.en: The team built rapport with the client through regular meetings.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队通过定期会面与客户建立了关系。

sentence_examples.en: The building is over 100 years old.
sentence_examples.zh: 这栋建筑已经有百余年历史。

sentence_examples.en: We entered the building through the main entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们从正门进入了这座建筑。

sentence_examples.en: A new building is going up on the site.
sentence_examples.zh: 现场正在兴建一座新建筑。

sentence_examples.en: The bulb in the ceiling fixture burned out.
sentence_examples.zh: 天花板灯里的灯泡烧坏了。

sentence_examples.en: She planted a bulb in the garden for next spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在花园里种下了一个郁金香球茎，为来年春天开花做准备。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to touch the bulb when it's hot.
sentence_examples.zh: 灯泡热的时候小心不要碰它。

translations.translation: 体积,容积;主体,大批,大量,大块

sentence_examples.en: The bulk of the project was completed in the first week.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目的大部分工作在第一周内完成。

sentence_examples.en: We save money by buying in bulk.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通过大宗购买节省了钱。

sentence_examples.en: The bulk of the cargo is stored in the warehouse.
sentence_examples.zh: 大部分货物存放在仓库里。

sentence_examples.en: The bull charged toward the fence.
sentence_examples.zh: 公牛朝着栅栏冲来。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer kept the bull in a sturdy pen.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民把公牛关在坚固的围栏里。

sentence_examples.en: We saw a bull in the field this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天早上我们在田野里看到了公牛。

sentence_examples.en: The marksman loaded a bullet into the chamber.
sentence_examples.zh: 神枪手把一发子弹装进枪膛。

sentence_examples.en: A bullet travels at high speed and can cause serious injury.
sentence_examples.zh: 子弹以高速飞行，可能造成严重伤害。

sentence_examples.en: The bullet pierced the wall.
sentence_examples.zh: 子弹穿透了墙壁。

sentence_examples.en: The town issued a bulletin about road closures this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 小镇发布了关于本周末道路封闭的公告。

sentence_examples.en: Read the safety bulletin before you start the experiment.
sentence_examples.zh: 在开始实验前，请阅读安全公告。

sentence_examples.en: The department sends a weekly bulletin with updates on projects.
sentence_examples.zh: 该部门每周发布一份关于项目进展的公告。

sentence_examples.en: The bully at school often picks on younger students.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校里的那个恃强欺弱者经常欺负年纪更小的学生。

sentence_examples.en: Don't bully others because of their clothes.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要因为衣着而欺负别人。

sentence_examples.en: She warned him not to bully his sister.
sentence_examples.zh: 她警告他不要欺负妹妹。

sentence_examples.en: I bumped into an old friend at the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在图书馆偶遇到一位老朋友。

sentence_examples.en: The car bumped along the rough road.
sentence_examples.zh: 汽车在崎岖的路面颠簸前进。

sentence_examples.en: There was a bump in the road and I almost dropped my bag.
sentence_examples.zh: 路上有一个颠簸，我差点儿把包掉落。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a bunch of bananas at the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在市场买了一串香蕉。

sentence_examples.en: Could you hand me that bunch of keys on the table?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能把桌子上的那一串钥匙递给我吗？

sentence_examples.en: There was a bunch of flowers on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有一束花。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a bundle of carrots at the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在市场买了一捆胡萝卜。

sentence_examples.en: She handed me a bundle of receipts.
sentence_examples.zh: 她递给我一捆收据。

sentence_examples.en: We need to bundle the cables before shipping.
sentence_examples.zh: 在发货前，我们需要把电缆捆起来。

sentence_examples.en: Carrying the burden of debt, she struggled to make ends meet.
sentence_examples.zh: 背负债务的重担让她难以维持生计。

sentence_examples.en: The new regulations burden small businesses with extra paperwork.
sentence_examples.zh: 新规定让小企业承担了额外的文书工作。

sentence_examples.en: He refused to burden his friends with his problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 他拒绝把自己的问题带给朋友们。

sentence_examples.en: She went to the city planning bureau to apply for a building permit.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去城市规划局申请建筑许可。

sentence_examples.en: The bureau released new guidelines for food safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 该局发布了食品安全的新指南。

sentence_examples.en: We filed the complaint with the tax bureau.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把投诉提交给税务局。

translations.translation: 官僚主义，官僚机构；(非民选的)委任官员

sentence_examples.en: The company is bogged down by bureaucracy.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司因官僚体制拖慢了进度。

sentence_examples.en: The department is full of red tape and bureaucracy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个部门充满繁文缭节和官僚主义。

sentence_examples.en: Reforming the bureaucracy can improve the delivery of public services.
sentence_examples.zh: 改革官僚体制可以改善公共服务的提供。

sentence_examples.en: The burglar sneaked into the house through an open window.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个窃贼从开着的窗户溜进了房子。

sentence_examples.en: A burglar was caught on camera stealing jewelry.
sentence_examples.zh: 窃贼被监控摄像头拍到正在偷珠宝。

sentence_examples.en: If you hear a burglar alarm, don't confront him.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果听到防盗警报，请不要与窃贼对峙。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to burn the toast.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心别把吐司烧焦。

sentence_examples.en: The campfire burned brightly all night.
sentence_examples.zh: 篝火整夜都烧得很旺。

sentence_examples.en: I got a burn on my finger from the hot kettle.
sentence_examples.zh: 我被热水壶烫伤了手指。

sentence_examples.en: The pipe burst after the water pressure rose.
sentence_examples.zh: 水压升高后，管道爆裂。

sentence_examples.en: There was a burst of laughter in the audience after the joke.
sentence_examples.zh: 笑话讲完后，观众席上突然爆发出一阵笑声。

sentence_examples.en: The sun burst through the clouds.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳穿透云层。

sentence_examples.en: The archaeologists found artifacts buried beneath the ruins.
sentence_examples.zh: 考古学家在废墟下发现了被埋藏的文物。

sentence_examples.en: They decided to bury the treasure in the garden and mark the spot.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们决定把宝藏埋在花园里并标记地点。

sentence_examples.en: She buried her disappointment and kept working.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把失望埋在心里，继续工作。

translations.translation: 公共汽车，总线，信息通路

sentence_examples.en: I waited at the bus stop for ten minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在公交车站等了十分钟。

sentence_examples.en: The bus comes every 15 minutes on weekdays.
sentence_examples.zh: 工作日每15分钟一班公交车。

sentence_examples.en: The city announced that a new bus route will open next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府宣布下个月将开通一条新的公交线路。

sentence_examples.en: The garden has several tall bushes along the path.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园小径两旁有几棵高大的灌木。

sentence_examples.en: A bush swayed in the wind, blocking part of the trail.
sentence_examples.zh: 一棵灌木在风中摇摆，挡住了小路的一部分。

sentence_examples.en: She trimmed the bush to keep it neat.
sentence_examples.zh: 她修剪灌木以保持整洁。

translations.translation: 商业,生意;事务,业务,职责

sentence_examples.en: I'm starting a small business with my friend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我和朋友正在创办一家小生意。

sentence_examples.en: This deal is good for our business.
sentence_examples.zh: 这笔交易对我们的生意有利。

sentence_examples.en: He left the business to pursue his passion.
sentence_examples.zh: 他离开了这项业务去追求自己的热情。

translations.translation: 忙，忙碌的；热闹的，繁忙的；(电话)占线

sentence_examples.en: I'm busy with work right now.
sentence_examples.zh: 我现在忙于工作。

sentence_examples.en: The street is busy on weekend mornings.
sentence_examples.zh: 周末早晨街上很热闹。

sentence_examples.en: The phone line is busy.
sentence_examples.zh: 电话线路占线。

sentence_examples.en: I wanted to go, but it started to rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想去，但下雨了。

sentence_examples.en: But for the traffic, we would have arrived earlier.
sentence_examples.zh: 要不是交通堵塞，我们本来会更早到达。

sentence_examples.en: There is but one way to solve this.
sentence_examples.zh: 只有一种方法可以解决这个问题。

sentence_examples.en: The butcher sold fresh beef this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位屠夫今早卖的牛肉很新鲜。

sentence_examples.en: I need to find a new butcher for our weekly meat order.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要找一位新的屠夫来处理我们每周的肉类订单。

sentence_examples.en: The butcher wrapped the meat in brown paper.
sentence_examples.zh: 屠夫把肉用棕色纸包好。

sentence_examples.en: I spread butter on my toast every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天早上把黄油抹在吐司上。

sentence_examples.en: Butter is a common ingredient in baking.
sentence_examples.zh: 黄油是烘焙中的常见原料。

sentence_examples.en: Could you butter the bread for me?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能给面包抹黄油吗？

sentence_examples.en: A butterfly landed on the flower.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只蝴蝶落在花上。

sentence_examples.en: I saw a butterfly in the garden this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天早晨我在花园里看到了一只蝴蝶。

sentence_examples.en: This butterfly has bright colors.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只蝴蝶颜色很鲜艳。

sentence_examples.en: Press the button to start the machine.
sentence_examples.zh: 按下按钮以启动机器。

sentence_examples.en: The red button is for emergencies.
sentence_examples.zh: 红色按钮用于紧急情况。

sentence_examples.en: She buttoned up her coat before going outside.
sentence_examples.zh: 她出门前把外套扣上。

sentence_examples.en: I plan to buy a new laptop this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我计划这个周末买一台新笔记本电脑。

sentence_examples.en: The politician tried to buy votes with gifts.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位政治家试图用礼物收买选票。

sentence_examples.en: She bought groceries on the way home.
sentence_examples.zh: 她回家的路上买了些杂货。

sentence_examples.en: The cake was baked by my sister.
sentence_examples.zh: 蛋糕是我妹妹做的。

sentence_examples.en: We travel to the city by train.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们乘火车去城里。

sentence_examples.en: The shop is by the station.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家店就在车站旁边。

sentence_examples.en: We had to bypass the construction zone on the highway.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们不得不绕过高速公路上的施工区。

sentence_examples.en: The city opened a new bypass to reduce downtown traffic.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府新建了一条绕城公路，以缓解市区交通。

sentence_examples.en: If the main door is closed, you can bypass it by using the side entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果正门关着，你可以通过侧门进入，从而绕过它。

translations.translation: 出租车，出租马车；驾驶室

sentence_examples.en: I hailed a cab outside the station.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在车站外打了一辆出租车。

sentence_examples.en: The cab pulled away as I climbed into the back seat.
sentence_examples.zh: 我爬进后座时，出租车就开走了。

sentence_examples.en: We cabbed to the airport because the train was delayed.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为火车晚点，我们打车去机场。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a head of cabbage at the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在市场买了一头卷心菜。

sentence_examples.en: Shredded cabbage adds crunch to coleslaw.
sentence_examples.zh: 切碎的卷心菜让卷心菜沙拉更脆。
