sentence_examples.en: The report provides a comprehensive overview of the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告对市场进行了全面的概述。

sentence_examples.en: We need a comprehensive plan to address all safety concerns.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要一份全面的计划来解决所有安全问题。

sentence_examples.en: Her comprehensive knowledge covers many areas of the subject.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对该学科有全面的知识，涵盖了许多领域。

translations.translation: 压紧，压缩；(把思想、文字等)浓缩

sentence_examples.en: You can compress the file to save disk space.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以压缩该文件以节省磁盘空间。

sentence_examples.en: She compressed her long article into a short summary.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把长篇文章浓缩成一个简短的摘要。

sentence_examples.en: The software compresses images without losing much detail.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件在不损失太多细节的情况下压缩图像。

translations.translation: 包含，包括，由...组成；构成，组成

sentence_examples.en: The team comprises players from five countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 该团队由来自五个国家的球员组成。

sentence_examples.en: The package comprises three books and a CD.
sentence_examples.zh: 该包裹包含三本书和一张光盘。

sentence_examples.en: The course comprises several modules.
sentence_examples.zh: 该课程由若干模块组成。

sentence_examples.en: A compromise was reached after hours of negotiation.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数小时的谈判，达成了妥协。

sentence_examples.en: We should compromise a little on the design to meet the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了赶在截止日期前完成，我们需要在设计上作出一些妥协。

sentence_examples.en: He refused to compromise his principles for a promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 他拒绝为了升职而牺牲原则。

translations.translation: 必须做的，强制性的，(课程)必修的

sentence_examples.en: In many countries, education until a certain age is compulsory.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多国家，义务教育到一定年龄是强制性的。

sentence_examples.en: Physical education is compulsory for all students in year 10.
sentence_examples.zh: 十年级所有学生都必须修体育课。

sentence_examples.en: Some courses are compulsory; others are optional.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些课程是必修的，其他课程则是选修的。

sentence_examples.en: We need to compute the total cost before placing the order.
sentence_examples.zh: 在下单前，我们需要把总成本计算出来。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers use simulations to compute the probability of outcomes.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员使用仿真来计算结果的概率。

sentence_examples.en: A calculator can compute the answer in seconds.
sentence_examples.zh: 计算器几秒钟就能算出答案。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new computer yesterday to help me with my work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我昨天买了一台新电脑来帮助我工作。

sentence_examples.en: This computer runs Windows 11 and starts programs quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台电脑运行 Windows 11，启动程序很快。

sentence_examples.en: She uses her computer to study online courses.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用电脑学习在线课程。

sentence_examples.en: The veteran introduced his comrade to the guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 老兵把他的同志介绍给来宾。

sentence_examples.en: In the old days, party members would call each other comrade.
sentence_examples.zh: 在过去，党员彼此称为同志。

sentence_examples.en: She treats her lab partner as a comrade who shares her goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把实验室伙伴视为与她志同道合的同志。

sentence_examples.en: She tried to conceal her disappointment after the test.
sentence_examples.zh: 她试图掩饰考试后的失望。

sentence_examples.en: The thief concealed the stolen jewelry in a bag.
sentence_examples.zh: 小偷把被盗的珠宝藏在一个包里。

sentence_examples.en: He concealed his true feelings behind a smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把真实的感受藏在笑容背后。

translations.translation: 承认；容许；(比赛结束前)认输；退让

sentence_examples.en: The spokesperson conceded that the policy had flaws.
sentence_examples.zh: 发言人承认该政策存在缺陷。

sentence_examples.en: The government conceded ground on tax reform.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府在税改问题上让步了一些。

sentence_examples.en: After trailing for most of the game, the team conceded defeat.
sentence_examples.zh: 在大部分比赛时间落后后，球队认输了。

translations.translation: (of)设想,构思,想象;以为;怀胎,怀有

sentence_examples.en: It's hard to conceive a workable plan without more data.
sentence_examples.zh: 没有更多数据，很难构想出一个可行的计划。

sentence_examples.en: I can't conceive that he would do such a thing.
sentence_examples.zh: 我无法想象他会做出这样的事。

sentence_examples.en: The couple conceived a child after several months of trying.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对夫妇在努力了几个月后怀上了孩子。

sentence_examples.en: I need to concentrate on my homework tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今晚需要专心做作业。

sentence_examples.en: You can concentrate the juice by boiling off the water.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以通过把水煮掉来浓缩果汁。

sentence_examples.en: I added orange concentrate to the smoothie.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在奶昔里加了橙汁浓缩物。

translations.translation: 专心，专注；集中，集结；浓度

sentence_examples.en: Her concentration on the task improved after a short break.
sentence_examples.zh: 短暂休息后，她对任务的专注力提高了。

sentence_examples.en: We adjusted the concentration of the solution to 5%.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把溶液的浓度调整到5%。

sentence_examples.en: There was a concentration of protesters outside the building.
sentence_examples.zh: 大楼外聚集着大量的抗议者。

sentence_examples.en: The concept of gravity explains why objects fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 重力的概念解释了物体为什么会下落。

sentence_examples.en: She struggled to understand the concept behind the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她很难理解这项新政策背后的概念。

sentence_examples.en: We need to clarify the main concept before we start.
sentence_examples.zh: 在开始之前，我们需要先明确主要概念。

sentence_examples.en: This issue concerns everyone in the community.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题关系到社区的每一个人。

sentence_examples.en: I am concerned about your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 我担心你的健康。

sentence_examples.en: The safety of passengers is our main concern.
sentence_examples.zh: 乘客的安全是我们最主要的关切。

sentence_examples.en: I have a few questions concerning the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对这份报告有一些问题。

sentence_examples.en: There were no issues concerning safety procedures.
sentence_examples.zh: 在安全程序方面没有问题。

sentence_examples.en: She sent an email concerning the upcoming conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 她发了一封关于即将举行的会议的邮件。

translations.translation: 音乐会,演奏会;一齐,一致

sentence_examples.en: We bought tickets to the concert downtown.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在市中心买了音乐会的门票。

sentence_examples.en: The orchestra sounded perfect during the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会期间，管弦乐团的演奏非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: The two groups acted in concert to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两组人为了完成项目而共同协作。

sentence_examples.en: The city granted a concession to a private company to operate the riverfront.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府授予一家私营公司经营河滨区域的特许经营权。

sentence_examples.en: She made a concession by admitting she was wrong.
sentence_examples.zh: 她承认自己错了，这是一个让步。

sentence_examples.en: The theater offers concession prices for students.
sentence_examples.zh: 剧院为学生提供优惠票价。

sentence_examples.en: Please keep your report concise and to the point.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把你的报告写得简明扼要。

sentence_examples.en: A concise summary helps readers understand the main idea quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个简明的摘要能帮助读者快速理解要点。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a concise answer that satisfied everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给出了一个简洁的回答，令大家满意。

translations.translation: 结束,终止;断定,下结论;缔结,议定

sentence_examples.en: We concluded the meeting after two hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在两小时后结束了会议。

sentence_examples.en: From the evidence, we can conclude that he is guilty.
sentence_examples.zh: 根据证据，我们可以断定他有罪。

sentence_examples.en: The company concluded a deal with a new partner.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司与新伙伴达成了一项协议。

translations.translation: 结论，推论；结尾；缔结，议定

sentence_examples.en: The scientist published his conclusion after years of experiments.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过多年的实验，该科学家发表了他的结论。

sentence_examples.en: We must avoid drawing premature conclusions from this data.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须避免从这些数据中得出草率的结论。

sentence_examples.en: In conclusion, the project has achieved all its goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 总之，该项目已实现了所有目标。

sentence_examples.en: The plan needs more concrete details before we can approve it.
sentence_examples.zh: 在批准前，该计划需要更具体的细节。

sentence_examples.en: The workers poured concrete to form the foundation.
sentence_examples.zh: 工人们浇筑混凝土以形成地基。

sentence_examples.en: They will concrete the driveway next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们计划下周用混凝土修筑车道。

translations.translation: 谴责,指责;判刑,宣告有罪

sentence_examples.en: The council condemned the proposal as harmful to the community.
sentence_examples.zh: 理事会谴责该提案，认为对社区有害。

sentence_examples.en: The court condemned him to ten years in prison.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院判处他十年监禁。

sentence_examples.en: Many critics condemned the government's decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多批评者谴责政府的决定。

translations.translation: (使)冷凝，(使)凝结；浓缩，压缩，简缩

sentence_examples.en: Steam condenses into water on a cold surface.
sentence_examples.zh: 蒸汽在冷表面上会凝结成水。

sentence_examples.en: We need to condense this article into a two-page summary.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要把这篇文章浓缩成两页摘要。

sentence_examples.en: This method condenses a lot of information into a few key points.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种方法把大量信息浓缩成几个要点。

sentence_examples.en: The road conditions are poor after the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨后，道路状况不佳。

sentence_examples.en: You must meet the conditions to join the club.
sentence_examples.zh: 加入俱乐部必须满足条件。

sentence_examples.en: The coach conditioned the players for the upcoming tournament.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练为即将到来的比赛对球员进行了训练。

translations.translation: 引导;管理;指挥(乐队);传导

sentence_examples.en: Her conduct during the interview was very professional.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在面试过程中的行为非常专业。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers conduct experiments to test the hypothesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员进行实验以检验假设。

sentence_examples.en: She conducts the orchestra with great precision.
sentence_examples.zh: 她以高超的技艺指挥乐队。

translations.translation: 管理者；(汽车)售票员；领队；导体

sentence_examples.en: The bus conductor collected fares from passengers.
sentence_examples.zh: 公交车售票员向乘客收取车费。

sentence_examples.en: The conductor of the orchestra raised the baton.
sentence_examples.zh: 乐队的指挥举起指挥棒。

sentence_examples.en: Copper is a good electrical conductor.
sentence_examples.zh: 铜是良好的导体。

translations.translation: 商讨；授予，颁给(勋衔，学位等)

sentence_examples.en: The committee will confer on the best way to allocate the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会将就预算分配的最佳方式进行商谈。

sentence_examples.en: The university conferred an honorary degree on the renowned author.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学向这位知名作者授予了荣誉学位。

sentence_examples.en: They conferred with the architect before finalizing the plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在最终敲定计划前与建筑师进行了商谈。

sentence_examples.en: I will attend a conference on climate change next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 我下个月将参加一场关于气候变化的正式会议。

sentence_examples.en: The conference room on the third floor can seat about 20 people.
sentence_examples.zh: 三楼的会议室可以容纳大约20人。

sentence_examples.en: She is preparing for a conference call.
sentence_examples.zh: 她正在为电话会议做准备。

sentence_examples.en: After hours of questioning, she finally confessed to the crime.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数小时的讯问后，她终于承认了罪行。

sentence_examples.en: He confessed his love to her in a shy voice.
sentence_examples.zh: 他羞怯地向她表白了爱意。

sentence_examples.en: The child confessed to breaking the vase.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子承认打碎了花瓶。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke with confidence about her plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对自己的计划充满自信。

sentence_examples.en: We have confidence in your ability to succeed.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们对你成功的能力充满信心。

sentence_examples.en: Please keep this information in confidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 请将此信息保密。

sentence_examples.en: She is confident of her ability to finish the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对自己按时完成项目的能力很有信心。

sentence_examples.en: He is confident in his team's plan to solve the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对团队解决问题的计划很有信心。

sentence_examples.en: They are confident that they can win the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们相信自己能够赢得这份合同。

translations.translation: 秘(机)密的；表信任的；担任机密工作的

sentence_examples.en: The contract contains confidential terms that only executives can see.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同包含只有高管才能查看的机密条款。

sentence_examples.en: Please keep this file confidential and do not share it with anyone outside the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 请将此文件保密，不要向团队外的任何人透露。

sentence_examples.en: She was given a confidential assignment to handle sensitive data.
sentence_examples.zh: 她被分配了一项需要处理敏感数据的机密任务。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor advised confining the patient to bed rest for a few days.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生建议将病人卧床休息几天。

sentence_examples.en: The museum confines its exhibits to the main hall.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆把展品限定在主展厅内。

sentence_examples.en: During quarantine, people were confined to their homes.
sentence_examples.zh: 隔离期间，人们被限制在家中。

translations.translation: 使更坚固,使更坚定;(进一步)证实;确认

sentence_examples.en: We need more data to confirm the results.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要更多数据来证实结果。

sentence_examples.en: Please confirm your attendance for the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 请确认您是否参加会议。

sentence_examples.en: The committee confirmed the plan yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会昨天确认了该计划。

sentence_examples.en: There was a conflict between the two teams over the rules.
sentence_examples.zh: 两队在规则上发生了冲突。

sentence_examples.en: The policy created a conflict with local traditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策与当地传统发生了冲突。

sentence_examples.en: The schedule conflicts with my vacation plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 日程与我的假期计划冲突。

sentence_examples.en: Employees must conform to the company's dress code.
sentence_examples.zh: 员工必须遵守公司的着装规定。

sentence_examples.en: The device must conform to international safety standards.
sentence_examples.zh: 该设备必须符合国际安全标准。

sentence_examples.en: Some people refuse to conform to social norms and may face criticism.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人拒绝遵守社会规范，可能会受到批评。

translations.translation: 使面临,使遭遇;面对(危险等)

sentence_examples.en: The company must confront its past mistakes.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司必须正视过去的错误。

sentence_examples.en: She confronted her fear of public speaking during the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在演讲过程中直面了公开演讲的恐惧。

sentence_examples.en: The protesters confronted the guards at the entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 抗议者在入口处与警卫对峙。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher's explanation confused many students.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师的讲解让许多学生感到困惑。

sentence_examples.en: Don't confuse these two words.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要把这两个词混淆。

sentence_examples.en: I often confuse his name with mine because they sound similar.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为名字听起来很相似，我常把他的名字和我的名字搞混。

translations.translation: 困惑，糊涂；混淆；混乱，骚乱

sentence_examples.en: There was a lot of confusion after the announcement.
sentence_examples.zh: 公告后出现了很多困惑。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher's unclear instructions caused confusion among the students.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师的指示不清楚，导致学生们困惑。

sentence_examples.en: A name mix-up caused confusion about who was who.
sentence_examples.zh: 名字的混淆让人分不清谁是谁。

sentence_examples.en: We would like to congratulate you on your promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们想向你表示祝贺，恭喜你升职。

sentence_examples.en: Please join me in congratulating our team on winning the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 请和我一起向我们的团队表示祝贺，他们赢得了这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: I would like to congratulate you on passing the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想祝贺你考试通过。

sentence_examples.en: Please accept my warm congratulation on your promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 请接受我对你升职的热烈祝贺。

sentence_examples.en: She sent me a short congratulation after the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 典礼结束后她给我发来了一句简短的祝贺。

sentence_examples.en: We sent our congratulation to the newlyweds.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们向新婚夫妇致以祝贺。

translations.translation: (代表)大会;(美国等国的)国会,议会

sentence_examples.en: Congress passed the bill after weeks of debate.
sentence_examples.zh: 国会经过数周的辩论后通过了这项法案。

sentence_examples.en: She testified before Congress about the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在国会就新政策作证。

sentence_examples.en: The United States Congress has two chambers: the Senate and the House of Representatives.
sentence_examples.zh: 美国国会由参议院和众议院组成。

sentence_examples.en: In English, 'and' is a conjunction.
sentence_examples.zh: 在英语里，'and' 是一个连词。

sentence_examples.en: The conjunction of the two ideas led to a new plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个想法的结合促成了一个新计划。

sentence_examples.en: The festival was held in conjunction with the parade.
sentence_examples.zh: 节日与游行同期举行。

sentence_examples.en: You need to connect the two cables to complete the circuit.
sentence_examples.zh: 你需要把这两根电缆连接起来以完成电路。

sentence_examples.en: I couldn't connect with the person at first, but we finally talked.
sentence_examples.zh: 起初我联系不上那个人，但最终我们聊起来了。

sentence_examples.en: The new bridge connects the two towns.
sentence_examples.zh: 新桥将这两个城镇连接起来。

sentence_examples.en: I lost the Wi-Fi connection during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议期间我的无线网络连接断了。

sentence_examples.en: There is a strong family connection between them.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们之间有很强的家庭关系。

sentence_examples.en: The new bridge will improve the road connection between the two towns.
sentence_examples.zh: 新桥将改善两座城镇之间的道路连接。

translations.translation: 征服,战胜,占领;克服,破除(坏习惯等)

sentence_examples.en: The army finally conquered the city after months of fighting.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数月的战斗，军队最终征服了这座城市。

sentence_examples.en: She conquered her fear of speaking in front of an audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 她终于克服了在众人面前演讲的恐惧。

sentence_examples.en: They set out to conquer this mountain peak before dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们计划在黎明前征服这座山峰。

sentence_examples.en: The conquest of the city lasted three months.
sentence_examples.zh: 对这座城市的征服持续了三个月。

sentence_examples.en: The general celebrated the conquest with a public ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 将军以公开仪式庆祝征服。

sentence_examples.en: Her diary describes the conquest as a turning point in history.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的日记把这次征服描述为历史上的一个转折点。

sentence_examples.en: Her conscience wouldn't let her lie.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的良心不允许她撒谎。

sentence_examples.en: He ignored his conscience and took the shortcut.
sentence_examples.zh: 他忽视了良心，走了捷径。

sentence_examples.en: She followed her conscience and spoke up for what was right.
sentence_examples.zh: 她凭着良心为正确的事情发声。

translations.translation: 审慎正直的，认真的，本着良心的

sentence_examples.en: A conscientious student will complete assignments on time and study diligently.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个认真负责的学生会按时完成作业并勤奋学习。

sentence_examples.en: Her conscientious approach to patient care earned her the respect of the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在病人护理方面的认真态度赢得了团队的尊重。

sentence_examples.en: He is conscientious about his work, double-checking every detail.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在工作上非常认真，事事都仔细核对。

translations.translation: (of)意识到的,自觉的;神志清醒的

sentence_examples.en: She became conscious of a strange smell in the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 她意识到房间里有一种奇怪的气味。

sentence_examples.en: He remained conscious after the accident and told us what happened.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在事故后仍然清醒，告诉了我们发生了什么。

sentence_examples.en: They were conscious of the risks before starting the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 在开始这个项目之前，他们就意识到了风险。

sentence_examples.en: She won the race for three consecutive years.
sentence_examples.zh: 她连续三年赢得比赛。

sentence_examples.en: The numbers 1, 2, and 3 appear in consecutive order.
sentence_examples.zh: 数字1、2和3按连续顺序出现。

sentence_examples.en: There were consecutive days of rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 连续多日下雨。

translations.translation: (意见等的)一致，一致同意，共识

sentence_examples.en: After hours of debate, the committee reached a consensus on the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数小时的辩论，委员会在预算问题上达成了共识。

sentence_examples.en: There is a broad consensus among scientists that climate change is urgent.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家们就气候变化的紧迫性达成了广泛的共识。

sentence_examples.en: We need to build consensus before moving forward with the policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 在推进这项政策之前，我们需要达成共识。

sentence_examples.en: They gave their consent for the surgery after a full discussion.
sentence_examples.zh: 在充分讨论后，他们同意进行手术。

sentence_examples.en: Parents must consent before their child can participate in the study.
sentence_examples.zh: 在孩子参与这项研究之前，家长必须同意。

sentence_examples.en: I cannot consent to the plan without more information.
sentence_examples.zh: 在没有更多信息的情况下，我不能同意这个计划。

sentence_examples.en: A minor mistake can have serious consequences.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个小错误也可能带来严重的后果。

sentence_examples.en: As a consequence, she had to start over from the beginning.
sentence_examples.zh: 因此，她不得不从头开始。

sentence_examples.en: The consequence of his action surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的行动的后果让每个人都感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The project ran over budget; consequently, we had to cut some features.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目超出预算，因此我们不得不削减一些功能。

sentence_examples.en: He forgot to set his alarm; consequently, he was late for the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他忘记设闹钟，因此开会迟到了。

sentence_examples.en: Sales fell sharply last quarter; consequently, the company revised its forecast.
sentence_examples.zh: 上个季度销售额急剧下降，因此公司修订了预测。

translations.translation: 保存,保护,保守;守恒,不灭

sentence_examples.en: The city funds programs for wildlife conservation.
sentence_examples.zh: 该市资助野生动物保护项目。

sentence_examples.en: The law ensures the conservation of energy in physical processes.
sentence_examples.zh: 法律确保物理过程中的能量守恒。

sentence_examples.en: Her work in a nature reserve sparked her interest in conservation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在自然保护区的工作激发了她对保护工作的兴趣。

sentence_examples.en: My grandfather is very conservative about spending money.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的祖父在花钱方面非常保守。

sentence_examples.en: He follows a conservative approach to investing.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在投资方面采取保守的方法。

sentence_examples.en: She is a conservative who believes in gradual reform.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一个主张渐进改革的保守派。

translations.translation: 考虑，想；体谅，顾及；认为，把…看作

sentence_examples.en: Please consider my proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 请考虑我的提议。

sentence_examples.en: We should consider all the options before deciding.
sentence_examples.zh: 在决定之前，我们应考虑所有选项。

sentence_examples.en: She considers him a good friend.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把他视为好朋友。

translations.translation: 相当大(或多)的,可观的;值得考虑的

sentence_examples.en: The project required a considerable amount of funding.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目需要相当多的资金。

sentence_examples.en: There was a considerable delay before the train arrived.
sentence_examples.zh: 列车到达前有相当长的延误。

sentence_examples.en: He has made considerable progress this semester.
sentence_examples.zh: 他这个学期取得了相当大的进展。

sentence_examples.en: It's very considerate of you to bring me to the airport.
sentence_examples.zh: 你带我去机场真是太体贴了。

sentence_examples.en: She is always considerate of others' feelings.
sentence_examples.zh: 她总是体谅别人的感受。

sentence_examples.en: Opening the door for me was very considerate.
sentence_examples.zh: 为我开门真是很体贴。

translations.translation: 需要考虑的事,理由;考虑,思考;体谅,照顾

sentence_examples.en: The committee will make a decision after careful consideration.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会在经过慎重考虑后将作出决定。

sentence_examples.en: There are several factors to take into consideration when choosing a city to move to.
sentence_examples.zh: 在选择搬到哪个城市时，有几个因素需要考虑。

sentence_examples.en: Please show consideration for your coworkers and arrive on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 请对同事多加体谅，准时到达。

sentence_examples.en: The team consists of players from five countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个团队由来自五个国家的成员组成。

sentence_examples.en: Success consists in solving the most difficult problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 成功在于解决最困难的问题。

sentence_examples.en: A healthy breakfast consists of cereal, fruit, and yogurt.
sentence_examples.zh: 健康的早餐由谷物、水果和酸奶组成。

sentence_examples.en: The results are consistent with the initial hypothesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果与初始假设一致。

sentence_examples.en: She is consistent in her workouts, never missing a day.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在训练方面保持前后一致，从不缺勤。

sentence_examples.en: To succeed, you must be consistent in your practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 要想成功，练习必须保持一致。

sentence_examples.en: The car's center console holds the gear lever and cup holders.
sentence_examples.zh: 汽车的中控台放置着换挡杆和杯托。

sentence_examples.en: The gaming console is connected to the TV.
sentence_examples.zh: 游戏主机连接到电视机上。

sentence_examples.en: People come to console the grieving family after the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们前来安慰悲痛的家属。

translations.translation: 使加固，使加强；(把...)联为一体，合并

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to consolidate its regional offices into a single headquarters.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划将区域办事处整合为一个总部。

sentence_examples.en: The agreement will consolidate several smaller deals into one contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 该协议将几笔较小的交易合并成一份合同。

sentence_examples.en: Regular practice helps consolidate what you have learned.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的练习有助于巩固所学的知识。

sentence_examples.en: Her bright red scarf made her conspicuous in the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 她鲜红的围巾在拥挤的人群中很显眼。

sentence_examples.en: The typo on the page was conspicuous to every reader.
sentence_examples.zh: 页面上的错字对每位读者来说都很明显。

sentence_examples.en: He wore a conspicuous gold watch that drew everyone's attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 他戴着一只显眼的金表，吸引了所有人的注意。

sentence_examples.en: There was a conspiracy among the board members to hide the facts.
sentence_examples.zh: 董事会成员之间存在一个阴谋，意图隐瞒事实。

sentence_examples.en: Investigators uncovered a conspiracy involving several suspects.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查人员揭露了涉及多名嫌疑人的阴谋。

sentence_examples.en: The court found no evidence of a conspiracy.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院没有发现阴谋的证据。

sentence_examples.en: The temperature remained constant at 20 degrees Celsius.
sentence_examples.zh: 温度维持在恒定的20摄氏度。

sentence_examples.en: The constant rain ruined our picnic.
sentence_examples.zh: 绵绵不断的雨毁了我们的野餐。

sentence_examples.en: Pi is a constant.
sentence_examples.zh: 圆周率是一个常数。

sentence_examples.en: The representative met with a constituent to discuss the issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 代表会见了一位选民，讨论这个问题。

sentence_examples.en: Hydrogen is a constituent of water.
sentence_examples.zh: 氢是水的组成成分之一。

sentence_examples.en: The constituent parts of the system need maintenance.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统的组成部分需要维护。

translations.translation: 组成，构成，形成；设立，建立，任命

sentence_examples.en: Eight planets constitute the solar system.
sentence_examples.zh: 八大行星构成了太阳系。

sentence_examples.en: Water and salt constitute a simple solution.
sentence_examples.zh: 水和盐构成了一种简单的溶液。

sentence_examples.en: The new regulations constitute a major change in policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 新规定构成了政策的重大改变。

translations.translation: 构成,构造,组成(方式),成分;体格;宪法

sentence_examples.en: She has a strong constitution and rarely gets sick.
sentence_examples.zh: 她体质很强，几乎不生病。

sentence_examples.en: The Constitution of the United States outlines the powers of the government.
sentence_examples.zh: 美国宪法概述了政府的权力。

sentence_examples.en: The chemical constitution of this compound determines its properties.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种化合物的化学构成决定了它的性质。

sentence_examples.en: The policy constrains companies from increasing emissions.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策限制公司增加排放。

sentence_examples.en: A tight deadline constrains our ability to complete the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 紧迫的期限限制了我们完成该项目的能力。

sentence_examples.en: External regulations constrain how much we can spend on research.
sentence_examples.zh: 外部监管限制了我们在研究上的支出。

sentence_examples.en: The city government will construct a new bridge this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府今年将修建一座新的桥梁。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers constructed a model to test the theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员构建了一个模型来检验该理论。

sentence_examples.en: The team plans to construct a reliable framework for data analysis.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队计划构建一个可靠的数据分析框架。

translations.translation: 建造，构造；建筑物，结构；释义，解释

sentence_examples.en: The construction of the new bridge will begin next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 新大桥的建造将于下个月开始。

sentence_examples.en: The construction of the building uses steel frames to improve strength.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座建筑的建造使用钢框架以提高强度。

sentence_examples.en: The phrase shows a common construction in English grammar.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个短语展示了英语语法中的常见结构。

translations.translation: 请教，向...咨询，找...商量；查阅，查看

sentence_examples.en: If you’re feeling unwell, consult a doctor.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你感觉不舒服，请去看医生。

sentence_examples.en: She consulted the manual before assembling the furniture.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在组装家具前查阅了手册。

sentence_examples.en: They decided to consult a lawyer about the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们决定就这份合同咨询律师。

translations.translation: 会诊医师,顾问医生;顾问

sentence_examples.en: The hospital called in a consultant to review the patient's case.
sentence_examples.zh: 医院请来一位会诊医师来审阅患者的病情。

sentence_examples.en: She works as a management consultant for several international firms.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在几家国际公司担任管理顾问。

sentence_examples.en: We hired a consultant to help with our marketing strategy.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们雇佣了一位顾问来帮助制定我们的市场营销策略。

translations.translation: 消耗；吃完，喝光；(with)使着迷；烧毁

sentence_examples.en: The new appliance will consume a lot of electricity.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台新电器会消耗大量电力。

sentence_examples.en: He consumed the entire pizza in one sitting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他一次就把整张披萨吃光了。

sentence_examples.en: The fire consumed the wooden cabin.
sentence_examples.zh: 大火吞噬了整座木屋。

sentence_examples.en: The country's energy consumption has risen by 5% this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 该国的能源消耗今年上涨了5%.

sentence_examples.en: Public health campaigns encourage people to reduce meat consumption.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共卫生宣传鼓励人们减少肉类消费。

sentence_examples.en: During the drought, water consumption exceeded the available supply.
sentence_examples.zh: 在干旱期间水的消耗量超过了可用供应。

sentence_examples.en: Please contact our support team for assistance.
sentence_examples.zh: 如需帮助，请与我们的支持团队联系。

sentence_examples.en: There was no contact between the two wires, so the circuit remained open.
sentence_examples.zh: 两根导线之间没有接触，电路保持开路。

sentence_examples.en: She shared her contact information at the end of the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议结束时留下了联系方式。

translations.translation: 包含，容纳；容忍，抑制；可被...除尽

sentence_examples.en: The jar can contain up to 500 milliliters of liquid.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个罐子最多能容纳500毫升液体。

sentence_examples.en: She tried to contain her laughter during the serious meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她努力抑制在严肃的会议上发笑。

sentence_examples.en: These boxes contain the batteries you ordered.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些盒子里装着你订购的电池。

sentence_examples.en: Store the cookies in an airtight container.
sentence_examples.zh: 把饼干放进密封容器里。

sentence_examples.en: The ship arrived with dozens of shipping containers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘船到港时装着几十个集装箱。

sentence_examples.en: She poured the medicine into a small container.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把药倒进一个小容器里。

translations.translation: 弄污,弄脏,毒害,传染,染污

sentence_examples.en: A chemical spill could contaminate the drinking water.
sentence_examples.zh: 化学物质泄漏可能污染饮用水。

sentence_examples.en: If you don't wash your hands, you may contaminate the food.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不洗手，可能会污染食物。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers must avoid contaminating the samples during testing.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员在测试过程中必须避免污染样本。

translations.translation: 盘算，计议；周密考虑；注视，凝视

sentence_examples.en: I'm contemplating whether to accept this job offer.
sentence_examples.zh: 我正在考虑是否接受这份工作邀请。

sentence_examples.en: He stood by the window, contemplating the stars.
sentence_examples.zh: 他站在窗前凝视星星。

sentence_examples.en: The committee is contemplating a new budget proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会正在考虑一项新的预算提案。

translations.translation: 现代的,当代的;同时代的

sentence_examples.en: The museum features contemporary paintings from living artists.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆展出来自在世艺术家的当代绘画。

sentence_examples.en: This building has a contemporary design with open spaces and large windows.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座建筑采用当代设计，空间开放且窗户很大。

sentence_examples.en: She studies contemporary history to understand recent events.
sentence_examples.zh: 她研究当代史以了解最近的事件。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd looked at the politician with contempt.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群对这位政治家投以蔑视的目光。

sentence_examples.en: The judge held him in contempt of court.
sentence_examples.zh: 法官认定他蔑视法庭。

sentence_examples.en: She has contempt for people who lie.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对说谎的人心怀蔑视。

sentence_examples.en: Several teams will contend for the championship this season.
sentence_examples.zh: 本赛季有几支队伍将竞争冠军。

sentence_examples.en: The lawyers contend that the contract is void.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师们坚持认为合同无效。

sentence_examples.en: We must contend with rising costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须应对日益上升的成本。

sentence_examples.en: The content of the report includes sales data and projections.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告的内容包含销售数据和预测。

sentence_examples.en: Please review the content on the website for accuracy.
sentence_examples.zh: 请核对网站上的内容以确保准确。

sentence_examples.en: She is content with her progress.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对自己的进步感到满意。

sentence_examples.en: The annual spelling contest drew students from all over the district.
sentence_examples.zh: 年度拼写比赛吸引了来自全区的学生。

sentence_examples.en: She won the math contest with a perfect score.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在数学竞赛中以满分获胜。

sentence_examples.en: The company will contest the tax assessment.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将对税务评估提出异议。

translations.translation: （文章等）前后关系；(事件等的)背景

sentence_examples.en: In this context, the term privacy has a specific meaning.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这个语境下，术语隐私有一个特定的含义。

sentence_examples.en: To understand the quote, you need the full context.
sentence_examples.zh: 要理解这段引言，你需要完整的上下文。

sentence_examples.en: The historical context explains why the policy was adopted.
sentence_examples.zh: 历史背景有助于解释该政策为何出台。

sentence_examples.en: Africa is the second-largest continent.
sentence_examples.zh: 非洲是世界上第二大大陆。

sentence_examples.en: We can travel from one continent to another by plane.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们可以乘坐飞机在不同大陆之间旅行。

sentence_examples.en: Every continent has its own unique ecosystems.
sentence_examples.zh: 每个大陆都有自己独特的生态系统。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting was interrupted by continual questions from the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议被观众不断提问打断。

sentence_examples.en: We faced continual delays due to bad weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于恶劣天气，我们遇到了持续的延迟。

sentence_examples.en: Her career has faced continual changes in direction.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的职业发展方向经历了持续的变动。

sentence_examples.en: Please continue your work after the break.
sentence_examples.zh: 休息后，请继续工作。

sentence_examples.en: The road continues for another five kilometers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条路再往前延伸五公里。

sentence_examples.en: If the weather improves, the team will continue with the outdoor activity.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果天气好转，团队将继续进行户外活动。

sentence_examples.en: The project requires continuous monitoring to ensure safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目需要持续监控以确保安全。

sentence_examples.en: There was continuous rain from morning to night.
sentence_examples.zh: 从早到晚一直在下雨。

sentence_examples.en: During the project, there was continuous improvement in the process.
sentence_examples.zh: 在项目期间，流程持续改进。

sentence_examples.en: We signed a contract with the supplier last month.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们上个月和供应商签订了一份合同。

sentence_examples.en: The metal contracts as it cools.
sentence_examples.zh: 金属冷却时会收缩。

sentence_examples.en: If you break the contract, you may face penalties.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你违反合同，可能会受到处罚。

sentence_examples.en: Her statement contradicts the official report.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的陈述与官方报告矛盾。

sentence_examples.en: These two accounts contradict each other.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两种说法彼此矛盾。

sentence_examples.en: The witness's testimony contradicted the defendant's story.
sentence_examples.zh: 证人的证词与被告的说法相矛盾。

sentence_examples.en: There is a contradiction between what he promised and what he actually did.
sentence_examples.zh: 他承诺的事情与他实际做的事情之间存在矛盾。

sentence_examples.en: Her statements contain a contradiction that undermines her credibility.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的陈述中存在矛盾，削弱了她的可信度。

sentence_examples.en: The theory presents a contradiction that weakens its overall argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 该理论呈现出一个矛盾，削弱了其整体论证。

sentence_examples.en: His views are contrary to the evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的观点与证据相矛盾。

sentence_examples.en: Some people think the project will fail; on the contrary, it is progressing well.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人认为这个项目会失败；相反，它正在顺利推进。

sentence_examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, cats can be trained.
sentence_examples.zh: 与普遍看法相反，猫也可以被训练。

sentence_examples.en: The contrast between the two paintings is striking.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两幅画之间的对比很显著。

sentence_examples.en: In contrast to last year, sales increased.
sentence_examples.zh: 与去年相比，销售额有所增加。

sentence_examples.en: The report contrasts the expected results with the actual results.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告对比了预期结果与实际结果。

sentence_examples.en: We can contribute to the project by sharing ideas.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们可以通过分享想法来为这个项目做出贡献。

sentence_examples.en: She contributed money to the charity last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去年向慈善机构捐款。

sentence_examples.en: He contributed an article to the magazine.
sentence_examples.zh: 他为杂志投稿了一篇文章。

sentence_examples.en: Her contribution to the project helped it succeed.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个项目的贡献帮助它取得了成功。

sentence_examples.en: He made a large contribution to the charity.
sentence_examples.zh: 他向慈善机构捐出了大量款项。

sentence_examples.en: Each member's contribution counts toward the final total.
sentence_examples.zh: 每位成员的贡献都会计入最终总数。

translations.translation: 谋划，策划；设法做到；设计，想出

sentence_examples.en: She contrived a way to leave the meeting early.
sentence_examples.zh: 她设法提前离开会议。

sentence_examples.en: They contrived a clever excuse to miss the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们编造了一个巧妙的借口来错过最后期限。

sentence_examples.en: The inventor contrived a new device that runs on solar power.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位发明家设计出一种能靠太阳能运行的新设备。

sentence_examples.en: The manager has control over the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理掌控预算。

sentence_examples.en: She learned to control her emotions during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议中学会控制情绪。

sentence_examples.en: We must regain control of the situation.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须重新掌控局势。

sentence_examples.en: The policy is controversial and has divided public opinion.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项政策有争议，公众意见分歧。

sentence_examples.en: The mayor's controversial decision drew protests.
sentence_examples.zh: 市长的一项有争议的决定引发了抗议。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists published a controversial study about the drug's safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家发表了一项关于该药物安全性的有争议的研究。

sentence_examples.en: The controversy over the policy divided the town.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于这项政策的争议使镇上分裂。

sentence_examples.en: The controversy surrounding the school's decision upset many parents.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于学校决定的争议让许多家长感到不安。

sentence_examples.en: There was a heated controversy about the project's funding.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于该项目资金的争议非常激烈。

sentence_examples.en: For your convenience, the hotel provides a 24-hour front desk.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了方便您，酒店提供24小时前台服务。

sentence_examples.en: Online ordering offers great convenience for busy shoppers.
sentence_examples.zh: 在线下单为忙碌的购物者带来极大的便利。

sentence_examples.en: Smart features add convenience to everyday tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 智能功能为日常任务带来便利。

sentence_examples.en: It's convenient to have a grocery store nearby.
sentence_examples.zh: 家附近有一家杂货店很方便。

sentence_examples.en: Using public transit is convenient for commuting.
sentence_examples.zh: 日常通勤坐公共交通很方便。

sentence_examples.en: This app is convenient for booking tickets.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个应用程序在订票方面很方便。

translations.translation: 大会,会议;惯例,常规,习俗;公约,协定

sentence_examples.en: The annual science convention drew speakers from around the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 一年一度的科学大会吸引了来自世界各地的演讲者。

sentence_examples.en: In many workplaces, it is a convention to start meetings on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多工作场所，准时开始会议是一种惯例。

sentence_examples.en: The two countries signed a convention to reduce trade barriers.
sentence_examples.zh: 两国签署了一项公约以降低贸易壁垒。

sentence_examples.en: Many farmers still use conventional farming methods that rely on chemical fertilizers.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多农民仍在使用依赖化肥的常规耕作方法。

sentence_examples.en: The architect avoided conventional layouts in favor of a more open plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位建筑师放弃了常规布局，转而采用更开放的平面。

sentence_examples.en: Some people prefer conventional medicine over alternative therapies.
sentence_examples.zh: 一些人更偏好常规医学，而非替代疗法。

sentence_examples.en: We had a long conversation about our future plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们就未来的计划进行了很长时间的谈话。

sentence_examples.en: The conversation with the manager cleared up the misunderstanding.
sentence_examples.zh: 与经理的谈话澄清了误解。

sentence_examples.en: It's important to have an open conversation about changes at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 在工作中的变动进行公开的对话很重要。

sentence_examples.en: Some people learn quickly in the morning; conversely, others perform best in the afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人在早晨学习效率很高；相反，其他人下午的表现最好。

sentence_examples.en: Increasing investment in one department can boost growth; conversely, it may reduce funds available for other projects.
sentence_examples.zh: 在一个部门增加投资可以促进增长；相反，它可能减少其他项目的资金。

sentence_examples.en: A high price often reduces demand; conversely, lowering prices can attract more customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格偏高通常会降低需求；相反，降价可以吸引更多顾客。

sentence_examples.en: The conversion of the attic into a studio took several weeks.
sentence_examples.zh: 把阁楼改造成工作室花了好几周。

sentence_examples.en: He underwent a religious conversion and started attending a new church.
sentence_examples.zh: 他经历了宗教信仰的改变，并开始去新的教堂参加活动。

sentence_examples.en: The conversion from Fahrenheit to Celsius is simple with a calculator.
sentence_examples.zh: 用计算器把华氏温度转换为摄氏温度很简单。

translations.translation: 变换,转换；改变（信仰等）；兑换（钱）

sentence_examples.en: You can convert the file to PDF before sending it.
sentence_examples.zh: 在发送前，你可以把文件转换成PDF。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to convert to Buddhism.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定改信佛教。

sentence_examples.en: You can convert dollars into euros at the airport.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以在机场把美元兑换成欧元。

translations.translation: 运送,搬运,转运;传达,传播

sentence_examples.en: The truck was hired to convey the goods to the warehouse.
sentence_examples.zh: 卡车被雇来把货物运送到仓库。

sentence_examples.en: Please convey my thanks to everyone who helped.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把我的感谢传达给所有帮助过的人。

sentence_examples.en: The painting conveys a sense of nostalgia.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画传达出一种怀旧的情感。

sentence_examples.en: The jury convicted him of fraud.
sentence_examples.zh: 陪审团裁定他犯有欺诈罪。

sentence_examples.en: She was convicted after a lengthy trial.
sentence_examples.zh: 经历一场漫长的审判后，她被定罪。

sentence_examples.en: The convict sat quietly in his cell.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名囚犯安静地坐在牢房里。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke with conviction about the importance of education.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对教育的重要性充满信念地说话。

sentence_examples.en: His conviction that he could win the case kept him going.
sentence_examples.zh: 他坚信自己能够赢得这场官司，这种信念支撑着他。

sentence_examples.en: The jury returned a conviction after the trial.
sentence_examples.zh: 陪审团在审判后作出定罪判决。

sentence_examples.en: I tried to convince him to join us for the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 我试图说服他和我们一起去旅行。

sentence_examples.en: She couldn't convince the jury of her innocence.
sentence_examples.zh: 她没能让陪审团相信她是无罪的。

sentence_examples.en: A strong argument can convince most people.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个有力的论点通常能说服大多数人。

translations.translation: 烹调，烧煮；纂改(账目)，捏造

sentence_examples.en: The cook prepared a delicious meal for the guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨师为客人准备了一顿美味的饭菜。

sentence_examples.en: She loves to cook Italian food on weekends.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢在周末烹调意大利菜。

sentence_examples.en: The company was accused of cooking the books.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司被指控粉饰账目。

sentence_examples.en: It's cool outside, so bring a light jacket.
sentence_examples.zh: 外面很凉，记得带件轻薄的外套。

sentence_examples.en: Let the soup cool for ten minutes before serving.
sentence_examples.zh: 在盛出前让汤冷却十分钟。

sentence_examples.en: She answered the question coolly, without getting flustered.
sentence_examples.zh: 她冷静地回答了这个问题，没有慌乱。

sentence_examples.en: We need to cooperate with the local authorities to solve the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要与当地当局合作来解决这个问题。

sentence_examples.en: The two teams cooperate on the project to finish it ahead of schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 两支队伍在该项目上合作，以提前完成任务。

sentence_examples.en: Please cooperate with the investigation.
sentence_examples.zh: 请配合调查。

sentence_examples.en: The students were cooperative and helped each other finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生们很合作，互相帮助完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The team showed cooperative spirit, which made the negotiations smoother.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队展现出合作精神，使谈判更加顺利。

sentence_examples.en: Many farmers joined a cooperative to market their crops.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多农民加入了合作社来销售他们的作物。

sentence_examples.en: What are the coordinates of the library on the map?
sentence_examples.zh: 地图上图书馆的坐标是什么？

sentence_examples.en: The coordinate plane uses the x-axis and y-axis.
sentence_examples.zh: 坐标平面使用 x 轴和 y 轴。

sentence_examples.en: We need to coordinate our schedules to avoid conflicts.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要协调各自的日程以避免冲突。

sentence_examples.en: The two departments are coordinate departments within the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个部门在公司内处于同等地位。

sentence_examples.en: The point's coordinate is (3, 5).
sentence_examples.zh: 该点在图上的坐标是(3, 5)。

sentence_examples.en: They coordinate their efforts to finish the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们协调努力，按时完成该项目。

sentence_examples.en: A cop pulled me over for speeding.
sentence_examples.zh: 一名警察因为超速把我拦下。

sentence_examples.en: The cop was polite and explained the rules.
sentence_examples.zh: 那名警察很有礼貌并向我解释了规定。

sentence_examples.en: I argued with the cop, but he still gave me a ticket.
sentence_examples.zh: 我和那名警察争辩，但他还是给了我一张罚单。

sentence_examples.en: Many small firms struggle to cope with fierce competition.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多小公司难以应对激烈的竞争。

sentence_examples.en: She learned how to cope with stress at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 她学会了如何在工作中应对压力。

sentence_examples.en: The team managed to cope with a sudden budget cut.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队设法应对突然的预算削减。

sentence_examples.en: The statue is made of copper and has a reddish-brown color.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕像是铜制的，呈现出红棕色。

sentence_examples.en: I found a copper coin on the street.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在街上捡到了一枚铜币。

sentence_examples.en: Copper pots and pans are common copperware in many kitchens.
sentence_examples.zh: 铜锅和平底锅是许多厨房常见的铜制餐具。

sentence_examples.en: I need a copy of the document.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要这份文件的副本。

sentence_examples.en: She copied the paragraph from the original text into her notes.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把原文中的段落抄写进笔记里。

sentence_examples.en: Copying answers on the exam is forbidden.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试中抄袭答案是被禁止的。

sentence_examples.en: The author retained the copyright to her novel.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位作者保留了她小说的版权。

sentence_examples.en: Under copyright law, you cannot copy this song without permission.
sentence_examples.zh: 根据版权法，未经许可不得复制这首歌曲。

sentence_examples.en: This image is protected by copyright.
sentence_examples.zh: 这张图片受版权保护。

sentence_examples.en: Please pass me the cord so I can tie this package.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把绳子递给我，好把这个包裹绑起来。

sentence_examples.en: The lamp is hanging from a thin cord.
sentence_examples.zh: 灯是用一根细绳悬挂着。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to trip on the cord near the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心别被门口的绳子绊倒。

sentence_examples.en: She greeted us with a cordial smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 她以诚恳的微笑迎接我们。

sentence_examples.en: The hosts gave a cordial welcome to all guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 主人们对所有来宾表示热情而诚挚的欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: He spoke in a cordial, respectful tone during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在会议中以热情而恭敬的语气发言。

sentence_examples.en: The core of the apple contains seeds.
sentence_examples.zh: 苹果的果核里有种子。

sentence_examples.en: Our core values guide the company's decisions.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的核心价值观指引公司的决策。

sentence_examples.en: The core idea of the project is simple.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目的核心思想很简单。

sentence_examples.en: We harvested the corn before the first frost.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在初霜前收获了玉米。

sentence_examples.en: She loves corn on the cob with butter.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢吃带黄油的玉米棒。

sentence_examples.en: Corn is a staple crop in many countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 玉米是许多国家的主要作物之一。

sentence_examples.en: She waited at the street corner.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在街角等着。

sentence_examples.en: The sofa sits in the corner of the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 沙发放在房间的角落里。

sentence_examples.en: The police cornered the suspect in a narrow alley.
sentence_examples.zh: 警察在一条狭窄的小巷里将嫌疑人逼入死角。

translations.translation: 市镇自治机关；法人；公司，企业

sentence_examples.en: The corporation plans to expand into Asia next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司计划明年扩展到亚洲。

sentence_examples.en: Shareholders elected a new CEO of the corporation.
sentence_examples.zh: 股东选举了这家公司的新任首席执行官。

sentence_examples.en: The town became a municipal corporation in the 19th century.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个镇在19世纪成为市镇自治机关。

sentence_examples.en: Please choose the correct option.
sentence_examples.zh: 请选择正确的选项。

sentence_examples.en: The student corrected his mistake before submitting the paper.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生在提交论文前纠正了他的错误。

sentence_examples.en: The instructions were not correct.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些说明不正确。

sentence_examples.en: These two variables correlate positively.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个变量呈正相关。

sentence_examples.en: Smoking correlates with a higher risk of lung cancer.
sentence_examples.zh: 吸烟与肺癌风险增加有关。

sentence_examples.en: A correlate of obesity is high blood pressure.
sentence_examples.zh: 肥胖的一个相关因素是高血压。

translations.translation: 通信,(with)符合,一致;(to)相当于,对应

sentence_examples.en: I will correspond with you by email about the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我将通过电子邮件就该项目与你通信。

sentence_examples.en: The results do not correspond to the initial hypothesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果与最初的假设不符合。

sentence_examples.en: Her description corresponds to the real events.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的描述与实际事件相符。

translations.translation: 通信,信件;(with)符合;(to)相当于,对应

sentence_examples.en: I received a lot of correspondence after the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 会后我收到了大量来信。

sentence_examples.en: There is a close correspondence between the chart and the data.
sentence_examples.zh: 图表与数据之间存在密切的对应关系。

sentence_examples.en: I maintained correspondence with my mentor while studying abroad.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在海外留学期间与导师保持通信。

sentence_examples.en: The war correspondent filed a report from the front lines.
sentence_examples.zh: 战地记者在前线发回报道。

sentence_examples.en: She works as a foreign affairs correspondent for a major newspaper.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在一家大型报纸担任外交事务记者。

sentence_examples.en: Every correspondent must verify facts before publishing.
sentence_examples.zh: 每位记者在发表报道前都必须核实事实。

sentence_examples.en: Please attach the corresponding document to your application.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在申请材料中附上相应的文件。

sentence_examples.en: Each question has a corresponding answer in the appendix.
sentence_examples.zh: 每个问题在附录中有相应的答案。

sentence_examples.en: Please select the corresponding option from the menu.
sentence_examples.zh: 请从菜单中选择相应的选项。

sentence_examples.en: She walked down the corridor to her classroom.
sentence_examples.zh: 她沿着走廊走到她的教室。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel corridor was quiet after midnight.
sentence_examples.zh: 午夜过后，酒店走廊很安静。

sentence_examples.en: The corridor connects the lobby to the conference rooms.
sentence_examples.zh: 走廊把大堂和会议室连接起来。

sentence_examples.en: Salt water can corrode metal if it is left unprotected.
sentence_examples.zh: 盐水若未加以防护，金属会被腐蚀。

sentence_examples.en: Acids can corrode concrete and metal alloys over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 酸会随着时间腐蚀混凝土和金属合金。

sentence_examples.en: Prolonged exposure to moisture can cause pipes to corrode.
sentence_examples.zh: 长期暴露在潮湿环境中会导致管道腐蚀。

sentence_examples.en: Money can corrupt a political system.
sentence_examples.zh: 金钱可以腐蚀政治体系。

sentence_examples.en: The corrupt official accepted bribes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位腐败的官员接受了贿赂。

sentence_examples.en: They offered money to corrupt the officials.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们提供钱财来贿赂官员。

translations.translation: 宇宙的；无比巨大的，无穷尽的

sentence_examples.en: Astronomers study cosmic rays from distant galaxies.
sentence_examples.zh: 天文学家研究来自遥远星系的宇宙射线。

sentence_examples.en: We gazed at the night sky and felt a cosmic sense of wonder.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们仰望夜空，感到一种宇宙般的敬畏。

sentence_examples.en: The scientists discussed the cosmic scale of the universe.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家们讨论了宇宙的浩瀚尺度。

sentence_examples.en: The cost of living has risen in the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个城市的生活成本上升了。

sentence_examples.en: What is the total cost of this project?
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目的总成本是多少？

sentence_examples.en: The repair costs $200.
sentence_examples.zh: 修理需要花费200美元。

translations.translation: 昂贵的,价值高的,豪华的

sentence_examples.en: Buying a new car can be costly.
sentence_examples.zh: 买一辆新车可能很昂贵。

sentence_examples.en: The repairs turned out to be more costly than we expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 修理费用比我们预期的更高。

sentence_examples.en: Careless mistakes can be costly in the long run.
sentence_examples.zh: 粗心的错误从长远来看可能代价高昂。

translations.translation: (流行的)服饰；戏装，(特定场合的)套装

sentence_examples.en: She wore a colorful costume to the masquerade.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一套色彩鲜艳的戏装去参加化装舞会。

sentence_examples.en: Children dressed in superhero costumes lined up for the parade.
sentence_examples.zh: 穿着超级英雄戏装的孩子们在游行中排队。

sentence_examples.en: This store sells traditional festival costumes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家店出售传统节日服装。

sentence_examples.en: The living room is cosy after a long day.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过一天的忙碌，客厅里显得温馨舒适。

sentence_examples.en: We kept the cottage cosy with a log fire.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用柴火炉把小屋弄得温暖舒适。

sentence_examples.en: The bed is cosy and perfect for a nap.
sentence_examples.zh: 这张床又暖和又舒适，正适合打个盹。

sentence_examples.en: We rented a cozy cottage by the lake.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在湖边租了一间舒适的小屋。

sentence_examples.en: The cottage has a small garden in front.
sentence_examples.zh: 这间小屋前面有一个小花园。

sentence_examples.en: They converted the old cottage into a guesthouse.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们把那间老小屋改成了客房。

sentence_examples.en: She bought some cotton to sew a shirt.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一些棉花来缝一件衬衫。

sentence_examples.en: This shirt is made of 100% cotton.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件衬衫是100%棉制成的。

sentence_examples.en: Cotton grows in warm climates.
sentence_examples.zh: 棉花在温暖的气候中生长。

sentence_examples.en: She sat on the couch and watched TV.
sentence_examples.zh: 她坐在沙发上看电视。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse laid the patient on the couch to rest.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士把病人放在长榻上休息。

sentence_examples.en: The spokesperson couches the proposal in cautious terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 发言人把提案用谨慎的措辞表达。

sentence_examples.en: I have a cough that won't go away.
sentence_examples.zh: 我一直在咳嗽，停不下来。

sentence_examples.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.
sentence_examples.zh: 你咳嗽时请遮住口鼻。

sentence_examples.en: She coughed loudly to get everyone's attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 她大声咳嗽，想引起大家的注意。

translations.translation: (口语)(表示许可或请求）可以...，行

sentence_examples.en: Could I borrow your pen for a moment?
sentence_examples.zh: 我可以借用你的笔一下吗？

sentence_examples.en: Could you pass me the salt, please?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能把盐递给我吗？

sentence_examples.en: Could we start the meeting now?
sentence_examples.zh: 我们现在可以开始会议吗？

translations.translation: 理事会,委员会,议事机构

sentence_examples.en: The city council voted to approve the new zoning plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 市议会就新分区规划投票通过了。

sentence_examples.en: She joined the student council to help organize school events.
sentence_examples.zh: 她加入了学生会，帮助组织学校活动。

sentence_examples.en: The town council discussed the budget at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 镇议会在会议上讨论了预算。

sentence_examples.en: The lawyer counsels clients on their rights.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师就客户的权利提供建议。

sentence_examples.en: She offered sound counsel after the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 会后她给出了中肯的忠告。

sentence_examples.en: The defendant hired counsel to represent him.
sentence_examples.zh: 被告聘请律师来代表他。

sentence_examples.en: I need to count the money before we leave.
sentence_examples.zh: 离开前，我需要把钱数清楚。

sentence_examples.en: Please count me in for the charity run.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把我算在慈善跑的行列里。

sentence_examples.en: The total count is 532.
sentence_examples.zh: 总数是532。

sentence_examples.en: She paid at the counter near the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在门口附近的柜台付款。

sentence_examples.en: There were counterarguments against the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 对该提案有反对意见。

sentence_examples.en: The lawyer countered the accusation with solid evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师用确凿的证据反驳了指控。

sentence_examples.en: The CEO met his counterpart to discuss the merger.
sentence_examples.zh: 首席执行官会见了他的对口方，讨论合并事宜。

sentence_examples.en: The manager met his counterpart at the client’s company to review the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理在客户公司会见了他的对口方，审阅合同。

sentence_examples.en: Her research aligns with the counterpart's findings.

translations.translation: (大学)院长;主持牧师; (基督教)教长

sentence_examples.zh: 学生们与院长会面，讨论课程安排。

sentence_examples.zh: 随着更有效的治疗，该疾病的死亡率下降了。

sentence_examples.zh: 死亡证明列出了死因。

sentence_examples.zh: 他们就新政策展开了一场热烈的辩论。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们将在会议上就利弊进行辩论。

sentence_examples.zh: 减少债务需要自律和一个明确的计划。

sentence_examples.zh: 在过去十年里，科技发展迅速。

sentence_examples.zh: 该项目完成大约需要十年时间。

sentence_examples.en: The fruit began to decay after sitting on the counter for a few days.
sentence_examples.zh: 水果放在柜台几天后开始腐烂。

sentence_examples.zh: 这座古老房子的木梁已经出现腐朽的迹象。

sentence_examples.en: Radioactive decay helps scientists determine the age of fossils.
sentence_examples.zh: 放射性衰变帮助科学家确定化石的年龄。

sentence_examples.en: The detective uncovered the deceit in the company's accounting.
sentence_examples.zh: 侦探揭露了公司账目中的欺骗行为。

sentence_examples.en: Deceit damages trust more than a single lie.
sentence_examples.zh: 欺骗比一次谎言更严重地损害信任。

sentence_examples.zh: 她试图用误导性的证词欺骗陪审团。

sentence_examples.zh: 广告商不应该用虚假宣传欺骗顾客。

sentence_examples.en: Do not deceive a friend for personal gain.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了个人利益，不要欺骗朋友。

sentence_examples.zh: 十二月是一年的最后一个月。

sentence_examples.en: We will travel in December.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们十二月会去旅行。

sentence_examples.en: There are many holidays in December.
sentence_examples.zh: 十二月有很多节日。

translations.translation: 体面的;正派的,合乎礼仪的;合适的

sentence_examples.en: It's a decent place to live.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是一个不错的居住地。

sentence_examples.en: He's a decent person who always helps others.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是一个正派的人，总是帮助别人。

sentence_examples.en: We paid a decent price for the car.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们买这辆车花了一个公道的价钱。

sentence_examples.zh: 在听取双方意见后，我再决定。

sentence_examples.en: They still haven't decided which movie to watch.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们还没决定看哪一部电影。

sentence_examples.en: The committee decided to postpone the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会决定把会议推迟。

translations.translation: 十进的,小数的,十进制的

sentence_examples.zh: 价格通常保留两位小数。

sentence_examples.en: The decimal system is based on ten.
sentence_examples.zh: 十进制系统以十为基数。

sentence_examples.en: A decimal point separates the integer part from the fractional part.
sentence_examples.zh: 小数点把整数部分和小数部分分开。

sentence_examples.zh: 她为赢得合同采取了决定性的行动。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们坐在甲板上看日落。

sentence_examples.zh: 一记猛拳把他打倒在地。

sentence_examples.zh: 他签署了遵守安全规定的声明。

sentence_examples.zh: 政府将宣布进入紧急状态。

sentence_examples.zh: 她宣布自己不会辞职。

sentence_examples.zh: 今年消费者支出有所下降。

sentence_examples.en: The road features a gentle decline.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条路有一个缓坡。

sentence_examples.en: We plan to decorate the hall for the wedding.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们计划为婚礼装饰大厅。

sentence_examples.en: The walls were decorated with old photographs.
sentence_examples.zh: 墙上摆放着旧照片作为装饰。

sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢用彩色糖霜来装饰杯子蛋糕。

sentence_examples.zh: 假期后学生人数减少。

sentence_examples.en: Prices are expected to decrease next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 预计明年价格会下降。

sentence_examples.zh: 我每天早上花两个小时学习英语。

sentence_examples.en: She dedicated her life to helping the poor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把一生奉献给帮助穷人。

sentence_examples.zh: 这位作者把这本书献给了她的导师。

sentence_examples.zh: 从脚印可以推断出小偷是步行离开现场。

sentence_examples.zh: 她的镇定举止让我们推断她对这个消息并不感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.zh: 对受限区域的进入被拒绝。

sentence_examples.zh: 这封邮件拒绝了他的退款请求。

sentence_examples.en: In mathematics, the symbol π denotes the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数学中，符号 π 表示圆的周长与直径之比。

sentence_examples.zh: 红旗表示危险。

sentence_examples.zh: 在图中，箭头表示从左向右的移动。

translations.translation: 公开指责,公然抨击;谴责

sentence_examples.en: The organization denounced the attack as a violent violation of human rights.
sentence_examples.zh: 该组织谴责这起袭击，认为这是对人权的暴力侵犯。

sentence_examples.en: They denounced the policy in a televised press conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在电视新闻发布会上公开抨击了该政策。

sentence_examples.zh: 许多科学家谴责这个传闻，认为它毫无根据且危险。

sentence_examples.en: The fog was so dense that we couldn't see the road.
sentence_examples.zh: 雾很浓，我们看不清路。

sentence_examples.zh: 这篇文章内容密集，难以理解。

sentence_examples.zh: 这种材料的密度会影响它的重量。

sentence_examples.zh: 在室温下，水的密度约为每立方厘米1克。

sentence_examples.zh: 这个城市的人口密度很高。

sentence_examples.zh: 我明天在诊所有一个牙科预约。

sentence_examples.en: Maintaining good dental hygiene requires regular brushing and flossing.
sentence_examples.zh: 保持良好的口腔卫生需要定期刷牙和使用牙线。

sentence_examples.en: The dentist recommended a dental cleaning every six months.
sentence_examples.zh: 牙医建议每六个月进行一次牙齿清洁。

sentence_examples.en: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我明天要去看牙医。

sentence_examples.en: The dentist said I need a filling.
sentence_examples.zh: 牙医说我需要补牙。

sentence_examples.en: My dentist recommended brushing twice a day.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的牙医建议我每天刷牙两次。

sentence_examples.en: He denies stealing the money.
sentence_examples.zh: 他否认偷了钱。

sentence_examples.en: She denies that she was involved in the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 她否认自己参与了这起事件。

sentence_examples.en: They denied the request due to budget limits.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们因为预算限制而拒绝了请求。

sentence_examples.zh: 列车将于上午10点从3号站台出发。

sentence_examples.en: She departed for Paris after saying goodbye.
sentence_examples.zh: 告别后，她启程前往巴黎。

sentence_examples.en: Many people whispered prayers for the departed.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人为逝者低声祈祷。

sentence_examples.en: Our department is hosting a meeting tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 本部门明天将召开会议。

sentence_examples.zh: 她在公司的财务部工作。

sentence_examples.en: The department approved the new budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 该部门批准了新预算。

sentence_examples.en: We waited at the station for the train's departure.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在车站等待火车出发。

sentence_examples.en: Her sudden departure surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她突然离开让大家吃了一惊。

sentence_examples.en: The departure board shows that the next flight is at 3:40.
sentence_examples.zh: 出发信息板显示下一趟航班是3:40。

sentence_examples.en: Whether we go hiking depends on the weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们是否去徒步取决于天气。

sentence_examples.en: The project's success depends on everyone's cooperation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目的成功取决于每个人的合作。

sentence_examples.en: I depend on you to keep this confidential.
sentence_examples.zh: 我指望你能把这件事保密。

translations.translation: 依靠的,依赖的,从属的;随…而定的

sentence_examples.zh: 她在经济上依赖父母。

sentence_examples.en: The project's success is dependent on your cooperation.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目的成功取决于你的合作。

sentence_examples.en: The outcome is dependent on the weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果取决于天气。

sentence_examples.en: The painting depicts a quiet village at dusk.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画描绘了黄昏时分的宁静村庄。

sentence_examples.en: The chart depicts the rise and fall of sales over the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这张图表显示了全年的销售额变化。

sentence_examples.en: The novel depicts the struggles of the protagonist.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部小说描绘了主人公的挣扎。

sentence_examples.zh: 请把钱存入你的储蓄账户。

sentence_examples.en: I made a deposit at the bank this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今天早上在银行存了款。

sentence_examples.en: The hillside contains a rich mineral deposit.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座山坡蕴藏着丰富的矿床。

sentence_examples.zh: 裁员的消息让整个团队感到沮丧。

sentence_examples.en: Low demand depresses prices in the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 需求低迷压低了市场价格。

sentence_examples.en: Depress the brake pedal slowly to stop the car.
sentence_examples.zh: 慢慢踩下刹车踏板让汽车停下。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy could deprive citizens of their basic rights.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策可能会剥夺公民的基本权利。

sentence_examples.en: A long drought can deprive farmers of their crops.
sentence_examples.zh: 长期干旱可能会让农民失去作物。

sentence_examples.en: Parents should not deprive children of love and support.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母不应剥夺孩子的爱和支持。

sentence_examples.zh: 这个湖水的深度大约20米。

sentence_examples.en: I was impressed by the depth of his argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 他论点的深度让我印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: The depth of color in the painting is striking.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画的色彩层次感很强。

sentence_examples.en: The deputy spoke on behalf of the mayor during the crisis.
sentence_examples.zh: 在危机期间，副手代表市长发言。

sentence_examples.en: She is the deputy to the chief engineer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是首席工程师的副手。

sentence_examples.en: The deputy mayor announced the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 副市长宣布了该计划。

translations.translation: 取得;导出;引申;来自;源自;出自

sentence_examples.en: Many herbs derive their flavor from essential oils.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多香草的风味来自精油。

sentence_examples.en: From the data, we can derive a clear pattern.
sentence_examples.zh: 从数据中，我们可以推导出一个清晰的模式。

sentence_examples.en: Architects derive inspiration from ancient buildings.
sentence_examples.zh: 建筑师从古代建筑汲取灵感。

translations.translation: 下来,下降;遗传(指财产,气质,权利)

sentence_examples.zh: 飞机在接近跑道时开始下降。

sentence_examples.en: The family fortune descended to his son after his father's death.
sentence_examples.zh: 家产在父亲去世后传给了他的儿子。

sentence_examples.en: She is descended from a long line of artists.
sentence_examples.zh: 她出自久负盛名的艺术家家族。

sentence_examples.en: She is a descendant of a famous writer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是著名作家的后代。

sentence_examples.en: The painting depicts a distant descendant of the founder.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画描绘了创始人的一位远系后裔。

sentence_examples.en: A descendant of the royal family spoke at the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位来自王室的后代在仪式上发言。

translations.translation: 下降,降下;斜坡;血统,家世

sentence_examples.en: The plane began its descent as it approached the airport.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机在靠近机场时开始下降。

sentence_examples.en: The road has a steep descent that requires careful braking.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条路有一个陡峭的下降段，需要小心制动。

sentence_examples.en: They take pride in their noble descent.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为自己高贵的血统感到自豪。

sentence_examples.en: Please describe the color and shape of the object.
sentence_examples.zh: 请描述这个物体的颜色和形状。

sentence_examples.en: The witness described the suspect as tall and wearing a red jacket.
sentence_examples.zh: 证人把嫌疑人描述为身材高大，穿着红色夹克。

sentence_examples.en: Describe the steps clearly so everyone can follow.
sentence_examples.zh: 把步骤描述清楚，这样每个人都能跟着做。

sentence_examples.en: The product description lists its features and price.
sentence_examples.zh: 产品描述中列出其功能和价格。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a vivid description of the sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对日落做了生动的描写。

sentence_examples.en: Please provide a brief description of the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 请提供这个房间的简短描述。

sentence_examples.en: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 撒哈拉沙漠是世界上最大的热带沙漠。

sentence_examples.en: During the strike, workers deserted their posts.
sentence_examples.zh: 在罢工期间，工人们离开了岗位。

sentence_examples.en: Some soldiers deserted their units during the retreat.
sentence_examples.zh: 撤退期间，一些士兵擅离了部队。

sentence_examples.en: If you work hard, you deserve the prize.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你努力工作，你就应得这个奖品。

sentence_examples.en: She deserves a break after such a long day.
sentence_examples.zh: 经历了这么长的一天，她值得休息一下。

sentence_examples.en: They deserve credit for solving the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们因为解决这个问题值得表扬。

translations.translation: 设计;构思;绘制;图案;企图

sentence_examples.en: The architect will design a new office building.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位建筑师将设计一座新的办公大楼。

sentence_examples.en: She designed the logo to be simple and recognizable.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把标志设计得简洁且易于辨识。

sentence_examples.en: The final design of the app focuses on usability.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款应用的最终设计注重可用性。

sentence_examples.zh: 委员会任命玛利亚为项目负责人。

sentence_examples.zh: 地图把这条路标注为自行车道。

sentence_examples.en: The label designates the product as made in Italy.
sentence_examples.zh: 标签把该产品标注为意大利制造。

translations.translation: 值得做的;合意的,称心的;期望得到的

sentence_examples.en: It is desirable to get enough sleep before an exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试前最好获得足够的睡眠。

sentence_examples.en: Desirable traits in a leader include honesty and empathy.
sentence_examples.zh: 领导者应具备的可取品质包括诚实和同理心。

sentence_examples.en: A desirable outcome would be higher patient satisfaction.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个可取的结果是提高患者满意度。

sentence_examples.en: Her desire to help others led her to volunteer at the shelter.
sentence_examples.zh: 她帮助他人的愿望促使她去收容所做志愿者。

sentence_examples.zh: 他对成功有强烈的渴望。

sentence_examples.en: If you desire more information, please contact us.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你渴望获得更多信息，请与我们联系。

sentence_examples.zh: 我把纸放在书桌上。

sentence_examples.en: She works at her desk every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天早上在书桌前工作。

sentence_examples.en: We asked at the front desk for a map.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在前台要了一张地图。

sentence_examples.en: The town looked desolate after the earthquake.
sentence_examples.zh: 地震后，这座镇子显得荒凉。

sentence_examples.en: She felt desolate after her friends moved away.
sentence_examples.zh: 朋友们搬走后，她感到十分孤独。

sentence_examples.en: The war desolated the countryside, leaving it barren.
sentence_examples.zh: 战争把乡村荒废，留下了一片荒凉。

sentence_examples.zh: 这条消息让他陷入绝望。

sentence_examples.en: Many people despair when faced with long-term unemployment.
sentence_examples.zh: 面对长期失业，许多人会感到绝望。

sentence_examples.en: She did not despair and kept trying to find a better opportunity.
sentence_examples.zh: 她没有绝望，继续努力寻找更好的机会。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们将于明天通过快递发送这些包裹。

sentence_examples.en: The company despatched the team to the site immediately after the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故发生后，公司立即派遣了团队前往现场。

sentence_examples.en: The despatch from the newsroom carried the latest reports.
sentence_examples.zh: 新闻室的急件带来了最新报道。

sentence_examples.zh: 他为了逃离着火的大楼，拼命试图逃出。

sentence_examples.en: With no money left, she faced a desperate situation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她身无分文，面临极为危急的处境。

sentence_examples.zh: 球队在比赛的最后几分钟拼尽全力去赢得比赛。

sentence_examples.zh: 我鄙视粗鲁的行为。

sentence_examples.en: She despises lying and won't trust someone who lies.
sentence_examples.zh: 她鄙视撒谎，也不会信任说谎的人。

sentence_examples.zh: 很多人鄙视政治中的腐败。

sentence_examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是去散步。

sentence_examples.zh: 尽管脚踝受伤，她还是完成了马拉松。

sentence_examples.zh: 尽管他缺乏经验，他还是拿到了这份工作。

sentence_examples.zh: 你想吃什么甜点？

sentence_examples.en: We usually save room for dessert after dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 晚餐后，我们通常留点胃口吃甜点。

sentence_examples.en: This chocolate cake is my favorite dessert.
sentence_examples.zh: 这块巧克力蛋糕是我最喜欢的甜点。

sentence_examples.en: What is your destination for this trip?
sentence_examples.zh: 这次旅行的目的地是什么？

sentence_examples.en: The plane landed smoothly at its destination.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机在目的地平稳降落。

sentence_examples.en: They planned a destination wedding in Hawaii.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在夏威夷计划了一场目的地婚礼。

sentence_examples.en: Some people believe that destiny guides the path of our lives.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人相信命运会引导我们的人生道路。

sentence_examples.en: They felt their chance meeting was part of their destiny.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们觉得这次偶遇是他们命运的一部分。

sentence_examples.en: The novel follows a young prince who struggles to accept his destiny.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本小说讲述一位年轻王子努力接受自己的命运。

sentence_examples.en: If it rains heavily, the storm could destroy the crops.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果下大雨，暴风雨可能会摧毁庄稼。

sentence_examples.en: She accidentally destroyed the vase when she cleaned the shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在打扫架子时不小心把花瓶弄坏了。

sentence_examples.en: We must not destroy evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们不能销毁证据。

sentence_examples.en: The storm caused widespread destruction across the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 风暴在这座城市造成了大范围的毁坏。

sentence_examples.en: They feared the destruction of the ancient temple would be permanent.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们担心这座古庙的毁灭将是永久性的。

sentence_examples.en: The plan aims to prevent the destruction of the rainforest.
sentence_examples.zh: 该计划旨在防止热带雨林的毁灭。

sentence_examples.en: The wildfire was extremely destructive, destroying forests and homes.
sentence_examples.zh: 野火极具破坏性，摧毁了森林和房屋。

sentence_examples.en: Destructive criticism can undermine a student's confidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 具有破坏性的批评会削弱学生的自信心。

sentence_examples.en: Ignoring safety rules can have destructive consequences.
sentence_examples.zh: 忽视安全规则会带来破坏性的后果。

translations.translation: 分开, 分离, 分遣, 派遣(军队)

sentence_examples.en: If you want to detach the lid, twist it gently and pull.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你想把盖子拆下，请轻轻扭动并拉开。

sentence_examples.en: Detach the panel from the device before replacing the screen.
sentence_examples.zh: 在更换屏幕之前，请将面板从设备上拆下。

sentence_examples.en: Try to detach your emotions from the outcome to stay focused.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽量把情绪和结果分离，以便保持专注。

sentence_examples.en: I want to know every detail of the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想知道这个计划的每一个细节。

sentence_examples.en: The report details the steps we will take.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告详细说明了我们将采取的步骤。

sentence_examples.zh: 他在付款前检查了发票的每一个细节。

sentence_examples.en: The police detained a suspect for questioning.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方扣留了一名嫌疑人进行讯问。

sentence_examples.en: Heavy snow detained travelers on the highway for several hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 大雪使高速公路上的旅客滞留了数小时。

sentence_examples.en: Security checks detained several passengers at the airport.
sentence_examples.zh: 安检在机场扣留了几名乘客。

sentence_examples.en: A smoke alarm can detect smoke quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 烟雾报警器能迅速检测到烟雾。

sentence_examples.zh: 测试用于检测系统中的欺诈行为。

sentence_examples.en: She can detect a hint of sarcasm in his voice.
sentence_examples.zh: 她能在他的声音里察觉一丝讽刺。

sentence_examples.zh: 这名侦探在犯罪现场搜集线索。

sentence_examples.zh: 她从小就梦想成为侦探。

sentence_examples.zh: 这名侦探凭借细致的观察破案。

sentence_examples.zh: 金属探测器能在海滩上帮助你找到埋藏的硬币。

sentence_examples.zh: 如果存在气体泄漏，气体探测器会发出警报。

sentence_examples.zh: 如果你忽视这个漏水问题，情况可能会恶化。

sentence_examples.zh: 病情在一夜之间恶化了。

sentence_examples.zh: 测试将决定这个假设是否正确。

sentence_examples.en: The results will determine the next steps.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果将决定下一步的行动。

sentence_examples.en: She developed her writing by taking a course.
sentence_examples.zh: 她通过参加课程提升了写作能力。

sentence_examples.zh: 路线开始偏离预定路径。

sentence_examples.zh: 该设备已连接到监控器，以实时跟踪数据。

sentence_examples.zh: 她在万圣节打扮成一个魔鬼。

sentence_examples.en: The devil is in the details.
sentence_examples.zh: 细节里藏着魔鬼。

translations.translation: 设计;发明;图谋;作出(计划);想出(办法)

sentence_examples.en: The team devised a new strategy to win the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 该团队设计出一种新策略来赢得比赛。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers devised a method to test the theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员设计出一种方法来验证该理论。

sentence_examples.zh: 罪犯设计出一个巧妙的计划来窃取数据。

sentence_examples.en: She devotes her life to helping others.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把毕生精力投入帮助他人。

sentence_examples.en: The team devotes most of its resources to the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个团队把大部分资源投入到这个项目中。

sentence_examples.en: He devotes himself to his work.
sentence_examples.zh: 他全身心投入到工作中。
