sentence_examples.zh: 清晨，草地上覆盖着露水。

sentence_examples.en: We walked through the field and dew clung to our shoes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们穿过田野时，露水沾在我们的鞋子上。

sentence_examples.en: Spider webs glisten with dew after a cool night.
sentence_examples.zh: 凉夜过后，蜘蛛网上的露珠闪闪发光。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor will diagnose the cause of your symptoms after tests.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生会在检查后诊断你症状的原因。

sentence_examples.en: It took several weeks to diagnose the rare illness.
sentence_examples.zh: 需要几周时间才诊断出这种罕见的疾病。

sentence_examples.en: Advances in medical imaging help doctors diagnose diseases more accurately.
sentence_examples.zh: 医学影像技术的进步帮助医生更准确地诊断疾病。

sentence_examples.en: Label each part of the diagram to show where the problem occurred.
sentence_examples.zh: 在图解的每个部分上标注，以显示问题发生的地方。

sentence_examples.en: The diagram in the manual shows how to assemble the machine.
sentence_examples.zh: 手册中的图解说明了如何组装这台机器。

sentence_examples.en: We drew a quick diagram to illustrate the workflow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们画了一个简要的图示来说明工作流程。

sentence_examples.en: Turn the dial on the stove to high heat.
sentence_examples.zh: 把炉子的旋钮转到最高火力。

sentence_examples.en: She dialed the number and waited for the call.
sentence_examples.zh: 她拨打了号码，等待电话接通。

sentence_examples.en: The clock dial shows the time clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 钟表的刻度盘清楚地显示时间。

sentence_examples.en: He learned to recognize the local dialect after living there a year.
sentence_examples.zh: 在那儿生活一年后，他学会了辨认当地的方言。

sentence_examples.en: The documentary explains how the dialect reflects regional history.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部纪录片解释了方言如何反映地区历史。

sentence_examples.en: In my town, the dialect is fading among young people.
sentence_examples.zh: 在我的小镇，方言在年轻人中正在消失。

sentence_examples.en: The dialog between the two friends sounded natural.
sentence_examples.zh: 两位朋友之间的对话听起来很自然。

sentence_examples.en: We rewrote the dialog to make the scene clearer.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把这段对话改写得更清晰。

sentence_examples.en: Actors practiced the dialog until they could deliver it smoothly.
sentence_examples.zh: 演员们练习这段对话，直到能流畅地表演。

sentence_examples.en: The diameter of the circle is 10 centimeters.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。

sentence_examples.en: We measured the diameter of the circle with a ruler.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用尺子测量了这个圆的直径。

sentence_examples.en: The hole's diameter must be at least 5 millimeters.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个孔的直径至少为5毫米。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a sparkling diamond ring.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戴着一只闪亮的钻石戒指。

sentence_examples.en: A diamond shape is used in many logos.
sentence_examples.zh: 菱形是许多标志中的常见形状。

sentence_examples.en: In baseball, the infield is called the diamond.
sentence_examples.zh: 在棒球中，内野被称为菱形。

sentence_examples.en: I keep a diary to record my thoughts every night.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天晚上写日记来记录我的想法。

sentence_examples.en: She wrote in her diary about the first day of school.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在日记里写下了上学第一天的事情。

sentence_examples.en: The diary has become a family heirloom that has been passed down for generations.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本日记成为了家族传家宝，代代相传。

translations.translation: 口授;(使)听写;指令,指示,命令

sentence_examples.en: The editor dictated the letter to the secretary.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑把信件口授给秘书。

sentence_examples.en: The boss dictated the terms of the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 老板口述了合同条款。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher dictated a paragraph for the students to copy.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师口授了一段供学生抄写。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher read a short passage for dictation.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师朗读了一段短文用于听写。

sentence_examples.en: During dictation, students write down exactly what they hear.
sentence_examples.zh: 在听写时，学生要把所听到的内容一字不差地写下来。

sentence_examples.en: He practiced dictation to improve his spelling and punctuation.
sentence_examples.zh: 他练习听写以提高拼写和标点。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new dictionary to look up unfamiliar words.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一本新词典来查找不熟悉的单词。

sentence_examples.en: This dictionary explains word meanings and pronunciation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本词典解释了单词的含义和发音。

sentence_examples.en: She keeps a pocket dictionary in her bag for quick reference.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把口袋词典放在包里，方便快速查阅。

translations.translation: 死，死亡；(草木)枯萎，凋谢；渴望

sentence_examples.en: This plant will die if you don't water it.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不浇水，这株植物就会死。

sentence_examples.en: I would die for a cup of good coffee.
sentence_examples.zh: 我愿意为一杯好咖啡而死。

sentence_examples.en: The old tree is dying from drought.
sentence_examples.zh: 这棵老树因干旱正在枯萎。

sentence_examples.en: A healthy diet includes a variety of fruits and vegetables.
sentence_examples.zh: 健康的饮食应包括各种水果和蔬菜。

sentence_examples.zh: 她坚持纯素饮食。

sentence_examples.zh: 他们在最佳做法上的意见不同。

sentence_examples.zh: 这两份报告的结论不同。

sentence_examples.en: Prices in the city differ from those in the suburbs.
sentence_examples.zh: 市区的价格与郊区的价格不同。

sentence_examples.en: There is a big difference between the old model and the new one.
sentence_examples.zh: 旧型号和新型号之间有很大的差异。

sentence_examples.zh: 这两个版本之间的价格差只有20美元。

sentence_examples.zh: 在如何推进这个项目的问题上，我们意见不一。

sentence_examples.zh: 两队穿着不同的制服。

sentence_examples.en: She chose a different route to avoid traffic.
sentence_examples.zh: 她选择了一条不同的路线来避开交通。

sentence_examples.en: Everyone has a different opinion about the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 每个人对这个计划有不同的看法。

sentence_examples.en: It's important to differentiate between fact and opinion.
sentence_examples.zh: 区分事实和观点很重要。

sentence_examples.zh: 该软件能通过高级音频分析区分不同的声音。

sentence_examples.zh: 老师帮助学生区分主题思想与细节。

sentence_examples.zh: 一开始学习新语言可能很困难。

sentence_examples.en: It's difficult to determine the exact cause.
sentence_examples.zh: 确定确切原因很困难。

sentence_examples.zh: 她面临一个关于移居海外的艰难决定。

sentence_examples.zh: 她在适应新工作方面遇到了困难。

sentence_examples.zh: 晨光透过百叶窗柔和地扩散进来。

sentence_examples.zh: 她谈吐端庄，心态平静。

sentence_examples.zh: 有尊严的人会以尊重对待他人。

sentence_examples.zh: 典礼进行得庄重。

sentence_examples.zh: 他们在海边的一家咖啡馆与朋友共进晚餐。

sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢把面包蘸橄榄油。

sentence_examples.zh: 公告后，价格略有下降。

sentence_examples.en: She took a quick dip in the pool.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在游泳池里泡了一下水。

sentence_examples.zh: 经过四年的努力，她终于拿到毕业文凭。

sentence_examples.zh: 他的办公室墙上挂着放在相框里的毕业文凭。

translations.translation: 外交的,从事外交的;策略的,有手腕的

sentence_examples.zh: 她的外交技巧帮助他避免了公开的争吵。

sentence_examples.en: The president urged a diplomatic approach to the crisis.
sentence_examples.zh: 总统呼吁对这场危机采取外交途径。

sentence_examples.en: He remained diplomatic despite the criticism.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管受到批评，他仍然保持了外交风度。

sentence_examples.zh: 走一条直达的路线去车站。

sentence_examples.zh: 主管指导团队完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.zh: 请把你的问题转给接待员。

sentence_examples.zh: 按照地图上的指示方向去博物馆。

sentence_examples.zh: 我需要关于如何组装这个书架的说明。

sentence_examples.en: Turn left in this direction to reach the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 沿着这个方向左转就能到公园。

sentence_examples.zh: 你到达时请直接来我的办公室。

sentence_examples.zh: 她直接和经理谈论这个问题。

sentence_examples.zh: 会议结束后我会直接给你打电话。

sentence_examples.zh: 新任导演将在新闻发布会上发言。

sentence_examples.zh: 我在电话簿里找到了她的号码。

sentence_examples.zh: 请把你的联系信息添加到通讯录，这样同事就能联系到你。

sentence_examples.en: The online directory lists thousands of businesses.
sentence_examples.zh: 在线目录列出了成千上万家企业。

sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们在外面玩耍后，衣服上全是污垢。

sentence_examples.zh: 他在进入建筑物前把鞋子上的污垢拂掉。

sentence_examples.zh: 他在远足时把衬衫弄脏了。

sentence_examples.zh: 那场事故让他数月无法行动。

sentence_examples.zh: 新软件会使旧硬件无法工作。

sentence_examples.en: The system will disable user accounts after 30 days of inactivity.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统在用户长时间不活跃后会禁用账户。

sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上的钱不见了。

sentence_examples.en: If you wait a moment, the magician will make the rabbit disappear.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你等一会儿，魔术师会让兔子消失。

sentence_examples.en: Missing the deadline would disappoint the team.

sentence_examples.zh: 错过截止日期将使发布计划陷入灾难。

sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨在这座城市造成了严重的洪水。

sentence_examples.en: This decision was disastrous for the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个决定对公司来说是灾难性的。

sentence_examples.en: The launch turned out to be disastrous.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次产品发布会最终以惨败告终。

sentence_examples.zh: 该光盘包含你需要安装的软件。

sentence_examples.zh: 请沿边缘拿光盘，以免留下指纹。

sentence_examples.zh: 她把文件刻录到一张空白的光盘上。

sentence_examples.zh: 你应该丢弃过期的优惠券。

sentence_examples.zh: 在审阅证据后，他能辨认出案件的关键点。

sentence_examples.en: From a distance, I could discern the silhouette of a person.
sentence_examples.zh: 从远处，我能辨认出一个人的轮廓。

translations.translation: 卸货,排出;发射,放(电);遣散,解雇

sentence_examples.en: The ship will discharge its cargo at the port.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘船将在港口卸货。

sentence_examples.en: The battery discharges quickly in cold weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 在寒冷的天气里，电池放电很快。

sentence_examples.en: The patient was discharged from the hospital after the operation.
sentence_examples.zh: 手术后，患者从医院出院。

sentence_examples.en: Self-discipline is key to success.
sentence_examples.zh: 自律是成功的关键。

sentence_examples.en: In the army, strict discipline is enforced.
sentence_examples.zh: 在军队中，纪律要求非常严格。

sentence_examples.en: The university offers many disciplines, such as physics and history.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学提供多门学科，例如物理学和历史学。

sentence_examples.en: The company will disclose its earnings tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司明天将披露其业绩。

sentence_examples.en: She refused to disclose the sources for the article.
sentence_examples.zh: 她拒绝透露这篇报道的消息来源。

sentence_examples.en: The report failed to disclose all the risks.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告未披露所有风险。

sentence_examples.en: I bought the jacket with a 20% discount.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了这件夹克，享受了 20% 的折扣。

sentence_examples.en: Stores discount seasonal items to make room for new stock.
sentence_examples.zh: 商店会对季节性商品打折以为新货让路。

sentence_examples.en: We should not discount his contribution; it was important.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们不应该低估他的贡献，它很重要。

sentence_examples.en: Critics tried to discourage her from pursuing a career in art.
sentence_examples.zh: 批评者试图让她放弃从事艺术的职业。

sentence_examples.en: The supervisor's harsh words discouraged him from finishing the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 上司的苛刻话语让他放弃完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: I don't want to discourage you, but this plan seems risky.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不想打击你，但这个计划似乎很冒险。

sentence_examples.en: The professor gave a long discourse on ancient philosophy.
sentence_examples.zh: 教授就古代哲学作了长篇论述。

sentence_examples.en: Public discourse on climate change has intensified recently.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于气候变化的公共讨论最近更加激烈。

sentence_examples.en: The author discourses on the themes of memory and identity in her latest novel.
sentence_examples.zh: 作者在她的最新小说中论述了记忆和身份的主题。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists hope to discover new species in the rainforest.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家希望在热带雨林中发现新的物种。

sentence_examples.en: I just discovered that the meeting was moved to Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我刚刚发现会议改到了星期五。

sentence_examples.en: We finally discovered the source of the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们终于发现了问题的根源。

sentence_examples.en: The discovery of a new species surprised scientists.
sentence_examples.zh: 新物种的发现让科学家们感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: She kept the discovery secret until the project finished.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把这个发现保密，直到项目结束。

sentence_examples.en: The museum opened an exhibit to showcase a recent discovery in archaeology.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆开设展览，展示最近的考古发现。

translations.translation: (言行)谨慎的；慎重的；有判断力的

sentence_examples.en: She was discreet about the salary details, not revealing them to anyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对工资细节保持谨慎，不向任何人透露。

sentence_examples.en: He handled the gossip discreetly, changing the subject.
sentence_examples.zh: 他谨慎地处理八卦，转移话题。

sentence_examples.en: Please be discreet about the surprise party so as not to spoil it.
sentence_examples.zh: 请对这个惊喜派对保持低调，以免破坏惊喜。

sentence_examples.en: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两份报告之间存在差异。

sentence_examples.en: The accountant found a discrepancy in the numbers.
sentence_examples.zh: 会计在数字上发现了差异。

sentence_examples.en: There is a discrepancy between what he said and what actually happened.
sentence_examples.zh: 他所说的话与实际发生的情况之间存在差异。

translations.translation: 区别,辨别;(against)有差别地对待,歧视

sentence_examples.en: We can discriminate between the two fabrics by touch.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们可以通过触摸区分这两种面料。

sentence_examples.en: This policy discriminates against people with disabilities.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项政策对残疾人士存在歧视。

sentence_examples.en: The software can discriminate between colors that look identical to the human eye.
sentence_examples.zh: 该软件能够区分在人眼看起来完全相同的颜色。

sentence_examples.en: We will discuss the plan at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将在会议上讨论这个计划。

sentence_examples.en: Let's discuss the schedule after lunch.
sentence_examples.zh: 午饭后我们来讨论日程安排。

sentence_examples.en: They discussed the impact of the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们讨论了新政策的影响。

sentence_examples.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的运动可以降低心脏病的风险。

sentence_examples.en: Early screening helps detect disease before symptoms appear.
sentence_examples.zh: 早期筛查有助于在出现症状前发现疾病。

sentence_examples.en: Chronic disease requires ongoing management.
sentence_examples.zh: 慢性疾病需要持续管理。

sentence_examples.en: The scandal brought disgrace to the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 这起丑闻给公司带来了耻辱。

sentence_examples.en: The athlete disgraced himself by using banned substances.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名运动员因为使用禁药而蒙羞。

sentence_examples.en: Lying about the issue would disgrace the whole organization.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果把这件事说谎，会让整个组织蒙羞。

sentence_examples.en: He disguises his voice to avoid being noticed.
sentence_examples.zh: 他为了不被人发现而伪装声音。

sentence_examples.en: The disguise helped the thief slip past the guards.
sentence_examples.zh: 这副伪装让窃贼混过警卫。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a disguise to attend the party, hiding her identity.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戴着伪装去参加派对，隐藏身份。

sentence_examples.en: The sight of spoiled meat filled him with disgust.
sentence_examples.zh: 看到变质的肉让他感到厌恶。

sentence_examples.en: That rude remark disgusts me.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个粗鲁的言论让我感到厌恶。

sentence_examples.en: She felt a deep disgust at the polluted river.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对被污染的河流感到强烈的厌恶。

sentence_examples.en: The main dish is roasted chicken.
sentence_examples.zh: 主菜是烤鸡。

sentence_examples.en: Please wash the dish after dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 晚饭后请把碟子洗干净。

sentence_examples.en: This dish is spicy and flavorful.
sentence_examples.zh: 这道菜又辣又香。

sentence_examples.en: I dislike waking up early.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不喜欢早起。

sentence_examples.en: I have a dislike for loud noises.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对吵闹的声音很反感。

sentence_examples.en: If you dislike cilantro, you can skip it in the recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢香菜，你可以在菜谱中省略它。

translations.translation: (使)沮丧;(使)惊慌;(使)失望,(使)绝望

sentence_examples.en: Her dismay grew when she opened the letter.
sentence_examples.zh: 她一打开信，沮丧之情便涌上心头。

sentence_examples.en: The announcement dismayed many students.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项公告让许多学生感到沮丧。

sentence_examples.en: A wave of dismay spread through the team after the setback.
sentence_examples.zh: 挫折后，团队中蔓延起一股沮丧情绪。

sentence_examples.en: The company dismissed him for poor performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司因业绩不佳解雇了他。

sentence_examples.en: The court dismissed the case due to lack of evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院因证据不足而驳回了案件。

sentence_examples.en: She dismissed the suggestion with a shake of her head.
sentence_examples.zh: 她摇头否决了这个提议。

translations.translation: 混乱,杂乱;骚乱;失调,疾病

sentence_examples.en: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 派对结束后，房间一片混乱。

sentence_examples.en: The demonstrations caused social disorder in the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 示威活动在这座城市引发社会动乱。

sentence_examples.en: Many people have a sleep disorder.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人患有睡眠障碍。

sentence_examples.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方用催泪弹驱散人群。

sentence_examples.en: The wind dispersed the seeds over the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 风把种子吹散在田野上。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd began to disperse after the speech.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲结束后，观众开始散去。

sentence_examples.en: The earthquake displaced thousands of residents.
sentence_examples.zh: 地震使成千上万名居民流离失所。

sentence_examples.en: The new software displaced the old system by offering faster performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 新软件凭借更快的性能取代了旧系统。

sentence_examples.en: The construction project displaced several families living nearby.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项开发项目迫使几户邻近的家庭搬离。

sentence_examples.en: The store will display the new collection in the window.
sentence_examples.zh: 商店会把新系列陈列在橱窗里。

sentence_examples.en: The museum's display of ancient artifacts attracted many visitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆对古代文物的展览吸引了许多游客。

sentence_examples.en: Touch the button to display the results on the screen.
sentence_examples.zh: 按下按钮将结果显示在屏幕上。

sentence_examples.en: Waste disposal is a major environmental issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 废物处置是一个重大的环境问题。

sentence_examples.en: The disposal of assets requires proper approvals and documentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 处置资产需要适当的批准和文档。

sentence_examples.en: They installed a new garbage disposal under the sink.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在水槽下安装了一个新的垃圾处理装置。

sentence_examples.en: We need to dispose of the old furniture.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要处置这些旧家具。

sentence_examples.en: The event planner disposed the chairs to face the stage.
sentence_examples.zh: 活动策划把椅子摆成面向舞台的布局。

sentence_examples.en: Always dispose of batteries and chemicals according to local regulations.
sentence_examples.zh: 请始终按照当地规定处置电池和化学品。

translations.translation: 排列,部署;性格倾向;倾向,意向

sentence_examples.en: Her sunny disposition makes her a popular colleague.
sentence_examples.zh: 她性格开朗，深受同事欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: Her disposition toward risk makes her cautious.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对风险的倾向使她变得谨慎。

sentence_examples.en: The general reviewed the disposition of the troops before the march.
sentence_examples.zh: 将军在出发前检查了部队的部署。

translations.translation: 争论,辩论;反驳;怀疑;阻止

sentence_examples.en: There was a dispute over the contract terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同条款方面存在争议。

sentence_examples.en: The two colleagues disputed the manager's decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 两位同事对经理的决定提出了异议。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers disputed the results of the study.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员对这项研究结果提出了质疑。

sentence_examples.en: The driver disregarded the stop sign and ran through the intersection.
sentence_examples.zh: 司机无视停车标志，冲过交叉口。

sentence_examples.en: There is a growing disregard for safety guidelines in some teams.
sentence_examples.zh: 一些团队对安全指南的漠视日益加剧。

sentence_examples.en: Please do not disregard the warning about icy conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 请不要忽视关于结冰条件的警告。

translations.translation: 使混乱，使崩溃，使分裂，使瓦解

sentence_examples.en: Heavy rain disrupted the outdoor concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 大雨干扰了户外音乐会的进行。

sentence_examples.en: New regulations disrupted the supply chain.
sentence_examples.zh: 新规定扰乱了供应链。

sentence_examples.en: The construction noise disrupted my sleep.
sentence_examples.zh: 建筑施工的噪音打断了我的睡眠。

translations.translation: 驱散;(使云、雾、疑虑等)消散;挥霍

sentence_examples.en: The morning sun dissipated the fog over the valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 清晨的阳光把山谷上的雾气驱散了。

sentence_examples.en: After the argument, the tension began to dissipate.
sentence_examples.zh: 争论结束后，紧张气氛开始消散。

sentence_examples.en: She dissipated her savings on lavish purchases.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把存款花在奢侈的购物上，挥霍一空。

sentence_examples.en: Sugar dissolves in hot water quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 糖在热水中很快溶解。

sentence_examples.en: The company dissolved the partnership last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司去年解散了合伙关系。

sentence_examples.en: Dissolve the tablet in a glass of water.
sentence_examples.zh: 把药片溶解在一杯水中。

sentence_examples.en: The distance between the two cities is about 300 miles.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两座城市之间的距离大约是300英里。

sentence_examples.en: They walked a long distance to reach the village.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们走了很长一段路才到达村庄。

sentence_examples.en: I kept my distance from the wild animal.
sentence_examples.zh: 我与野生动物保持距离。

translations.translation: 远的;遥远的;疏远的;不亲近的

sentence_examples.en: The distant mountains looked blue against the sky.
sentence_examples.zh: 远处的群山在天空下显得蔚蓝。

sentence_examples.en: She remained distant after the argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 在争吵之后，她仍然很疏远。

sentence_examples.en: I have a distant memory of visiting that town as a child.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对小时候去过那个小镇还有一段遥远的记忆。

translations.translation: 蒸馏，用蒸馏法提取；吸取，提炼

sentence_examples.en: Chemists distill the liquid to separate the alcohol from water.
sentence_examples.zh: 化学家通过蒸馏将液体中的酒精与水分离。

sentence_examples.en: The report distills the complex issue into a few clear points.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告把复杂的问题提炼成几个清晰的要点。

sentence_examples.en: She distills the speech into a few bullet points.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把演讲提炼成几个要点。

translations.translation: 清楚的,明显的;(from)截然不同的

sentence_examples.en: There is a distinct smell of pine in the forest.
sentence_examples.zh: 森林里有一种明显的松香味。

sentence_examples.en: The two species are distinct from each other.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两种物种彼此截然不同。

sentence_examples.en: Her handwriting is distinct and easy to read.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的字迹清晰，易读。

translations.translation: 区别,差别;级别;特性;声望;显赫

sentence_examples.en: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
sentence_examples.zh: 对错之间有清晰的区别。

sentence_examples.en: She graduated with distinction from the university.
sentence_examples.zh: 她以优异成绩从大学毕业。

sentence_examples.en: The distinguishing feature of this model is its durability.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款产品的显著特征是它的耐用性。

sentence_examples.en: It's important to distinguish fact from opinion.
sentence_examples.zh: 把事实和意见区分开来很重要。

sentence_examples.en: She could distinguish the twins by their birthmarks.
sentence_examples.zh: 她能通过胎记把那对双胞胎分辨开来。

sentence_examples.en: Her early work helped distinguish her as a rising star in the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的早期工作帮助她在该领域脱颖而出。

translations.translation: 弄歪(嘴脸等);扭曲;歪曲(真理、事实等)

sentence_examples.en: The funhouse mirror distorts your reflection.
sentence_examples.zh: 游乐园里的变形镜扭曲了你的倒影。

sentence_examples.en: The report distorts the facts to mislead readers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份报道歪曲了事实，误导读者。

sentence_examples.en: He tried not to distort the truth in his interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在采访中尽量不扭曲真相。

translations.translation: 分散;使分心;打扰;使心情烦乱

sentence_examples.en: The loud music distracted me from studying for the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 嘈杂的音乐让我在备考时分心。

sentence_examples.en: Don't distract the driver.
sentence_examples.zh: 请不要让司机分心。

sentence_examples.en: Her phone notifications distracted her from the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的手机通知让她在会议中分心。

sentence_examples.en: The news caused her distress.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个消息让她感到非常苦恼。

sentence_examples.en: A ship in distress sent out a mayday.
sentence_examples.zh: 处于危难中的船只发出求救信号。

sentence_examples.en: The rescue team worked to relieve the distress of the survivors.
sentence_examples.zh: 救援队努力缓解幸存者的苦恼。

translations.translation: 分发;分配;分布;配(电);(over)散布

sentence_examples.en: The charity will distribute food to families in need.
sentence_examples.zh: 慈善机构将把食品分发给有需要的家庭。

sentence_examples.en: The manager distributed the tasks among the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理把任务分配给团队成员。

sentence_examples.en: The seeds were distributed evenly across the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 种子在花园里被均匀分布。

translations.translation: 地区,行政区;美国各州的众议院选区

sentence_examples.en: The city is divided into several districts.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座城市分成几个行政区。

sentence_examples.en: I live in a quiet district near the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 我住在河边的一个安静的地区。

sentence_examples.en: The district elected a new representative last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 该区在去年选举了新代表。

sentence_examples.en: Please don’t disturb me while I’m studying.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在学习时请不要打扰我。

sentence_examples.en: The loud traffic disturbed his sleep.
sentence_examples.zh: 喧闹的交通声打扰了他的睡眠。

sentence_examples.en: The party next door disturbed the neighbors.
sentence_examples.zh: 隔壁的聚会打扰了邻居们。

sentence_examples.en: There was a disturbance outside the theater after the show.
sentence_examples.zh: 演出结束后，剧院外发生了骚乱。

sentence_examples.en: The loud construction work caused a disturbance for nearby residents.
sentence_examples.zh: 喧闹的施工声给附近居民带来干扰。

sentence_examples.en: Police were called to handle a disturbance at the bar.
sentence_examples.zh: 警察被叫去处理酒吧里的骚乱。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer dug a ditch along the field to drain the water.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民在田地旁挖了一条沟渠来排水。

sentence_examples.en: The car got stuck in a ditch after the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨后，汽车卡在路边的沟里。

sentence_examples.en: We need to clear the ditch beside the road.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要清理路边的水沟。

sentence_examples.en: I like to dive into the pool on hot days.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢在炎热的日子跳进泳池。

sentence_examples.en: The divers perform a perfect dive.
sentence_examples.zh: 潜水运动员完成了一次完美的跳水。

sentence_examples.en: The plane suddenly began to dive toward the sea.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机突然开始向海面俯冲。

sentence_examples.en: Our campus hosts a diverse group of students from around the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的校园接待了来自世界各地的多元化学生。

sentence_examples.en: The team includes players from diverse backgrounds.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队成员来自不同背景。

sentence_examples.en: The museum has a diverse collection, spanning ancient artifacts to contemporary art.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆拥有丰富多样的藏品，涵盖从古代文物到当代艺术。

translations.translation: 转向,转移;牵制;解闷;娱乐

sentence_examples.en: There is a diversion around the construction site.
sentence_examples.zh: 施工现场设有分流。

sentence_examples.en: Reading provides a welcome diversion from the routine.
sentence_examples.zh: 阅读为日常生活提供了一个解闷的途径。

sentence_examples.en: The festival offers a pleasant diversion for residents.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个节日为居民提供了愉快的娱乐消遣。

translations.translation: 使转向，使改道；转移(注意力)；使娱乐

sentence_examples.en: Construction work will divert traffic away from the city center.
sentence_examples.zh: 施工将交通改道，绕开市中心。

sentence_examples.en: A short break can divert your attention from work.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个短暂的休息可以把你对工作的注意力转移开。

sentence_examples.en: The comedian's show is designed to divert the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员的演出旨在娱乐观众。

sentence_examples.en: We need to divide the cake into eight pieces.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要把蛋糕分成八份。

sentence_examples.en: The class is divided into four groups for the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了这个项目，班级被分成四组。

sentence_examples.en: If you divide 12 by 3, you get 4.
sentence_examples.zh: 把12除以3，结果是4。

translations.translation: 红利，股息；回报，效益；被除数

sentence_examples.en: The company announced a higher dividend this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司宣布今年将发放更高的股息。

sentence_examples.en: Shareholders expect a dividend of $2 per share.

sentence_examples.zh: 父母通过以身作则来教育孩子。

sentence_examples.en: The program educates adults who never finished school.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目教育那些没有完成学业的成年人。

sentence_examples.en: Education is important for a successful career.
sentence_examples.zh: 教育对成功的职业生涯很重要。

sentence_examples.en: She plans to pursue higher education after high school.
sentence_examples.zh: 她计划高中毕业后继续接受高等教育。

sentence_examples.en: Investing in education benefits society.
sentence_examples.zh: 投资教育有利于社会发展。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy has a positive effect on small businesses.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策对小型企业产生了积极影响。

sentence_examples.en: The researchers hope to effect significant changes in policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员希望通过政策实现重大改变。

sentence_examples.en: The lighting created a dramatic effect in the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 照明在房间里营造出戏剧性的效果。

translations.translation: 有效的,生效的;被实施的;给人深刻印象

sentence_examples.en: This method is effective for solving this problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种方法对解决这个问题很有效。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy will be effective from next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策将从下月起生效。

sentence_examples.en: Her advice was effective in improving the team's performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的建议在提升团队绩效方面很有效。

sentence_examples.en: Improving fuel efficiency can save drivers a lot of money.
sentence_examples.zh: 提高燃油效率可以为司机省下很多钱。

sentence_examples.en: The new workflow increased the team's efficiency by eliminating redundant steps.
sentence_examples.zh: 新工作流程通过消除冗余步骤提高了团队的效率。

sentence_examples.en: We measured the machine's efficiency under different load conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在不同负载条件下测量了这台机器的效率。

translations.translation: 有效的,效率高的;有能力的,能胜任的

sentence_examples.en: The new machine is more efficient than the old one, saving us time.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台新机器比旧机器更高效，能节省时间。

sentence_examples.en: She is an efficient worker who completes tasks quickly and accurately.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位高效的员工，能快速且准确地完成任务。

sentence_examples.en: We need an efficient plan to reduce costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要一个高效的计划来降低成本。

sentence_examples.en: She put a lot of effort into her presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在演讲上投入了大量努力。

sentence_examples.en: Effort pays off when you practice regularly.
sentence_examples.zh: 只要你经常练习，努力就会得到回报。

sentence_examples.en: The team made a joint effort to fix the issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队共同努力解决了这个问题。

sentence_examples.en: I need three eggs for this recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个食谱需要三个鸡蛋。

sentence_examples.en: She fried an egg for breakfast.
sentence_examples.zh: 她早餐煎了一个鸡蛋。

sentence_examples.en: Eggs should be kept in the refrigerator.
sentence_examples.zh: 鸡蛋应保存在冰箱里。

translations.translation: 自我，自负，利已主义；(心理学)自我意识

sentence_examples.en: Her ego wouldn't let her ask for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的自负不让她请求帮助。

sentence_examples.en: In psychology, the ego mediates between the id and the superego.
sentence_examples.zh: 在心理分析中，自我在本我和超我之间起调解作用。

sentence_examples.en: He spoke with such an inflated ego that others found him arrogant.
sentence_examples.zh: 他说话时带着膨胀的自我，别人觉得他很傲慢。

sentence_examples.en: There are eight cookies on the plate.
sentence_examples.zh: 盘子上有八块饼干。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting starts at eight o'clock.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议在八点钟开始。

sentence_examples.en: Eight students joined the club.
sentence_examples.zh: 有八名学生加入了这个俱乐部。

sentence_examples.en: He turned eighteen last month.
sentence_examples.zh: 他上个月满十八岁。

sentence_examples.en: There are eighteen students in the class.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个班有十八个学生。

sentence_examples.en: The book costs eighteen dollars.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书要价十八美元。

sentence_examples.en: There are eighty students in the class.
sentence_examples.zh: 班里有八十名学生。

sentence_examples.en: She turned eighty last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去年已经满八十岁。

sentence_examples.en: The speed limit is eighty kilometers per hour.
sentence_examples.zh: 限速为每小时八十公里。

sentence_examples.en: You can choose either option.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以选择任一选项。

sentence_examples.en: I don't like it either.
sentence_examples.zh: 我也不喜欢它。

sentence_examples.en: We can meet at either time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们可以在任一时间见面。

sentence_examples.en: The printer will eject the paper when the print is done.
sentence_examples.zh: 打印完成后，纸张会从打印机弹出。

sentence_examples.en: The pilot had to eject from the aircraft after the engine failed.
sentence_examples.zh: 发动机故障后，飞行员不得不从飞机弹射出去。

sentence_examples.en: He was ejected from the game for unsportsmanlike conduct.
sentence_examples.zh: 他因不体育道德行为被逐出比赛。

translations.translation: 精心制作(的);详细阐述(的)

sentence_examples.en: Could you elaborate on your plan for the project?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能详细阐述一下你对这个项目的计划吗？

sentence_examples.en: She wore an elaborate dress for the gala.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在晚会上穿了一件精心设计的礼服。

sentence_examples.en: The room was filled with elaborate decorations.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间里布满了精心设计的装饰。

sentence_examples.en: Weeks elapsed before the new policy took effect.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策生效前，已经过去了几周。

sentence_examples.en: Two hours elapsed while I waited for the bus.
sentence_examples.zh: 我等公交车时，已经过去了两个小时。

sentence_examples.en: As time elapses, memories fade.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着时间的流逝，记忆会逐渐模糊。

sentence_examples.en: The waistband is elastic and fits comfortably.
sentence_examples.zh: 腰部的松紧带有弹性，穿起来很舒服。

sentence_examples.en: The elastic at the waist keeps the shorts up.
sentence_examples.zh: 腰部的松紧带能把短裤撑起来，防止滑落。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to stretch the elastic.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心不要把松紧带拉得过度。

sentence_examples.en: Her elbow hurt after she bumped it on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的肘部在撞到桌子后疼痛。

sentence_examples.en: The elbow of the sleeve is reinforced with extra stitching.
sentence_examples.zh: 袖子的肘部用额外的缝线加固。

sentence_examples.en: She elbowed her way through the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用肘部挤过人群。

sentence_examples.en: The elder students formed a study group after class.
sentence_examples.zh: 放学后，年长的学生组成了一个学习小组。

sentence_examples.en: In many tribes, elders advise the community.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多部落中，长者为社区提供建议。

sentence_examples.en: She is the elder sister in the family.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是家里的大姐。

sentence_examples.en: The elderly man sits on the bench and watches the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位年长的男子坐在长椅上，望着公园。

sentence_examples.en: The elderly are advised to stay active.
sentence_examples.zh: 老年人被建议保持活跃。

sentence_examples.en: The charity helps the elderly with daily tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 慈善机构帮助老年人完成日常任务。

translations.translation: 选举,推选;选择,作出选择

sentence_examples.en: The students will elect a class president this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年学生们将选出班级主席。

sentence_examples.en: They elected him captain after the vote.
sentence_examples.zh: 投票后，他们选他为队长。

sentence_examples.en: If you elect to accept the offer, please respond by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你选择接受这个提议，请在周五前回复。

sentence_examples.en: The electric car is becoming more popular.
sentence_examples.zh: 電動車在城市路上越來越普及。

sentence_examples.en: Always unplug electric appliances before cleaning.
sentence_examples.zh: 清潔前，請務必拔掉電器的插頭。

sentence_examples.en: A small electric shock can occur if you touch a live wire.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果觸碰到帶電的電線，可能會觸電。

sentence_examples.en: The electrical outlet is overloaded.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个电源插座过载了。

sentence_examples.en: He works in electrical engineering.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在电气工程领域工作。

sentence_examples.en: Electrical safety is important in the workplace.
sentence_examples.zh: 工作场所的电气安全很重要。

sentence_examples.en: The electrician fixed the faulty wiring in the kitchen.
sentence_examples.zh: 电工修好了厨房的故障电线。

sentence_examples.en: We called an electrician to install a new ceiling light in the living room.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们请来一位电工，在客厅安装一个新吸顶灯。

sentence_examples.en: The electrician explained how to reset the circuit breaker after the outage.
sentence_examples.zh: 电工解释了停电后如何重置断路器。

sentence_examples.en: Electricity powers most of modern life.
sentence_examples.zh: 电力支撑着现代生活的方方面面。

sentence_examples.en: The electricity went out during the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨时停电了。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists study electricity to understand how atoms move.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家研究电学，以了解原子如何运动。

sentence_examples.en: An electron is a negatively charged particle.
sentence_examples.zh: 电子是带负电荷的微粒。

sentence_examples.en: In atoms, electrons orbit the nucleus.
sentence_examples.zh: 在原子里，电子绕原子核运动。

sentence_examples.en: Electric current is the flow of electrons.
sentence_examples.zh: 电流是电子的流动。

sentence_examples.en: I bought an electronic organizer to help manage my notes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一个电子记事本来帮助整理我的笔记。

sentence_examples.en: Electronic payments are now accepted at most stores.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在大多数商店都接受电子支付。

sentence_examples.en: This electronic device runs on rechargeable batteries.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个电子设备使用可充电电池供电。

sentence_examples.en: Her dress was elegant and timeless.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的裙子既优雅又永不过时。

sentence_examples.en: He offered an elegant solution to the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 他提出了一个优雅的解决方案。

sentence_examples.en: The room looked elegant with its simple decor.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间以简洁的装饰显得优雅。

translations.translation: 元素;要素;成分;元件;自然环境

sentence_examples.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
sentence_examples.zh: 氢是最轻的元素。

sentence_examples.en: A good design includes an element of surprise.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个好的设计往往包含惊喜这一要素。

sentence_examples.en: Safety is a crucial element of any project.
sentence_examples.zh: 安全是任何项目中的关键要素。

translations.translation: 初步的;基本的;[化]元素的;自然力的

sentence_examples.en: This is an elementary task that any beginner can complete.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是一个初级任务，任何初学者都能完成。

sentence_examples.en: Hydrogen is an elementary substance.
sentence_examples.zh: 氢是一种元素。

sentence_examples.en: The theory describes the elementary forces that govern the universe.
sentence_examples.zh: 该理论描述了支配宇宙的基本力。

sentence_examples.en: The elephant is the largest land animal.
sentence_examples.zh: 大象是陆地上最大的动物。

sentence_examples.en: We saw an elephant at the zoo.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在动物园看见了一头大象。

sentence_examples.en: An elephant's trunk is used to grab objects.
sentence_examples.zh: 大象的鼻子用来抓取物体。

translations.translation: 举起,提拔,振奋,提升...的职位

sentence_examples.en: The crane can elevate heavy machinery onto the platform.
sentence_examples.zh: 起重机可以把重型机械举升到平台上。

sentence_examples.en: The board decided to elevate her to a senior partner.
sentence_examples.zh: 董事会决定将她提升为高级合伙人。

sentence_examples.en: A new training program can elevate employees' skills.
sentence_examples.zh: 一项新的培训计划可以提升员工的技能。

sentence_examples.en: I took the elevator to the tenth floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 我乘电梯到十楼。

sentence_examples.en: The elevator is out of order, please use the stairs.
sentence_examples.zh: 电梯坏了，请走楼梯。

sentence_examples.en: This building has a fast elevator.
sentence_examples.zh: 这栋大楼的电梯很快。

sentence_examples.en: There are eleven players on the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 场上有十一名球员。

sentence_examples.en: We ordered eleven pizzas for the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 派对上我们点了十一份披萨。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting starts at eleven.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议在十一点开始。

translations.translation: 符合条件的;(尤指婚姻等)合适(意)的

sentence_examples.en: Only eligible voters can participate in the election.
sentence_examples.zh: 只有符合条件的选民才能参加选举。

sentence_examples.en: She became eligible for the scholarship after submitting all required documents.
sentence_examples.zh: 在提交所有必需文件后，她获得了奖学金的资格。

sentence_examples.en: They are eligible to marry after meeting the legal requirements.
sentence_examples.zh: 在满足法定条件后，他们就有资格结婚。

translations.translation: 除去;淘汰;排(删,消)除;削减(人员)

sentence_examples.en: We need to eliminate all duplicate records from the database.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要从数据库中删除所有重复记录。

sentence_examples.en: New policies aim to eliminate waste and reduce costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策旨在消除浪费并降低成本。

sentence_examples.en: She was eliminated from the competition in the semifinals.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在半决赛中被淘汰出局。

translations.translation: <法>[集合名词]精华;精锐;中坚分子

sentence_examples.en: Only the elite from the university are invited to the exclusive research conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 只有来自该校的精英被邀请参加这次专门的研究会议。

sentence_examples.en: The elite of the nation gathered to discuss how to respond to the crisis.
sentence_examples.zh: 国家的精英聚集起来讨论如何应对危机。

sentence_examples.en: He joined the local art elite after winning a prestigious award.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在赢得一项有声望的奖项后加入了当地艺术精英的行列。

translations.translation: 雄辩的,有说服力的;善辩的,口才流利的

sentence_examples.en: Her speech was eloquent and moved the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的演讲雄辩，深深打动了听众。

sentence_examples.en: He gave an eloquent defense of his proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对自己的提案进行了有说服力的辩护。

sentence_examples.en: An eloquent writer can express complex ideas clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 善辩的作家能够清晰地表达复杂的观点。

translations.translation: 其它，另外，别的；[与or连用]否则

sentence_examples.en: Would you like anything else?
sentence_examples.zh: 你还想要别的东西吗？

sentence_examples.en: Is there anyone else who can help?
sentence_examples.zh: 还有谁能帮忙吗？

sentence_examples.en: There is nothing else I can do.
sentence_examples.zh: 我没别的办法了。

sentence_examples.en: If you can't find the book here, try looking elsewhere.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果在这里找不到这本书，可以去别处看看。

sentence_examples.en: We looked elsewhere for a solution.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们去其他地方找解决办法。

sentence_examples.en: Is there coffee elsewhere in the building?
sentence_examples.zh: 大楼里其他地方还有咖啡吗？

sentence_examples.en: I received an e-mail from the project team this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今天早上收到项目组发来的电子邮件。

sentence_examples.en: Please reply to the e-mail by the end of the day.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在今天之内回复这封电子邮件。

sentence_examples.en: She sent me an e-mail with the file attached.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给我发了一封带有附件的电子邮件。

translations.translation: (使)上船(或飞机,汽车等);着手,从事

sentence_examples.en: Passengers are asked to embark on their flight at Gate 12.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在12号登机口登机。

sentence_examples.en: The company will embark on a new marketing campaign next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将于下月启动一项新的市场活动。

sentence_examples.en: He decided to embark on a solo backpacking trip across Europe.
sentence_examples.zh: 他决定展开一次独自的背包旅行，横跨欧洲。

translations.translation: 使困窘,使局促不安;阻碍,麻烦

sentence_examples.en: Please don't embarrass me in front of my friends.
sentence_examples.zh: 请不要在我的朋友面前让我难堪。

sentence_examples.en: The unexpected question embarrasses the speaker.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个出人意料的问题让发言人感到尴尬。

sentence_examples.en: His clumsy mistake embarrassed the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 他笨拙的错误让团队感到尴尬。

sentence_examples.en: We went to the embassy to apply for a visa.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们去大使馆申请签证。

sentence_examples.en: The embassy issued a travel advisory after the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事件发生后，大使馆发布了旅行提醒。

sentence_examples.en: She visited the embassy to renew her passport.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去大使馆续办护照。

translations.translation: 把…嵌(埋、插)入，扎牢；使深留脑中

sentence_examples.en: The journalist embedded with the troops to report from the front lines.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名记者与部队同驻，在前线进行报道。

sentence_examples.en: The engineer embedded a temperature sensor in the wall to monitor heat.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师把温度传感器嵌入墙内以监测温度。

sentence_examples.en: The important safety rules were embedded in her memory after the training.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过培训后，重要的安全规则已深深印在她的记忆里。

translations.translation: 具体表达,使具体化;包含,收录

sentence_examples.en: The charity's mission embodies the values of compassion and service.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个慈善机构的使命体现了同情和服务的价值观。

sentence_examples.en: The sculpture embodies the artist's concept of resilience.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕塑体现了艺术家对韧性的概念。

sentence_examples.en: The policy embodies the principles of equality and includes protections for minorities.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策体现了平等原则，并包括对少数群体的保护。

translations.translation: 拥抱;包含;包围;环绕;采用;接受

sentence_examples.en: They embraced after decades apart.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在分离了几十年后拥抱在一起。

sentence_examples.en: The school embraces new teaching methods.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校采用了新的教学方法。

sentence_examples.en: The festival embraces people from many cultures.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个节日包容来自多种文化背景的人们。

sentence_examples.en: A figure emerged from the shadows.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个人影从阴影中浮现出来。

sentence_examples.en: The truth will emerge over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 真相终会浮出水面。

sentence_examples.en: He emerged as the leader after the restructuring.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在重组后成为了领导者。

translations.translation: 紧急情况,突然事件,非常时刻

sentence_examples.en: In an emergency, stay calm and call for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 在紧急情况下，保持冷静并寻求帮助。

sentence_examples.en: The emergency exit is clearly marked beside the stairs.
sentence_examples.zh: 紧急出口在楼梯旁边，标识清晰。

sentence_examples.en: The school conducts an emergency drill every year.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校每年进行一次应急演练。

sentence_examples.en: Many people emigrate to Canada for a better life.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人为了更好的生活移居到加拿大。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to emigrate from her homeland to Australia.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定从祖国移居到澳大利亚。

sentence_examples.en: They plan to emigrate next year after finishing their studies.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们计划在完成学业后明年移居国外。

translations.translation: 显赫的;杰出的;有名的;优良的

sentence_examples.en: The eminent scientist gave a talk on climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位杰出的科学家就气候变化发表了演讲。

sentence_examples.en: An eminent author is often invited to speak at conferences.
sentence_examples.zh: 知名作家经常被邀请在会议上发言。

sentence_examples.en: She studied under an eminent professor who wrote several influential papers.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在一位声誉卓著的教授门下学习，该教授撰写了几篇有影响力的论文。

translations.translation: 发出;放射;吐露;散发;发表;发行

sentence_examples.en: The lamp emits a soft glow that lights the whole room.
sentence_examples.zh: 灯发出柔和的光，照亮整个房间。

sentence_examples.en: Some plants emit oxygen during photosynthesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物在光合作用中释放氧气。

sentence_examples.en: The device emits a warning beep when there is an error.
sentence_examples.zh: 设备出现错误时会发出警报声。

sentence_examples.en: Her face showed emotion as she listened.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在聆听时脸上露出情绪。

sentence_examples.en: The speech was filled with emotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲充满了情感。

sentence_examples.en: Music can convey emotion without words.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐可以在没有语言的情况下传达情感。

sentence_examples.en: The emperor wore a golden crown during the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 皇帝在仪式上戴着金皇冠。

sentence_examples.en: People bowed as the emperor passed by.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们在皇帝经过时鞠躬。

sentence_examples.en: The emperor issued a decree.
