sentence_examples.zh: 技术的演变已经改变了许多行业。

sentence_examples.en: This debate shows how social attitudes toward gender roles are evolving.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场辩论表明社会对性别角色的态度正在演变。

sentence_examples.en: Technology continues to evolve at a rapid pace.
sentence_examples.zh: 科技正在以极快的速度发展。

sentence_examples.en: The project evolved from a simple idea into a complex system.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目从一个简单的想法逐步演变成一个复杂的系统。

sentence_examples.en: Over time, her role in the company evolved from assistant to manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，她在公司中的角色从助理逐步演变为经理。

sentence_examples.en: Please give me the exact address.
sentence_examples.zh: 请给我确切的地址。

sentence_examples.en: She knew the exact time of his arrival.
sentence_examples.zh: 她知道他抵达的确切时间。

sentence_examples.en: We need the exact measurements for the recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要配方的确切用量。

sentence_examples.en: Don't exaggerate what happened.
sentence_examples.zh: 别把发生的事说得比实际情况更严重。

sentence_examples.en: She often exaggerates her achievements.
sentence_examples.zh: 她常常夸大自己的成就。

sentence_examples.en: The salesman exaggerated the benefits of the product.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位销售员夸大了该产品的好处。

sentence_examples.en: I have an exam tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我明天有考试。

sentence_examples.en: The exam was tougher than I expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试比我想象的要难。

sentence_examples.en: She studied all night for the math exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为了数学考试整晚都在复习。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse will examine the patient to check for fever.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士将对患者进行检查，以确认是否发烧。

sentence_examples.en: The detective will examine the evidence before making a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 侦探在做出决定前会仔细审查证据。

sentence_examples.en: She needs to examine the contract for any hidden terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 她需要审查合同，看看是否有隐藏条款。

sentence_examples.en: This is a good example of how to use the new feature.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是新功能如何使用的一个好例子。

sentence_examples.en: She set a good example for her students.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给学生树立了一个好榜样。

sentence_examples.en: Please provide an example to support your argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 请提供一个例子来支持你的论点。

sentence_examples.en: The final score exceeded our expectations.
sentence_examples.zh: 最终分数超出了我们的预期。

sentence_examples.en: Don't exceed the speed limit.
sentence_examples.zh: 请不要超过限速。

sentence_examples.en: The project budget exceeded the initial estimate.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目预算超过了最初的估算。

sentence_examples.en: The project proved exceedingly difficult.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目极其困难。

sentence_examples.en: In early spring, the weather was exceedingly hot.
sentence_examples.zh: 早春时节，天气极其炎热。

sentence_examples.en: She was exceedingly grateful for the support.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这次的帮助极其感激。

sentence_examples.en: She excels at math.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在数学方面非常擅长。

sentence_examples.en: The product excels in durability compared to its competitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 该产品在耐用性方面优于竞争对手。

sentence_examples.en: He excels under pressure.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在压力下也能出色。

sentence_examples.en: She did an excellent job on the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在这个项目上做得非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: We had an excellent time at the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在研讨会上度过了一段非常愉快的时光。

sentence_examples.en: That is an excellent idea.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是一个极好的主意。

sentence_examples.en: Everyone attended the meeting except Mary.
sentence_examples.zh: 除了玛丽，大家都参加了会议。

sentence_examples.en: She goes to the gym every day except Sundays.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天都去健身房，除了周日。

sentence_examples.en: There is no option except to cancel the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 别无选择，只能取消这次旅行。

sentence_examples.en: There is no exception to the rule that students must arrive on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 该规则没有例外，学生必须准时到达。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher made an exception for Mary and allowed her to submit the assignment late.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师对玛丽破例，允许她晚交作业。

sentence_examples.en: That is an exception to the rule.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是该规则的一个例外。

sentence_examples.en: His performance was exceptional.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的表现非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel provides exceptional service.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家酒店提供的服务非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: Under exceptional circumstances, the policy can be waived.
sentence_examples.zh: 在特殊情况下，可以豁免该政策。

sentence_examples.en: The excerpt from the report clarified the key findings.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告中的摘录澄清了关键发现。

sentence_examples.en: The editor excerpted several passages from the manuscript for the article.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑从手稿中摘录了几段用于报道。

sentence_examples.en: An excerpt from his speech was published online.
sentence_examples.zh: 他演讲中的一段摘录被发布在网上。

sentence_examples.en: There was an excess of sugar in the recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 配方中的糖分过量。

sentence_examples.en: Excess sugar in your diet can lead to health problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 日常饮食中的糖分过量可能导致健康问题。

sentence_examples.en: Drinking in excess can harm your health.
sentence_examples.zh: 过量饮酒会损害健康。

sentence_examples.en: The request for refunds was excessive and unnecessary.
sentence_examples.zh: 退款的要求过分且没有必要。

sentence_examples.en: There is excessive packaging on many consumer goods.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多消费品的包装过度。

sentence_examples.en: Her excessive optimism blinded her to risks.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的过度乐观让她忽视了风险。

sentence_examples.en: I exchanged my old coins for new ones at the bank.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在银行把旧币换成新币。

sentence_examples.en: We had an exchange of ideas during the workshop.
sentence_examples.zh: 研讨会上进行了思想交流。

sentence_examples.en: She visited the currency exchange to convert dollars into euros.
sentence_examples.zh: 她去货币兑换处把美元换成欧元。

sentence_examples.en: The news excited the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条消息让人群兴奋。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher tried to excite curiosity in his students.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师努力激发学生的好奇心。

sentence_examples.en: The new product excites customers with its features.
sentence_examples.zh: 新产品凭借其功能激发顾客的兴趣。

sentence_examples.en: There was a lot of excitement in the crowd as the band took the stage.
sentence_examples.zh: 乐队登台时，观众群里充满了兴奋。

sentence_examples.en: Her excitement about the trip was evident on her face.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这次旅行的兴奋之情在脸上显而易见。

sentence_examples.en: The new project caused a sudden surge of excitement in the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 新项目让团队突然兴奋起来。

translations.translation: 令人兴奋的,使人激动的

sentence_examples.en: The movie was exciting from start to finish.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都令人兴奋。

sentence_examples.en: It's an exciting time to start a new business.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在是创业的一个激动人心的时刻。

sentence_examples.en: The concert was exciting and sold out quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会很令人兴奋，票很快就卖光了。

sentence_examples.en: She exclaimed, 'I won the prize!'
sentence_examples.zh: 她兴奋地喊道：“我赢得了奖！”

sentence_examples.en: The crowd exclaimed in unison, 'Yes!'
sentence_examples.zh: 人群齐声喊道：“是的！”

sentence_examples.en: He exclaimed with relief, 'That was close!'
sentence_examples.zh: 他松了一口气地喊道：“差点儿就完了！”

sentence_examples.en: The policy excludes people under 18 from attending the event.
sentence_examples.zh: 政策把18岁以下的人排除在外，不能参加该活动。

sentence_examples.en: We should exclude irrelevant items from the list.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们应从清单中排除无关项。

sentence_examples.en: The price excludes tax.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格不含税。

translations.translation: 独占的;排他的;孤高的;唯一的;高级的

sentence_examples.en: The club offers exclusive access for members.
sentence_examples.zh: 该俱乐部仅向会员提供专属进入权限。

sentence_examples.en: The magazine features exclusive interviews with celebrities.
sentence_examples.zh: 杂志对名人进行了独家专访。

sentence_examples.en: This hotel offers exclusive suites for VIP guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家酒店为贵宾提供独家套房。

translations.translation: 短途旅行,游览;离题;[物理]偏移,漂移

sentence_examples.en: We went on an excursion to the countryside last weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 上周末我们去郊外进行了短途游。

sentence_examples.en: The lecture included an excursion into medieval poetry.
sentence_examples.zh: 讲座中有一段离题，涉及中世纪诗歌。

sentence_examples.en: The particle's excursion from its expected trajectory was detected.
sentence_examples.zh: 观测到粒子偏离预期轨迹。

sentence_examples.en: Please excuse my lateness.
sentence_examples.zh: 请原谅我迟到。

sentence_examples.en: Her excuse for missing the meeting was travel delays.
sentence_examples.zh: 她缺席会议的借口是交通延误。

sentence_examples.en: Excuse me, could you repeat that?
sentence_examples.zh: 打扰一下，您能再说一遍吗？

translations.translation: 实行;实施;执行;完成;履行;处死

sentence_examples.en: The company will execute the new policy starting next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将从下月开始执行这项新政策。

sentence_examples.en: The plan was executed flawlessly.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划被完美地执行了。

sentence_examples.en: The prisoner was executed at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 那名囚犯在黎明时被处决。

translations.translation: 总经理,董事,行政负责人

sentence_examples.en: The executive approved the annual budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 高管批准了年度预算。

sentence_examples.en: She was promoted to an executive position at the firm.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在公司晋升为高管。

sentence_examples.en: An executive decision was announced today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天宣布了一项高层决定。

translations.translation: 举例证明;示范;作...的范例[榜样]

sentence_examples.en: Her calm leadership exemplifies the qualities we want in a project manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 她冷静的领导力体现了我们在项目经理身上想要的品质。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher used a real case to exemplify how the theory works.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师用一个真实案例来示范该理论如何运作。

sentence_examples.en: This award exemplifies the company's commitment to innovation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个奖项体现了公司在创新方面的承诺。

sentence_examples.en: Children under 18 are exempt from the registration fee.
sentence_examples.zh: 18岁以下的儿童免缴注册费。

sentence_examples.en: The city exempts low-income families from tolls.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府对低收入家庭免收通行费。

sentence_examples.en: The exempt are not required to file tax returns.
sentence_examples.zh: 免税者不需要提交税务申报。

sentence_examples.en: She does ten minutes of exercise every morning to stay fit.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每天早晨做十分钟锻炼来保持身材。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher gave us some grammar exercises.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师给了我们一些语法练习。

sentence_examples.en: Citizens can exercise their right to vote.
sentence_examples.zh: 公民有权行使投票权。

sentence_examples.en: She exerted every effort to finish the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她不遗余力地为按时完成该项目而努力。

sentence_examples.en: The manager exerts pressure on suppliers to lower prices.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理对供应商施加压力以降低价格。

sentence_examples.en: He exerts influence in the industry through his research and network.
sentence_examples.zh: 他通过研究和人脉在行业中发挥影响力。

sentence_examples.en: The long hike exhausts the hikers.
sentence_examples.zh: 长时间的徒步让徒步者感到筋疲力尽。

sentence_examples.en: Constant interruptions exhaust my patience.
sentence_examples.zh: 不断的打断耗尽了我的耐心。

sentence_examples.en: The exhaust from the car pollutes the air.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车的废气污染了空气。

sentence_examples.en: The museum will exhibit ancient artifacts from the Silk Road.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆将展出来自丝绸之路的古代文物。

sentence_examples.en: The artist chose to exhibit her latest work at the gallery.
sentence_examples.zh: 艺术家选择在画廊展出她的最新作品。

sentence_examples.en: An exhibit on space exploration opens this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于太空探索的展览本周末开幕。

sentence_examples.en: The museum is hosting an art exhibition this summer.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆今年夏天正在举办一场艺术展览。

sentence_examples.en: The exhibition features works by modern painters.
sentence_examples.zh: 展览汇集了现代画家的作品。

sentence_examples.en: We visited the science exhibition at the library yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨天我们参观了图书馆的科普展览。

sentence_examples.en: After the revolution, he lived in exile.
sentence_examples.zh: 革命后，他处于流亡状态。

sentence_examples.en: The government exiled dissidents to distant islands.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府将异见人士流放到偏远的岛屿。

sentence_examples.en: She grew up in exile, always longing to return home.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在流亡中长大，总盼望回到家园。

sentence_examples.en: Only a few ancient diseases still exist.
sentence_examples.zh: 只有少数古老的疾病至今仍然存在。

sentence_examples.en: Do ghosts exist?
sentence_examples.zh: 鬼魂真的存在吗？

sentence_examples.en: We exist to help others and make a difference.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的存在是为了帮助他人并带来改变。

translations.translation: 存在,实在;生存,生活(方式)

sentence_examples.en: The existence of life on other planets remains uncertain.
sentence_examples.zh: 其他行星上生命的存在仍不确定。

sentence_examples.en: The study provides evidence for the existence of a new species.
sentence_examples.zh: 该研究提供了新物种存在的证据。

sentence_examples.en: Some people prefer a simple existence in the countryside.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人更喜欢在乡村过着简单的生活。

sentence_examples.en: The exit is clearly marked.
sentence_examples.zh: 出口标识很清楚。

sentence_examples.en: Where is the nearest exit?
sentence_examples.zh: 最近的出口在哪里？

sentence_examples.en: The emergency exit must be kept clear.
sentence_examples.zh: 紧急出口必须保持畅通。

translations.translation: 奇异的;异国情调的;外(国)来的

sentence_examples.en: The market offers exotic fruits from distant lands.
sentence_examples.zh: 市场上有来自遥远之地的异国水果。

sentence_examples.en: She wore an exotic dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一件异国风情的连衣裙参加派对。

sentence_examples.en: The restaurant tries to cook exotic dishes from around the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐厅尝试烹制来自世界各地的异国菜肴。

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to expand its operations to new markets.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划将业务扩展到新市场。

sentence_examples.en: The balloon expands as it is heated.
sentence_examples.zh: 气球在加热时会膨胀。

sentence_examples.en: She expanded on her idea during the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在演讲中进一步阐述了自己的想法。

sentence_examples.en: The expansion of the city has led to more housing and roads.
sentence_examples.zh: 城市的扩张带来了更多的住房和道路。

sentence_examples.en: The expansion of the universe is a key concept in cosmology.
sentence_examples.zh: 宇宙膨胀是宇宙学中的一个核心概念。

sentence_examples.en: The company announced plans for expansion to hire more staff.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司宣布了扩张计划，以雇用更多员工。

sentence_examples.en: I expect the train to arrive on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我预计火车会准时到达。

sentence_examples.en: She expects a lot from her team.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对她的团队有很高的期望。

sentence_examples.en: I didn't expect to see you here.
sentence_examples.zh: 我没想到在这里会看到你。

sentence_examples.en: Her expectations for the project were high.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个项目的期望很高。

sentence_examples.en: We need to adjust our expectations for the outcome.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要调整对结果的预期。

sentence_examples.en: There is an expectation that the train will arrive on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们普遍期望火车按时到达。

sentence_examples.en: The Arctic expedition started in June.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次北极远征在六月启程。

sentence_examples.en: A college expedition will map the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 一所大学的考察队将绘制这条河的地图。

sentence_examples.en: The expedition returned with several rock samples.
sentence_examples.zh: 探险队带回了若干岩石样本。

sentence_examples.en: The school expelled the student for cheating.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校因作弊把这名学生开除了。

sentence_examples.en: The board voted to expel a member from the committee.
sentence_examples.zh: 董事会投票决定将一名成员从委员会除名。

sentence_examples.en: Plants expel water vapor through their leaves.
sentence_examples.zh: 植物通过叶子排出水蒸气。

sentence_examples.en: They expended a lot of time on the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在提案上花费了大量时间。

sentence_examples.en: We expend money on training programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在培训项目上花钱。

sentence_examples.en: Don't expend all your energy on the first task.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要在第一项任务上耗尽全部精力。

translations.translation: 花费;(时间,金钱等的)支出,消耗

sentence_examples.en: The government's expenditure on education has increased this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府在教育方面的支出今年增加了。

sentence_examples.en: We need to track our monthly expenditure to avoid overspending.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要记录每月的支出，以避免超支。

sentence_examples.en: The company's total expenditure for the quarter reached two million dollars.
sentence_examples.zh: 本季度公司的总支出达到两百万美元。

sentence_examples.en: Buying a new laptop was a large expense.
sentence_examples.zh: 买一台新笔记本是一笔巨大的花费。

sentence_examples.en: We split the expense of the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们分摊了这次旅行的花费。

sentence_examples.en: The overall expense for the project exceeded the budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目的总支出超过了预算。

sentence_examples.en: This jacket is expensive.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件夹克很贵。

sentence_examples.en: That restaurant is expensive, but the service is excellent.
sentence_examples.zh: 那家餐厅很贵，但服务很棒。

sentence_examples.en: Gadgets have become more expensive in recent years.
sentence_examples.zh: 近年来，电子产品变得越来越贵。

sentence_examples.en: Her experience as a nurse helps her respond quickly during emergencies.
sentence_examples.zh: 她作为护士的经验在紧急情况下能帮助她迅速应对。

sentence_examples.en: I want to experience the local culture when I travel.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想在旅行时亲身体验当地文化。

sentence_examples.en: This internship gave me valuable experience.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次实习给了我宝贵的经验。

sentence_examples.en: The scientists conducted a new experiment to test the drug's effects.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家进行了一个新实验，以测试药物的效果。

sentence_examples.en: We need more data before drawing conclusions from the experiment.
sentence_examples.zh: 在从这次实验得出结论之前，我们需要更多数据。

sentence_examples.en: You can experiment with different spices to find the best flavor.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以尝试不同的香料，以找到最佳口味。

sentence_examples.en: The researchers conducted an experimental study to test the new drug.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员进行了实验性研究来测试新药。

sentence_examples.en: This is the project's experimental phase.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是该项目的实验阶段。

sentence_examples.en: The device is still in an experimental prototype stage and may not be safe.
sentence_examples.zh: 该设备仍处于实验性原型阶段，可能不安全。

translations.translation: 熟练的,有经验的;专门的

sentence_examples.en: The museum invited an expert to judge the sculpture.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位专家来评判这件雕塑。

sentence_examples.en: She is an expert in cybersecurity.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是网络安全方面的专家。

sentence_examples.en: They relied on expert advice to plan the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们依赖专家的建议来规划这个项目。

translations.translation: 专门知识(或技能等),专长

sentence_examples.en: Her expertise in software security helped the team avoid a major breach.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在软件安全方面的专长帮助团队避免了重大漏洞。

sentence_examples.en: The consultant was hired for his expertise in data analytics.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位顾问因其数据分析方面的专长被雇佣。

sentence_examples.en: They need someone with expertise to guide the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们需要在该领域有专长的人来指导这个项目。

translations.translation: 期满,(期限)终止;呼气;断气,死亡

sentence_examples.en: The warranty will expire next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 保修将在明年到期。

sentence_examples.en: My passport will expire in six months.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的护照将在六个月后到期。

sentence_examples.en: The patient expired last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 患者昨晚去世了。

sentence_examples.en: Could you explain how this works?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能解释这怎么运作吗？

sentence_examples.en: The teacher explained the concept clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师把这个概念讲得很清楚。

sentence_examples.en: Please explain your reasoning.
sentence_examples.zh: 请解释你的推理。

sentence_examples.en: I need a simple explanation of how this works.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要一个关于这个如何运作的简单解释。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the concept.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师对这个概念给出了清晰的解释。

sentence_examples.en: There is no explanation for the delay.
sentence_examples.zh: 对于延迟没有给出解释。

translations.translation: 详述的,明确的;坦率的;显然的

sentence_examples.en: The instruction manual provides explicit steps to assemble the product.
sentence_examples.zh: 使用手册提供了组装产品的明确步骤。

sentence_examples.en: She was explicit about her goals and what she would not compromise on.
sentence_examples.zh: 她明确地说明了自己的目标以及不妥协的底线。

sentence_examples.en: There are explicit terms in the contract that protect both parties.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同中有明确的条款，保护双方的权益。

sentence_examples.en: The rocket exploded shortly after launch.
sentence_examples.zh: 火箭在发射后不久爆炸了。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to shake the bottle of soda, or it might explode.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心不要摇汽水瓶，否则它可能会爆炸。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd exploded in applause when the band finished.
sentence_examples.zh: 乐队演出结束时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。

sentence_examples.en: Tech companies should exploit new technologies to stay competitive.
sentence_examples.zh: 科技公司应开发新技术以保持竞争力。

sentence_examples.en: The workers felt they were being exploited by the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 工人们觉得他们被公司剥削了。

sentence_examples.en: Her latest exploit in the project earned her wide recognition.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在该项目中的最新功绩赢得了广泛认可。

sentence_examples.en: We plan to explore the ancient ruins on the island this summer.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们计划今年夏天去岛上的古代遗址勘探。

sentence_examples.en: The scientists want to explore new methods for measuring climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家希望探索用于测量气候变化的新方法。

sentence_examples.en: Children enjoy exploring the forest behind the house.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在房子后面的森林里探索。

sentence_examples.en: The explosion caused extensive damage to the building.
sentence_examples.zh: 爆炸对这栋建筑造成了严重损坏。

sentence_examples.en: Emergency crews arrived after the explosion to assess the damage.
sentence_examples.zh: 爆炸发生后，救援人员赶到现场评估损害。

sentence_examples.en: Investigators are inspecting the scene to determine the cause of the explosion.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查人员正在现场调查爆炸的原因。

sentence_examples.en: The material is highly explosive and must be stored safely.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种材料极易爆炸，必须安全储存。

sentence_examples.en: The police found an explosive in the suspect's bag.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方在嫌疑人的包里发现了一个爆炸物。

sentence_examples.en: Her anger was explosive after the argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 争论后，她的愤怒爆发得非常强烈。

sentence_examples.en: The country plans to export more agricultural products this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家计划今年出口更多农产品。

sentence_examples.en: The company exports electronics to Europe.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司把电子产品出口到欧洲。

sentence_examples.en: Exports rose last quarter due to higher demand.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于需求增加，出口额在上个季度上升。

sentence_examples.en: The report exposes corruption at the city hall.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份报告揭露了市政府的腐败。

sentence_examples.en: Do not expose your skin to the sun without sunscreen.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要让皮肤在没有防晒的情况下暴露在阳光下。

sentence_examples.en: Bright light exposes film.
sentence_examples.zh: 强光会让胶片曝光。

translations.translation: 暴露,揭露;方向;陈列;遗弃;照射量

sentence_examples.en: The photo's exposure was too long, causing the image to be overexposed.
sentence_examples.zh: 这张照片的曝光时间太长，图像过曝。

sentence_examples.en: Workers face exposure to hazardous chemicals on the job.
sentence_examples.zh: 工人在工作中暴露于有害化学物质。

sentence_examples.en: The exposure of the fraud shocked investors.
sentence_examples.zh: 对诈骗的揭露让投资者震惊。

sentence_examples.en: She expressed her gratitude with a handwritten note.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用一封手写的信表达了她的感激。

sentence_examples.en: I usually take the express train to save time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我通常乘坐特快列车以节省时间。

sentence_examples.en: We shipped it by express to ensure it arrives tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们选择快运寄送，以确保明天能到达。

translations.translation: 表达;表情;声调;腔调;榨出;措词;式;符号

sentence_examples.en: The expression on her face showed she was surprised.
sentence_examples.zh: 她脸上的表情显示她很惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The expression 'thank you' is often used to show gratitude.
sentence_examples.zh: ‘thank you’这个表达常用来表示感谢。

sentence_examples.en: In algebra, 2x + 3 is an expression.
sentence_examples.zh: 在代数中，2x + 3 是一个表达式。

translations.translation: 优美的，高雅的，精致的；剧烈的，异常的

sentence_examples.en: The exhibit featured exquisite porcelain from the 18th century.
sentence_examples.zh: 展览展出了18世纪的精致瓷器。

sentence_examples.en: Her handwriting was exquisite, with letters perfectly formed.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的笔迹极为优美，字母笔画都十分端正。

sentence_examples.en: The chef prepared an exquisite dessert that impressed everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨师准备了一道精致的甜点，令大家印象深刻。

translations.translation: 延长,延伸;扩充;给予;提供;估价

sentence_examples.en: The deadline has been extended by a week.
sentence_examples.zh: 截止日期已被延长一周。

sentence_examples.en: We would like to extend an invitation to you.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们想向您发出邀请。

sentence_examples.en: The company extends credit to new customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司向新客户提供信用。

translations.translation: 延长;扩大;范围;大小;尺寸;电话分机

sentence_examples.en: We requested an extension of the deadline by two days.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们请求把截止日期延长两天。

sentence_examples.en: The house has a new extension at the back that adds more living space.
sentence_examples.zh: 房子后面新增加了一个扩建部分，增加了居住空间。

sentence_examples.en: Please dial extension 210 to speak with the front desk.
sentence_examples.zh: 请拨打分机210与前台联系。

sentence_examples.en: The renovation included extensive repairs to the roof and plumbing.
sentence_examples.zh: 装修包括对屋顶和管道的广泛修缮。

sentence_examples.en: She did extensive research before writing her thesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在写论文之前进行了大量研究。

sentence_examples.en: The area has extensive farmland and forests.
sentence_examples.zh: 该地区拥有广阔的农田和森林。

translations.translation: 广度,宽度,长度;程度,限度

sentence_examples.en: They measured the extent of the problem before proposing a solution.
sentence_examples.zh: 在提出解决方案之前，他们先衡量了问题的程度。

sentence_examples.en: The extent of the damage is still being assessed.
sentence_examples.zh: 损失的程度仍在评估中。

sentence_examples.en: The extent of her influence across the organization was surprising.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在整个组织中的影响力之大令人惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The exterior of the building was damaged in the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座建筑的外部在风暴中受损。

sentence_examples.en: The exterior walls are made of brick.
sentence_examples.zh: 外墙是砖砌的。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel has a striking exterior.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家酒店的外观非常引人注目。

translations.translation: 外部的;客观的;外国的;表面的;[医]外用的

sentence_examples.en: The external walls of the building were painted white.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座建筑的外墙被漆成白色。

sentence_examples.en: We need to consider external factors, such as the economy and competition.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要考虑外部因素，如经济和竞争。

sentence_examples.en: This cream is for external use only.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种药膏仅供外用。

sentence_examples.en: The dodo is extinct.
sentence_examples.zh: 渡渡鸟已经灭绝。

sentence_examples.en: Some languages have become extinct.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些语言已经灭绝了。

sentence_examples.en: An extinct volcano sits near the coast.
sentence_examples.zh: 沿海有座死火山。

translations.translation: 熄灭;消灭;结束;压制;使黯然失色;偿清

sentence_examples.en: Firefighters quickly extinguished the blazing fire.
sentence_examples.zh: 消防员迅速扑灭了熊熊大火。

sentence_examples.en: The company aims to extinguish its debt by the end of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划在年末偿清债务。

sentence_examples.en: The official statement quickly extinguished rumors about the scandal.
sentence_examples.zh: 官方声明迅速平息了关于丑闻的传闻。

sentence_examples.en: I need extra time to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要额外的时间来完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The movie hired many extras for the crowd scenes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影为群众场景雇佣了许多群演。

sentence_examples.en: There was an extra item in my bag.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的包里多出了一件额外的东西。

sentence_examples.en: The dentist will extract the tooth.
sentence_examples.zh: 牙医将拔出这颗牙齿。

sentence_examples.en: You can extract juice from oranges using a juicer.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以用榨汁机从橙子里榨出果汁。

sentence_examples.en: Vanilla extract is used to flavor cakes.
sentence_examples.zh: 香草精常用于给蛋糕提味。

translations.translation: 非常的;格外的;意外的;离奇的;临时的

sentence_examples.en: Her performance was extraordinary, earning her a standing ovation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的表演非同寻常，赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

sentence_examples.en: We faced extraordinary delays due to the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于暴风雨，我们遇到了异常的延误。

sentence_examples.en: An extraordinary coincidence led them to the same bus.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个非同寻常的巧合让他们坐上了同一辆公交车。

translations.translation: 奢侈的;过分的;(言行等)放肆的

sentence_examples.en: Her wedding was extravagant, with crystal chandeliers and a champagne fountain.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的婚礼非常奢华，装饰有水晶吊灯和香槟喷泉。

sentence_examples.en: He has an extravagant taste for luxury cars and designer clothing.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在豪华汽车和名牌服饰方面有奢侈的品味。

sentence_examples.en: Don't be so extravagant with your praise; a simple thank you will do.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要对赞美过于放肆，一句简单的谢谢就够了。

sentence_examples.en: The extreme end of the street is where the old café sits.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条街的尽头坐落着一家老咖啡馆。

sentence_examples.en: The extremes of temperature in this region can be dangerous.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个地区的温度极端变化可能带来危险。

sentence_examples.en: That is an extreme measure for dealing with the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是为解决这个问题所采取的极端措施。

sentence_examples.en: I have something in my eye.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的眼睛里有东西。

sentence_examples.en: Please keep an eye on the pot while I’m away.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不在时请盯着锅看。

sentence_examples.en: He eyed the menu carefully.
sentence_examples.zh: 他仔细端详着菜单。

sentence_examples.en: She raised an eyebrow at the surprising news.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个令人惊讶的消息挑了挑眉毛。

sentence_examples.en: Her eyebrow curved into a soft arc.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的眉毛弯成一个柔和的弧线。

sentence_examples.en: The makeup artist filled in her eyebrow with pencil.
sentence_examples.zh: 化妆师用眉笔把她的眉毛描得更整齐。

sentence_examples.en: My eyesight is getting worse as I age.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着年龄增长，我的视力越来越差。

sentence_examples.en: He wears glasses to correct his eyesight.
sentence_examples.zh: 他戴眼镜来矫正视力。

sentence_examples.en: Protecting your eyesight with regular breaks from screens is important.
sentence_examples.zh: 定期休息眼睛、减少屏幕时间，对保护视力很重要。

sentence_examples.en: The fable teaches that honesty is the best policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个寓言告诉我们，诚实是最好的处事之道。

sentence_examples.en: A fable is a short story with a moral at the end.
sentence_examples.zh: 寓言是一则带有道德教训的短篇故事。

sentence_examples.en: She used a fable to explain why we should think before acting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用一个寓言来解释为何要三思而后行。

translations.translation: 织物;织品;结构;构造;建筑物

sentence_examples.en: This fabric is soft and breathable.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种织物柔软而透气。

sentence_examples.en: The fabric of society is changing as technology advances.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着科技的发展，社会结构正在改变。

sentence_examples.en: We need a durable fabric for outdoor furniture.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要一种耐用的户外家具织物。

translations.translation: 捏造,编造(谎言,借口等);建造,制造

sentence_examples.en: She fabricated an excuse to explain her lateness.
sentence_examples.zh: 她编造了一个借口来解释自己的迟到。

sentence_examples.en: The team was found to have fabricated the data in the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 据调查，该团队在报告中伪造了数据。

sentence_examples.en: The factory fabricates steel parts for construction.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家工厂为建筑制造钢部件。

translations.translation: 极好的；极为巨大的；寓言中的，传说中的

sentence_examples.en: The new restaurant received fabulous reviews.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家新餐厅获得了极高的评价。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a fabulous dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在派对上穿了一条极漂亮的连衣裙。

sentence_examples.en: They live in a fabulous house with a massive garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们住在一座极其豪华的房子里，花园也很大。

sentence_examples.en: She wiped the mud off her face.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把脸上的泥巴擦掉。

sentence_examples.en: Face the camera and smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 面对镜头，微笑。

sentence_examples.en: She has a kind face.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有一张温和的脸。

translations.translation: 使变得(更)容易;使便利;推动;帮助;处进

sentence_examples.en: Technology can facilitate communication between people who speak different languages.
sentence_examples.zh: 科技可以促进说不同语言的人之间的沟通。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy is designed to facilitate trade by simplifying procedures.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项新政策旨在通过简化手续来促进贸易。

sentence_examples.en: She facilitated the meeting by organizing the agenda and inviting the right participants.
sentence_examples.zh: 她通过整理议程并邀请合适的参与者来促进会议的召开。

sentence_examples.en: She writes code with great facility.
sentence_examples.zh: 她写代码非常熟练。

sentence_examples.en: The university has excellent facilities for students.
sentence_examples.zh: 这所大学为学生提供了优秀的设施。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel has facilities such as a gym, pool, and restaurant.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店提供健身房、游泳池和餐厅等设施。

sentence_examples.en: The fact is that we underestimated the cost.
sentence_examples.zh: 事实是，我们低估了成本。

sentence_examples.en: It's a fact that exercise improves health.
sentence_examples.zh: 锻炼确实有益健康。

sentence_examples.en: What he said is a fact.
sentence_examples.zh: 他所说的是事实。

sentence_examples.en: One major factor in climate change is greenhouse gas emissions.
sentence_examples.zh: 气候变化的一个主要因素是温室气体排放。

sentence_examples.en: Price is not the only factor when deciding which car to buy.
sentence_examples.zh: 在决定买哪辆车时，价格并不是唯一的因素。

sentence_examples.en: Weather can be a factor that affects crop yields.
sentence_examples.zh: 天气可能是影响作物产量的一个因素。

sentence_examples.en: The new factory opened near the highway last month.
sentence_examples.zh: 新工厂上个月在公路附近开业。

sentence_examples.en: Workers crowded into the factory to start their shifts.
sentence_examples.zh: 工人们挤进工厂开始上班。

sentence_examples.en: The factory produces electronic components.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家工厂生产电子元件。

translations.translation: 才能;学院,系;(学院或系的)全体教学人员

sentence_examples.en: The university hired more faculty to teach economics.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学聘请了更多的教师来教授经济学。

sentence_examples.en: She joined the physics faculty as an assistant professor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她加入了物理系的教师队伍，担任助理教授。

sentence_examples.en: He has a natural faculty for languages.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在语言方面具有天赋。

sentence_examples.en: The colors in the painting will fade over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 画中的颜色会随着时间褪色。

sentence_examples.en: The scene fades in from black at the start of the movie.
sentence_examples.zh: 场景在电影开头从黑屏淡入。

sentence_examples.en: As the lecture wore on, the audience's interest began to fade.
sentence_examples.zh: 讲座继续进行，观众的兴趣开始减退。

sentence_examples.en: If you don't study, you will fail the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不学习，你就会在考试中不及格。

sentence_examples.en: The project failed due to poor planning.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于计划不当，项目失败了。

sentence_examples.en: She tried to meet the deadline, but she failed to finish on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她试着赶上最后期限，但未能按时完成。

translations.translation: 失败,不及格;失败者;故障,失灵;未能

sentence_examples.en: The project was a failure due to poor planning.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目因为策划不周而失败。

sentence_examples.en: There was a system failure that caused the outage.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统发生故障，导致停机。

sentence_examples.en: She felt like a failure after missing the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 她错过截止日期后，觉得自己是个失败者。

translations.translation: 微弱的;不明显的;暗淡的

sentence_examples.en: The room's lighting is faint.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间里的灯光很暗淡。

sentence_examples.en: She felt faint after standing in the heat.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在高温下站着后感到头晕。

sentence_examples.en: He almost fainted when he heard the news.
sentence_examples.zh: 听到这个消息时他差点昏倒。

sentence_examples.en: It's not fair that he gets all the credit.
sentence_examples.zh: 让他一个人得到所有功劳并不公平。

sentence_examples.en: The judge made a fair decision after reviewing the evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 在审查证据后，法官作出了公正的裁决。

sentence_examples.en: We visited the county fair last weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 上周末我们去了县集市。

translations.translation: 公正地,正当地;相当,还算

sentence_examples.en: The project was fairly easy to complete.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目相当容易完成。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher treated all students fairly.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师对待所有学生都很公正。

sentence_examples.en: The soup was fairly spicy, but not too hot.
sentence_examples.zh: 这汤相当辣，不过不至于太辣。

translations.translation: 幻想中的;虚构的;优雅的

sentence_examples.en: A tiny fairy landed on the raspberry bush and waved.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只小仙女落在覆盆子丛中，挥了挥手。

sentence_examples.en: Fairy lights twinkled along the garden path.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园小路边的仙女灯串在闪烁。

sentence_examples.en: The story felt like a fairy tale set in a quiet village.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个故事就像发生在宁静村庄里的童话。

sentence_examples.en: People place their faith in science and medicine.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们把信任寄托在科学和医学上。

sentence_examples.en: She kept the faith during difficult times.
sentence_examples.zh: 在困难时期，她仍然坚持信念。

sentence_examples.en: The family's faith in their church guides their daily life.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家人对教会的信仰指引着他们的日常生活。

translations.translation: 守信的,忠实的,如实的,可靠的

sentence_examples.en: She has been a faithful friend through all my troubles.
sentence_examples.zh: 在我经历所有困难时，她一直是个忠实的朋友。

sentence_examples.en: The dog is faithful to its owner, always waiting by the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只狗对主人非常忠诚，总是在门口等待。

sentence_examples.en: The report should provide a faithful account of what happened.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告应如实地叙述发生的情况。

sentence_examples.en: That watch is a fake.
sentence_examples.zh: 那块手表是赝品。

sentence_examples.en: This bag is fake.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个包是假的。

sentence_examples.en: They faked the documents.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们伪造了文件。

translations.translation: 跌倒;下降;减弱;坠落;变成,陷于

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to fall when you walk on the wet floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 走在湿滑的地板上时要小心，别摔倒。

sentence_examples.en: Fall is the season when the leaves change color.
sentence_examples.zh: 秋季是树叶变色的季节。

sentence_examples.en: Prices may fall if demand remains weak.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果需求持续疲软，价格可能会下降。

translations.translation: 谬误的,虚伪的,伪造的,假的

sentence_examples.en: That statement is false.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个说法是假的。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a false address on the form.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在表格上填写了一个虚假的地址。

sentence_examples.en: The evidence turned out to be false.
sentence_examples.zh: 证据最终被证明是虚假的。

translations.translation: 名声;名望;传说 vt使出名;传扬…的名

sentence_examples.en: Her fame grew after the film's release.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在那部电影上映后名声大增。

sentence_examples.en: Many actors chase fame, sometimes at the expense of privacy.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多演员追逐名声，有时以牺牲隐私为代价。

sentence_examples.en: The singer rose to fame in a few years.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位歌手在短短几年内成名。

sentence_examples.en: I'm not familiar with this software.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对这个软件不熟悉。

sentence_examples.en: That tune sounds familiar.
sentence_examples.zh: 那段旋律听起来很熟悉。

sentence_examples.en: I ran into a familiar at the cafe.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在咖啡馆遇到了熟人。

translations.translation: 家,家庭成员;氏族,家庭;族,科

sentence_examples.en: My family is visiting next weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的家人下周末来访。

sentence_examples.en: She comes from a large family.
sentence_examples.zh: 她来自一个大家庭。

sentence_examples.en: Family traditions are important to many people.
sentence_examples.zh: 家庭传统对许多人很重要。

sentence_examples.en: Drought caused famine in parts of the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 干旱导致该国部分地区发生饥荒。

sentence_examples.en: Millions of people fled to cities to escape famine.
sentence_examples.zh: 数以百万计的人为了躲避饥荒而逃往城市。

sentence_examples.en: Aid programs are crucial to prevent famine after a disaster.
sentence_examples.zh: 灾后援助计划对于防止饥荒至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: She is famous for her charity work.
sentence_examples.zh: 她因慈善工作而出名。

sentence_examples.en: The town is famous for its beautiful coastline.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个小镇以美丽的海岸线而闻名。

sentence_examples.en: His first novel won an award, and he became famous.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的第一本小说获奖后成名。

sentence_examples.en: I turned on the ceiling fan to cool the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把吊扇打开，让房间凉快一点。

sentence_examples.en: She’s a big fan of that singer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是那位歌手的忠实粉丝。

sentence_examples.en: He fanned himself with a magazine.
sentence_examples.zh: 他用杂志扇风降温。

sentence_examples.en: She has a fancy for vintage cars.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对老爷车有偏好。

sentence_examples.en: Would you fancy a cup of tea?
sentence_examples.zh: 你想来杯茶吗？

sentence_examples.en: She wore a fancy dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在派对上穿了一件华丽的礼服。

sentence_examples.en: The cave opened into a fantastic chamber filled with glowing crystals.
sentence_examples.zh: 洞穴打开，进入一个奇异的房间，里面充满发光的水晶。

sentence_examples.en: She told a fantastic story about a talking fox who could mend broken hearts.
sentence_examples.zh: 她讲了一个幻想的故事，关于一只会说话的狐狸能够治愈受伤的心。

sentence_examples.en: The parade featured fantastic costumes and fantastical creatures that delighted the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 游行有奇异的服装和离奇的生物，吸引了观众的欢呼。

translations.translation: 幻想，空想；空想的产物，幻想作品

sentence_examples.en: Her fantasy of becoming a famous singer kept her motivated.
sentence_examples.zh: 她关于成为著名歌手的幻想让她保持动力。

sentence_examples.en: The novel blends science fiction with medieval fantasy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部小说把科幻与中世纪奇幻融合在一起。

sentence_examples.en: He dismissed the plan as a childish fantasy.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把这个计划当成幼稚的幻想。

sentence_examples.en: The village is far from the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个村庄离城市很远。

sentence_examples.en: The results are far better than we expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果比我们预期的要好得多。

sentence_examples.en: The soup is far too salty.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤太咸了。

sentence_examples.en: The bus fare has gone up this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年公交车票价上涨了。

sentence_examples.en: Please pay the fare before boarding.
sentence_examples.zh: 登车前请支付车费。

sentence_examples.en: The restaurant offers affordable fare.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐厅的饭菜价格实惠。

sentence_examples.en: We bid our host farewell.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们向主人告别。

sentence_examples.en: They held a farewell party to bid him goodbye.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们举行了告别派对，为他送行。

sentence_examples.en: Farewell! Until we meet again.
sentence_examples.zh: 再会，直到我们再次相遇。

sentence_examples.en: My family runs a small farm.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的家人经营着一个小农场。

sentence_examples.en: They farm corn and soybeans in the valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在山谷里种玉米和大豆。

sentence_examples.en: He plans to farm this land next year.
sentence_examples.zh: 他计划明年在这块土地上务农。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer irrigated the fields after sunrise.
sentence_examples.zh: 日出后，农民给田地灌溉。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer sells fresh vegetables at the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民在市场上卖新鲜蔬菜。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer uses sustainable methods to grow crops.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民使用可持续的方法来种植作物。

sentence_examples.en: We walked farther than we planned.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们走得比计划的还远。

sentence_examples.en: We sat at the farther end of the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们坐在花园的更远的一端。

sentence_examples.en: There is a farther town down the road.
sentence_examples.zh: 路上再走一段就有一个更远的城镇。

sentence_examples.en: Music fascinates me.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐让我着迷。

sentence_examples.en: The magician's tricks fascinated the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 魔术师的把戏让观众着迷。

sentence_examples.en: The idea of space travel fascinates many students.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于太空旅行的想法吸引了许多学生。

translations.translation: 流行式样(或货品),风尚,风气;样子,方式

sentence_examples.en: Fashion is about expressing who you are.
sentence_examples.zh: 时尚是表达你自己的方式。

sentence_examples.en: This season, bold colors are in fashion.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个季节，鲜艳的颜色很流行。

sentence_examples.en: She keeps up with fashion by following the latest trends.
sentence_examples.zh: 她通过关注最新的潮流来跟上时尚。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a fashionable dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一件时髈的连衣裙去参加聚会。

sentence_examples.en: This season, minimalist outfits are more fashionable than bold patterns.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个季节，极简风格的装扮比大胆的花纹更时髦。

sentence_examples.en: He bought a fashionable jacket that matches his style.
sentence_examples.zh: 他买了一件与他的风格相配的时髦夹克。

sentence_examples.en: The car is fast.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车很快。

sentence_examples.en: She runs fast.
sentence_examples.zh: 她跑得很快。

sentence_examples.en: The rope is fast to the post.
sentence_examples.zh: 绳子被牢牢地系在桩上。

sentence_examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane takes off.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在飞机起飞前系好安全带。

sentence_examples.en: He fastened the straps to secure the load.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把带子系紧以固定货物。

sentence_examples.en: The door will fasten automatically when closed.
sentence_examples.zh: 关门时门会自动扣上。

translations.translation: 多脂肪的，肥胖的；丰厚的

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to eat too much fat.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心别吃太多脂肪。

sentence_examples.en: That cat is fat.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只猫很胖。

sentence_examples.en: We trimmed the fat from the steak.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把牛排上的肥肉去掉。

sentence_examples.en: The crash was fatal, and two people died.
sentence_examples.zh: 这起车祸致命，造成两人死亡。

sentence_examples.en: There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划中存在一个致命缺陷。

sentence_examples.en: If untreated, the disease can be fatal.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果不治疗，这种疾病可能致命。

sentence_examples.en: Many people believe that fate brought them together.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人相信命运让他们走到一起。

sentence_examples.en: She studied hard to change her fate.
sentence_examples.zh: 她努力学习，想改变自己的命运。

sentence_examples.en: Sometimes fate can surprise you in unexpected ways.
sentence_examples.zh: 有时命运会以出人意料的方式让你感到惊讶。

translations.translation: 父亲；创始人，发明者；(Father)神父

sentence_examples.en: My father helped me with my homework.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的父亲帮我做作业。

sentence_examples.en: He is known as the father of invention.
sentence_examples.zh: 他被称为发明之父。

sentence_examples.en: This priest introduced himself as Father Michael.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位神父自我介绍为迈克尔神父。

sentence_examples.en: The long hike caused fatigue to set in by noon.
sentence_examples.zh: 长途徒步在中午前后让人开始感到疲劳。

sentence_examples.en: Lack of sleep can fatigue your body and mind.
sentence_examples.zh: 睡眠不足会使身体和大脑疲惫。

sentence_examples.en: Chronic fatigue can be a symptom of illness.
sentence_examples.zh: 慢性疲劳可能是疾病的一个症状。

sentence_examples.en: It's my fault that we missed the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们错过截止日期是我的过错。

sentence_examples.en: The driver was at fault in the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故中司机负有过错。

sentence_examples.en: There is a fault in the bridge that needs repairs.
sentence_examples.zh: 大桥有一个缺陷，需要维修。

translations.translation: 有错误的，有缺点的，不完善的

sentence_examples.en: The faulty wiring in the house caused a short circuit.
sentence_examples.zh: 房子里的故障电线引起了短路。

sentence_examples.en: The car was recalled due to faulty airbags.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于安全气囊存在缺陷，汽车被召回。

sentence_examples.en: A faulty thermometer gave us inaccurate readings.
sentence_examples.zh: 温度计有故障，读数不准确。

sentence_examples.en: Her honesty earned the manager's favor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的诚实赢得了经理的好感。

sentence_examples.en: I favor simpler designs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我更偏爱更简单的设计。

sentence_examples.en: The committee is in favor of the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会赞成这个计划。

sentence_examples.en: The weather forecast is favorable for our picnic this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 周末的天气对我们的野餐很有利。

sentence_examples.en: Her presentation received favorable reviews from the committee.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的演讲得到委员会的积极评价。

sentence_examples.en: We reached a favorable agreement with the supplier.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们与供应商达成了有利的协议。

sentence_examples.en: Her favorite hobby is painting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她最喜欢的爱好是绘画。

sentence_examples.en: This restaurant is my favorite.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐馆是我最喜欢的。

sentence_examples.en: She wore her favorite dress to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着她最喜欢的裙子去参加派对。

sentence_examples.en: I faxed the contract to the supplier.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把合同传真给了供应商。

sentence_examples.en: We need a new fax machine for the office.
sentence_examples.zh: 办公室需要一台新的传真机。

sentence_examples.en: The fax arrived late because of line noise.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于线路噪声，传真晚到了。

sentence_examples.en: Fear can hold you back from trying new things.
sentence_examples.zh: 恐惧会让你不敢尝试新事物。

sentence_examples.en: Her fear of heights kept her from going on the balcony.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对高处的恐惧让她不敢走上阳台。

sentence_examples.en: Don't fear making mistakes; it's part of learning.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要害怕犯错，犯错是学习的一部分。

translations.translation: 可怕的，吓人的；害怕，担心，惊恐

sentence_examples.en: She felt fearful about the upcoming exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对即将到来的考试感到害怕。

sentence_examples.en: The dog looked fearful when the thunder rumbled.
sentence_examples.zh: 雷声轰鸣时，那只狗看起来很害怕。

sentence_examples.en: A fearful crowd gathered at the scene.
sentence_examples.zh: 现场聚集着一群惊恐的人群。

translations.translation: 可行的;切实可行的;行得通的;可用的

sentence_examples.en: It's not feasible to finish the project in one week.
sentence_examples.zh: 在一周内完成这个项目不可行。

sentence_examples.en: We should only pursue feasible options that fit our budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们应该只考虑符合预算、可行的选项。

sentence_examples.en: A feasible plan would outline clear steps and deadlines.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个可行的计划应包含清晰的步骤和截止日期。

sentence_examples.en: The town held a feast to celebrate the harvest.
sentence_examples.zh: 小镇为庆祝丰收举行了一场盛宴。

sentence_examples.en: After the ceremony, they had a feast with traditional dishes.
sentence_examples.zh: 仪式结束后，他们用传统菜肴举行了一场盛宴。

sentence_examples.en: The family prepared a feast on Christmas Eve.
sentence_examples.zh: 全家人在圣诞前夕准备了一顿盛宴。

sentence_examples.en: Climbing Mount Everest in winter was an incredible feat.
sentence_examples.zh: 在冬季攀登珠穆朗玛峰是一项了不起的壮举。

sentence_examples.en: The magician's escape act was a clever feat of misdirection.
sentence_examples.zh: 魔术师的逃脱表演是一项巧妙的技艺，善于转移观众注意力。

sentence_examples.en: Completing the marathon in under three hours was a personal feat.
sentence_examples.zh: 在三小时内完成马拉松是一项个人壮举。

sentence_examples.en: A feather floated down from the branch.
sentence_examples.zh: 一根羽毛从树枝上飘落下来。

sentence_examples.en: The bird's colorful feathers shimmered in the sun.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只鸟五彩的羽毛在阳光下闪闪发光。

sentence_examples.en: She tucked a feather into her hat.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把一根羽毛塞进帽子里。

sentence_examples.en: The main feature of the new smartphone is its long-lasting battery.
sentence_examples.zh: 新款智能手机的主要特征是电池续航时间很长。

sentence_examples.en: Her best feature is her bright smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 她最迷人的特征是她灿烂的笑容。

sentence_examples.en: The article will feature an interview with the author.
sentence_examples.zh: 这篇文章将刊登一篇对作者的采访。

sentence_examples.en: February is the second month of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 二月是一年的第二个月。

sentence_examples.en: My birthday is in February.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的生日在二月。

sentence_examples.en: The conference will take place in February.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议将在二月举行。

translations.translation: 联邦的;联邦制的;联合的;同盟的

sentence_examples.en: The federal government announced new climate policies.
sentence_examples.zh: 联邦政府宣布了新的气候政策。

sentence_examples.en: Under federal law, you must pay taxes.
sentence_examples.zh: 根据联邦法律，你必须缴税。

sentence_examples.en: Many federal agencies oversee national programs.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多联邦机构监管国家级项目。

translations.translation: 同盟;联邦;联合;联盟;联合会

sentence_examples.en: Canada is a federation of ten provinces and three territories.
sentence_examples.zh: 加拿大是由十个省和三个领地组成的联邦。

sentence_examples.en: The federation balances national authority with regional autonomy.
sentence_examples.zh: 该联邦在国家权力与地区自治之间保持平衡。

sentence_examples.en: The federation was founded to bring together several semi-autonomous states under a single government.
sentence_examples.zh: 该联邦成立，是为了将若干半自治的州纳入一个统一的政府之下。

sentence_examples.en: The entrance fee is $10.
sentence_examples.zh: 入场费是10美元。

sentence_examples.en: I pay a membership fee every month.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每月支付会费。

sentence_examples.en: There is a service fee for processing payments.
sentence_examples.zh: 处理付款时会收取服务费。

sentence_examples.en: After a long illness, he was too feeble to stand.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过长时间的病痛，他太虚弱，站不起来。

sentence_examples.en: The feeble light barely lit the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 微弱的光线几乎照亮不了房间。

sentence_examples.en: Her feeble argument convinced no one.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的薄弱论点没有说服任何人。

sentence_examples.en: I feed the cat every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天早上给猫喂食。

sentence_examples.en: Farmers feed the chickens twice a day.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民每天喂鸡两次。

sentence_examples.en: The charity feeds the homeless with hot meals.
sentence_examples.zh: 慈善机构为无家可归者提供热餐。

sentence_examples.en: Please share your feedback on the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 请分享你对新政策的反馈。

sentence_examples.en: After the presentation, the manager asked for feedback from the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲结束后，经理请求团队提供反馈。

sentence_examples.en: We use customer feedback to improve our service.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用客户的反馈来改进我们的服务。

translations.translation: 摸上去有…感觉；摸索；觉得

sentence_examples.en: I can feel the cold metal in my hand.
sentence_examples.zh: 我手里能感觉到冰冷的金属。

sentence_examples.en: I feel this plan will work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我觉得这个计划会奏效。

sentence_examples.en: She felt for her keys in the dark.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在黑暗中摸索着找钥匙。

sentence_examples.en: I have a feeling that something good will happen today.
sentence_examples.zh: 我感觉今天会有好事发生。

sentence_examples.en: Her feeling about the project changed after the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议后对这个项目的看法改变了。

sentence_examples.en: Music gives me a feeling of calm.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐让我感到一种平静。

sentence_examples.en: The branch fell from the tree during the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 风暴中，树枝从树上落下。

sentence_examples.en: The loggers felled several trees near the river last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 去年他们在河边伐倒了几棵树。

sentence_examples.en: The legend tells of a fell beast that roamed the mountains.
sentence_examples.zh: 传说中有一头凶猛的野兽在山中游荡。

sentence_examples.en: That fellow over there is the new manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 那边的那位是新任经理。

sentence_examples.en: We are fellow students at the same university.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们是同一所大学的同学。

sentence_examples.en: He is my fellow worker at the plant.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是我在工厂的同事。

sentence_examples.en: She joined a local fellowship to meet others who share her volunteering interests.
sentence_examples.zh: 她加入了当地的联谊会，认识志趣相投的志愿者。

sentence_examples.en: The scientists formed a fellowship to collaborate on the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家们组建了一个伙伴关系，以便在该项目上合作。

sentence_examples.en: She received a research fellowship to study abroad.
sentence_examples.zh: 她获得了研究奖学金去海外学习。

sentence_examples.en: The females in the class formed a study group.
sentence_examples.zh: 班里的女同学组成了一个学习小组。

sentence_examples.en: Many female athletes compete worldwide.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多女运动员在全球范围内比赛。

sentence_examples.en: A female from the team spoke about the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 队里的一位女性谈及了计划。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a dress with a feminine cut that looked elegant.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一条剪裁得更女性化的裙子，看起来很优雅。

sentence_examples.en: The painting uses soft, feminine colors to create a gentle mood.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画使用柔和、女性化的颜色，营造出温柔的氛围。

sentence_examples.en: The perfume has a light, feminine scent.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款香水有清淡的女性香气。

sentence_examples.en: The garden is surrounded by a white fence.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园被一圈白色的篱笆围着。

sentence_examples.en: A tall fence blocks the path to the backyard.
sentence_examples.zh: 一道高大的围栏挡住了通往后院的小路。

sentence_examples.en: She fences with a foil at the club.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在俱乐部用花剑击剑。

sentence_examples.en: We took a ferry to the island.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们乘渡船去那个岛上。

sentence_examples.en: The ferry leaves from the harbor at 9 a.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 渡船在上午9点从港口出发。

sentence_examples.en: The workers ferried the equipment across the river.

sentence_examples.en: She will turn forty next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 她下个月就满四十岁了。

sentence_examples.en: The recipe serves forty people.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个食谱可供四十个人吃饭。

sentence_examples.en: Please post your question in the forum.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在论坛发帖提问。

sentence_examples.en: The town held a public forum on affordable housing.
sentence_examples.zh: 该镇举行了关于经济适用房的公开论坛。

sentence_examples.en: The conference served as a forum for researchers to share results.
sentence_examples.zh: 大会为研究人员提供了分享研究成果的平台。

sentence_examples.en: Please move forward in line.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在排队时往前走。

sentence_examples.en: The forward section of the ship was damaged.
sentence_examples.zh: 船的前部受损。

sentence_examples.en: Please forward the document to the manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把该文件转交给经理。

sentence_examples.en: The paleontologist found a fossil in the rock layer.
sentence_examples.zh: 古生物学家在岩层中发现了一块化石。

sentence_examples.en: Fossils provide clues about how ancient life lived.
sentence_examples.zh: 化石提供了关于远古生物如何生活的线索。

sentence_examples.en: This museum has a well-preserved dinosaur fossil on display.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家博物馆展出了一块保存完好的恐龙化石。

sentence_examples.en: The program aims to foster independence in young people.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目旨在培养年轻人的独立性。

sentence_examples.en: They placed a foster child with a caring family.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们把寄养儿童安置在一个友善的家庭中。

sentence_examples.en: The foster parent attended the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位寄养父母参加了会议。

sentence_examples.en: There was a foul odor in the kitchen.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨房里有一股难闻的气味。

sentence_examples.en: The player fouled his opponent.
sentence_examples.zh: 那名球员对对手犯规。

sentence_examples.en: The referee called a foul.
sentence_examples.zh: 裁判判罚了一次犯规。

translations.translation: 建立;创立;创办;使有根据;铸造;熔制

sentence_examples.en: The university was founded in 1965.
sentence_examples.zh: 这所大学成立于1965年。

sentence_examples.en: They founded a charity to help the homeless.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们创办了一个慈善机构来帮助无家可归者。

sentence_examples.en: The policy is founded on solid evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策以可靠的证据为基础。

translations.translation: 基础,根本,建立,创立;地基,基金,基金会

sentence_examples.en: A strong foundation in math helps you learn more advanced topics.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数学方面打下扎实的基础有助于学习更高阶的内容。

sentence_examples.en: The foundation for the house was poured last week.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座房子的地基上周浇筑完成。

sentence_examples.en: The charity foundation announced a new scholarship program.
sentence_examples.zh: 该慈善基金会宣布了一项新的奖学金项目。

sentence_examples.en: The fountain in the town square sparkles after sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 日落后，镇广场的喷泉闪闪发光。

sentence_examples.en: Children love to throw coins into the fountain.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢把硬币投进喷泉里。

sentence_examples.en: The city installed a drinking fountain for visitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座城市为游客安装了饮用水喷泉。

sentence_examples.en: There are four apples on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有四个苹果。

sentence_examples.en: She bought four postcards from her trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在旅行时买了四张明信片。

sentence_examples.en: We have four options to choose from.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们有四个可选项供选择。

sentence_examples.en: I am fourteen years old.
sentence_examples.zh: 我十四岁。

sentence_examples.en: There are fourteen chapters in this book.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书共有十四章。

sentence_examples.en: The team scored fourteen goals in the match.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队在比赛中打进了十四个进球。

sentence_examples.en: A red fox ran across the yard at dusk.
sentence_examples.zh: 黄昏时，一只红狐狸跑过院子。

sentence_examples.en: The fox watched us from behind the hedge.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只狐狸从树篱后面盯着我们。

sentence_examples.en: In many forests, the fox is a common animal.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多森林里，狐狸很常见。

translations.translation: 碎片,小部分,一点儿;分数

sentence_examples.en: Only a small fraction of the budget was spent on marketing.
sentence_examples.zh: 预算中只有一小部分花在市场营销上。

sentence_examples.en: A fraction is a number that represents part of a whole.
sentence_examples.zh: 分数是表示整体部分的一个数字。

sentence_examples.en: He arrived in a fraction of a second.
sentence_examples.zh: 他不到一秒钟就到了。

sentence_examples.en: The bone could fracture if you fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你摔倒，骨头可能会骨折。

sentence_examples.en: There is a hairline fracture in the ceramic plate.
sentence_examples.zh: 这块陶瓷板有一道细小的裂纹。

sentence_examples.en: The engineers warned that the pipe could fracture under high pressure.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师警告说，在高压下管道可能会断裂。

translations.translation: 易碎的，脆的，易损坏的；虚弱的，脆弱的

sentence_examples.en: The glass vase is fragile, so please handle it with care.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个玻璃花瓶很脆，请小心处理。

sentence_examples.en: That package is fragile and should not be dropped.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个包裹很易碎，不能摔落。

sentence_examples.en: Her health was fragile after the illness.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在生病后，健康状况变得脆弱。

sentence_examples.en: Only a fragment of pottery remained after the dig.
sentence_examples.zh: 挖掘后只剩下一个陶器碎片。

sentence_examples.en: The article was only a fragment of the full story.
sentence_examples.zh: 这篇报道只是完整故事的一部分。

sentence_examples.en: A fragment of broken glass lay on the floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 地板上躺着一块破碎的玻璃碎片。

sentence_examples.en: The flowers in the garden are fragrant.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园里的花很芬芳。

sentence_examples.en: The kitchen was fragrant with herbs.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨房里充满了香草的香气。

sentence_examples.en: The air was fragrant with jasmine.
sentence_examples.zh: 空气中弥漫着茉莉花的香气。

translations.translation: 框架;体格;骨架;组织;机构

sentence_examples.en: The wooden frame around the painting protects it.
sentence_examples.zh: 画作周围的木框保护了它。

sentence_examples.en: The window frame needs repainting.
sentence_examples.zh: 窗框需要重新粉刷。

sentence_examples.en: The designer framed the project within a strict budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 设计师在严格的预算内框定了这个项目。

translations.translation: 构架;框架;结构;组织;机构

sentence_examples.en: The new policy provides a framework for improving classroom safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策为改进课堂安全提供了一个框架。

sentence_examples.en: We evaluated the project within the framework of international guidelines.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在国际准则框架内评估了该项目。

sentence_examples.en: The legal framework defines the rights and responsibilities of all parties.
sentence_examples.zh: 法律框架规定了各方的权利和义务。

sentence_examples.en: He gave me a frank answer.
sentence_examples.zh: 他给了我一个坦率的回答。

sentence_examples.en: It's better to be frank about the risks.
sentence_examples.zh: 在风险问题上坦率一点会更好。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a frank assessment of the situation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对形势作出了坦率的评估。

translations.translation: 欺诈，诈骗；欺骗(行为)；骗子；假货

sentence_examples.en: The company was charged with fraud after investigators uncovered fake invoices.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查人员发现假发票后，该公司因欺诈被起诉。

sentence_examples.en: She reported the fraud to the bank after noticing unfamiliar charges on her account.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在账户上发现陌生扣款后向银行报案，指控欺诈。

sentence_examples.en: Online shoppers should beware of fraud and verify seller legitimacy.
sentence_examples.zh: 网购时，买家应警惕欺诈并核实卖家的信誉。

translations.translation: 自由的;免费的;免税的;空闲的

sentence_examples.en: Admission to the museum is free today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天博物馆入场免费。

sentence_examples.en: You are free to choose any seat.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以自由选择任意座位。

sentence_examples.en: The guard will free the prisoner.
sentence_examples.zh: 警卫将释放囚犯。

sentence_examples.en: Everyone deserves freedom of expression.
sentence_examples.zh: 每个人都应享有表达自由。

sentence_examples.en: She values her freedom to travel and explore.
sentence_examples.zh: 她珍惜自己旅行和探索的自由。

sentence_examples.en: With freedom comes responsibility.
sentence_examples.zh: 自由伴随着责任。

sentence_examples.en: Water will freeze at 0 degrees Celsius.
sentence_examples.zh: 水在摄氏0度时会结冰。

sentence_examples.en: Milk left in the freezer will freeze into solid blocks.
sentence_examples.zh: 放在冷冻室的牛奶会冻结成固体块。

sentence_examples.en: The lake could freeze over this winter if temperatures stay low.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果气温持续偏低，今年冬天湖面可能会结冰。

sentence_examples.en: We insured the freight before it was shipped.
sentence_examples.zh: 在发运前，我们对货物投保。

sentence_examples.en: The freight arrived at the port intact and on schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 货物按计划抵达港口，完好无损。

sentence_examples.en: Freight costs are included in the total price.
sentence_examples.zh: 运费包含在总价中。

sentence_examples.en: The frequency of the alarm is once every hour.
sentence_examples.zh: 警报的频率是一小时一次。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists study the frequency of waves to understand the signal.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家研究波的频率来了解信号。

sentence_examples.en: To measure the frequency, count how many times it happens per minute.
sentence_examples.zh: 要测量频率，请统计每分钟发生的次数。

sentence_examples.en: Noise is frequent in this area during rush hour.
sentence_examples.zh: 高峰时段，这一带的噪音很频繁。

sentence_examples.en: She is a frequent visitor to the museum.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是博物馆的常客。

sentence_examples.en: There are frequent outages in the neighborhood.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个社区经常停电。

sentence_examples.en: The market sells fresh fruit every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 市场每天早上出售新鲜的水果。

sentence_examples.en: After a shower, she felt fresh and ready for the day.
sentence_examples.zh: 洗完澡后，她感觉精神焕发，准备迎接新的一天。

sentence_examples.en: She is a fresh graduate who just joined the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是刚毕业的应届毕业生，刚加入公司。

sentence_examples.en: Friction slows moving objects.
sentence_examples.zh: 摩擦力会减慢运动中的物体。

sentence_examples.en: The brakes rely on friction to stop the car.
sentence_examples.zh: 刹车靠摩擦力让汽车停下来。

sentence_examples.en: There is friction between the two teams after the merger.
sentence_examples.zh: 合并后，两队之间出现了摩擦。

sentence_examples.en: Friday is the last day of the workweek.
sentence_examples.zh: 星期五是一周工作的最后一天。

sentence_examples.en: I'll meet you on Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我会在星期五和你见面。

sentence_examples.en: Friday night is when I usually relax.
sentence_examples.zh: 星期五晚上我通常放松一下。

sentence_examples.en: Put the milk in the fridge to keep it cold.
sentence_examples.zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱里冷藏。

sentence_examples.en: The fridge is full; we need to buy groceries.
sentence_examples.zh: 冰箱里装满了，我们需要买些杂货。

sentence_examples.en: I can't find the butter in the fridge.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在冰箱里找不到黄油。

sentence_examples.en: My friend invited me to the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的朋友邀请我去音乐会。

sentence_examples.en: She is a close friend of mine.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是我的一个亲密朋友。

sentence_examples.en: I met a new friend at the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在会议上认识了一个新朋友。

sentence_examples.en: The shop owner was very friendly and greeted me with a smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 店主非常友好，笑着向我打招呼。

sentence_examples.en: She has a friendly personality that makes new coworkers feel welcome.
sentence_examples.zh: 她性格友好，能让新同事感到受欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: The neighbors were very friendly and helped us settle in.
sentence_examples.zh: 邻居们非常友好，帮助我们安顿下来。

sentence_examples.en: They formed a strong friendship at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在工作中建立了牢固的友谊。

sentence_examples.en: Friendship means being there for each other.
sentence_examples.zh: 友谊意味着彼此在需要时互相扶持。

sentence_examples.en: Maintaining friendship takes time and effort.
sentence_examples.zh: 维持友谊需要时间和努力。

sentence_examples.en: The loud thunder gave me a fright.
sentence_examples.zh: 雷声很大，把我吓了一跳。

sentence_examples.en: He stood in fright when the bear appeared.
sentence_examples.zh: 熊出现时，他惊恐地站在那里。

sentence_examples.en: She froze with fright at the sudden noise.
sentence_examples.zh: 她听到突然的声音时僵住了。

sentence_examples.en: The loud thunder frightened the hikers.
sentence_examples.zh: 巨响的雷声吓到了徒步者们。

sentence_examples.en: Don't frighten the baby with loud noises.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要用响声吓到婴儿。

sentence_examples.en: The horror movie frightened me last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚那部恐怖片把我吓坏了。

translations.translation: 边缘；(窗帘)缘饰；额前垂发

sentence_examples.en: The village lies on the fringe of the city, where fields meet tall buildings.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个村庄位于城市的边缘，田地与高楼交错。

sentence_examples.en: The curtain is trimmed with a decorative fringe along the bottom.
sentence_examples.zh: 窗帘底部饰有精美的边饰。

sentence_examples.en: A row of trees fringes the riverbank, creating a natural boundary.
sentence_examples.zh: 一排树木点缀着河岸，形成天然的边界。

sentence_examples.en: The frog hopped away into the pond.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只青蛙跳进了池塘里。

sentence_examples.en: We found a frog under a log in the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在花园里的一块原木下发现了一只青蛙。

sentence_examples.en: A frog can croak.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只青蛙可以呱呱叫。

translations.translation: 从，自从；由于；离；根据，按；去除

sentence_examples.en: She is from Canada.
sentence_examples.zh: 她来自加拿大。

sentence_examples.en: The shop is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 商店从上午9点到下午5点营业。

sentence_examples.en: I learned a lot from this experience.
sentence_examples.zh: 我从这次经历学到了很多。

sentence_examples.en: The front door needs repainting.
sentence_examples.zh: 前门需要重新粉刷。

sentence_examples.en: The front of the building faces the street.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座建筑的正面朝向街道。

sentence_examples.en: The spokesperson fronted the media at the press conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 发言人在新闻发布会上面对媒体。

sentence_examples.en: The soldiers patrolled the frontier between the two countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 两国之间的边境线由士兵巡逻。

sentence_examples.en: Advances in artificial intelligence are pushing the frontier of technology.
sentence_examples.zh: 人工智能的进步正在推动科技前沿。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists are exploring the frontier of quantum computing.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家正在探索量子计算的前沿。

sentence_examples.en: The car windshield was covered in frost this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今晨，汽车挡风玻璃上结满了霜。

sentence_examples.en: Frost formed on the grass overnight.
sentence_examples.zh: 草地在一夜之间结了霜。

sentence_examples.en: An early frost damaged some tender flowers.
sentence_examples.zh: 一次早霜损坏了几株娇嫩的花朵。

sentence_examples.en: I frown when I read unclear instructions.
sentence_examples.zh: 我读不清楚的说明书时会皱起眉头。

sentence_examples.en: She frowned at the messy handwriting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对潦草的笔迹皱起眉头。

sentence_examples.en: He frowns whenever someone interrupts him.
sentence_examples.zh: 每当有人打断他时他都会皱眉。

sentence_examples.en: I bought some fruit at the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在市场买了一些水果。

sentence_examples.en: Fruit is rich in vitamins.
sentence_examples.zh: 水果富含维生素。

sentence_examples.en: The fruit of their labor is evident in the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们劳动的果实在这个项目中显现。

translations.translation: 多产的;果实累累的,富有成效的

sentence_examples.en: The negotiations were fruitful, leading to a new contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 谈判很有成果，促成了一份新合同。

sentence_examples.en: After months of research, the project proved fruitful with several breakthroughs.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数月的研究，该项目取得了多项突破，成果丰硕。

sentence_examples.en: The workshop was fruitful for attendees, sparking new ideas.
sentence_examples.zh: 研讨会对参与者很有成效，激发了新的想法。

sentence_examples.en: The rain frustrated our picnic plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 下雨挫败了我们的野餐计划。

sentence_examples.en: Security measures frustrate attempts to steal data.
sentence_examples.zh: 安全措施阻挠了窃取数据的企图。

sentence_examples.en: Slow progress frustrated the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 缓慢的进展让团队感到挫败。

sentence_examples.en: Fry the eggs in a little oil for about three minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 用少量油把鸡蛋煎约三分钟。

sentence_examples.en: He likes to fry potatoes until they are crispy.
sentence_examples.zh: 他喜欢把土豆油煎到酥脆。

sentence_examples.en: She asked me to fry the fish gently over medium heat.
sentence_examples.zh: 她让我在中火下把鱼轻轻煎熟。

sentence_examples.en: The car needs fuel.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车需要燃料。

sentence_examples.en: We fuel the car with gasoline.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用汽油给汽车加油。

sentence_examples.en: Coal is used as a fuel in power plants.
sentence_examples.zh: 煤炭被用作发电厂的燃料。

sentence_examples.en: She promised to fulfill her duties as a volunteer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她承诺履行作为志愿者的职责。

sentence_examples.en: The project failed to fulfill its goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目未能实现其目标。

sentence_examples.en: Reading books can help fulfill your curiosity.
sentence_examples.zh: 阅读书籍可以帮助满足你的好奇心。

sentence_examples.en: The cup is full of water.
sentence_examples.zh: 杯子装满了水。

sentence_examples.en: The room is full of people.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间里挤满了人。

sentence_examples.en: She has a full understanding of the topic.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个主题有充分的理解。

sentence_examples.en: The fume from the burning plastic irritated my eyes.
sentence_examples.zh: 燃烧塑料的烟雾刺激了我的眼睛。

sentence_examples.en: A sharp fume hung in the lab after the chemical reaction.
sentence_examples.zh: 化学反应后，实验室里弥漫着刺鼻的烟雾。

sentence_examples.en: We had to evacuate because the fumes leaked into the hall.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为烟雾泄入走廊，我们不得不疏散。

translations.translation: 玩笑,娱乐;有趣的人(或事物)

sentence_examples.en: We had a lot of fun at the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在派对上玩得很开心。

sentence_examples.en: The game was a lot of fun.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款游戏很有趣。

sentence_examples.en: She's a lot of fun to be around.
sentence_examples.zh: 和她在一起很开心。

sentence_examples.en: The function of this tool is to measure temperature.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个工具的功能是测量温度。

sentence_examples.en: The company hosted a formal function to celebrate the milestone.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司举行了一场正式的活动来庆祝里程碑。

sentence_examples.en: The machine will function normally after the reboot.
sentence_examples.zh: 重新启动后，机器将正常运行。

translations.translation: 资金,基金;存款,现款;(知识等的)累积

sentence_examples.en: The company set up a new fund to invest in renewable energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司设立了一个新的基金，用于投资可再生能源。

sentence_examples.en: She donated a large sum to the education fund.
sentence_examples.zh: 她向教育基金捐出了一大笔钱。

sentence_examples.en: The government allocated funds for disaster relief.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府为灾难救助分配了资金。

sentence_examples.en: Understanding the fundamental concepts is essential for mastering the subject.
sentence_examples.zh: 理解基本概念对于掌握这门学科至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: Regular exercise is a fundamental part of a healthy lifestyle.
sentence_examples.zh: 规律的锻炼是健康生活方式的基本部分。

sentence_examples.en: Developing good study habits is fundamental to academic success.
sentence_examples.zh: 培养良好的学习习惯对学业成功至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: The funeral will be held at the church next Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 葬礼将于下周五在教堂举行。

sentence_examples.en: Family and friends gathered to attend the funeral.
sentence_examples.zh: 家人和朋友聚集参加葬礼。

sentence_examples.en: The funeral service included a moment of silence.
sentence_examples.zh: 葬礼仪式包括一段默哀。

sentence_examples.en: That movie was funny; I couldn't stop laughing.
sentence_examples.zh: 那部电影很搞笑，我笑个不停。

sentence_examples.en: He told a funny joke at dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在晚餐时讲了一个好笑的笑话。

sentence_examples.en: It's funny how she acts when she's nervous.
sentence_examples.zh: 她紧张时的举动真有趣。

sentence_examples.en: The coat is made of real fur.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件大衣是用真正的毛皮做的。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a scarf with fur trim.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一个带毛皮饰边的围巾。

sentence_examples.en: The cat's fur is very soft.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只猫的毛发非常柔软。

sentence_examples.en: She was furious when she learned the delay ruined her plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 她得知延误毁了她的计划时，气得要命。

sentence_examples.en: The referee's decision left the crowd furious.
sentence_examples.zh: 裁判的判罚让球迷们怒不可遏。

sentence_examples.en: A furious wind slammed against the coast during the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风中狂怒的风猛烈地拍打着海岸线。

sentence_examples.en: The furnace heats the house in winter.
sentence_examples.zh: 炉子在冬天为房子取暖。

sentence_examples.en: Metal was melted in the furnace.
sentence_examples.zh: 金属在熔炉中被熔化。

sentence_examples.en: They installed a new furnace last month.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们上个月安装了一台新炉子。

sentence_examples.en: The company will furnish new equipment next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将于下个月提供新设备。

sentence_examples.en: The contract requires the landlord to furnish heating and hot water.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同要求房东提供暖气和热水。

sentence_examples.en: They furnished the room with a comfortable sofa and soft lighting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为房间配备了舒适的沙发和柔和的灯光。

sentence_examples.en: We bought new furniture for the living room.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们为客厅买了新家具。

sentence_examples.en: The furniture in this hotel is modern and comfortable.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家酒店的家具现代且舒适。

sentence_examples.en: Old furniture can be restored rather than replaced.
sentence_examples.zh: 旧家具可以修复，而不是更换。

sentence_examples.en: We walked further down the road.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们沿着这条路往前走得更远。

sentence_examples.en: We should further our research before making a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 在作出决定之前，我们应进一步研究。

sentence_examples.en: We will discuss the further steps in the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将讨论计划中的进一步步骤。

sentence_examples.en: The project failed due to lack of funding; furthermore, the team did not meet the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于资金不足，项目失败。此外，团队也没有按时完成任务。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy will reduce costs for customers; furthermore, it will improve service quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策将降低客户成本；此外，它还将提高服务质量。

sentence_examples.en: Furthermore, she is a talented developer with strong leadership and communication skills.
sentence_examples.zh: 此外，她是一位才华横溢的开发人员，具备出色的领导力和沟通能力。

sentence_examples.en: The fuse blew when the short circuit occurred.
sentence_examples.zh: 短路发生时，保险丝烧断了。

sentence_examples.en: Replace the blown fuse in the electrical panel.
sentence_examples.zh: 在配电箱里把烧断的保险丝换掉。

sentence_examples.en: They fused the metal parts with heat to form a single piece.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们用热量把金属件熔合成一体。

sentence_examples.en: There is no need to make a fuss over a broken pencil.
sentence_examples.zh: 对于一根坏铅笔没必要大惊小怪。

sentence_examples.en: Don't fuss about every little detail.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要对每一个小细节斤斤计较。

sentence_examples.en: The children made a fuss when the school announced a snow day.
sentence_examples.zh: 学校宣布放雪日时，孩子们大惊小怪。

translations.translation: 无效的，无用的，无希望的

sentence_examples.en: All their efforts to revive the project were futile.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们挽救这个项目的所有努力都是徒劳的。

sentence_examples.en: It would be futile to argue with him; he never changes his mind.
sentence_examples.zh: 跟他争论是徒劳的；他从不改变主意。

sentence_examples.en: Trying to fix the broken relationship with a single apology may be futile.
sentence_examples.zh: 仅仅道歉就想修复破裂的关系可能是徒劳的。

sentence_examples.en: In the future, scientists hope to cure major diseases.
sentence_examples.zh: 将来，科学家希望治愈重大疾病。

sentence_examples.en: The future of renewable energy is bright.
sentence_examples.zh: 可再生能源的前景光明。

sentence_examples.en: We must prepare for future challenges.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须为未来的挑战做好准备。

sentence_examples.en: She hopes to gain more experience after the internship.
sentence_examples.zh: 她希望在实习后获得更多经验。

sentence_examples.en: The company reported a gain in profits last quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在上个季度实现了利润增长。

sentence_examples.en: The team aims to gain ground in the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 这支团队正努力在市场上取得进展。

translations.translation: 星系;(the Galaxy)银河(系);一群显赫的人

sentence_examples.en: Astronomers study distant galaxies to understand the history of the universe.
sentence_examples.zh: 天文学家研究遥远的星系，以了解宇宙的历史。

sentence_examples.en: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our solar system.
sentence_examples.zh: 银河系是包含我们的太阳系的星系。

sentence_examples.en: We looked up at the galaxy and felt very small.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们抬头仰望银河，感到自己很渺小。

sentence_examples.en: We walked through the gallery to see the latest paintings.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们走过画廊去看最新的画作。

sentence_examples.en: The long gallery connects several rooms in the museum.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条长廊连接了博物馆的几个房间。

sentence_examples.en: The gallery is hosting a new exhibition of contemporary art.
sentence_examples.zh: 画廊正在举办一场当代艺术的新展览。

sentence_examples.en: A gallon of milk costs about three dollars.
sentence_examples.zh: 一加仑牛奶大约三美元。

sentence_examples.en: A gallon is equal to four quarts.
sentence_examples.zh: 一加仑等于四夸脱。

sentence_examples.en: Please add a gallon of water.
sentence_examples.zh: 请加一加仑水。

sentence_examples.en: The horse began to gallop across the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 那匹马开始在田野里奔驰。

sentence_examples.en: The rider urged the horse to gallop.
sentence_examples.zh: 骑手催促马儿飞奔。

sentence_examples.en: It can gallop at speeds of up to 40 mph.
sentence_examples.zh: 它可以以最高每小时40英里的速度飞奔。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to gamble her savings on the stock market.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定把积蓄投在股市，赌一把。

sentence_examples.en: Gambling can be addictive and risky.
sentence_examples.zh: 赌博可能会上瘾，风险也很高。

sentence_examples.en: Some people gamble on new startups to chase big returns.
