sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会上有很多人。

sentence_examples.en: We drew lots to decide who would go first.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用抽签来决定谁先去。

sentence_examples.en: They bought a lot to build a new house.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们买了一块地来盖新房子。

translations.translation: 抽彩；碰运气的事，难于算计的事

sentence_examples.en: I bought a lottery ticket and hoped for a big prize.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一张彩票，希望能中大奖。

sentence_examples.en: Winning the lottery can dramatically change a person's life.
sentence_examples.zh: 中彩票可以极大地改变一个人的生活。

sentence_examples.en: Many people treat the lottery as a game of chance rather than a reliable investment.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人把彩票当作一场碰运气的游戏，而不是可靠的投资。

translations.translation: 大声的,响亮的;吵闹的,喧嚣的

sentence_examples.en: The music was so loud that I couldn't think clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐太响了，我根本没法清楚地思考。

sentence_examples.en: Please don't be so loud in the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 请不要在图书馆里太吵。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd grew louder as the game went on.
sentence_examples.zh: 比赛进行时，观众越来越吵闹。

sentence_examples.en: The loudspeaker crackled with static before the announcement.
sentence_examples.zh: 公告前，扬声器里传出静电噪声。

sentence_examples.en: Please turn up the volume on the loudspeaker so everyone can hear.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把扬声器的音量调大，这样大家就能听见。

sentence_examples.en: The loudspeaker system failed during the ceremony, and no one heard the speech.
sentence_examples.zh: 仪式期间扩音系统坏了，大家都听不到讲话。

sentence_examples.en: We relaxed in the lounge after dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 晚饭后，我们在客厅放松。

sentence_examples.en: The airport lounge has comfortable seating and free Wi-Fi.
sentence_examples.zh: 机场休息室有舒适的座位和免费的Wi-Fi。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel lounge is quiet, with a coffee bar nearby.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店的休息室很安静，旁边有一家咖啡吧。

sentence_examples.en: Love is a powerful emotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 爱是一种强烈的情感。

sentence_examples.en: Her love for music grows every day.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对音乐的热爱每天都在增长。

sentence_examples.en: I love reading novels in my free time.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在空闲时间喜欢读小说。

translations.translation: 可爱的,好看的;令人愉快的,美好的

sentence_examples.en: What a lovely day!
sentence_examples.zh: 多么美好的一天！

sentence_examples.en: She has a lovely smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有一个迷人的微笑。

sentence_examples.en: That's a lovely idea.
sentence_examples.zh: 那是一个很棒的主意。

sentence_examples.en: Her lover surprised her with a bouquet of roses.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的恋人给她送来一束玫瑰花。

sentence_examples.en: He is a wine lover who enjoys trying new varieties.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是个葡萄酒爱好者，喜欢尝试新酒。

sentence_examples.en: The two lovers walked along the river at sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对恋人在日落时沿着河边散步。

translations.translation: 低，矮；低级的，下层的，卑贱的；低声的

sentence_examples.en: The sun is low in the sky.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳在天空中很低。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke in a low voice.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用低声说话。

sentence_examples.en: This camera is of low quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台相机质量很差。

sentence_examples.en: The lower shelves hold the manuals.
sentence_examples.zh: 下层货架放着手册。

sentence_examples.en: Lower the blinds to block the sun.
sentence_examples.zh: 把百叶窗降下来挡住阳光。

sentence_examples.en: Lower the price to attract more customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 降价以吸引更多顾客。

sentence_examples.en: She remained loyal to her friend during difficult times.
sentence_examples.zh: 在困难时期，她对朋友始终忠诚。

sentence_examples.en: A loyal customer will return and recommend the business.
sentence_examples.zh: 忠诚的顾客会回头光顾并推荐这家店。

sentence_examples.en: He is loyal to his country.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对自己的国家很忠诚。

sentence_examples.en: Her loyalty to her family never wavered.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对家庭的忠诚从未动摇。

sentence_examples.en: The loyalty program rewards customers with points.
sentence_examples.zh: 忠诚计划通过积分来奖励客户。

sentence_examples.en: A soldier's loyalty to his country is highly valued.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵对祖国的忠诚被高度重视。

translations.translation: 润滑,加润滑油,行贿,收买

sentence_examples.en: Before assembling the bicycle, lubricate the chain with oil.
sentence_examples.zh: 在组装自行车之前，用油润滑链条。

sentence_examples.en: Some people try to lubricate officials by offering gifts.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人试图通过送礼来行贿官员。

sentence_examples.en: A good manager knows how to lubricate collaboration between departments.
sentence_examples.zh: 优秀的管理者知道如何促进部门之间的合作，使之更顺畅。

sentence_examples.en: It was bad luck to drop my phone in water.
sentence_examples.zh: 把我的手机掉进水里真倒霉。

sentence_examples.en: She had no luck finding a seat.
sentence_examples.zh: 她找不到座位，运气真差。

sentence_examples.en: Good luck with your test tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 祝你明天考试顺利。

sentence_examples.en: I was lucky to catch the last train.
sentence_examples.zh: 我很幸运赶上了末班车。

sentence_examples.en: She considers herself lucky to have such supportive friends.
sentence_examples.zh: 她觉得自己很幸运，拥有这么多支持她的朋友。

sentence_examples.en: We were lucky to arrive before the doors closed.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们很幸运在关门前到达。

sentence_examples.en: I packed my luggage for the business trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 我为商务旅行打包了行李。

sentence_examples.en: The luggage is on the conveyor belt at baggage claim.
sentence_examples.zh: 行李在行李领取处的传送带上。

sentence_examples.en: If any luggage is damaged, please file a claim with the airline.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果行李有损坏，请向航空公司提出索赔。

sentence_examples.en: The lumber yard stocks pine and cedar for builders.
sentence_examples.zh: 木材场为建筑商备有松木和雪松等木材。

sentence_examples.en: They used rough-cut lumber to frame the walls.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们用粗切木材来搭建墙体的框架。

sentence_examples.en: Lumber prices have risen this year due to demand.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于需求增加，今年木材价格上涨。

sentence_examples.en: There is a lump in my throat.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喉咙里有一股哽咽感。

sentence_examples.en: I added a lump of sugar to my coffee.
sentence_examples.zh: 我往咖啡里放了一块糖。

sentence_examples.en: If you overmix the batter, it will lump.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果搅拌过度，面糊就会结块。

sentence_examples.en: The lunar eclipse will be visible tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 今晚将看到月食。

sentence_examples.en: Ancient cultures used lunar calendars.
sentence_examples.zh: 古代文化使用阴历。

sentence_examples.en: The lunar surface is covered with fine dust.
sentence_examples.zh: 月球表面覆盖着细小的尘埃。

sentence_examples.en: What time is lunch today?
sentence_examples.zh: 今天的午餐是几点？

sentence_examples.en: I packed a sandwich for lunch.
sentence_examples.zh: 我带了一个三明治作为午餐。

sentence_examples.en: We usually have lunch around noon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常在中午吃午餐。

sentence_examples.en: A damaged lung can cause shortness of breath.
sentence_examples.zh: 受损的肺会引起呼吸困难。

sentence_examples.en: Exercise is good for your lungs.
sentence_examples.zh: 运动对肺部有好处。

sentence_examples.en: He injured his left lung in the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在事故中左肺受伤。

sentence_examples.en: The lure of easy money attracted many investors.
sentence_examples.zh: 轻松赚钱的诱惑吸引了许多投资者。

sentence_examples.en: The hunter used a lure to attract the birds.
sentence_examples.zh: 猎人用诱饵引来鸟儿。

sentence_examples.en: Don't be lured into buying things you don't need.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要被诱惑去买你不需要的东西。

sentence_examples.en: Buying a new car is a luxury for many families.
sentence_examples.zh: 对许多家庭来说，买一辆新车是一种奢侈。

sentence_examples.en: We saved for a luxury vacation this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年我们存钱，打算去一次奢侈的假期。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel offers luxury amenities.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家酒店提供豪华设施。

sentence_examples.en: The machine stopped working suddenly.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台机器突然停止工作。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a new washing machine to replace the old one.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一台新的洗衣机来替换旧的。

sentence_examples.en: The engineer will machine the metal parts to exact tolerances.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师将把金属部件加工到精确公差。

sentence_examples.en: The factory invested in new machinery to improve efficiency.
sentence_examples.zh: 工厂投资了新设备以提高效率。

sentence_examples.en: The machine shop uses heavy machinery to manufacture parts.
sentence_examples.zh: 车间使用大型机械来制造零件。

sentence_examples.en: A malfunction in the machinery caused a halt in production.
sentence_examples.zh: 机械发生故障，导致生产中断。

translations.translation: 发疯的;狂热的,着迷的;恼火的,生气的

sentence_examples.en: The crowd went mad when the team scored the winning goal.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队打进制胜球时，观众都疯狂了。

sentence_examples.en: She's mad about basketball and watches games every night.
sentence_examples.zh: 她迷上篮球，每晚都看比赛。

sentence_examples.en: I'm mad at you for forgetting my birthday.
sentence_examples.zh: 你忘了我的生日，我很生气。

sentence_examples.en: The concierge greeted her as 'Madame' and offered help with her luggage.
sentence_examples.zh: 礼宾员把她称作“Madame”，并主动提出帮助提行李。

sentence_examples.en: In formal letters, she signs as Madame Dupont to show respect.
sentence_examples.zh: 在正式信件中，她署名为 Madame Dupont，以示尊敬。

sentence_examples.en: The waiter addressed her as Madame and asked how she would like her coffee.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位服务员把她称作Madame，并问她想要喝哪种咖啡。

sentence_examples.en: I read a magazine on the train.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在火车上读一本杂志。

sentence_examples.en: She subscribes to a weekly fashion magazine.
sentence_examples.zh: 她订阅了一本每周出版的时尚杂志。

sentence_examples.en: The magazine published an article about climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本杂志发表了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

sentence_examples.en: The magician performed amazing magic.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个魔术师表演了精彩的魔术。

sentence_examples.en: Stories have a touch of magic that makes us dream.
sentence_examples.zh: 故事里有一丝魔力，让人产生幻想。

sentence_examples.en: The child whispered that they wished for magic.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子低声说自己希望拥有魔力。

translations.translation: 地方行政官，地方法官，治安官

sentence_examples.en: The magistrate adjourned the court for the day.
sentence_examples.zh: 地方法官宣布休庭，结束一天的审理。

sentence_examples.en: The magistrate issued a warrant to search the premises.
sentence_examples.zh: 地方法官签发了搜查令。

sentence_examples.en: Local residents trusted the magistrate to settle disputes fairly.
sentence_examples.zh: 当地居民信任地方法官公正地解决纠纷。

sentence_examples.en: A magnet can attract iron.
sentence_examples.zh: 磁铁可以吸引铁。

sentence_examples.en: He used a magnet to pick up the nails.
sentence_examples.zh: 他用磁铁捡起钉子。

sentence_examples.en: This magnet is strong enough to hold a note on the fridge.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个磁铁足够强，可以把便条贴在冰箱上。

translations.translation: 磁的,有磁性的;有吸引力的

sentence_examples.en: The needle of a compass is magnetic.
sentence_examples.zh: 指南针的指针有磁性。

sentence_examples.en: Her magnetic personality attracts people.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有磁性的人格，能吸引人。

sentence_examples.en: The metal becomes magnetic after being exposed to a strong magnetic field.
sentence_examples.zh: 金属在暴露于强磁场后会变得有磁性。

sentence_examples.en: The view from the mountaintop was magnificent.
sentence_examples.zh: 山顶的景色极其壮丽。

sentence_examples.en: During our trip, we visited a magnificent cathedral.
sentence_examples.zh: 在旅途中，我们参观了一座宏伟的大教堂。

sentence_examples.en: Her magnificent generosity impressed everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的高尚慷慨让每个人印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: A magnifying glass can magnify small print.
sentence_examples.zh: 放大镜可以放大小字。

sentence_examples.en: The media magnified the scandal, making it seem much worse.
sentence_examples.zh: 媒体放大了丑闻，让它看起来更糟。

sentence_examples.en: Don't magnify the issue; let's address it calmly.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要放大这个问题，我们冷静地处理。

sentence_examples.en: The magnitude of the earthquake was 7.2.
sentence_examples.zh: 地震的震级达到7.2级。

sentence_examples.en: We underestimated the magnitude of the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们低估了问题的严重性。

sentence_examples.en: The magnitude of the storm surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场风暴的规模让大家吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: The maid cleaned the kitchen this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 女仆今天早上打扫了厨房。

sentence_examples.en: We hired a maid to help with the cleaning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们雇了一位女仆来帮忙打扫。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel maid brought us towels and extra soap.
sentence_examples.zh: 旅馆的女仆给我们送来了毛巾和额外的肥皂。

translations.translation: 未婚的,纯洁的,无经验的

sentence_examples.en: The young maiden waved to the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个年轻的少女向人群挥手。

sentence_examples.en: The ship's maiden voyage attracted worldwide attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘船的处女航吸引了全球关注。

sentence_examples.en: Her maiden name was Williams.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的娘家姓是 Williams。

sentence_examples.en: I check the mail every afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天下午检查邮件。

sentence_examples.en: The mail arrived this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 邮件今天早上到了。

sentence_examples.en: I will mail the letter tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我明天把信寄出。

sentence_examples.en: The main reason I moved here is for the job.
sentence_examples.zh: 我搬到这里的主要原因是为了这份工作。

sentence_examples.en: This is the main road through town.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是城里的主干道。

sentence_examples.en: We turned off the mains before starting the repair.
sentence_examples.zh: 在开始维修之前，我们把主管道关掉。

sentence_examples.en: People on the island often travel to the mainland for work.
sentence_examples.zh: 岛上的人通常去大陆工作。

sentence_examples.en: The mainland has more factories and job opportunities.
sentence_examples.zh: 大陆有更多工厂和就业机会。

sentence_examples.en: From the mainland, you can reach the island by ferry.
sentence_examples.zh: 从大陆乘渡轮可以到达该岛。

translations.translation: 维修,保养,维持,供养,坚持,主张,支持

sentence_examples.en: It's important to maintain your car regularly to prevent problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 定期对你的汽车进行保养很重要，以防止出现问题。

sentence_examples.en: The company strives to maintain high quality in all its products.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司努力在所有产品中保持高质量。

sentence_examples.en: She maintains that the policy will help the economy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她坚持认为这项政策会促进经济。

translations.translation: 维修,保养,维持,保持,生活费用

sentence_examples.en: Regular maintenance is required to keep the car running smoothly.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了让汽车运行顺畅，需要进行定期维护。

sentence_examples.en: The building's maintenance costs are rising this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年这栋楼的维护费用在上升。

sentence_examples.en: Proper maintenance can extend the life of the equipment.
sentence_examples.zh: 适当的维护可以延长设备寿命。

translations.translation: 雄伟,壮丽,庄严,威严;最高权威,王权

sentence_examples.en: The mountains rose with quiet majesty.
sentence_examples.zh: 群山静静地呈现出雄伟的气势。

sentence_examples.en: The king spoke with regal majesty.
sentence_examples.zh: 国王以庄严的威仪讲话。

sentence_examples.en: We admired the majesty of the cathedral.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们欣赏大教堂的雄伟气势。

translations.translation: 成年人,专业学生,主修课程

sentence_examples.en: Her major goal is to finish the project by the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的主要目标是在截止日期前完成项目。

sentence_examples.en: She is a biology major.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是生物专业的学生。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to major in music.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定主修音乐。

translations.translation: 多数,大多数,成年,法定年龄

sentence_examples.en: A majority of students voted for the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 大多数学生投票支持该提案。

sentence_examples.en: The age of majority is 18 in many countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多国家，成年的年龄是18岁。

sentence_examples.en: The majority of MPs supported the bill.
sentence_examples.zh: 多数议员支持该项法案。

sentence_examples.en: What make is your car?
sentence_examples.zh: 你的车是什么牌子？

sentence_examples.en: The make of this appliance is listed on the box.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台电器的牌子在盒子上有标注。

sentence_examples.en: We will make dinner tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们今晚做晚饭。

sentence_examples.en: He has a male hamster.
sentence_examples.zh: 他有一只雄性仓鼠。

sentence_examples.en: The survey found that most male participants preferred early morning workouts.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查发现，大多数男性参与者更喜欢清晨锻炼。

sentence_examples.en: In many species, the male helps raise the young.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多物种中，雄性会帮助养育后代。

translations.translation: 恶性的，致命的；恶意的，恶毒的

sentence_examples.en: The biopsy confirmed a malignant tumor.
sentence_examples.zh: 活检确认了恶性肿瘤。

sentence_examples.en: Malignant tumors can spread rapidly if not treated.
sentence_examples.zh: 恶性肿瘤若不治疗，会迅速扩散。

sentence_examples.en: He flashed a malignant smile that made the room feel cold.
sentence_examples.zh: 他露出一个恶意的笑容，让房间的气氛顿时变冷。

sentence_examples.en: A whale is a mammal.
sentence_examples.zh: 鲸鱼是一种哺乳动物。

sentence_examples.en: Humans are mammals.
sentence_examples.zh: 人类是哺乳动物。

sentence_examples.en: Cats and dogs are mammals.
sentence_examples.zh: 猫和狗都是哺乳动物。

translations.translation: men)人；人类(单数，不加冠词)；男人

sentence_examples.en: The man next door is a carpenter.
sentence_examples.zh: 隔壁那个男人是木匠。

sentence_examples.en: A man should be honest.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个男人应该诚实。

sentence_examples.en: The crew manned the station for 24 hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 船员们在该站点值守24小时。

translations.translation: 经营,管理,处理;设法,对付;操纵,运用

sentence_examples.en: She manages a small software company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她经营着一家小型软件公司。

sentence_examples.en: He managed to finish the report on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 他设法按时完成了报告。

sentence_examples.en: I can't manage all these tasks by myself.
sentence_examples.zh: 我一个人处理不了所有这些任务。

translations.translation: 经营,管理;处理,操纵;管理部门

sentence_examples.en: Good time management helps you meet deadlines.
sentence_examples.zh: 良好的时间管理有助于你按时完成任务。

sentence_examples.en: The management team approved the new project plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 管理团队批准了新的项目计划。

sentence_examples.en: She studied management at university.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学学习管理学。

sentence_examples.en: The project manager scheduled a meeting for tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 项目经理把明天的会议安排好了。

sentence_examples.en: Our manager asked us to submit the report by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的经理要求我们在周五前提交报告。

sentence_examples.en: She was promoted to the position of manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 她被提升为经理。

sentence_examples.en: The driver made a sharp maneuver to avoid the obstacle.
sentence_examples.zh: 司机为了避开障碍物，完成了一次急转弯。

sentence_examples.en: The company used a clever maneuver to win back customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司巧妙地采取了一项策略来赢回客户。

sentence_examples.en: The pilot will maneuver the plane through the narrow valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞行员将操纵飞机穿过狭窄的山谷进行机动。

sentence_examples.en: Her fear began to manifest as trembling hands.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的恐惧开始以颤抖的双手表现出来。

sentence_examples.en: Symptoms may manifest days after exposure to the allergen.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴露于过敏原后，症状可能在数日后出现。

sentence_examples.en: The evidence was manifest to all.
sentence_examples.zh: 证据对所有人都显而易见。

translations.translation: (熟练地)使用，操作；(巧妙地)处理

sentence_examples.en: You can manipulate the data to reveal trends.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以操作数据以发现趋势。

sentence_examples.en: The technician manipulated the switches to restart the machine.
sentence_examples.zh: 技术员操作开关以重新启动机器。

sentence_examples.en: She manipulated the negotiation to secure a better deal.
sentence_examples.zh: 她巧妙地处理谈判以获得更有利的条件。

sentence_examples.en: Mankind has always been curious about the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 人类一直对世界充满好奇。

sentence_examples.en: Climate change challenges the future of mankind.
sentence_examples.zh: 气候变化给人类的未来带来挑战。

sentence_examples.en: Mankind must work together to solve global problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 人类必须携手合作解决全球问题。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke in a calm manner.
sentence_examples.zh: 她以平静的方式说话。

sentence_examples.en: Please behave in a respectful manner.
sentence_examples.zh: 请以礼貌的举止行事。

sentence_examples.en: In many cultures, table manners differ.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多文化中，餐桌礼仪各不相同。

sentence_examples.en: This coffee grinder is manual, so you turn it by hand.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台咖啡研磨机是手动的，需要用手转动。

sentence_examples.en: Please consult the manual before assembling the furniture.
sentence_examples.zh: 在组装家具前，请查阅手册。

sentence_examples.en: The manual explains safety guidelines and basic operating steps.
sentence_examples.zh: 手册解释了安全指南和基本操作步骤。

sentence_examples.en: The company manufactures electronic components in a factory.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司在工厂里制造电子元件。

sentence_examples.en: The country is known for its automobile manufacture.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家以汽车制造业而闻名。

sentence_examples.en: We will manufacture the parts to meet demand.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将生产这些部件以满足需求。

sentence_examples.en: The author handed the manuscript to the editor.
sentence_examples.zh: 作者把手稿交给编辑。

sentence_examples.en: She revised the manuscript before submitting it to the publisher.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在把手稿提交给出版商之前进行了修改。

sentence_examples.en: The manuscript is handwritten and includes several marginal notes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份手稿是手写的，边缘有若干注释。

sentence_examples.en: Many people travel abroad to study.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人出国学习。

sentence_examples.en: There are many books on the shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 书架上有很多书。

sentence_examples.en: She has many friends in the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在这座城市有很多朋友。

translations.translation: 在地图上标示出,绘制地图

sentence_examples.en: I opened the map to find the nearest subway station.
sentence_examples.zh: 我打开地图，找最近的地铁站。

sentence_examples.en: The explorer mapped the coastline after the voyage.
sentence_examples.zh: 探险家在航行后绘制了海岸线地图。

sentence_examples.en: The app maps your location in real time.
sentence_examples.zh: 该应用会实时在地图上显示你的位置。

sentence_examples.en: The kitchen countertops are made of marble.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨房的台面是大理石做的。

sentence_examples.en: The statue in the museum is carved from white marble.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆里的雕像是用白色大理石雕刻的。

sentence_examples.en: Marble is a durable material used in many historic buildings.
sentence_examples.zh: 大理石是一种耐用材料，被用于许多历史建筑。

sentence_examples.en: The soldiers will march to the parade ground at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵们将在黎明时分向阅兵场行进。

sentence_examples.en: The students will march to the city hall to protest.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生们将步行前往市政厅抗议。

sentence_examples.en: The long march to the capital took several days.
sentence_examples.zh: 去首都的长途行军花了几天。

sentence_examples.en: March is the third month of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 三月是一年的第三个月。

sentence_examples.en: The festival takes place in March.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个节日是在三月举行的。

sentence_examples.en: The deadline is on Mar. 5.
sentence_examples.zh: 截止日期是3月5日。

translations.translation: 页边空白;边缘;余地;幅度

sentence_examples.en: Please leave a 1-inch margin on all sides of the page.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在页面四边留出1英寸的页边空白。

sentence_examples.en: The company increased its profit margin to 15% last quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在上个季度将利润率提高到15%。

sentence_examples.en: There is a margin for error in this calculation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个计算存在误差的余地。

translations.translation: 记在页边的,旁注的;(意识)边缘的

sentence_examples.en: The marginal notes explain difficult terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 页边注释解释了这些术语。

sentence_examples.en: The plan offers only marginal benefits compared with the costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 与成本相比，该计划的边际收益很小。

sentence_examples.en: Her influence on the decision was marginal.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这项决策的影响很微小。

translations.translation: 海的,海生的;船舶的,航海的

sentence_examples.en: The marine ecosystem is fragile and needs protection.
sentence_examples.zh: 海洋生态系统脆弱，需要保护。

sentence_examples.en: A marine biologist explained how coral reefs support diverse life.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位海洋生物学家解释了珊瑚礁如何支撑多样的生物。

sentence_examples.en: The shipyard specializes in marine engines and hull repairs.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家船厂专门从事船用发动机和船体维修。

sentence_examples.en: The couple attended a workshop on marital communication.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对夫妇参加了关于婚姻沟通的研讨会。

sentence_examples.en: Marital problems can strain a family.
sentence_examples.zh: 婚姻问题可能会给家庭带来压力。

sentence_examples.en: Her marital status changed after the divorce.
sentence_examples.zh: 离婚后，她的婚姻状况发生了变化。

sentence_examples.en: There is a mark on the wall where the picture used to hang.
sentence_examples.zh: 墙上有一个痕迹，是画框曾经挂着的位置留下的。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher marked the tests in red.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师用红笔给考试打分。

sentence_examples.en: The incident will mark a turning point in his career.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件事将成为他职业生涯的转折点。

sentence_examples.en: I bought fresh fruit at the local market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在本地市场买了新鲜水果。

sentence_examples.en: There is strong demand in the market for renewable energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 市场对可再生能源的需求很强。

sentence_examples.en: The company markets its products online.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在网上销售其产品。

sentence_examples.en: They celebrated their marriage with a small ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们以一个简单的仪式庆祝了婚姻。

sentence_examples.en: Marriage requires compromise and mutual respect.
sentence_examples.zh: 婚姻需要妥协和相互尊重。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke about how marriage changes over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她谈到了婚姻会随着时间而改变。

translations.translation: 已婚的,夫妇的;(to)与…结婚的

sentence_examples.en: She is married to a doctor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她嫁给了一位医生。

sentence_examples.en: The married couple is planning to buy a house.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对已婚夫妇打算买房。

sentence_examples.en: Married life has its ups and downs.
sentence_examples.zh: 婚后生活有起伏。

sentence_examples.en: They will marry next spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们明年春天就要结婚。

sentence_examples.en: She decided to marry him after dating for three years.
sentence_examples.zh: 她交往了三年后决定和他结婚。

sentence_examples.en: In many cultures, people marry for love.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多文化中，人们为爱而结婚。

sentence_examples.en: The magician performed a marvelous trick.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位魔术师表演了一场惊人的魔术。

sentence_examples.en: What a marvelous view from the hilltop.
sentence_examples.zh: 山顶的景色美极了。

sentence_examples.en: Her marvelous generosity touched everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的惊人的慷慨感动了每一个人。

sentence_examples.en: The professor argued that a Marxist approach could explain the economy's downturn.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位教授认为，马克思主义的方法可以解释经济衰退的原因。

sentence_examples.en: She identifies as a Marxist and writes about workers' rights.
sentence_examples.zh: 她自称是马克思主义者，致力于研究工人权益。

sentence_examples.en: To appeal to the working class, the party adopted a Marxist platform.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了争取工人阶级的支持，该党采用了马克思主义纲领。

translations.translation: 男性的，似男性的；［语法］阳性的

sentence_examples.en: The actor's masculine features make him look strong on screen.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位演员的阳刚特征让他在银幕上看起来很强壮。

sentence_examples.en: In grammar, the masculine gender is used for male nouns.
sentence_examples.zh: 在语法中，阳性（masculine）用于表示男性名词。

sentence_examples.en: Some people associate masculine traits with strength and independence.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人把阳刚的特征与力量和独立联系在一起。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a mask to protect herself from the dust.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戴着口罩来防尘。

sentence_examples.en: The masks at the festival were bright and elaborate.
sentence_examples.zh: 节日里的面具色彩鲜艳、造型复杂。

sentence_examples.en: He tried to mask his disappointment with a smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 他试着用笑容掩饰自己的失望。

sentence_examples.en: There was a mass of evidence supporting his theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 有大量证据支持他的理论。

sentence_examples.en: A mass of people gathered outside the stadium.
sentence_examples.zh: 一大群人聚集在体育场外。

sentence_examples.en: The mass of an object is a measure of the amount of matter it contains.
sentence_examples.zh: 物体的质量是它所含物质数量的度量。

sentence_examples.en: The massacre shocked the nation and drew international attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场大屠杀震惊了全国并引起国际关注。

sentence_examples.en: The commander ordered the soldiers to massacre the civilians.
sentence_examples.zh: 指挥官命令士兵残杀平民。

sentence_examples.en: Witnesses described the massacre that occurred near the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 目击者描述了发生在河边的那场大屠杀。

translations.translation: 大而重的,厚实的,粗大的;大规模的,大量的

sentence_examples.en: The statue is massive and weighs several tons.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕像体积巨大，重达数吨。

sentence_examples.en: The project faced massive cost overruns.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目出现了巨额成本超支。

sentence_examples.en: Massive crowds gathered for the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会吸引了大批观众。

sentence_examples.en: The master of the house greeted the guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 房子的主人迎接了客人。

sentence_examples.en: She has mastered the piano after several years of practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 她经过数年的练习，已经精通钢琴。

sentence_examples.en: The master bedroom is upstairs.
sentence_examples.zh: 主卧在楼上。

sentence_examples.en: The new novel is a masterpiece that showcases the author's talent.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部新小说是一部杰作，展现了作者的才华。

sentence_examples.en: Her performance was a masterpiece of timing and emotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的表演是时机与情感的杰作。

sentence_examples.en: This film is a masterpiece of modern cinema.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影是现代电影的杰作。

sentence_examples.en: Please wipe your feet on the mat.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在门口的垫子上擦脚。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a new bath mat.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一个新的浴室垫子。

sentence_examples.en: I roll out my yoga mat before exercising.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在锻炼前摊开瑜伽垫。

translations.translation: 火柴;比赛,竞赛;对手,配偶

sentence_examples.en: I struck a match to light the candle.
sentence_examples.zh: 我用火柴点亮了蜡烛。

sentence_examples.en: The football match starts at 7 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场足球比赛在晚上7点开始。

sentence_examples.en: These colors don't match.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些颜色不搭配。

sentence_examples.en: He's my mate at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是我在工作的同事。

sentence_examples.en: My camping mate helped me set up the tent.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的露营伙伴帮我把帐篷搭好。

sentence_examples.en: Birds mate in spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 鸟类在春天交配。

translations.translation: 物质的,肉体的,实质性的

sentence_examples.en: The artist used clay as a material for the sculpture.
sentence_examples.zh: 艺术家把粘土作为雕塑的材料。

sentence_examples.en: The report includes material such as charts and case studies.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告包含了如图表和案例研究等资料。

sentence_examples.en: The facts of the case are material.
sentence_examples.zh: 该案件的事实具有实质性。

sentence_examples.en: Her approach was strictly mathematical.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的方法完全是基于数学的。

sentence_examples.en: The mathematical model helps predict climate patterns.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个数学模型有助于预测气候模式。

sentence_examples.en: He enjoys solving mathematical puzzles.
sentence_examples.zh: 他喜欢解数学谜题。

sentence_examples.en: I have maths at 10 a.m. today.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今天上午十点有数学课。

sentence_examples.en: She enjoys maths because she loves solving problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢数学，因为她喜欢解题。

sentence_examples.en: We reviewed maths formulas for the upcoming test.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在为即将到来的考试复习数学公式。

translations.translation: 物质,物体;毛病,麻烦;事情

sentence_examples.en: All matter in the universe is made up of atoms.
sentence_examples.zh: 宇宙中的所有物质都由原子组成。

sentence_examples.en: We need to discuss this matter with the manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要和经理讨论这件事。

sentence_examples.en: What matters most is how you respond.
sentence_examples.zh: 最重要的是你如何应对。

sentence_examples.en: The fruit is mature and ready to eat.
sentence_examples.zh: 水果已经成熟，可以吃了。

sentence_examples.en: Time will mature his judgment.
sentence_examples.zh: 时间会使他的判断变得成熟。

sentence_examples.en: She showed a mature attitude at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在工作中表现出成熟的态度。

sentence_examples.en: The maximum height allowed is 3 meters.
sentence_examples.zh: 允许的最大高度是3米。

sentence_examples.en: You should not exceed the maximum capacity of the battery.
sentence_examples.zh: 你不应该超过电池的最大容量。

sentence_examples.en: This setting limits the maximum speed.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个设定限制了最大速度。

translations.translation: 可能，也许；可以，被允许；祝，愿

sentence_examples.en: It may rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以带伞。

sentence_examples.en: You may leave the classroom once you finish the test.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试结束后，你就可以离开教室。

sentence_examples.en: May you live a long and happy life.
sentence_examples.zh: 愿你一生健康快乐。

sentence_examples.en: My birthday is in May.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的生日在五月。

sentence_examples.en: We usually plant flowers in May.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常在五月种花。

sentence_examples.en: May is the fifth month of the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 五月是一年的第五个月。

sentence_examples.en: Maybe I'll go to the gym after work.
sentence_examples.zh: 也许下班后我会去健身房。

sentence_examples.en: Maybe it's too late to call him.
sentence_examples.zh: 也许给他打电话太晚了。

sentence_examples.en: Maybe we should ask for directions.
sentence_examples.zh: 也许我们应该问路。

sentence_examples.en: The mayor announced a new policy to reduce traffic jams.
sentence_examples.zh: 市长宣布了一项新政策，旨在减少交通拥堵。

sentence_examples.en: Residents criticized the mayor for delaying infrastructure projects.
sentence_examples.zh: 居民们批评市长延迟推进基础设施项目。

sentence_examples.en: The candidate campaigned to become mayor of the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位候选人竞选成为该市的市长。

sentence_examples.en: Can you help me with this?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能帮我这个忙吗？

sentence_examples.en: She invited me to her party.
sentence_examples.zh: 她邀请我参加她的聚会。

sentence_examples.en: Don't tell me what to do.
sentence_examples.zh: 别告诉我该怎么做。

sentence_examples.en: We picnicked on the meadow after the hike.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在远足后在草地上野餐。

sentence_examples.en: The meadow was blanketed with wildflowers in spring.
sentence_examples.zh: 春天，草地上铺满了野花。

sentence_examples.en: Cows graze peacefully in the meadow.
sentence_examples.zh: 奶牛在草地上安静地吃草。

sentence_examples.en: I usually have three meals a day.
sentence_examples.zh: 我一天通常吃三顿饭。

sentence_examples.en: This meal includes rice and vegetables.
sentence_examples.zh: 这顿饭包括米饭和蔬菜。

sentence_examples.en: We shared a meal with friends after work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们下班后和朋友一起吃了一顿饭。

sentence_examples.en: What do you mean by that?
sentence_examples.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentence_examples.en: He's always so mean to his coworkers.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对同事总是很刻薄。

sentence_examples.en: The mean of these numbers is 5.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些数字的平均值是5。

translations.translation: 意思,意义,含义;重要性,价值

sentence_examples.en: What is the meaning of this word?
sentence_examples.zh: 这个词的意思是什么？

sentence_examples.en: The meaning of life is a common question for many people.
sentence_examples.zh: 人生的意义是许多人常问的问题。

sentence_examples.en: The meaning of this painting is open to interpretation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画的意义因人而异。

sentence_examples.en: We need new means to solve the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要解决这个问题的新方法。

sentence_examples.en: Public transport is a cheap means of travel.
sentence_examples.zh: 公共交通是一种便宜的出行方式。

sentence_examples.en: The means of communication have evolved rapidly in the digital age.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数字时代，通信手段已迅速发展。

sentence_examples.en: Meantime, I'll start drafting the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 其间，我将开始起草提案。

sentence_examples.en: In the meantime, the team is collecting data to support the decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 在此期间，团队正在收集数据以支持决策。

sentence_examples.en: Meantime, repairs on the building are underway.
sentence_examples.zh: 其间，建筑维修正在进行。

sentence_examples.en: Meanwhile, she finished the report as the team prepared the slides.
sentence_examples.zh: 与此同时，她完成了报告，而团队则在准备幻灯片。

sentence_examples.en: Meanwhile, the children played in the yard.
sentence_examples.zh: 与此同时，孩子们在院子里玩耍。

sentence_examples.en: The power went out; meanwhile, we lit candles and told stories.
sentence_examples.zh: 停电了，与此同时，我们点起蜡烛并讲故事。

sentence_examples.en: Could you measure the length of the room?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能测量房间的长度吗？

sentence_examples.en: The government introduced new measures to improve safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府推出了新的措施来提高安全。

sentence_examples.en: Add the right measure of sugar to the mixture.
sentence_examples.zh: 向混合物加入适量的糖。

sentence_examples.en: I bought some meat to cook for dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一些肉来做晚饭。

sentence_examples.en: Be sure to cook the meat until it's cooked through.
sentence_examples.zh: 一定要把肉煮熟透。

sentence_examples.en: The butcher sells fresh meat every day.
sentence_examples.zh: 肉铺每天都卖新鲜的肉。

sentence_examples.en: The mechanic fixed my car.
sentence_examples.zh: 技工把我的车修好了。

sentence_examples.en: I asked the mechanic for an estimate before the repair.
sentence_examples.zh: 在维修前，我请技工给出估价。

sentence_examples.en: A good mechanic can diagnose problems quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个好的技工能快速诊断问题。

translations.translation: 机械的,由机构制成的;机械似的,呆板的

sentence_examples.en: The car's mechanical parts need regular maintenance.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车的机械部件需要定期维护。

sentence_examples.en: Her voice sounded mechanical, as if she were reading from a script.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的声音听起来很机械，像在照本宣科。

sentence_examples.en: The device uses mechanical gears to convert motion into rotation.
sentence_examples.zh: 该装置使用机械齿轮将运动转换为旋转。

sentence_examples.en: The mechanism inside the watch keeps time accurately.
sentence_examples.zh: 手表的机芯能准确走时。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists are studying the brain's fear mechanism.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家正在研究大脑的恐惧机制。

sentence_examples.en: This door opens by a simple mechanism.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个门是通过一个简单的机构打开的。

sentence_examples.en: She earned a medal for her bravery in the race.
sentence_examples.zh: 她因在比赛中的勇敢而获得了一枚奖章。

sentence_examples.en: The medal was awarded to the team after the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 颁奖仪式结束后，该队获得了奖章。

sentence_examples.en: He wore a medal on his chest to show his achievement.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把奖章挂在胸前，展示了他的成就。

translations.translation: 医学的，医疗的，医药的；内科的

sentence_examples.en: She studies medical ethics in college.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学学习医学伦理学。

sentence_examples.en: The hospital keeps medical records for all patients.
sentence_examples.zh: 医院为所有患者保存医疗记录。

sentence_examples.zh: 有一种神话说喝柠檬汁可以治感冒。

sentence_examples.zh: 她的观点很狭隘，不愿接受新观念。
