sentence_examples.en: I have a question about the assignment.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对作业有一个问题。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher questioned the student after class.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师在下课后向学生提了几个问题。

sentence_examples.en: Many people question his motives.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人对他的动机表示怀疑。

sentence_examples.en: The company sent a questionnaire to all employees.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司向所有员工发送了一份调查问卷。

sentence_examples.en: Please fill out the questionnaire before the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在截止日期前填写这份问卷。

sentence_examples.en: The questionnaire collected data on customer satisfaction.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查问卷收集了客户满意度的数据。

sentence_examples.en: There was a long queue outside the cinema.
sentence_examples.zh: 电影院外排着很长的队伍。

sentence_examples.en: We queued up for tickets at the box office.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在售票处排队买票。

sentence_examples.en: The bus passengers queued at the stop.
sentence_examples.zh: 公交车站的乘客排着队等车。

translations.translation: 快的;灵敏的,伶俐的;敏锐的

sentence_examples.en: She is a quick learner.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是个学得很快的人。

sentence_examples.en: Take a quick look at this chart.
sentence_examples.zh: 请快速看一眼这个图表。

sentence_examples.en: They finished the task quickly.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们很快完成了任务。

sentence_examples.en: The library is quiet.
sentence_examples.zh: 图书馆很安静。

sentence_examples.en: The quiet after the rain was comforting.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨后的安静让人感到安慰。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse quieted the crying baby.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士安抚哭闹的婴儿，使他安静下来。

sentence_examples.en: She tucked the quilt around the sleeping child.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把被子盖在睡着的孩子身上。

sentence_examples.en: The quilt features a traditional floral pattern.
sentence_examples.zh: 这床被子带有传统花卉图案。

sentence_examples.en: Winter nights feel warmer with a thick quilt.
sentence_examples.zh: 在冬夜，厚被子让人睡得更暖和。

translations.translation: 离开,退出;停止,放弃,辞职

sentence_examples.en: She decided to quit her job and travel the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定辞掉工作去环游世界。

sentence_examples.en: He quit smoking last year and hasn't touched a cigarette since.
sentence_examples.zh: 他去年戒烟了，从此再也没有碰过烟。

sentence_examples.en: Don't quit now; we're almost finished.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在别放弃，我们快完成了。

translations.translation: 十分,完全;相当,颇;的确,真正

sentence_examples.en: The movie was quite interesting.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影相当有趣。

sentence_examples.en: I'm quite sure he will come to the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 我很确定他会来参加派对。

sentence_examples.en: That's quite enough for today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天就够了。

sentence_examples.en: Her voice quivered as she spoke.
sentence_examples.zh: 她说话时声音颤抖。

sentence_examples.en: The leaves quivered in the breeze.
sentence_examples.zh: 微风中叶子颤抖着。

sentence_examples.en: His hands quivered with fear.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的手因恐惧而颤抖。

translations.translation: 小型考试,测验,问答比赛

sentence_examples.en: We had a quick quiz in biology class.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在生物课上做了一个简短的测验。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher announced a pop quiz for tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师宣布明天要进行一次突击测验。

sentence_examples.en: They won the quiz competition last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在昨晚的问答比赛中获胜。

translations.translation: (生产、进出口等的)配额，(移民的)限额

sentence_examples.en: The factory has met its monthly production quota.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家工厂已经完成本月的生产配额。

sentence_examples.en: The government reduced the import quota to protect local industries.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府为保护本地产业，降低了进口配额。

sentence_examples.en: Immigration quotas determine how many people can enter the country each year.
sentence_examples.zh: 移民配额决定每年可进入该国的人数。

sentence_examples.en: Please quote the exact words from the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 请引用报告中的原文。

sentence_examples.en: He refused to quote the source, claiming it was confidential.
sentence_examples.zh: 他拒绝援引来源，声称信息是机密的。

sentence_examples.en: I quoted my mentor's words to support my argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 我援引导师的话来支持我的论点。

sentence_examples.en: I saw a rabbit in the park today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天我在公园看到一只兔子。

sentence_examples.en: The rabbit hid behind the bushes when I approached.
sentence_examples.zh: 我走近时，那只兔子藏在灌木丛后面。

sentence_examples.en: We adopted a rabbit from the shelter.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们从收容所领养了一只兔子。

sentence_examples.en: The race starts at 9 a.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 比赛在上午9点开始。

sentence_examples.en: People from many races live in this city.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个城市居住着来自许多不同种族的人。

sentence_examples.en: I like to race my friend to the bus stop.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢和朋友比着跑去公交车站。

sentence_examples.en: Racial tensions were high in the city after the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事件发生后，城市里的种族紧张情绪上升。

sentence_examples.en: The program promotes racial equality and inclusion.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目促进种族平等和包容。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke about her family's racial background.
sentence_examples.zh: 她谈到了她家族的种族背景。

sentence_examples.en: She hung the towels on a rack in the bathroom.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把毛巾挂在浴室的搁物架上。

sentence_examples.en: The wine rack in the dining room has six bottles.
sentence_examples.zh: 餐厅的酒架有六瓶酒。

sentence_examples.en: The country was racked by famine.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家因饥荒深受折磨。

sentence_examples.en: He swung his racket and sent the ball over the net.
sentence_examples.zh: 他挥动球拍，把球打过网。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a lightweight racket for tennis practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一个轻便的球拍来练习网球。

sentence_examples.en: The coach checked my racket tension before practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练在训练前检查了我的球拍张力。

sentence_examples.en: The ship uses radar to detect other vessels at night.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘船在夜间用雷达探测其他船只。

sentence_examples.en: I checked the radar and realized we were off course.
sentence_examples.zh: 我查看雷达，意识到我们偏离航线。

sentence_examples.en: The radar on the ship is so sensitive it can detect distant storms.
sentence_examples.zh: 船上的雷达非常灵敏，甚至能探测远处的风暴。

translations.translation: 发光的,辐射的,容光焕发的

sentence_examples.en: Her radiant smile lit up the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 她灿烂的笑容照亮了房间。

sentence_examples.en: The sunrise cast a radiant glow over the valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 日出为山谷洒下灿烂的光辉。

sentence_examples.en: She looked radiant after the makeover.
sentence_examples.zh: 改造后她看起来容光焕发。

sentence_examples.en: The sun radiates light and heat across the solar system.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳向整个太阳系辐射光和热。

sentence_examples.en: Her smile radiates warmth and makes everyone feel welcome.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的微笑散发出温暖，让每个人都感到受欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: The fireplace radiates warmth throughout the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 壁炉把温暖辐射到整个房间。

translations.translation: 基本的,重要的;激进的,极端的;根本的

sentence_examples.en: The policy proposes radical cuts to taxes.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策提出对税收进行大幅削减。

sentence_examples.en: The radical idea behind the project is to empower local communities.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目背后的根本理念是赋予本地社区权力。

sentence_examples.en: There is a radical difference between the two theories.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两种理论之间存在根本性的差异。

translations.translation: 收音机；无线电报，无线电话

sentence_examples.en: I listen to the radio every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天早晨都在听收音机。

sentence_examples.en: This old radio doesn’t work anymore.
sentence_examples.zh: 这台老收音机已经不工作了。

sentence_examples.en: The dispatcher radioed the location to the rescue team.
sentence_examples.zh: 调度员通过无线电把位置告知救援队。

sentence_examples.en: The lab detected a radioactive source near the containment area.
sentence_examples.zh: 实验室在封控区附近发现了一个放射性源。

sentence_examples.en: The waste is highly radioactive and must be handled with care.
sentence_examples.zh: 废物具有强放射性，必须小心处理。

sentence_examples.en: Radioactive isotopes decay over time, releasing energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 放射性同位素会随时间衰变，释放能量。

translations.translation: 半径,半径范围,有效航程,范围,界限

sentence_examples.en: The radius of this circle is five meters.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个圆的半径是五米。

sentence_examples.en: The emergency services operate within a 50-mile radius of the town.
sentence_examples.zh: 应急服务在镇子半径50英里的范围内提供服务。

sentence_examples.en: Delivery is available within a 3-mile radius of the store.
sentence_examples.zh: 仅在商店半径3英里范围内提供配送。

sentence_examples.en: I spilled juice and wiped it up with a rag.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把果汁洒出后用抹布擦干净。

sentence_examples.en: The painter used a rag to wipe the dust from the shelves.
sentence_examples.zh: 画家用抹布擦拭书架上的灰尘。

sentence_examples.en: There was a rag on the floor behind the chair.
sentence_examples.zh: 椅子后面的地板上有一块抹布。

sentence_examples.en: Her rage filled the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的愤怒充满了房间。

sentence_examples.en: In a moment of rage, he smashed the vase.
sentence_examples.zh: 在一瞬间的愤怒中，他把花瓶打碎了。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd's rage grew after the announcement.
sentence_examples.zh: 公告公布后，民众的愤怒日益高涨。

sentence_examples.en: The police carried out a dawn raid on the warehouse.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方在清晨对仓库发动了一次突袭。

sentence_examples.en: Hackers planned a raid on the data center, but security stopped them.
sentence_examples.zh: 黑客计划对数据中心发动一次突袭，但安保阻止了他们。

sentence_examples.en: During the raid, officers searched every room.
sentence_examples.zh: 在突袭期间，警员逐一搜查了每个房间。

sentence_examples.en: She held the child by the rail to keep him from falling.
sentence_examples.zh: 她扶着栏杆，以防他跌倒。

sentence_examples.en: The train runs on the rails.
sentence_examples.zh: 火车在铁轨上行驶。

sentence_examples.en: The guard rail kept cars from leaving the road.
sentence_examples.zh: 防护栏杆防止汽车驶离路面。

sentence_examples.en: The railroad runs through the valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 铁路穿过山谷。

sentence_examples.en: We took the railroad from Boston to New York.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们乘坐铁路从波士顿到纽约。

sentence_examples.en: The company railroaded the freight to the port.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司通过铁路把货物运送到港口。

sentence_examples.en: The rain kept me indoors.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨把我困在室内。

sentence_examples.en: It rained all day.
sentence_examples.zh: 整天都在下雨。

sentence_examples.en: Criticism rained down on the government after the speech.
sentence_examples.zh: 演讲后，对政府的批评如雨点般落下。

sentence_examples.en: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨后天空出现了一道彩虹。

sentence_examples.en: We watched a rainbow form as the sun came out.
sentence_examples.zh: 阳光出来时，我们看着一道彩虹形成。

sentence_examples.en: A rainbow often appears in children's books.
sentence_examples.zh: 彩虹常出现在儿童书中。

translations.translation: 举起,提升;增加;饲养;引起;竖起;提出

sentence_examples.en: Please raise your hand if you have a question.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你有问题，请举手。

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to raise prices next quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划在下个季度提价。

sentence_examples.en: Farmers raise cattle on their farm.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民在他们的农场饲养牛。

sentence_examples.en: I used a rake to gather fallen leaves.
sentence_examples.zh: 我用耙子把落叶收集起来。

sentence_examples.en: We rake the yard every weekend to keep it tidy.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们每个周末都会把院子耙干净，保持整洁。

sentence_examples.en: They raked through the files for clues.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们翻阅文件以寻找线索。

sentence_examples.en: After the setback, the team managed to rally and win the match.
sentence_examples.zh: 遭遇挫折后，球队设法振作起来并赢得了比赛。

sentence_examples.en: The rally attracted thousands of supporters to the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次集会吸引了成千上万名支持者来到公园。

sentence_examples.en: The upcoming rally is one of the world's most famous car races.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场即将举行的拉力赛是世界上最著名的汽车比赛之一。

sentence_examples.en: The results were based on a random sample.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果基于一个随机样本。

sentence_examples.en: She picked a random page from the book to start reading.
sentence_examples.zh: 她从书中随意挑选了一页来开始读。

sentence_examples.en: The prize was awarded at random.
sentence_examples.zh: 奖品被随机抽取。

translations.translation: 范围,领域;排列,连续;(山)脉

sentence_examples.en: The price range for starter houses is between $200,000 and $350,000.
sentence_examples.zh: 入门房屋的价格区间在20万美元到35万美元之间。

sentence_examples.en: The mountain range stretches from the east to the west across the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座山脉从东到西横跨全国。

sentence_examples.en: Water depths range from 1 to 5 meters.
sentence_examples.zh: 水深从1米到5米不等。

sentence_examples.en: He earned the rank of captain after years of service.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在多年服役后获得了上尉军衔。

sentence_examples.en: The system ranks candidates by their exam scores.
sentence_examples.zh: 该系统按考试分数对候选人进行排名。

sentence_examples.en: She rose in rank within the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在公司内部升了一个等级。

sentence_examples.en: There was a rap on the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 门口传来了一声敲门声。

sentence_examples.en: He rapped on the table to get everyone's attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 他敲了敲桌子以引起大家的注意。

sentence_examples.en: The coach rapped the team for being late.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练因为他们迟到斥责了球队。

sentence_examples.en: Rape is a serious crime.
sentence_examples.zh: 强奸是一种严重的罪行。

sentence_examples.en: The suspect was charged with rape.
sentence_examples.zh: 嫌疑人被控以强奸罪。

sentence_examples.en: Historically, the word rape also meant to plunder.
sentence_examples.zh: 历史上，rape 这个词也曾有掠夺的含义。

sentence_examples.en: The speed of innovation has been rapid.
sentence_examples.zh: 创新的速度一直很快。

sentence_examples.en: The team crossed the rapids in a sturdy raft.
sentence_examples.zh: 队伍乘着结实的木筏穿过急流。

sentence_examples.en: He made a rapid decision to take a shortcut.
sentence_examples.zh: 他迅速地做出走捷径的决定。

translations.translation: 稀有的,难得的,珍奇的;稀薄的,稀疏的

sentence_examples.en: This bird is rare in the wild.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种鸟在野外很稀有。

sentence_examples.en: These coins are rare collectibles.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些硬币是稀有的收藏品。

sentence_examples.en: I like my steak rare.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢把牛排煎成三分熟。

sentence_examples.en: I rarely eat breakfast before work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我很少在上班前吃早餐。

sentence_examples.en: She rarely visits us in the winter.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在冬天很少来看我们。

sentence_examples.en: They rarely agree on anything.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们几乎在任何事情上都不同意。

sentence_examples.en: It would be rash to invest all your savings in one stock.
sentence_examples.zh: 把所有存款都投在一支股票上是轻率的。

sentence_examples.en: The patient developed a rash on the arm after using the cream.
sentence_examples.zh: 患者在使用这种药膏后，手臂上出现了皮疹。

sentence_examples.en: She woke up with a rash on her neck.
sentence_examples.zh: 她醒来时颈部出现了皮疹。

sentence_examples.en: A rat ran across the kitchen floor at night.
sentence_examples.zh: 夜里，一只老鼠从厨房地板上跑过。

sentence_examples.en: There are rats in the alley behind the building.
sentence_examples.zh: 大楼后面的巷子里有老鼠。

sentence_examples.en: The scientists used a rat for the experiment.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家在实验中使用了一只老鼠。

sentence_examples.en: The interest rate has risen this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年利率上升了。

sentence_examples.en: The rate of inflation is rising.
sentence_examples.zh: 通货膨胀率在上升。

sentence_examples.en: They rated the hotel four stars.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们给这家酒店打了四星。

translations.translation: 相当,有一点儿;宁愿,宁可

sentence_examples.en: It's rather cold today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天有点儿冷。

sentence_examples.en: I would rather stay at home than go out in the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 我宁愿在家里待着，也不愿在雨中外出。

sentence_examples.en: The movie was rather long.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影相当长。

sentence_examples.en: The ratio of boys to girls in the class is 2:3.
sentence_examples.zh: 班上男生对女生的比例是2:3。

sentence_examples.en: The recipe calls for a flour-to-water ratio of 3:2.
sentence_examples.zh: 配方中面粉与水的比例是3:2。

sentence_examples.en: The film's aspect ratio is 16:9.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影的宽高比是16:9。

sentence_examples.en: It's rational to invest in education to improve your future.
sentence_examples.zh: 为将来投资教育是有道理的。

sentence_examples.en: The professor explained his rational method for solving the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 教授解释了他用于解决这个问题的理性方法。

sentence_examples.en: She made a rational choice and chose the cheaper option.
sentence_examples.zh: 她做出了理性的选择，选了更便宜的那个。

translations.translation: 未煮过的,生的;未加工过的,未经训练的

sentence_examples.en: I like to eat raw carrots.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢吃生胡萝卜。

sentence_examples.en: We need to process the raw data before analysis.
sentence_examples.zh: 在分析之前，我们需要处理原始数据。

sentence_examples.en: The steak is still raw in the middle.
sentence_examples.zh: 牛排中间还没熟透。

sentence_examples.en: A ray of sunlight streamed through the window.
sentence_examples.zh: 一道阳光透过窗户照进来。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor ordered an X-ray to examine the injury.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生拍了一张X光片来检查伤势。

sentence_examples.en: A stray ray of light bounced off the mirror.
sentence_examples.zh: 一道光线从镜子上反射回来。

sentence_examples.en: I forgot my razor at home and had to borrow one.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把剃刀忘在家里，只好向朋友借用一个。

sentence_examples.en: Most travelers carry a disposable razor for convenience.
sentence_examples.zh: 大多数旅客为了方便，随身携带一次性剃刀。

sentence_examples.en: This razor is very sharp; be careful.
sentence_examples.zh: 这把剃刀很锋利，要小心使用。

sentence_examples.en: We expect to reach the town by noon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们预计中午前到达镇上。

sentence_examples.en: She reached for the coin on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 她伸手去够桌子上的硬币。

sentence_examples.en: The program's reach has expanded to include rural areas.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目的覆盖范围已扩大到农村地区。

translations.translation: 反应,起作用;(against)反对,起反作用

sentence_examples.en: The crowd reacted to the news with laughter.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群对这个消息发出笑声。

sentence_examples.en: If you mix baking soda with vinegar, it reacts and fizzes.
sentence_examples.zh: 把小苏打和醋混合时会发生化学反应并起泡。

sentence_examples.en: Residents reacted against the government's new tax proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 居民们反对政府的新税收提案。

sentence_examples.en: I read a chapter of a book before class.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在上课前读了一章书。

sentence_examples.en: She read the sign carefully and turned left.
sentence_examples.zh: 她仔细看路牌，向左转。

sentence_examples.en: I read in the email that the meeting was canceled.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在邮件里得知会议被取消了。

translations.translation: 读者；读本，读物；(英国的)大学讲师

sentence_examples.en: The reader paused to highlight the main idea.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位读者停下来标出要点。

sentence_examples.en: This reader is a graded collection of texts for language learners.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本分级读物是为语言学习者准备的文本集。

sentence_examples.en: In Britain, a reader is a senior university lecturer.
sentence_examples.zh: 在英国，Reader 是大学中的资深讲师。

sentence_examples.en: The instructions are readily understood by beginners.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些说明对初学者来说很容易理解。

sentence_examples.en: She readily agreed to help.
sentence_examples.zh: 她欣然同意提供帮助。

sentence_examples.en: Spare parts are readily available at the store.
sentence_examples.zh: 该店备件很容易买到。

translations.translation: 读书,读物,(仪表等的)读数,阅读

sentence_examples.en: She enjoys reading every evening.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每晚都喜欢阅读。

sentence_examples.en: The library has a wide selection of readings for children.
sentence_examples.zh: 图书馆有大量适合儿童的读物。

sentence_examples.en: The speedometer shows a reading of 60 miles per hour.
sentence_examples.zh: 车速表显示的读数为60英里/小时。

sentence_examples.en: The coffee is ready.
sentence_examples.zh: 咖啡已经准备好了。

sentence_examples.en: Are you ready to leave?
sentence_examples.zh: 你准备好离开了吗？

sentence_examples.en: She's ready for the challenge.
sentence_examples.zh: 她已经准备好迎接挑战。

translations.translation: 真的,真实的;实际的,现实的

sentence_examples.en: This necklace is real gold, not plated.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条项链是真金，不是镀金的。

sentence_examples.en: We need real solutions, not quick fixes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要真正的解决方案，而不是快速的修补。

sentence_examples.en: This is a real opportunity to prove yourself.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是一个真正的机会让你证明自己。

sentence_examples.en: I realise I forgot to send the email.
sentence_examples.zh: 我意识到自己忘记发邮件了。

sentence_examples.en: She realised her dream of opening a bookstore.
sentence_examples.zh: 她实现了开书店的梦想。

sentence_examples.en: We realise the project will take longer than expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们意识到这个项目比预期需要更长的时间。

sentence_examples.en: It's not realistic to expect a miracle.
sentence_examples.zh: 指望奇迹并不现实。

sentence_examples.en: She has a realistic view of her chances in the competition.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对自己在比赛中的机会有现实的看法。

sentence_examples.en: We need a realistic plan to reduce costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要一个现实的计划来降低成本。

sentence_examples.en: We must face reality and plan ahead.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须面对现实并提前计划。

sentence_examples.en: In reality, the project is more expensive than we expected.
sentence_examples.zh: 事实上，这个项目比我们预期的要昂贵。

sentence_examples.en: Reality TV shows are popular around the world.
sentence_examples.zh: 真人秀节目在世界各地很受欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: I really enjoyed the movie.
sentence_examples.zh: 我真的很喜欢那部电影。

sentence_examples.en: Are you really sure about this decision?
sentence_examples.zh: 你真的确定这个决定吗？

sentence_examples.en: This recipe is really easy to follow.
sentence_examples.zh: 按照这个食谱做起来真的很简单。

sentence_examples.en: The queen defended the realm against invaders.
sentence_examples.zh: 女王捍卫王国免受侵略。

sentence_examples.en: The realm of science offers many exciting discoveries.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学领域提供了许多令人兴奋的发现。

sentence_examples.en: She left the corporate realm to pursue her own business.
sentence_examples.zh: 她离开企业领域去创业。

sentence_examples.en: Farmers reap the crops in autumn.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民在秋天收割庄稼。

sentence_examples.en: If you work hard, you will reap the rewards.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你努力工作，你将收获回报。

sentence_examples.en: The company reaped the benefits of the new market.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司从新市场中获益。

sentence_examples.en: The rear of the car was damaged in the crash.
sentence_examples.zh: 汽车的后部在事故中受损。

sentence_examples.en: Parents rear their children with care.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母会细心抚养孩子。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer rears cattle on the farm.
sentence_examples.zh: 农场主在农场饲养牛群。

sentence_examples.en: The reason I called is to confirm the appointment.
sentence_examples.zh: 我打电话的原因是确认约定的时间。

sentence_examples.en: The reason for the delay was a traffic jam.
sentence_examples.zh: 延迟的原因是交通堵塞。

sentence_examples.en: We tried to reason with the seller to lower the price.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们试着与卖家讲理，要求降价。

translations.translation: 合理的,有道理的;通情达理的;适度的

sentence_examples.en: It's a reasonable explanation for the delay.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是对延迟的合理解释。

sentence_examples.en: The price is reasonable given the quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 考虑到质量，价格很合理。

sentence_examples.en: Taking a break after two hours of work is reasonable.
sentence_examples.zh: 连续工作两小时后休息是合理的。

translations.translation: 使安心，使放心；使消除疑虑

sentence_examples.en: The doctor reassured the patient that the procedure would be safe.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生让患者放心，说手术会很安全。

sentence_examples.en: Parents reassured their children that they would be kept informed.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母让孩子放心，说他们会及时得到通知。

sentence_examples.en: The company reassured investors after the earnings drop.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司在盈利下滑后安抚了投资者。

sentence_examples.en: The people chose to rebel against the oppressive laws.
sentence_examples.zh: 人民选择反抗那些压迫性的法律。

sentence_examples.en: Young activists decided to rebel and demand change.
sentence_examples.zh: 年轻的活动家决定反抗并要求变革。

sentence_examples.en: A rebel led the uprising.
sentence_examples.zh: 一名叛乱者领导了这场起义。

sentence_examples.en: The rebellion began in the capital after weeks of protests.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数周的抗议之后，叛乱在首都爆发。

sentence_examples.en: The authorities cracked down on the rebellion with military force.
sentence_examples.zh: 当局以军事力量镇压叛乱。

sentence_examples.en: He joined the rebellion to fight for freedom.
sentence_examples.zh: 他加入叛乱，为自由而战。

sentence_examples.en: I can't recall his name.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想不起他的名字。

sentence_examples.en: A whiff of cinnamon recalled memories of my grandmother's kitchen.
sentence_examples.zh: 一股肉桂的香味让我想起祖母的厨房。

sentence_examples.en: The company recalled thousands of faulty cars.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司召回了数千辆有缺陷的汽车。

translations.translation: 退回,后退;收回,撤回;跌落,缩减,贬值

sentence_examples.en: The flood waters receded after the rain stopped.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴雨过后，洪水退去。

sentence_examples.en: Her hairline began to recede as she aged.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着年龄增长，她的发际线开始后退。

sentence_examples.en: As concerns about cost grew, public interest in the project receded.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着成本担忧的增加，公众对该项目的兴趣下降。

sentence_examples.en: Please keep the receipt in case you want to return the item.
sentence_examples.zh: 请保留收据，以便退货时使用。

sentence_examples.en: The receipt lists the date of purchase and the total amount.
sentence_examples.zh: 收据上列出购买日期和总金额。

sentence_examples.en: Please confirm receipt of the package.
sentence_examples.zh: 请确认已收到包裹。

translations.translation: 收到,接到;遭受,受到;接待,接见

sentence_examples.en: I received your email yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我昨天收到了你的邮件。

sentence_examples.en: The ambassador will receive delegates at the embassy.
sentence_examples.zh: 大使将在大使馆接待代表。

sentence_examples.en: We received some good news about the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们收到了关于这个项目的一些好消息。

sentence_examples.en: The recent update fixed several bugs.
sentence_examples.zh: 最近的更新修复了几个错误。

sentence_examples.en: Recent events have drawn global attention to climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 最近的事件引起了全球对气候变化的关注。

sentence_examples.en: She has not seen him in recent months.
sentence_examples.zh: 她近几个月没有见到他。

translations.translation: 接待,招待会;接收,接受,接收效果

sentence_examples.en: We held a reception after the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 典礼结束后我们举行了招待会。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel's reception is in the lobby.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店的前台在大堂里。

sentence_examples.en: The proposal received a warm reception from customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项提案受到了客户的热烈欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: I followed my grandmother's recipe for chocolate cake.
sentence_examples.zh: 我照着奶奶的巧克力蛋糕食谱来做。

sentence_examples.en: The recipe for success in this project includes planning and teamwork.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目成功的诀窍包括计划和团队合作。

sentence_examples.en: Could you share the recipe for your lasagna?
sentence_examples.zh: 你能把你做的千层面的食谱分享给我吗？

sentence_examples.en: The recipient of the award will speak at the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 获奖者将于仪式上发言。

sentence_examples.en: The recipient must sign for the package at the front desk.
sentence_examples.zh: 收件人必须在前台签收包裹。

sentence_examples.en: The lab uses a large recipient to hold the chemical.
sentence_examples.zh: 实验室用一个大容器来盛放化学品。

sentence_examples.en: They signed a reciprocal agreement to reduce tariffs.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们签署了一项互惠协议，以降低关税。

sentence_examples.en: They have reciprocal respect for each other's opinions.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们彼此对对方的意见互相尊重。

sentence_examples.en: The treaty establishes reciprocal obligations for both parties.
sentence_examples.zh: 该条约为双方设立了互惠的义务。

sentence_examples.en: She can recite a poem from memory.
sentence_examples.zh: 她能把一首诗背诵下来。

sentence_examples.en: The students were asked to recite their favorite quotes aloud.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生们被要求大声朗诵自己喜欢的名句。

sentence_examples.en: He will recite the pledge at the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 他将在典礼上朗诵誓词。

translations.translation: 不注意的,大意的,卤莽的,不顾后果的

sentence_examples.en: His reckless driving could have caused a serious crash.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的鲁莽驾驶可能导致一起严重的车祸。

sentence_examples.en: Investing all your savings in a single stock is reckless.
sentence_examples.zh: 把全部积蓄投在一支股票上是鲁莽的。

sentence_examples.en: The decision to skip safety checks was reckless.
sentence_examples.zh: 跳过安全检查的决定很鲁莽。

translations.translation: 计算,总计,估计,猜想,依赖

sentence_examples.en: I reckon it will take about an hour.
sentence_examples.zh: 我估计大约需要一个小时。

sentence_examples.en: The mechanic reckoned the repair would cost about $200.
sentence_examples.zh: 修理工估计修理要花大约200美元。

sentence_examples.en: You can reckon on me to help.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以指望我来帮忙。

sentence_examples.en: The government plans to reclaim the polluted land for a park.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府计划将这块污染的土地收回并改建成公园。

sentence_examples.en: She filed a claim to reclaim her lost passport.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为找回丢失的护照而提出索赔。

sentence_examples.en: Farmers reclaimed swampy land to grow crops.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民们开垦沼泽地来种植作物。

sentence_examples.en: Her recognition of the thief's face helped the police catch him.
sentence_examples.zh: 她认出窃贼的脸，帮助警方将他逮捕。

sentence_examples.en: The company gave him recognition for his hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司对他的辛勤工作给予了认可。

sentence_examples.en: The film earned international recognition for its innovative storytelling.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影因其创新的叙事获得了国际认可。

sentence_examples.en: I can recognize her from a distance.
sentence_examples.zh: 我能从远处认出她。

sentence_examples.en: The team recognized his dedication with an award.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队用奖项表彰了他的奉献。

sentence_examples.en: Many people recognize the university as a leader in research.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人公认为这所大学是研究领域的领头羊。

translations.translation: 回忆,想起,记起,忆起,记得

sentence_examples.en: I can't recollect where I left my keys.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想不起我把钥匙放在哪里。

sentence_examples.en: She recollected the details of the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 她回忆起事件的细节。

sentence_examples.en: As I recollect, we met last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 据我记得，我们去年见过面。

sentence_examples.en: I would recommend the new cafe on Main Street.
sentence_examples.zh: 我会推荐主街上的那家新咖啡馆。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor recommended rest for a few days.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生建议休息几天。

sentence_examples.en: She recommended a good book to me.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给我推荐了一本好书。

translations.translation: 使和好,调解,使调和;(to,with)使一致

sentence_examples.en: She tried to reconcile with her old friend after the argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 她试图在争吵后和老朋友和解。

sentence_examples.en: The manager and the union tried to reconcile their differences.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理与工会努力调和彼此的分歧。

sentence_examples.en: It's hard to reconcile his dream with reality.
sentence_examples.zh: 很难把他的梦想与现实协调一致。

translations.translation: 记录;最高记录;履历;唱片

sentence_examples.en: I bought a new record by my favorite band.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了我最喜欢乐队的一张新唱片。

sentence_examples.en: Please record the meeting for our records.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把会议记录下来，以备存档。

sentence_examples.en: He broke the record for the 100-meter dash.
sentence_examples.zh: 他打破了百米赛跑的纪录。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a small digital voice recorder to capture interviews.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一个小型数字录音机来记录访谈。

sentence_examples.en: The court recorder took down every statement during the hearing.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院记录员在听证期间逐字记录每句话。

sentence_examples.en: A cassette recorder sits on the shelf in the studio.
sentence_examples.zh: 工作室的架子上放着一台卡带录音机。

translations.translation: 收回;(from)恢复,痊愈;重新获得

sentence_examples.en: The company hopes to recover its costs from the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司希望从这个项目中收回成本。

sentence_examples.en: She is slowly recovering from the flu.
sentence_examples.zh: 她正在从流感中慢慢痊愈。

sentence_examples.en: After the crash, we recovered the data from the backup.
sentence_examples.zh: 崩溃后，我们从备份中恢复了数据。

sentence_examples.en: The recovery after surgery took several weeks.
sentence_examples.zh: 手术后的康复需要几周时间。

sentence_examples.en: The economy is in recovery after the recession.
sentence_examples.zh: 经济在衰退后逐步复苏。

sentence_examples.en: She is making a slow recovery from her injury.
sentence_examples.zh: 她正在从伤势中缓慢康复。

sentence_examples.en: Many people find recreation in hiking on weekends.
sentence_examples.zh: 周末，许多人通过徒步来寻求娱乐。

sentence_examples.en: The park has a recreation area with playgrounds and picnic spots.
sentence_examples.zh: 公园设有一个娱乐区，里面有游乐场和野餐区。

sentence_examples.en: Team sports are a common form of recreation for many teenagers.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队运动是许多青少年常见的休闲方式。

sentence_examples.en: The company plans to recruit more engineers this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司计划今年招募更多工程师。

sentence_examples.en: The new recruit will start training next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 这名新成员将于下周开始培训。

sentence_examples.en: The program aims to recruit volunteers from the local community.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目旨在从当地社区招募志愿者。

sentence_examples.en: A rectangle has four right angles.
sentence_examples.zh: 矩形有四个直角。

sentence_examples.en: Draw a rectangle with length 8 cm and width 5 cm.
sentence_examples.zh: 画一个长8厘米、宽5厘米的矩形。

sentence_examples.en: The rug in the living room is a rectangle.
sentence_examples.zh: 客厅里的地毯是一个长方形。

sentence_examples.en: The company issued a plan to rectify the accounting errors.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司发布了纠正会计错误的计划。

sentence_examples.en: We need to rectify the situation before it worsens.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要纠正这种局势，以防止事态恶化。

sentence_examples.en: The technician rectified the faulty wiring to restore power.
sentence_examples.zh: 技术员修复了有故障的电路以恢复供电。

translations.translation: (尤指不好的事)一再发生；重现

sentence_examples.en: Despite treatment, the symptoms may recur.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管经过治疗， symptom仍可能再次出现。

sentence_examples.en: The issue tends to recur in cycles throughout the year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题在一年中往往会周期性地再次出现。

sentence_examples.en: If you stop taking the medication, the allergy may recur.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果停止用药，过敏可能会再次发作。

sentence_examples.en: We recycle plastic bottles to reduce waste.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们回收塑料瓶以减少垃圾。

sentence_examples.en: Residents are encouraged to recycle paper and cardboard.
sentence_examples.zh: 鼓励居民回收纸张和纸板。

sentence_examples.en: The city provides separate bins to recycle glass, metal, and plastic.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个城市提供分区回收箱，用来回收玻璃、金属和塑料。

sentence_examples.en: The ball is red.
sentence_examples.zh: 球是红色的。

sentence_examples.en: The red light means stop.
sentence_examples.zh: 红灯表示停车。

sentence_examples.en: She added red to the paint to brighten the color.
sentence_examples.zh: 她往颜料里加入红色以提亮颜色。

sentence_examples.en: We need to reduce plastic waste to protect the environment.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了保护环境，我们需要减少塑料垃圾。

sentence_examples.en: To reduce costs, the team cut unnecessary steps in the process.
sentence_examples.zh: 为降低成本，团队精简了流程中的不必要步骤。

sentence_examples.en: She reduced the recipe by half to serve fewer people.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把配方减半，以便为更少的人做饭。

sentence_examples.en: A reduction in emissions is a key goal of the policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 排放量的减少是该政策的一个关键目标。

sentence_examples.en: The store is offering a price reduction on selected items.
sentence_examples.zh: 商店对部分商品提供降价。

sentence_examples.en: The company announced a reduction in staff to cut costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司宣布裁减员工以降低成本。

translations.translation: 多余的,过剩的;(食物)丰富的;被解雇的

sentence_examples.en: The old system is redundant now that we have a new one.
sentence_examples.zh: 有了新系统，旧系统现在变得多余了。

sentence_examples.en: Several employees were made redundant after the company merged.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司合并后，几名员工被裁员。

sentence_examples.en: The report contains redundant data that repeats the same figures.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告中有冗余数据，重复了相同的数字。

sentence_examples.en: Tall reeds lined the riverbank, rustling in the wind.
sentence_examples.zh: 河岸边长着高高的芦苇，在风中沙沙作响。

sentence_examples.en: The clarinetist replaced the reed before the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 单簧管演奏者在音乐会前换了簧片。

sentence_examples.en: Reeds thrive in wetlands and provide shelter for small creatures.
sentence_examples.zh: 芦苇在湿地茁壮成长，为小动物提供栖息处。

sentence_examples.en: The fishing reel jammed when he tried to wind in the line.
sentence_examples.zh: 他试图收线时，钓鱼线轮卡住了。

sentence_examples.en: She wound the rope onto the reel to store it.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把绳子绕到线轴上以便收起来。

sentence_examples.en: He was reeling from the punch.
sentence_examples.zh: 他被那一拳击得踉跄不稳。

translations.translation: 参考,查询;提到,引用,涉及;提交,上呈

sentence_examples.en: The article refers to recent studies on climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 该文提到了关于气候变化的最近研究。

sentence_examples.en: Please refer to the user manual for setup instructions.
sentence_examples.zh: 请参考用户手册以获取安装说明。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor referred him to a specialist for further tests.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生将他转诊给专科医生以进行进一步检查。

translations.translation: 提及,涉及;参考,参考书目;证明书（人）

sentence_examples.en: The reference section lists all the sources used.
sentence_examples.zh: 参考文献部分列出所用的所有来源。

sentence_examples.en: The report makes no reference to his previous work.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告没有提及他以前的工作。

sentence_examples.en: She agreed to be a reference for my job application.
sentence_examples.zh: 她同意成为我工作申请的推荐人。

translations.translation: 精炼,精制,提纯;使文雅,使高尚

sentence_examples.en: The plant refines crude oil into gasoline.
sentence_examples.zh: 该工厂把原油精炼成汽油。

sentence_examples.en: She spent years refining her writing style.
sentence_examples.zh: 她花了多年时间打磨自己的写作风格。

sentence_examples.en: We need to refine the proposal before presenting it to the board.
sentence_examples.zh: 在向董事会提交之前，我们需要对提案进行修改和完善。

translations.translation: 反射,反映,表现,反省,沉思

sentence_examples.en: The lake's surface reflects the mountains.
sentence_examples.zh: 湖面的倒影映出山脉。

sentence_examples.en: The results reflect the improvements from the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 结果反映出新政策带来的改进。

sentence_examples.en: She likes to reflect on her day before bed.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢在睡前反思一天的经历。

sentence_examples.en: The reflection in the lake mirrored the sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 湖面的倒影映照着落日。

sentence_examples.en: He paused for reflection after receiving the news.
sentence_examples.zh: 在收到消息后他停下来进行反思。

sentence_examples.en: The mirror showed a clear reflection of her face.
sentence_examples.zh: 镜子清晰地映出她的脸。

sentence_examples.en: The government plans to reform the tax system.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府计划改革税制。

sentence_examples.en: Education reform aims to improve schools.
sentence_examples.zh: 教育改革旨在改善学校。

sentence_examples.en: Reform is a slow process that requires public support.
sentence_examples.zh: 改革是一个需要公众支持的缓慢过程。

sentence_examples.en: Please refrain from using flash photography.
sentence_examples.zh: 请勿在拍照时使用闪光灯。

sentence_examples.en: She refrained from commenting until she had all the facts.
sentence_examples.zh: 在掌握所有事实之前，她克制自己不发表评论。

sentence_examples.en: The poem's refrain repeats the same line throughout.
sentence_examples.zh: 这首诗的叠句在整首诗中重复同一句话。

sentence_examples.en: A short nap can refresh you before the afternoon meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 短暂的小睡可以在下午的会议前让你精神焕发。

sentence_examples.en: Coffee refreshed me after the long, tiring drive.
sentence_examples.zh: 长时间疲惫的驾车之后，咖啡让我精神振作起来。

sentence_examples.en: A walk outside refreshed her mood and energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 在外面散步让她的心情和精力都恢复了。

sentence_examples.en: We offered light refreshments after the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议结束后，我们提供了一些点心和饮料。

sentence_examples.en: A quick break for refreshments helped everyone recharge.
sentence_examples.zh: 短暂的休息和点心让大家重新充满活力。

sentence_examples.en: On a hot day, a cool drink was a welcome refreshment.
sentence_examples.zh: 在炎热的一天里，一杯清凉的饮品是受欢迎的提神之物。

sentence_examples.en: The hikers found refuge in a cave during the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨中，徒步者在洞穴里找到了避难所。

sentence_examples.en: The refugees sought refuge in a church for the night.
sentence_examples.zh: 难民们在教堂寻求避难所过夜。

sentence_examples.en: A quiet garden became her refuge from the daily stress.
sentence_examples.zh: 安静的花园成了她摆脱日常压力的避难所。

sentence_examples.en: A refugee told us his story at the refugee shelter.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位难民在难民收容所讲述了他的经历。

sentence_examples.en: The government granted asylum to every refugee who escaped the war.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府把庇护授予每一位因战争而逃离的难民。

sentence_examples.en: Nonprofit groups provide language classes to refugees to help them settle in.
sentence_examples.zh: 非营利组织为难民提供语言课程，帮助他们安顿下来。

sentence_examples.en: I received a refund for my faulty headphones.
sentence_examples.zh: 我因耳机有故障而得到了退款。

sentence_examples.en: The clerk refunded the full amount to my credit card.
sentence_examples.zh: 店员把全额退还到了我的信用卡上。

sentence_examples.en: If you're not satisfied, you can get a full refund within 30 days.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不满意，在30天内可以获得全额退款。

sentence_examples.en: Her refusal to answer the question surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她拒绝回答这个问题，让大家都吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: The manager's refusal to grant the request disappointed the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理拒绝批准这一请求，让团队感到失望。

sentence_examples.en: The government issued a refusal to comment on the matter.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府对该问题发出不予置评的声明。

sentence_examples.en: I refuse to sign the contract until I understand it.
sentence_examples.zh: 在我理解之前，我拒绝签署这份合同。

sentence_examples.en: They refused the invitation because they were busy.
sentence_examples.zh: 因为忙碌，他们拒绝了邀请。

sentence_examples.en: The refuse from the kitchen filled the bin.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨房垃圾把垃圾桶装满了。

sentence_examples.en: The lawyer tried to refute the defendant's claims with new evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师试图用新证据反驳被告的主张。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists have failed to refute the theory, despite many experiments.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管进行了大量实验，科学家们仍未能推翻该理论。

sentence_examples.en: She refuted the rumor by presenting receipts and emails.
sentence_examples.zh: 她通过提供收据和邮件来驳斥谣言。

sentence_examples.en: I regard this decision as a mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把这个决定视为一个错误。

sentence_examples.en: She is held in high regard by her colleagues.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在同事中备受尊敬。

sentence_examples.en: With regard to your question, here is the information you requested.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于你的问题，以下是你所要求的信息。

sentence_examples.en: I have a few questions regarding the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对这个项目有一些问题。

sentence_examples.en: There have been several updates regarding the schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于日程安排，已有几项更新。

sentence_examples.en: Please send the report regarding the budget by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在周五前提交关于预算的报告。

translations.translation: 不管…的,不顾…的,不注意的

sentence_examples.en: She went to the concert regardless of the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 无论下雨，她仍然去参加音乐会。

sentence_examples.en: We'll proceed with the plan regardless of objections.
sentence_examples.zh: 无论有人提出反对，我们仍然按计划进行。

sentence_examples.en: Prices are the same for everyone, regardless of age.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格对所有人都相同，不论年龄大小。

sentence_examples.en: The new regime promised reforms and greater political freedom.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政权承诺进行改革，并带来更大的政治自由。

sentence_examples.en: The regime imposed strict media controls and censorship.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政权实施了严格的媒体管制和审查。

sentence_examples.en: After the coup, the country fell under a military regime.
sentence_examples.zh: 政变后，该国进入了军事政权。

translations.translation: 地区,地带,行政区,(科学等)领域

sentence_examples.en: The northern region is known for its forests.
sentence_examples.zh: 北部地区以森林著称。

sentence_examples.en: The Amazon region is famous for its biodiversity.
sentence_examples.zh: 亚马逊地区以生物多样性闻名。

sentence_examples.en: Different regions of the country have different laws.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家的不同地区有不同的法律。

sentence_examples.en: Please register for the conference online.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在网上注册参加会议。

sentence_examples.en: The thermometer registers at 40 degrees.
sentence_examples.zh: 温度计显示40摄氏度。

sentence_examples.en: We sent the documents by registered mail.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们用挂号邮件寄送了文件。

sentence_examples.en: I regret not taking that opportunity.
sentence_examples.zh: 我后悔没有抓住那个机会。

sentence_examples.en: Her regret over the decision was obvious.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个决定的后悔很明显。

sentence_examples.en: We regret to inform you that your application has been rejected.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们很遗憾地通知您，您的申请已被拒绝。

translations.translation: 有规律的;整齐的,匀称的,正规的,正式的

sentence_examples.en: I try to keep a regular routine to stay healthy.
sentence_examples.zh: 我努力保持有规律的作息以保持健康。

sentence_examples.en: The regular bus runs every 20 minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 固定时刻发车的公交车每20分钟一班。

sentence_examples.en: She wears a regular uniform to work.
sentence_examples.zh: 她上班时穿着一套标准制服。

translations.translation: 管制,控制;调节,校准;调整

sentence_examples.en: The government plans to regulate the sale of fireworks to reduce accidents.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府计划对烟花销售进行管制，以减少事故。

sentence_examples.en: You can regulate the temperature by adjusting the thermostat.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以通过调节恒温器来控制室温。

sentence_examples.en: Industries must regulate their advertising to avoid misleading claims.
sentence_examples.zh: 各行业必须规范广告，避免误导性宣传。

translations.translation: 规则,规章;调节,校准;调整

sentence_examples.en: The government issued a regulation to reduce plastic waste.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府发布了一项法规以减少塑料垃圾。

sentence_examples.en: Companies must follow the new safety regulation in factories.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司必须遵守工厂的新安全规定。

sentence_examples.en: Regulation of the market can help prevent price spikes.
sentence_examples.zh: 市场调控有助于防止价格飙升。

translations.translation: 排练,排演,演习,预演,试演

sentence_examples.en: The actors ran through the lines again during rehearsal to fix the pacing.
sentence_examples.zh: 演员们在排练中再次把台词跑了一遍，以调整节奏。

sentence_examples.en: We have a dress rehearsal tomorrow before opening night.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们明天在首演前举行一场正式彩排。

sentence_examples.en: The rehearsal schedule is posted on the bulletin board.
sentence_examples.zh: 排练日程表贴在公告板上。

sentence_examples.en: Queen Victoria's reign lasted for nearly 64 years.
sentence_examples.zh: 维多利亚女王的统治持续了近64年。

sentence_examples.en: During his reign, the empire expanded rapidly.
sentence_examples.zh: 在他的统治时期，帝国迅速扩张。

sentence_examples.en: Peace reigned across the country after the war.
sentence_examples.zh: 战争结束后，全国和平盛行。

sentence_examples.en: The rider tightened the reins to slow the horse.
sentence_examples.zh: 骑手拉紧缰绳让马慢下来。

sentence_examples.en: The city must rein in pollution to meet the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 该市必须抑制污染，以便在截止日期前完成任务。

sentence_examples.en: The manager kept a tight rein on the project budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理对项目预算保持严格控制。

sentence_examples.en: The new evidence will reinforce my argument.
sentence_examples.zh: 新证据将加强我的论点。

sentence_examples.en: We need to reinforce security measures after the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事件发生后，我们需要加强安全措施。

sentence_examples.en: The wall was reinforced with steel bars.
sentence_examples.zh: 这堵墙已用钢筋加固。

translations.translation: 拒绝,抵制,丢弃,排斥,退掉

sentence_examples.en: The committee rejected his proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会拒绝了他的提案。

sentence_examples.en: The editor rejected the manuscript.
sentence_examples.zh: 编辑拒绝了这份手稿。

sentence_examples.en: He felt like a reject after not getting the job.
sentence_examples.zh: 他没得到那份工作后，觉得自己像个落选者。

sentence_examples.en: We rejoiced at the good news.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们对这个好消息感到欣喜。

sentence_examples.en: People rejoiced when the festival began.
sentence_examples.zh: 节日开始时，人们都很高兴。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd rejoiced as the team scored the winning goal.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队打进制胜球时，观众们欣喜不已。

sentence_examples.en: She will relate how the event unfolded at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她会讲述事件在会议上是如何发生的。

sentence_examples.en: The two stories relate to the same incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个故事都涉及同一事件。

sentence_examples.en: I can't relate to his feelings about the decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 我无法理解他对这个决定的感受。

sentence_examples.en: The relation between diet and health is complex.
sentence_examples.zh: 饮食与健康之间的关系很复杂。

sentence_examples.en: He is a distant relation of mine.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是我的一位远亲。

sentence_examples.en: In relation to the new policy, the company updated its guidelines.
sentence_examples.zh: 就新政策而言，公司更新了指南。

sentence_examples.en: She values her close relationship with her sister.
sentence_examples.zh: 她非常珍视与妹妹之间的亲密关系。

sentence_examples.en: We have a good working relationship with our suppliers.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们与供应商之间有良好的合作关系。

sentence_examples.en: There is a relationship between study time and exam performance.
sentence_examples.zh: 学习时间与考试成绩之间存在关系。

translations.translation: 相对的,比较的,有关系的

sentence_examples.en: The price is relative to demand.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格取决于需求。

sentence_examples.en: I visited a relative yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我昨天去拜访了一位亲戚。

sentence_examples.en: In grammar, 'which' is a relative pronoun.
sentence_examples.zh: 在语法中，'which' 是一个关系代词。

sentence_examples.en: Relativity is a fundamental concept in physics that describes how speed and time can affect measurements.
sentence_examples.zh: 相对性是物理学中的一个基本概念，描述速度和时间如何影响测量。

sentence_examples.en: The relativity of simultaneity shows that whether two events occur at the same time can depend on the observer's motion.
sentence_examples.zh: 同时性的相对性表明，两个事件是否在同一时间发生可能取决于观察者的运动状态。

sentence_examples.en: In everyday life, people often forget that relativity exists and interpret facts from their own perspective.
sentence_examples.zh: 在日常生活中，人们常常忘记相对性的存在，而从自己的角度来解释事实。

sentence_examples.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
sentence_examples.zh: 深呼吸，放松一下。

sentence_examples.en: Relax your shoulders to ease the tension.
sentence_examples.zh: 放松你的肩膀以缓解紧张。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor told me to relax my neck after the long drive.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生让我在长途驾车后放松颈部。

sentence_examples.en: Please relay this message to your supervisor.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把这条信息转告给你的上司。

sentence_examples.en: The satellite will relay live footage to viewers.
sentence_examples.zh: 卫星将把现场直播画面转播给观众。

sentence_examples.en: The 4×100 relay team won the race.
sentence_examples.zh: 这支4×100米接力队赢得了比赛。

sentence_examples.en: The company will release a new smartphone next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将在下个月发布一款新智能手机。

sentence_examples.en: The prisoner was released from jail yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 囚犯昨天从监狱获释。

sentence_examples.en: The release of the new policy surprised some residents.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策的发布让一些居民感到意外。

translations.translation: 有关的,中肯的,相应的,实质性的

sentence_examples.en: Her comments were relevant to the discussion.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的评论与讨论相关。

sentence_examples.en: Please provide the most relevant data to support your claim.
sentence_examples.zh: 请提供最相关的数据来支持你的说法。

sentence_examples.en: The issue is not relevant to our current project.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题与我们当前的项目无关。

translations.translation: 可靠的,可信赖的,确实的

sentence_examples.en: A reliable friend is someone you can count on.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个可靠的朋友是你可以依靠的人。

sentence_examples.en: This brand is known for its reliable products.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个品牌以产品的可靠性而闻名。

sentence_examples.en: We need reliable data to make a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要可靠的数据来做决定。

translations.translation: 信任,信心,依靠,依靠的人或物

sentence_examples.en: Her reliance on her friends kept her going during hard times.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在困难时期对朋友的依赖支撑着她。

sentence_examples.en: The company's reliance on imported parts caused production delays.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司对进口零件的依赖导致生产延误。

sentence_examples.en: Developing self-reliance helps students solve problems without help.
sentence_examples.zh: 培养自立能力有助于学生在没有帮助时解决问题。

sentence_examples.en: The medicine brought him relief from the pain.
sentence_examples.zh: 药物让他缓解了疼痛。

sentence_examples.en: Aid workers delivered relief to the flood victims.
sentence_examples.zh: 救援人员向洪水灾民提供救济。

sentence_examples.en: She sighed with relief when the exam ended.
sentence_examples.zh: 考试结束时她松了一口气，感到如释重负。

translations.translation: 减轻,解除,援救,救济,换班

sentence_examples.en: Taking a painkiller can relieve your headache.
sentence_examples.zh: 吃止痛药可以缓解头痛。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy is designed to relieve poverty.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策旨在减轻贫困。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse will relieve the doctor during the night shift.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士将在夜班接替这名医生的工作。

sentence_examples.en: Many people are curious about different religions.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人对不同的宗教感到好奇。

sentence_examples.en: She studies religion at university and writes about faith.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在大学学习宗教并撰写关于信仰的论文。

sentence_examples.en: He follows a religion that teaches compassion.
sentence_examples.zh: 他信奉一种教导仁爱的宗教。

sentence_examples.en: She attends religious services every week.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每周参加宗教礼拜。

sentence_examples.en: The festival is a religious holiday in the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个节日是该国的宗教节日。

sentence_examples.en: He wears a religious symbol to show his faith.
sentence_examples.zh: 他戴着一个宗教符号来表达他的信仰。

translations.translation: 美味,味道,调味品,食欲,乐趣

sentence_examples.en: I like to add relish to hot dogs for extra flavor.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢给热狗加酸黄瓜酱以增添风味。

sentence_examples.en: She tackled the project with relish.
sentence_examples.zh: 她满怀热情地投入了这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: I relish the chance to travel and meet new people.
sentence_examples.zh: 我很珍惜旅行和结识新朋友的机会。

sentence_examples.en: She was reluctant to speak at the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议上不愿发言。

sentence_examples.en: He was reluctant to admit he was wrong.
sentence_examples.zh: 他不愿承认自己错了。

sentence_examples.en: The team was reluctant to start the project without more information.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队不愿在信息不足的情况下开始这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: I rely on my savings to pay the rent.
sentence_examples.zh: 我依靠储蓄来付房租。

sentence_examples.en: You can rely on her to finish the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以信赖她按时完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: Many people rely on smartphones for daily tasks.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人依赖智能手机来完成日常任务。

translations.translation: 剩下,余留;留待,尚须;仍然是,依旧是

sentence_examples.en: Only a few cookies remain after the party.
sentence_examples.zh: 派对结束后只剩下几块饼干。

sentence_examples.en: Please remain seated until the announcement.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在宣布之前保持就座。

sentence_examples.en: The old rules remain in effect.
sentence_examples.zh: 旧规则仍然生效。

translations.translation: 剩余物,剩下的;余数,余项

sentence_examples.en: Only a small remainder of the budget was unspent.
sentence_examples.zh: 预算中只有少量余额未花费。

sentence_examples.en: The remainder when 17 is divided by 5 is 2.
sentence_examples.zh: 把 17 除以 5 的余数是 2。

sentence_examples.en: We kept the remainder of the cake for later.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把剩下的蛋糕留到以后吃。

sentence_examples.en: Archaeologists uncovered the remains of an ancient statue.
sentence_examples.zh: 考古学家发现了一座古代雕像的遗骸。

sentence_examples.en: Only the remains of the burned village were found.
sentence_examples.zh: 只发现了被烧毁村庄的遗迹。

sentence_examples.en: After the flood, only the remains of the bridge could be seen.
sentence_examples.zh: 洪水后，只有桥梁的遗迹才能看见。

sentence_examples.en: Her remark about the policy surprised everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这项政策的评论让大家都吃了一惊。

sentence_examples.en: The manager remarked on the team's progress.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理对团队的进展发表了评论。

sentence_examples.en: He made a remark about the weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对天气发表了评论。

translations.translation: 值得注意的;显著的,异常的,非凡的

sentence_examples.en: Her performance was remarkable, especially given the short rehearsal time.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的表演相当出色，尤其是在排练时间很短的情况下。

sentence_examples.en: The team's perseverance is remarkable.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个团队的坚持精神令人印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: It is remarkable that she learned the language in six months.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在六个月内就学会了这门语言，真是了不起。

sentence_examples.en: There is no easy remedy for this problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题没有简单的解决办法。

sentence_examples.en: Her grandmother swore that herbal tea was a remedy for colds.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的祖母说草药茶能治感冒。

sentence_examples.en: The company must remedy the defects in the software.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司必须纠正软件中的缺陷。

translations.translation: 记住;(to)转达问候,代…致意,代…问好

sentence_examples.en: Remember to lock the door before you leave.
sentence_examples.zh: 离开前请记得锁门。

sentence_examples.en: I can't remember where I put my keys.
sentence_examples.zh: 我忘了把钥匙放在哪儿。

sentence_examples.en: Please remember me to your family.
sentence_examples.zh: 请替我向你们家人问好。

sentence_examples.en: This photo reminds me of our trip last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 这张照片让我想起去年的旅行。

sentence_examples.en: Please remind me to call the bank tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 请提醒我明天给银行打电话。

sentence_examples.en: Her smile reminds everyone of her kindness.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的笑容让大家想起她的善良。

sentence_examples.en: A remnant of the original painting survived the fire.
sentence_examples.zh: 原作画作的残余部分在火灾中幸存下来。

sentence_examples.en: She kept a remnant of the wedding dress as a keepsake.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把婚纱的一小块剩料留作纪念。

sentence_examples.en: The remnant population of the species clung to the last habitat.
sentence_examples.zh: 该物种的残存种群紧紧依附在最后的栖息地。

translations.translation: 远的,遥远的,疏远的,偏僻的,细微的

sentence_examples.en: The village is in a remote valley far from the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏僻山谷。

sentence_examples.en: The chances of rain tomorrow are remote.
sentence_examples.zh: 明天降雨的几率很小。

sentence_examples.en: After the argument, he seemed remote and distant.
sentence_examples.zh: 争吵后，他显得很疏远，也很少和任何人交谈。

sentence_examples.en: The removal of the old wallpaper took all afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 旧墙纸的移除花了整整一个下午。

sentence_examples.en: The removal of debris after the storm took several days.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨后的残骸清除花了好几天。

sentence_examples.en: The removal of the old building for the new mall was controversial.
sentence_examples.zh: 为新购物中心拆除旧建筑引发了争议。

sentence_examples.en: Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在进屋前把鞋子脱掉。

sentence_examples.en: You can remove the sticker if you don't want it.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不想要这个贴纸，可以把它移除。

sentence_examples.en: The manager decided to remove him from his position.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理决定将他免职。

translations.translation: [the R-]文艺复兴(时期)；新生，复兴

sentence_examples.en: The Renaissance began in Italy in the 14th century.
sentence_examples.zh: 文艺复兴起于14世纪的意大利。

sentence_examples.en: The town is experiencing a renaissance, with new art and small businesses.
sentence_examples.zh: 小镇正在经历一次文艺复兴，涌现出新的艺术和小型企业。

sentence_examples.en: There is a renaissance in renewable energy investment across the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 全国范围内正出现对可再生能源投资的复兴。

translations.translation: 使得,致使;提出,提供,呈报

sentence_examples.en: The heavy rain rendered the road impassable.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴雨使路面无法通行。

sentence_examples.en: The artist rendered the landscape in vibrant colors.
sentence_examples.zh: 艺术家用鲜艳的颜色描绘了这幅风景。

sentence_examples.en: The committee will render a final report next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会将于下周提交最终报告。

sentence_examples.en: I need to renew my passport before the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 在出发前，我需要续期我的护照。

sentence_examples.en: The company decided to renew the contract for another year.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司决定再续签一年的合同。

sentence_examples.en: She renewed her subscription online.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在线续订了订阅。

sentence_examples.en: We plan to renovate the kitchen next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们计划下个月翻新厨房。

sentence_examples.en: The city is renovating the old theater to attract tourists.
sentence_examples.zh: 市政府正在翻新这座老剧院以吸引游客。

sentence_examples.en: They hired a contractor to renovate the bathroom.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们雇了一名承包商来翻新浴室。

sentence_examples.en: We decided to rent an apartment next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们决定下个月租一套公寓。

sentence_examples.en: The monthly rent for the apartment is $1,200.
sentence_examples.zh: 这套公寓的月租金是1200美元。

sentence_examples.en: They decided to rent out their old car to someone.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们决定把旧车出租给别人。

sentence_examples.en: We need to repair the leak in the kitchen sink.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要修理厨房水槽的漏水。

sentence_examples.en: The shop offers same-day repair for smartphones.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家店提供手机的当日修理服务。

sentence_examples.en: A quick repair can fix the problem.
sentence_examples.zh: 一次快速的修理就能解决这个问题。

sentence_examples.en: I will repay you for helping me.
sentence_examples.zh: 我会报答你对我的帮助。

sentence_examples.en: She repaid him by cooking dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 她通过做晚饭来报答他。

sentence_examples.en: You should repay what you borrowed from the bank.
sentence_examples.zh: 你应该把从银行借的钱还清。

sentence_examples.en: Please repeat what you just said.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把你刚才说的再说一遍。

sentence_examples.en: There was a repeat of the same mistake in the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告中再次出现了同样的错误。

sentence_examples.en: The app can repeat the action automatically.
sentence_examples.zh: 该应用程序可以自动重复该操作。

sentence_examples.en: He warned her repeatedly not to touch the box.
sentence_examples.zh: 他反复警告她不要碰那个箱子。

sentence_examples.en: The data were analyzed repeatedly to ensure accuracy.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了确保准确性，数据被反复分析。

sentence_examples.en: She pressed the doorbell repeatedly, hoping someone would answer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她反复按门铃，希望有人会来应答。

translations.translation: 击退,抵制,使厌恶,使不愉快

sentence_examples.en: The shield is designed to repel arrows.
sentence_examples.zh: 这面盾牌的设计是用来挡箭矢。

sentence_examples.en: A strong scent can repel pests.
sentence_examples.zh: 强烈的气味可以驱赶害虫。

sentence_examples.en: The scandal repelled many voters.
sentence_examples.zh: 这起丑闻让许多选民感到厌恶。

translations.translation: 节目,全部剧目,保留剧目,全部技能

sentence_examples.en: Her repertoire includes classical piano pieces and contemporary songs.
sentence_examples.zh: her 的曲目包括古典钢琴曲和现代歌曲。

sentence_examples.en: The magician added three new tricks to his repertoire.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位魔术师的新花样已加入到他的曲目中。

sentence_examples.en: A singer's repertoire grows as they learn more songs.
sentence_examples.zh: 歌手的曲目会随着他们学会更多歌曲而扩大。

sentence_examples.en: Repetition helps students memorize new vocabulary.
sentence_examples.zh: 重复有助于学生记住新词汇。

sentence_examples.en: There was too much repetition in his speech, which bored the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的演讲中重复太多，令听众感到厌烦。

sentence_examples.en: The workout uses repetition to build muscle memory.
sentence_examples.zh: 训练通过重复练习来建立肌肉记忆。

translations.translation: 取代,替换,代替,把...放回原处

sentence_examples.en: We need to replace the battery in the remote.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要更换遥控器里的电池。

sentence_examples.en: The company decided to replace the old manager with a new one.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司决定用新经理来取代旧经理。

sentence_examples.en: After using the jar, please replace the lid.
sentence_examples.zh: 使用后请把盖子放回原处。

translations.translation: 取代,替换,替换物,代替物

sentence_examples.en: I need a replacement part for my coffee maker.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的咖啡机需要一个替换部件。

sentence_examples.en: The replacement for the broken screen arrived today.
sentence_examples.zh: 坏屏幕的替换件今天到了。

sentence_examples.en: The company introduced a replacement for the old policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司推出了旧政策的替代方案。

sentence_examples.en: Please reply to my message when you have a moment.
sentence_examples.zh: 有空时，请回复我的信息。

sentence_examples.en: Her reply surprised him.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的回复让他吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: Please reply by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在周五前回复。

sentence_examples.en: I filed a report on the quarterly sales results.
sentence_examples.zh: 我提交了关于季度销售结果的报告。

sentence_examples.en: The manager asked me to report any changes to the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理要求我如有计划变动，请汇报。

sentence_examples.en: There are reports that the project is behind schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 有报道称该项目进度落后。

translations.translation: 报告人,通讯员;记者,报导者

sentence_examples.en: The reporter asked for a statement from the mayor.
sentence_examples.zh: 记者向市长要了一份声明。

sentence_examples.en: She works as a reporter for a local newspaper.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在当地报纸担任记者。

sentence_examples.en: A reporter must verify facts before publishing.
sentence_examples.zh: 记者在刊发前必须核实事实。

translations.translation: 描述,表示;代表,代理;阐明,说明

sentence_examples.en: The flag represents the nation's unity.
sentence_examples.zh: 国旗象征着国家的团结。

sentence_examples.en: A lawyer will represent the defendant in court.
sentence_examples.zh: 律师将在法庭上代表被告出庭。

sentence_examples.en: The chart represents the sales trend over the last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 图表显示了过去一年的销售趋势。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke on behalf of the union as its representative.
sentence_examples.zh: 她作为工会的代表发言。

sentence_examples.en: The company's customer service representative will assist you.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司的客户服务代表将协助您。

sentence_examples.en: This painting is representative of the artist's early work.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画代表了这位艺术家早期作品的风格。

sentence_examples.en: The government's repression of dissent drew international condemnation.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府对异议的镇压遭到国际谴责。

sentence_examples.en: Repression of memories can affect how a person behaves.
sentence_examples.zh: 记忆的压抑可能影响一个人的行为。

sentence_examples.en: The repression of information kept the public from knowing the truth.
sentence_examples.zh: 信息被压制，公众因此无法知道真相。

sentence_examples.en: The manager reproached the staff for missing the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理因为未按时完成任务而指责员工。

sentence_examples.en: There was a look of reproach on her face after he forgot her birthday.
sentence_examples.zh: 在他忘记她的生日后，她脸上露出责备的神情。

sentence_examples.en: He reproached his colleague for leaving the meeting early.
sentence_examples.zh: 他因为提前离开会议而指责了同事。

translations.translation: 生殖;翻版;繁殖;复制,仿造

sentence_examples.en: The museum can reproduce ancient statues using 3D printing.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆可以用3D打印技术复制古代雕像。

sentence_examples.en: Many plants reproduce by producing seeds.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多植物通过产生种子来繁殖。

sentence_examples.en: The photographer tried to reproduce the original scene as closely as possible.
sentence_examples.zh: 摄影师努力把原始场景尽量再现。

sentence_examples.en: A snake is a reptile.
sentence_examples.zh: 蛇是一种爬行动物。

sentence_examples.en: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin.
sentence_examples.zh: 爬行动物的皮肤干燥且有鳞片。

sentence_examples.en: Some reptiles can live in deserts.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些爬行动物可以在沙漠中生活。

sentence_examples.en: The country chose to become a republic rather than a monarchy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家选择成为共和国，而不是君主制。

sentence_examples.en: In a republic, citizens elect representatives to make laws.
sentence_examples.zh: 在共和国中，公民通过选举代表来制定法律。

sentence_examples.en: The constitution outlines the powers of the republic's government.
sentence_examples.zh: 宪法规定了共和国政府的权力。

sentence_examples.en: The country adopted a republican form of government.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家采用了共和的政体。

sentence_examples.en: The party supported republican principles in its platform.
sentence_examples.zh: 该党在纲领中支持共和原则。

sentence_examples.en: A republican system limits the power of the monarchy.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个共和制度会限制君主制的权力。

sentence_examples.en: Her reputation for honesty helped her get the job.
sentence_examples.zh: 她因诚实而享有良好声誉，从而得到这份工作。

sentence_examples.en: This company has a strong reputation for quality.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司的质量享有很高的声誉。

sentence_examples.en: Gossip can damage a person's reputation.
sentence_examples.zh: 流言蜚语可能会损害一个人的名誉。

sentence_examples.en: I would like to make a request for a day off.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想请一天假。

sentence_examples.en: The bank granted his loan request.
sentence_examples.zh: 银行批准了他的贷款请求。

sentence_examples.en: She requested a copy of the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 她请求了一份报告的副本。

sentence_examples.en: This course requires dedication and hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 这门课程需要投入和努力。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher requires us to submit homework on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师要求我们按时提交作业。

sentence_examples.en: The law requires drivers to wear seat belts.
sentence_examples.zh: 法律要求司机系安全带。

sentence_examples.en: Meeting the safety requirement is mandatory before the project can start.
sentence_examples.zh: 在项目开始之前，必须满足安全要求。

sentence_examples.en: One of the job requirements is a bachelor's degree.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份工作的一个要求是本科学历。

sentence_examples.en: The visa application has several requirements that applicants must meet.
sentence_examples.zh: 签证申请有若干要求，申请人必须满足。

sentence_examples.en: Firefighters rescued the hikers from the mountain.
sentence_examples.zh: 消防员把山上的登山者救了下来。

sentence_examples.en: They launched a rescue operation after the ship sank.
sentence_examples.zh: 船沉没后，他们启动了营救行动。

sentence_examples.en: The police helped with the rescue of the missing climber.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方协助对失踪的攀登者进行营救。

sentence_examples.en: The scientist will conduct research on renewable energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位科学家将进行关于可再生能源的研究。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers are researching the effects of sleep on memory.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员正在研究睡眠对记忆的影响。

sentence_examples.en: They published the research results in a leading journal.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在一家权威期刊上发表了研究结果。

sentence_examples.en: She bears a strong resemblance to her mother.
sentence_examples.zh: 她和她的母亲长得很像。

sentence_examples.en: There is a remarkable resemblance between the twins.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对双胞胎之间有显著的相似之处。

sentence_examples.en: The resemblance between the old design and the new design is striking.
sentence_examples.zh: 旧设计和新设计之间的相似之处很明显。

sentence_examples.en: The twins resemble each other a lot.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对双胞胎非常相像。

sentence_examples.en: The painting resembles a famous portrait.
sentence_examples.zh: 这幅画看起来像一幅著名的肖像。

sentence_examples.en: The new design resembles the old one.
sentence_examples.zh: 新设计与旧设计很相似。

sentence_examples.en: She began to resent her manager for denying her a promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 她开始因为经理没让她升职而怨恨。

sentence_examples.en: Employees resent the new policy because it reduces their hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 员工们因为新政策缩短工时而感到怨恨。

sentence_examples.en: He resented being asked to work late again.
sentence_examples.zh: 他再次被要求加班，感到怨恨。

translations.translation: 保留,保留意见;预定,预订

sentence_examples.en: We made a reservation at the restaurant for seven o'clock.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在餐厅为七点做了预订。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel confirmed my reservation for next weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店确认了我下个周末的预订。

sentence_examples.en: I have some reservations about the new plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对这个新计划有些保留意见。

sentence_examples.en: They kept a large reserve of water in case of drought.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为干旱备用了大量水储备。

sentence_examples.en: You can reserve a table for dinner online.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以在网上预订一张晚餐的桌子。

sentence_examples.en: She reserved her judgment until she had all the evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在掌握全部证据之前先保留了自己的判断。

sentence_examples.en: The city draws its drinking water from a nearby reservoir.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座城市的饮用水来自附近的水库。

sentence_examples.en: During the drought, the reservoir levels dropped dramatically.
sentence_examples.zh: 在干旱期间，水库水位显著下降。

sentence_examples.en: The fisherman sat by the reservoir and watched the sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 渔民坐在水库边，看着日落。

sentence_examples.en: Many countries require proof of residence when opening a bank account.
sentence_examples.zh: 开设银行账户时，许多国家需要居住证明。

sentence_examples.en: They moved into a new residence near the university.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们搬进了离大学不远的新居。

sentence_examples.en: She applied for a residence permit to live and work in the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 她申请了一份居留许可，在该国居住和工作。

sentence_examples.en: The residents of the town gathered for the festival.
sentence_examples.zh: 小镇的居民们聚集参加节日活动。

sentence_examples.en: Every resident must show ID at the gate.
sentence_examples.zh: 每位居民在大门处必须出示身份证。

sentence_examples.en: The building has a resident manager who lives on site.
sentence_examples.zh: 这栋楼有一名常驻管理员，住在楼内。

translations.translation: 辞去,辞职,使听从(于),使顺从

sentence_examples.en: She decided to resign from her position after the controversy.
sentence_examples.zh: 在争议爆发后，她决定辞去自己的职位。

sentence_examples.en: He submitted his resignation and left the company immediately.
sentence_examples.zh: 他提交了辞职信并立即离开了公司。

sentence_examples.en: If you resign yourself to the situation, you can focus on what you can control.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你接受现实，专注于你能控制的事情。

translations.translation: 抵抗,反抗;抗,忍得住,抵制

sentence_examples.en: She tried to resist the temptation to eat the cake.
sentence_examples.zh: 她试图抵抗吃蛋糕的诱惑。

sentence_examples.en: The soldiers resisted the enemy's advance.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵们抵抗了敌人的进攻。

sentence_examples.en: I can't resist a good joke.
sentence_examples.zh: 我抵挡不住一个好笑话的诱惑。

sentence_examples.en: There is strong resistance to the new policy among employees.
sentence_examples.zh: 员工对新政策存在强烈的抵制情绪。

sentence_examples.en: The wire has a high electrical resistance.
sentence_examples.zh: 这根电线的电阻很高。

sentence_examples.en: Regular exercise can increase your resistance to colds.
sentence_examples.zh: 经常运动可以提高你对感冒的抵抗力。

sentence_examples.en: The coating is resistant to corrosion.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种涂层耐腐蚀。

sentence_examples.en: Some people are resistant to change.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些人对改变很抗拒。

sentence_examples.en: Many materials are resistant to moisture.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多材料耐潮湿。

sentence_examples.en: She remained resolute in the face of criticism.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在面对批评时仍然坚决不动摇。

sentence_examples.en: He took a resolute stance on the issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在这个问题上采取了坚决的立场。

sentence_examples.en: They were resolute about finishing the project on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们坚持要按时完成项目。

sentence_examples.en: She faced the challenge with quiet resolution.
sentence_examples.zh: 她以平静的决心面对挑战。

sentence_examples.en: The committee adopted a resolution to improve safety.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会通过了一项关于改善安全的决议。

sentence_examples.en: Her personal resolution to quit smoking lasted only a few weeks.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戒烟的个人决心只坚持了几周。

sentence_examples.en: She resolved to quit smoking.
sentence_examples.zh: 她下定决心戒烟。

sentence_examples.en: The two sides resolved the dispute after negotiations.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过谈判，双方解决了争端。

sentence_examples.en: His resolve to finish the project kept him going.
sentence_examples.zh: 他完成这个项目的决心一直支撑着他。

translations.translation: 度假胜地,常去之处,手段

sentence_examples.en: We stayed at a lakeside resort for our vacation.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在湖畔的度假胜地度过了假期。

sentence_examples.en: The resort offers spa services, gourmet dining, and guided hikes.
sentence_examples.zh: 该度假胜地提供水疗、精致餐饮和有导游带领的徒步活动。

sentence_examples.en: If talks fail, the company may resort to legal action.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果谈判失败，公司可能诉诸法律行动。

translations.translation: )资源,财力;办法,智谋;应变之才

sentence_examples.en: We must manage our resources more efficiently to finish the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须更高效地管理资源，以完成这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: Water is a precious resource in drought-prone regions.
sentence_examples.zh: 水在易干旱地区是一种宝贵的资源。

sentence_examples.en: She is a valuable resource for the team, always helping with quick solutions.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是团队宝贵的资源，总是能提供迅速的解决方案。

sentence_examples.en: I have great respect for her work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对她的工作深感尊重。

sentence_examples.en: Please show respect to your elders.
sentence_examples.zh: 请对长辈表示尊敬。

sentence_examples.en: There are many respects in which this agreement helps both sides.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多方面，这项协议对双方都有帮助。

sentence_examples.en: They returned to their respective homes.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们回到了各自的家中。

sentence_examples.en: Each student submitted their respective project.
sentence_examples.zh: 每个学生提交了各自的项目。

sentence_examples.en: The two teams presented their respective strategies.
sentence_examples.zh: 两支队伍展示了各自的策略。

sentence_examples.en: She didn't respond to my message.
sentence_examples.zh: 她没有回复我的消息。

sentence_examples.en: Please respond to the invitation by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在周五前对邀请做出回应。

sentence_examples.en: He responded with a smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 他微笑着回应。

sentence_examples.en: Her prompt response to the email impressed her supervisor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这封邮件的及时回复让她的上司印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: We published a response to the issue on our website.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在网站上发布了关于该问题的回应。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd's response was very positive.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群的反应非常积极。

sentence_examples.en: Taking care of a pet is a big responsibility.
sentence_examples.zh: 照顾宠物是一项很大的责任。

sentence_examples.en: It's my responsibility to finish the report by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 在星期五之前把报告完成是我的责任。

sentence_examples.en: The company expects employees to take responsibility for their work.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司希望员工对自己的工作负责。

translations.translation: (for,to)应负责的;可靠的;责任重大的

sentence_examples.en: She is responsible for the project budget.
sentence_examples.zh: 她负责这个项目的预算。

sentence_examples.en: He is a very responsible employee.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是一个非常负责任的员工。

sentence_examples.en: If you break it, you are responsible for fixing it.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你把它弄坏了，你就要负责修理它。

sentence_examples.en: I need to rest for a few minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要休息几分钟。

sentence_examples.en: Please finish the rest of the assignment.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把剩下的作业做完。

sentence_examples.en: The book rests on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书放在桌子上。

sentence_examples.en: We ate at a nice restaurant near the station.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在车站附近的一家不错的餐馆吃饭。

sentence_examples.en: The restaurant opens at 11 o'clock.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家餐馆在11点开门。

sentence_examples.en: I prefer a quiet restaurant for a business dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 我更喜欢去安静的餐馆吃商务晚餐。

translations.translation: 得不到休息的;不平静的;坐立不安的

sentence_examples.en: After the long flight, he felt restless and couldn't sit still.
sentence_examples.zh: 长途飞行后，他感到坐立不安，坐不住。

sentence_examples.en: She had a restless night, tossing and turning in bed.
sentence_examples.zh: 她整晚都睡不好，在床上翻来覆去。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd grew restless as the delay dragged on.
sentence_examples.zh: 延期拖得越来越久，观众变得越来越焦躁。

translations.translation: 恢复,使回复;归还,交还;修复,重建

sentence_examples.en: The rain washed away the dust and restored the garden's color.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨水冲走了尘土，花园的颜色重新恢复了。

sentence_examples.en: Please restore the original file from the backup.
sentence_examples.zh: 请从备份中还原原始文件。

sentence_examples.en: A good night's sleep can restore your energy.
sentence_examples.zh: 一晚的好睡眠可以恢复你的精力。

sentence_examples.en: I tried to restrain my laughter during the serious ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 我努力在庄重的仪式中克制笑声。

sentence_examples.en: The security guard restrained the prisoner to prevent his escape.
sentence_examples.zh: 警卫制服了囚犯，以防他逃跑。

sentence_examples.en: She restrained her emotions and spoke calmly.
sentence_examples.zh: 她克制住情绪，平静地说话。

sentence_examples.en: She showed restraint after the disagreement.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在意见分歧后表现出克制。

sentence_examples.en: Economic restraints limited how much the company could invest.
sentence_examples.zh: 经济约束限制了公司投资的规模。

sentence_examples.en: He exercised restraint and avoided a harsh reply.
sentence_examples.zh: 他克制自己，避免了强硬的回复。

sentence_examples.en: The policy restricts access to certain websites.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策限制对某些网站的访问。

sentence_examples.en: We restrict the number of guests to ten.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将来宾人数限制在十人以内。

sentence_examples.en: Access to the files is restricted to authorized staff.
sentence_examples.zh: 只有经授权的员工才能访问这些文件。

translations.translation: 结果,致使,导致,由…而造成

sentence_examples.en: The final result of the survey will be published next week.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项调查的最终结果将于下周公布。

sentence_examples.en: Her exam result surprised her family.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的考试成绩让她的家人吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: Poor planning may result in delays.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划不周可能导致延迟。

translations.translation: 作为结果而发生的;合成的

sentence_examples.en: The resultant effect of the policy changes was increased employment.
sentence_examples.zh: 政策变化的最终效果是就业增加。

sentence_examples.en: The resultant force on the object is the vector sum of all forces acting on it.
sentence_examples.zh: 作用在物体上的合力是所有作用力的向量和。

sentence_examples.en: The engineers measured the resultant signal from the sensor array.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师测量了传感器阵列的最终信号。

translations.translation: 再继续,重新开始;再用;恢复

sentence_examples.en: I updated my resume before applying for the job.
sentence_examples.zh: 在申请这份工作前，我更新了我的个人简历。

sentence_examples.en: We will resume the meeting at 3 p.m.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将在下午3点重新开始会议。

sentence_examples.en: Production will resume after the shutdown.
sentence_examples.zh: 停工后，生产将恢复。

sentence_examples.en: The store sells products at retail.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家商店以零售价格出售产品。

sentence_examples.en: Retail prices have risen due to inflation.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于通货膨胀，零售价格上涨。

sentence_examples.en: In retail, customer service is crucial for repeat business.
sentence_examples.zh: 在零售行业，客户服务对回头客至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: The company will retain all customer data for five years.
