sentence_examples.zh: 我们必须确保电网的稳定性。

sentence_examples.en: Maintaining stability is crucial for sustainable growth.
sentence_examples.zh: 保持稳定性对可持续增长至关重要。

sentence_examples.en: The patient's condition is stable.
sentence_examples.zh: 病人的病情稳定。

sentence_examples.en: The horse is in the stable.
sentence_examples.zh: 马在马厩里。

sentence_examples.en: The weather has been stable for weeks.
sentence_examples.zh: 天气已经稳定了好几周。

sentence_examples.en: There is a stack of books on the desk.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有一堆书。

sentence_examples.en: Please stack the plates after dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 晚饭后请把盘子叠起来。

sentence_examples.en: She carried a stack of papers to the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把一摞纸带到了会议。

sentence_examples.en: The stadium will host a football match this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个周末体育场将举办一场足球比赛。

sentence_examples.en: Fans lined up outside the stadium hours before kickoff.
sentence_examples.zh: 球迷们在开球前几个小时排在体育场外。

sentence_examples.en: The stadium can seat over sixty thousand spectators.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座体育场可容纳超过六万名观众。

sentence_examples.en: The staff at the front desk were very helpful.
sentence_examples.zh: 前台的全体员工非常热心。

sentence_examples.en: The manager decided to staff the new department with experienced engineers.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理决定为新部门配备有经验的工程师。

sentence_examples.en: We need to hire more staff to handle the workload.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要雇佣更多员工来处理工作量。

sentence_examples.en: The actor walked on stage to perform his monologue.
sentence_examples.zh: 演员走上舞台表演他的独白。

sentence_examples.en: This is the final stage of the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是项目的最后阶段。

sentence_examples.en: The company announced the next stage of its expansion.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司宣布了扩张的下一个阶段。

sentence_examples.en: She staggered to her feet after the fall.
sentence_examples.zh: 她跌跌撞撞地站起身来。

sentence_examples.en: The drunk man staggered down the street.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个醉汉蹒跚地走在街上。

sentence_examples.en: There was a noticeable stagger in his gait.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的步态明显有些摇晃。

sentence_examples.en: A coffee stain ruined her white shirt.
sentence_examples.zh: 一块咖啡渍把她的白衬衫弄坏了。

sentence_examples.en: The scandal left a stain on his reputation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场丑闻给他的名声留下了污点。

sentence_examples.en: Sunlight can stain white fabrics over time.
sentence_examples.zh: 日光会随着时间在白色织物上留下污渍。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful on the stair.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心走这段楼梯。

sentence_examples.en: The stair is made of wood.
sentence_examples.zh: 这段楼梯是木制的。

sentence_examples.en: She paused on the stair to catch her breath.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在楼梯上停下来喘口气。

sentence_examples.en: We climbed the staircase to the second floor.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们爬上楼梯到二楼。

sentence_examples.en: The staircase creaked as we walked up.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们走上楼梯时，楼梯发出吱嘎声。

sentence_examples.en: A grand staircase leads from the lobby to the gallery.
sentence_examples.zh: 大堂有一座宏伟的楼梯通往画廊。

sentence_examples.en: There is a lot at stake in this deal.
sentence_examples.zh: 这笔交易的利害关系很大。

sentence_examples.en: A wooden stake was driven into the ground to mark the boundary.
sentence_examples.zh: 一根木桩被打进地里，用来标记边界。

sentence_examples.en: She has a large financial stake in the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在这家公司有很大的经济利益。

translations.translation: 变质的,不新鲜的;陈旧的,陈腐的

sentence_examples.en: The bread is stale after sitting out all day.
sentence_examples.zh: 面包放了一整天后就不新鲜了。

sentence_examples.en: The crackers are stale and dry.
sentence_examples.zh: 饼干发硬，不再新鲜。

sentence_examples.en: Their jokes have become stale and predictable.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们的笑话已经变得陈旧、让人一眼就能猜到。

sentence_examples.en: The stalk of the sunflower swayed in the breeze.
sentence_examples.zh: 向日葵的茎在微风中摇摆。

sentence_examples.en: The cat stalks its prey through the grass.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只猫在草丛中悄悄跟踪它的猎物。

sentence_examples.en: He stalked into the room, tall and confident.
sentence_examples.zh: 他昂首阔步走进房间，显得高大自信。

sentence_examples.en: I bought fresh fruit at a street stall.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在街头摊位买了新鲜水果。

sentence_examples.en: The horse stood in its stall, waiting for feeding time.
sentence_examples.zh: 那匹马在厩里等着喂食时间。

sentence_examples.en: The committee stalled the decision by asking for more data.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会通过要求更多数据来拖延决定。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a stamp at the post office.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在邮局买了一张邮票。

sentence_examples.en: Please stamp the document with the official seal.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在文件上盖上公章。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd stamped their feet in excitement.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群兴奋地跺着脚。

sentence_examples.en: She can stand for hours without getting tired.
sentence_examples.zh: 她可以站着好几个小时也不累。

sentence_examples.en: The statue stands in the town square.
sentence_examples.zh: 那座雕像矗立在城镇广场。

sentence_examples.en: They set up a lemonade stand in the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在公园里设立了一个柠檬水摊位。

sentence_examples.en: The safety standard for this device is 99.9% uptime.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款设备的安全标准是99.9%的可用性。

sentence_examples.en: This is standard procedure.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是标准做法。

sentence_examples.en: Prices have returned to standard levels.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格已恢复到标准水平。

sentence_examples.en: From a financial standpoint, the project is too costly.
sentence_examples.zh: 从财务角度来看，这个项目成本太高。

sentence_examples.en: From a legal standpoint, the contract is enforceable.
sentence_examples.zh: 在法律上，这份合同具有执行力。

sentence_examples.en: Her standpoint on the issue differs from mine.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在这个问题上的立场与我不同。

translations.translation: 主要产品；名产；纤维；主要成分，主食

sentence_examples.en: Rice is a staple in many countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 米饭在许多国家是主食。

sentence_examples.en: Cotton is a staple fiber used in textiles.
sentence_examples.zh: 棉花是一种常见的纤维，用于纺织品。

sentence_examples.en: Bread is a staple in many households.
sentence_examples.zh: 面包在许多家庭中是主食。

sentence_examples.en: The sky is full of stars tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 今晚的天空布满星星。

sentence_examples.en: She is a famous movie star.
sentence_examples.zh: 她是一位知名的电影明星。

sentence_examples.en: The film stars Tom Hanks.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影由汤姆·汉克斯主演。

sentence_examples.en: He couldn't stop staring at the painting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他忍不住盯着那幅画看。

sentence_examples.en: Don't stare at people; that can make them uncomfortable.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要盯着别人看，那会让他们不舒服。

sentence_examples.en: She stared at the menu, trying to decide what to order.
sentence_examples.zh: 她盯着菜单看，试着决定点什么。

translations.translation: 开始;动身;吃惊;开办,开动

sentence_examples.en: Let's start the meeting now.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们现在开始会议。

sentence_examples.en: She started the car and drove away.
sentence_examples.zh: 她启动车子，开走了。

sentence_examples.en: The start of the new project was rough.
sentence_examples.zh: 新项目的开端很艰难。

sentence_examples.en: The loud noise startled her.
sentence_examples.zh: 那声巨响把她吓了一跳。

sentence_examples.en: The sudden movement startled him.
sentence_examples.zh: 突然的动作把他吓了一跳。

sentence_examples.en: Please don't startle the sleeping baby.
sentence_examples.zh: 请不要把正在睡着的宝宝吓醒。

sentence_examples.en: Many children in the disaster area will starve if relief teams don't arrive soon.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果救援队不能尽快到达，灾区的许多儿童将挨饿。

sentence_examples.en: People in famine conditions can starve within a week.
sentence_examples.zh: 在饥荒条件下，人们可能在一周内饿死。

sentence_examples.en: If you skip meals regularly, you may starve and feel weak.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你经常不吃饭，可能会挨饿并感到虚弱。

sentence_examples.en: The patient is in a critical state after the accident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故后，病人处于危急状态。

sentence_examples.en: She moved to another state to pursue a new job.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为了找新工作搬到了另一个州。

sentence_examples.en: Please state your full name for the record.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在记录中说明你的全名。

sentence_examples.en: The statement she gave clarified the project's goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给出的声明澄清了项目的目标。

sentence_examples.en: The CEO made a public statement about the merger.
sentence_examples.zh: 首席执行官就合并发表了公开声明。

sentence_examples.en: That statement was based on several trusted sources.
sentence_examples.zh: 那份陈述基于几个可信来源。

sentence_examples.en: The statesman spoke about unity and reform.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位政治家谈及团结与改革。

sentence_examples.en: Many people respected this statesman.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人尊敬这位政治家。

sentence_examples.en: He is remembered as a statesman who guided the country through crisis.
sentence_examples.zh: 他被记为在危机中带领国家前进的政治家。

sentence_examples.en: The image on the monitor stayed static after the update.
sentence_examples.zh: 更新后，显示器上的图像保持静态。

sentence_examples.en: Static friction prevents objects from starting to move.
sentence_examples.zh: 静摩擦力阻止物体开始移动。

sentence_examples.en: Static electricity can build up on dry clothing.
sentence_examples.zh: 干燥的衣物上容易积聚静电。

sentence_examples.en: We arrived at the station just before the train departed.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在火车出发前到达车站。

sentence_examples.en: The army will station troops at the base to maintain security.
sentence_examples.zh: 军队将把部队驻扎在基地以维持安全。

sentence_examples.en: She holds a high station in society.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在社会上地位很高。

sentence_examples.en: The car remained stationary at the red light.
sentence_examples.zh: 这辆车在红灯时保持静止。

sentence_examples.en: The statue stood stationary while people walked around it.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕像在游客经过时保持静止。

sentence_examples.en: Please keep the equipment stationary during transport.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在运输过程中保持设备静止。

sentence_examples.en: I bought some stationery for the new school year.
sentence_examples.zh: 我为新学年买了一些文具。

sentence_examples.en: The stationery section is to the right of the entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 入口处的文具区在右边。

sentence_examples.en: We stocked up on stationery for the office.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们为办公室备足了文具。

sentence_examples.en: The statistical results confirm the hypothesis.
sentence_examples.zh: 统计结果证实了假设。

sentence_examples.en: This report uses statistical methods to analyze the data.
sentence_examples.zh: 本报告使用统计方法来分析数据。

sentence_examples.en: Statistical charts show trends in the dataset.
sentence_examples.zh: 统计图表显示数据集中的趋势。

sentence_examples.en: The statue in the city center attracts tourists.
sentence_examples.zh: 市中心的雕像吸引了游客。

sentence_examples.en: They unveiled a new statue in the city square.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在市广场揭幕了一座新雕像。

sentence_examples.en: A statue of the founder stands in the lobby.
sentence_examples.zh: 大堂里竖着创始人的雕像。

sentence_examples.en: Her status at work changed after the promotion.
sentence_examples.zh: 晋升后，她在工作中的地位发生了变化。

sentence_examples.en: The app shows your online status as green.
sentence_examples.zh: 应用显示你的在线状态为绿色。

sentence_examples.en: The current status of the project is behind schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目当前的进展落后于计划。

translations.translation: 成文法，法令，法规；章程，规则，条例

sentence_examples.en: The statute requires employers to provide safe working conditions.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项成文法规定雇主必须提供安全的工作条件。

sentence_examples.en: Violating the statute could result in fines.
sentence_examples.zh: 违反该成文法可能会被罚款。

sentence_examples.en: Many statutes require labeling for food products.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多成文法要求食品产品贴标签。

sentence_examples.en: We decided to stay in the hotel for one more night.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们决定在酒店再住一个晚上。

sentence_examples.en: The court issued a stay of execution.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院发布了暂停处决的命令。

sentence_examples.en: Please stay where you are until I call you.
sentence_examples.zh: 请你待在原地，等我叫你。

sentence_examples.en: She kept a steady pace as she ran the marathon.
sentence_examples.zh: 她跑马拉松时保持着稳定的步伐。

sentence_examples.en: The engineer reinforced the beam to steady the structure.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师通过加固横梁来稳定结构。

sentence_examples.en: His voice remained steady during the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的声音在演讲中一直很稳定。

sentence_examples.en: I'll have a steak, medium rare, please.
sentence_examples.zh: 请给我一份中等偏生的牛排。

sentence_examples.en: The steak was juicy and perfectly seasoned.
sentence_examples.zh: 这份牛排多汁，调味恰到好处。

sentence_examples.en: We grilled a steak for the barbecue.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在烧烤时烤了一块牛排。

sentence_examples.en: Someone tried to steal my bike last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚有人试图偷我的自行车。

sentence_examples.en: She stole a quick glance at the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 她偷偷地瞥了一眼门口。

sentence_examples.en: The company was accused of stealing trade secrets.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司被指控窃取商业秘密。

sentence_examples.en: The pot is boiling and steam is rising from the lid.
sentence_examples.zh: 锅在沸腾，锅盖上方冒出水蒸气。

sentence_examples.en: Steam is used to cook vegetables in a healthy way.
sentence_examples.zh: 蒸汽被用来健康地烹煮蔬菜。

sentence_examples.en: Please steam the dumplings for about 10 minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把饺子蒸大约10分钟。

sentence_examples.en: The steamer left the harbor at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘蒸汽轮船在黎明离开港口。

sentence_examples.en: Passengers waved from the deck as the steamer set sail.
sentence_examples.zh: 乘客们在甲板上挥手，蒸汽轮船起航。

sentence_examples.en: An old steamer still plies the river between the two cities.
sentence_examples.zh: 一艘老式蒸汽轮船仍在两座城市之间的河上穿行。

sentence_examples.en: Steel is a strong metal used in construction.
sentence_examples.zh: 钢是一种用于建筑的坚固金属。

sentence_examples.en: This knife is made of steel.
sentence_examples.zh: 这把刀是用钢制成的。

sentence_examples.en: The bridge uses steel beams.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座桥使用钢梁。

translations.translation: 陡峭，险峻的；急剧升降的

sentence_examples.en: The trail became steep as we approached the summit.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们靠近山顶时，小路变得越来越陡。

sentence_examples.en: This year's rent increase was steep.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年的房租涨幅很大。

sentence_examples.en: We steeped the tea for five minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把茶浸泡了五分钟。

sentence_examples.en: He steered the car through the sharp turn.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把车稳稳地开过那个急转弯。

sentence_examples.en: The captain steered the ship toward the harbor.
sentence_examples.zh: 船长把船驶向港口。

sentence_examples.en: We steer the discussion toward a practical solution.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把讨论引导到一个实际的解决方案上。

sentence_examples.en: The stem of the flower is green and sturdy.
sentence_examples.zh: 花的茎又绿又结实。

sentence_examples.en: The government has taken measures to stem the spread of the disease.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府已采取措施遏制疾病的蔓延。

sentence_examples.en: Her success stems from careful planning.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的成功源于周密的计划。

sentence_examples.en: Take the next step carefully.
sentence_examples.zh: 小心地迈出下一步。

sentence_examples.en: The first step in learning a language is to practice every day.
sentence_examples.zh: 学习语言的第一步是每天练习。

sentence_examples.en: She stepped onto the stage to give her speech.
sentence_examples.zh: 她走上舞台发表演讲。

translations.translation: 立体声音响；立体声装置

sentence_examples.en: We bought a new stereo to replace the old one.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们买了一个新的立体声音响来替代旧的。

sentence_examples.en: Turn up the stereo; the music sounds better.
sentence_examples.zh: 把立体声音响的音量调大，音乐听起来更好。

sentence_examples.en: Her apartment has a stereo in the living room.
sentence_examples.zh: 她公寓客厅里有一台立体声音响。

sentence_examples.en: The stereotype that all programmers are introverts isn't accurate.
sentence_examples.zh: 把所有程序员都视为内向的人的刻板印象并不准确。

sentence_examples.en: The article stereotypes younger workers as entitled.
sentence_examples.zh: 这篇文章把年轻的工人刻板地描绘为自以为是的一群人。

sentence_examples.en: Stereotypes can limit people's opportunities.
sentence_examples.zh: 刻板印象会限制人们的机会。

sentence_examples.en: The principal gave a stern warning to the students.
sentence_examples.zh: 校长对学生发出了严厉的警告。

sentence_examples.en: Her stern expression told him to stop talking.
sentence_examples.zh: 她那严厉的表情告诉他要停止说话。

sentence_examples.en: The ship's stern was painted white.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘船的船尾被涂成白色。

translations.translation: 乘务员，服务员；看管人；膳食管理员

sentence_examples.en: The steward on the ship served meals and helped passengers.
sentence_examples.zh: 船上的膳食管理员为乘客提供餐食并协助他们。

sentence_examples.en: At the hotel, the steward helped guests with their bags.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店里的服务员帮助客人提行李。

sentence_examples.en: As the estate steward, he supervised repairs and managed finances.
sentence_examples.zh: 作为庄园的管家，他负责监督修缮并管理财务。

sentence_examples.en: The child waved a stick like a magic wand.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子挥舞着一根树枝，像在用魔杖一样。

sentence_examples.en: She used glue to stick the papers together.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用胶水把纸张粘在一起。

sentence_examples.en: If you stick to the plan, we'll finish on time.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你坚持按计划走，我们就能准时完成。

translations.translation: 粘的，粘性的；棘手的；(道路)泥泞的

sentence_examples.en: The label on the jar is sticky.
sentence_examples.zh: 罐子上的标签很粘。

sentence_examples.en: We're in a sticky situation after missing the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 错过截止日期后，我们陷入了一个棘手的局面。

sentence_examples.en: The road was sticky and muddy after the rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 雨后路面既粘又泥泞。

translations.translation: 硬的,僵直的;拘谨的;呆板的;艰难的

sentence_examples.zh: 睡醒后我的脖子很僵硬。

sentence_examples.en: The chair is stiff and uncomfortable to sit on.
sentence_examples.zh: 这把椅子很硬，坐着不舒服。

sentence_examples.en: He gave a stiff, formal greeting to the guests.
sentence_examples.zh: 他对来宾致以僵硬而正式的问候。

sentence_examples.en: The lake is still at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 拂晓时，湖面很平静。

sentence_examples.en: He still hasn't arrived.
sentence_examples.zh: 他到现在还没到。

sentence_examples.en: Please stay still while I take your photo.
sentence_examples.zh: 拍照时请保持不动。

sentence_examples.en: Caffeine can stimulate the nervous system.
sentence_examples.zh: 咖啡因可以刺激神经系统。

sentence_examples.en: The government hopes the new policy will stimulate economic growth.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府希望新政策能够刺激经济增长。

sentence_examples.en: A motivational talk can stimulate creativity in a team.
sentence_examples.zh: 一次激励性的演讲可以激发团队的创造力。

sentence_examples.en: If you bother the wasp, it may sting you.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果打扰黄蜂，它可能会蜇你。

sentence_examples.en: I got stung by a bee on my finger.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的手指被蜜蜂蜇了一下。

sentence_examples.en: Her words had a sting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的话里带着刺痛。

translations.translation: 搅拌,搅动;动,摇动;激动;轰动;煽动,鼓动

sentence_examples.en: She used a spoon to stir the soup until it was smooth.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用勺子搅拌汤，直到汤变得顺滑。

sentence_examples.en: This announcement stirred the crowd into cheers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个宣布让人群欢呼起来。

sentence_examples.en: The rumor stirred up trouble in the neighborhood.
sentence_examples.zh: 传闻在社区里掀起了麻烦。

translations.translation: 一针；(因跑步引起的)肋部剧痛

sentence_examples.en: The cut needs a stitch.
sentence_examples.zh: 这道伤口需要缝上一针。

sentence_examples.en: I got a stitch in my side during the run.

sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一只黑色长袜来搭配正式的裙子。

sentence_examples.zh: 这座雕像是用石头雕刻的。

sentence_examples.zh: 她坐在柜台旁的一张木凳子上。

sentence_examples.zh: 仓库为季节性物品提供额外的存储空间。

sentence_examples.en: I bought groceries at the local store.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在当地的商店买了杂货。

sentence_examples.en: Please store these boxes in the attic.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把这些箱子存放在阁楼里。

sentence_examples.en: The store has a sale today.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家商店今天在促销。

sentence_examples.en: The building has five storeys.

sentence_examples.en: The top storey contains a spacious living room.
sentence_examples.zh: 顶层有一个宽敞的客厅。

translations.translation: 暴风雨,暴风雪;激动,爆发

sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚，一场暴风雨导致停电。

sentence_examples.zh: 终场哨响后，球迷冲进球场。

sentence_examples.en: Police stormed the building to arrest the suspects.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方冲进大楼逮捕嫌疑人。

sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢在睡前读一个恐怖故事。

sentence_examples.zh: 这栋建筑共有六层。

sentence_examples.en: He told a story about his childhood to the class.
sentence_examples.zh: 他向全班讲了一个关于他童年的故事。

sentence_examples.zh: 在做饭前，我清理了炉子。

sentence_examples.en: The stove in the kitchen is gas-powered.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨房里的炉子是煤气炉。

sentence_examples.en: We turned on the stove to boil some water.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们打开炉子把水烧开。

sentence_examples.en: The road ahead is straight for miles.
sentence_examples.zh: 前方的路笔直延伸了好几英里。

sentence_examples.en: Please walk straight to the office; it's on the right after the lobby.
sentence_examples.zh: 请直走到办公室，办公室在右边。

sentence_examples.en: He's a straight shooter who tells the truth.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是个说话直截了当、讲真话的人。

sentence_examples.en: The instructions are straightforward and easy to follow.
sentence_examples.zh: 说明很简单，容易遵循。

sentence_examples.en: She gave a straightforward answer to the question.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个问题给出了直截了当的回答。

sentence_examples.zh: 他直截了当地解释了计划。

translations.translation: 拉紧;紧张;扭伤;竭尽全力

sentence_examples.zh: 绳子在承受重量时绷紧。

sentence_examples.zh: 他抬箱子后背部扭伤了。

sentence_examples.en: The project is under strain due to budget cuts.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于预算削减，项目承受着压力。

translations.translation: 奇怪的,奇异的;陌生的,生疏的;外地的

sentence_examples.en: It's strange that he didn't call back.
sentence_examples.zh: 他没有回电话，这真奇怪。

sentence_examples.en: A strange smell filled the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 房间里弥漫着一种奇怪的气味。

sentence_examples.en: The town felt strange to me when I first arrived.
sentence_examples.zh: 我刚到时，这座城镇对我来说很陌生。

translations.translation: 陌生人,生客;外地人,外国人

sentence_examples.en: A stranger asked me for directions.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个陌生人向我问路。

sentence_examples.zh: 一个陌生人主动提出载我一程。

sentence_examples.en: I felt like a stranger in the new city.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在新城市里感到自己像个陌生人。

translations.translation: 用带扣住，束牢；用绷带包扎

sentence_examples.zh: 她把背包的带子系紧，防止滑落。

sentence_examples.zh: 护士把受伤的手臂用带子固定，以使其保持不动。

sentence_examples.en: He adjusted the strap on his watch to fit his wrist.
sentence_examples.zh: 他调整手表的表带以贴合手腕。

sentence_examples.zh: 公司需要一个新的策略来吸引年轻客户。

sentence_examples.en: We should analyze our strategy before launching the campaign.
sentence_examples.zh: 在推出活动之前，我们应该分析我们的策略。

sentence_examples.en: A good strategy helps you reach your goals.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个好的策略能帮助你实现目标。

sentence_examples.en: The farmer spread straw in the barn for the animals.
sentence_examples.zh: 农民在谷仓里铺稻草给动物用。

sentence_examples.en: I drank the lemonade through a straw.
sentence_examples.zh: 我用吸管喝柠檬水。

sentence_examples.en: She wore a straw hat to shield her face from the sun.
sentence_examples.zh: 她戴着草帽遮挡阳光。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a box of strawberries at the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在市场买了一盒草莓。

sentence_examples.en: She added sliced strawberries to her yogurt.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把切好的草莓放进酸奶里。

sentence_examples.en: Strawberry season lasts from late spring to early summer.
sentence_examples.zh: 草莓的旺季从春末一直到初夏。

sentence_examples.en: A small stream runs through the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园里有一条小溪流过。

sentence_examples.zh: 水从水龙头涌出。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要简化审批流程，以减少延误。

sentence_examples.zh: 流线型设计可以降低阻力并节省能源。

sentence_examples.en: The street was crowded with people.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条街上挤满了人。

sentence_examples.en: We crossed the street to get to the market.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们穿过马路去市场。

translations.translation: 力量；实力；长处，优点；人力；兵力

sentence_examples.en: Her strength helps her lift the heavy box.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的力量帮助她抬起那个重箱子。

sentence_examples.en: The team's strength was evident in how they finished the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队在比赛结束时展现出的实力很明显。

sentence_examples.zh: 他的一个长处是在压力下保持冷静的能力。

sentence_examples.zh: 规律的运动可以增强你的心肺功能。

sentence_examples.zh: 政府计划加强与邻国的贸易关系。

sentence_examples.en: Reading daily helps strengthen memory and concentration.
sentence_examples.zh: 每天阅读有助于提高记忆力和专注力。

translations.translation: 费力的，艰辛的；奋发的，努力的

sentence_examples.zh: 跑马拉松对耐力是一项费力的考验。

sentence_examples.zh: 登山的徒步很费力，但很值得。

sentence_examples.zh: 她开始了一套费力的锻炼计划来提高体能。

sentence_examples.zh: 考试给她带来很大压力。

sentence_examples.zh: 这座建筑的结构在地震中经受住了考验。

sentence_examples.zh: 这篇文章的结构有助于读者理解论点。

sentence_examples.zh: 这名学生在实验室里开展了一个小型研究项目。

sentence_examples.zh: 她在公园附近的一间明亮画室里画画。

sentence_examples.zh: 乐队在市区的一间小型录音室里录制专辑。

sentence_examples.zh: 在雨中不打灯开车真是太蠢了。

sentence_examples.zh: 这张桌子结实，足以承受重型设备的重量。

sentence_examples.zh: 她展现出完成这个项目的坚定决心。

sentence_examples.zh: 我们买了一个结实的背包，适合徒步。

translations.translation: 风格,文体;式样,时式,类型

sentence_examples.en: Her style is clean and simple, with neutral colors.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的风格干净简约，偏好中性色。

sentence_examples.en: This writer's style is easy to read.
sentence_examples.zh: 这位作者的写作风格易读。

sentence_examples.en: The designer updated the house style with new furniture.
sentence_examples.zh: 设计师用新家具改造了房子的风格。

sentence_examples.en: What is the subject of today's discussion?
sentence_examples.zh: 今天讨论的主题是什么？

sentence_examples.en: The contract is subject to approval by the board.
sentence_examples.zh: 该合同须经董事会批准。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor subjected the patient to several tests.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生对患者进行了几项检查。

sentence_examples.en: People's opinions are often subjective rather than objective.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们的意见往往是主观的，而非客观的。

sentence_examples.en: Her judgment of the painting is subjective because she loves the artist.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这幅画的评价带有主观性，因为她喜爱这位艺术家。

sentence_examples.en: We should avoid subjective interpretations when analyzing the data.
sentence_examples.zh: 在分析数据时，我们应避免主观解读。

sentence_examples.en: The submarine surfaced after five hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 潜艇在五小时后浮出水面。

sentence_examples.en: Submarine cables carry data across oceans.
sentence_examples.zh: 海底光缆在各大洋之间传输数据。

sentence_examples.en: A submarine can stay underwater for days.
sentence_examples.zh: 潜艇可以在水下待好几天。

sentence_examples.en: A submarine can submerge to avoid detection.
sentence_examples.zh: 潜艇可以潜入水下以避免被发现。

sentence_examples.en: She submerges her hand in the cold water to feel the temperature.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把手浸在冰冷的水中以感受温度。

sentence_examples.en: The village was submerged by the flood.
sentence_examples.zh: 村庄被洪水淹没。

sentence_examples.en: I will submit my application online tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今晚会在线提交我的申请。

sentence_examples.en: The soldiers refused to submit to the enemy.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵们拒绝向敌人投降。

sentence_examples.en: Please submit this form by Friday.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在周五前提交此表格。

sentence_examples.en: In the company, the marketing team is subordinate to the sales department.
sentence_examples.zh: 在公司里，市场部从属于销售部。

sentence_examples.en: The manager emphasized that subordinate staff must follow the new policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理强调下属员工必须遵守新政策。

sentence_examples.en: The contract states that subordinate units report to the central authority.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同规定下级单位向中央机关汇报。

sentence_examples.en: I subscribe to a weekly newsletter to receive updates.
sentence_examples.zh: 我订阅了一个每周通讯，以便接收更新。

sentence_examples.en: She subscribes to the belief that honesty is the best policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她认同“诚实是最好的政策”这一信念。

sentence_examples.en: The company subscribes to a sponsorship program and donates monthly.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司参与一个赞助计划并按月捐款。

sentence_examples.en: The accident caused injuries, and the subsequent treatment took months.
sentence_examples.zh: 事故造成伤势，随后的治疗花了数月。

sentence_examples.en: In subsequent years, the company expanded internationally.
sentence_examples.zh: 在随后的几年里，公司扩大了国际业务。

sentence_examples.en: He was promoted, and his subsequent responsibilities increased.
sentence_examples.zh: 他升职后，随后的职责增加了。

sentence_examples.en: The farmers received a government subsidy to help with crop costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府向农民提供补助金以帮助他们降低作物成本。

sentence_examples.en: The university offers a subsidy for students who commute long distances.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学为长途通勤的学生提供津贴。

sentence_examples.en: Without the government subsidy, many small businesses would struggle to survive.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果没有政府补贴，许多小企业将难以生存。

translations.translation: 物质；实质，本质；主旨；财产，资产

sentence_examples.en: The substance in the bottle is a dangerous chemical.
sentence_examples.zh: 瓶子里的物质是一种危险的化学品。

sentence_examples.en: There is no substance to his claim.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的主张没有实质依据。

sentence_examples.en: The substance of the business is its assets and cash reserves.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司的实质在于其资产和现金储备。

translations.translation: 实质的;相当的;显著的;坚固的;富裕的

sentence_examples.en: This plan requires substantial time and resources.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个计划需要大量的时间和资源。

sentence_examples.en: There is substantial evidence to support the claim.
sentence_examples.zh: 有充分的证据支持这一说法。

sentence_examples.en: He made substantial progress in learning English.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的英语学习取得了显著的进步。

sentence_examples.en: A substitute teacher filled in for the regular teacher for the day.
sentence_examples.zh: 代课老师当天顶替了常任教师。

sentence_examples.en: You can substitute olive oil for butter in this recipe.
sentence_examples.zh: 在这道菜的做法中，可以用橄榄油代替黄油。

sentence_examples.en: The substitute for sugar in the recipe is honey.
sentence_examples.zh: 这道食谱中，糖的代用品是蜂蜜。

translations.translation: 精巧的,巧妙的;细微的,微妙的

sentence_examples.en: The artist used subtle shading to create depth.
sentence_examples.zh: 艺术家用细腻的阴影来创造层次感。

sentence_examples.en: Her apology was subtle, not admitting fault but expressing regret.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的道歉很含蓄，并未直接承认错误，但表达了歉意。

sentence_examples.en: There's a subtle difference between the two plans.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两个计划之间有细微的差别。

sentence_examples.en: Subtract 5 from 12 to get 7.
sentence_examples.zh: 把12减去5，得到7。

sentence_examples.en: You subtract expenses from the budget to see how much is left.
sentence_examples.zh: 你把预算中的支出减去，以了解还剩多少。

sentence_examples.en: Subtract the discount from the total to get the final price.
sentence_examples.zh: 从总价中减去折扣，以得到最终价格。

sentence_examples.en: I moved to the suburb to enjoy quieter streets.
sentence_examples.zh: 我搬到了郊区，想要享受更安静的街道。

sentence_examples.en: The suburb has many parks and good schools.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个郊区有很多公园和好学校。

sentence_examples.en: Commuting from the suburb to the city center takes about 40 minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 从郊区到市中心通勤大约需要40分钟。

sentence_examples.en: I take the subway to work most mornings.
sentence_examples.zh: 我大多数早晨都坐地铁去上班。

sentence_examples.en: The subway stops are clearly marked on the map.
sentence_examples.zh: 地图上清晰标注了地铁站的位置。

sentence_examples.en: There is a pedestrian subway under the park that connects the two streets.
sentence_examples.zh: 公园下面有一个地下行人隧道，连接两条街道。

sentence_examples.en: She succeeded in passing the driving test on her first try.
sentence_examples.zh: 她第一次尝试就通过了驾驶考试。

sentence_examples.en: The new manager will succeed the previous one next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 新任经理将于下月接替前任。

sentence_examples.en: If you work hard, you will succeed.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你努力，你就会成功。

translations.translation: 成就，成功；成功的事物，有成就的人

sentence_examples.en: Her hard work led to great success in her career.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的努力让她的职业生涯取得了巨大的成功。

sentence_examples.en: The new strategy quickly yielded success.
sentence_examples.zh: 新策略很快取得了成功。

sentence_examples.en: This project was a huge success.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目取得了巨大的成功。

sentence_examples.en: Her presentation was successful, and she impressed the investors.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的演讲很成功，给投资者留下了深刻印象。

sentence_examples.en: The project turned out to be a successful one.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目最终取得了成功。

sentence_examples.en: He is a successful businessman.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是一位成功的商人。

sentence_examples.en: The team won three games in succession.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队连续赢了三场比赛。

sentence_examples.en: There has been a succession of small changes to the policy.
sentence_examples.zh: 该政策经历了一连串的小变动。

sentence_examples.en: The prince's succession to the throne was smooth.
sentence_examples.zh: 王位继承过程很顺利。

sentence_examples.en: There were three successive days of rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 连续下了三天的雨。

sentence_examples.en: The team won successive games to reach the finals.
sentence_examples.zh: 球队接连赢了几场比赛，进入决赛。

sentence_examples.en: There were successive failures in the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目接连出现了失败。

translations.translation: 接替的人或事物，继任者

sentence_examples.en: The king chose his successor to take the throne.
sentence_examples.zh: 国王选定了自己的继任者来登基。

sentence_examples.en: The founder's successor now runs the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 创始人的继任者现在负责管理公司。

sentence_examples.en: A new successor was named to lead the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 新任继任者被任命来领导该项目。

sentence_examples.en: It's such a beautiful day.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天天气真好。

sentence_examples.en: She can't afford such a luxury.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买不起那样的奢侈品。

sentence_examples.en: Such is life.
sentence_examples.zh: 这就是生活。

sentence_examples.en: The baby can suck on the bottle.
sentence_examples.zh: 婴儿可以吮吸奶瓶。

sentence_examples.en: Don't suck your thumb.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要吮拇指。

sentence_examples.en: The vacuum cleaner sucks up dust.
sentence_examples.zh: 吸尘器把灰尘吸起来。

sentence_examples.en: A sudden change of plans forced us to stay home.
sentence_examples.zh: 计划的突然改变迫使我们待在家里。

sentence_examples.en: There was a sudden rainstorm during the hike.
sentence_examples.zh: 徒步时突然下起了一场暴雨。

sentence_examples.en: He felt a sudden chill when the door opened.
sentence_examples.zh: 门一开，他突然感到一阵冷意。

sentence_examples.en: If the company misleads customers, they may sue for damages.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果公司误导客户，他们可能会就损害赔偿提起诉讼。

sentence_examples.en: The tenant plans to sue the landlord over the faulty apartment.
sentence_examples.zh: 租户计划就公寓的故障问题对房东提起诉讼。

sentence_examples.en: She decided not to sue and settled the dispute out of court.
sentence_examples.zh: 她决定不提起诉讼，并在法院外达成和解。

translations.translation: (from)受痛苦,患病;受损失;遭受;忍受

sentence_examples.en: Many people suffer from chronic pain.
sentence_examples.zh: 许多人饱受慢性疼痛。

sentence_examples.en: The town suffered heavy damage in the flood.
sentence_examples.zh: 洪水让该镇遭受了严重破坏。

sentence_examples.en: The company suffered losses after the market downturn.
sentence_examples.zh: 市场低迷后，该公司遭受了损失。

sentence_examples.en: A single page of notes will suffice for the exam.
sentence_examples.zh: 一页笔记就足以应付考试。

sentence_examples.en: The meal will suffice for everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 这顿饭应该足够大家吃。

sentence_examples.en: The soup should suffice him for now.
sentence_examples.zh: 这汤现在应该能让他吃饱。

sentence_examples.en: There is sufficient evidence to convict him.
sentence_examples.zh: 有足够的证据可以定他的罪。

sentence_examples.en: The supply is sufficient for everyone's needs.
sentence_examples.zh: 供应足以满足每个人的需要。

sentence_examples.en: We have a sufficient amount of money to cover the costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们有足够的钱来支付这些费用。

sentence_examples.en: I add sugar to my coffee.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在咖啡里加糖。

sentence_examples.en: If you like it sweet, sugar the tea to taste.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你喜欢甜味，可以在茶里按口味加糖。

sentence_examples.en: Too much sugar can cause tooth decay.
sentence_examples.zh: 太多糖会导致蛀牙。

translations.translation: 建议,提出；使联想,使想起…；暗示

sentence_examples.en: I suggest starting early to avoid traffic.
sentence_examples.zh: 我建议早点出发以避开交通拥堵。

sentence_examples.en: A gentle nod can suggest agreement.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个温和的点头可以表示同意。

sentence_examples.en: The study suggests a possible link between the two diseases.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究表明两种疾病之间可能存在联系。

translations.translation: 建议，意见；细微的迹象；暗示，联想

sentence_examples.en: She offered a suggestion to improve the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她提出了一个改进项目的建议。

sentence_examples.en: There is a suggestion that the leak came from the plumbing.
sentence_examples.zh: 有说法认为泄漏来自管道。

sentence_examples.en: I took your suggestion and adjusted the schedule.
sentence_examples.zh: 我采纳了你的建议并调整了日程。

translations.translation: 自杀；给自己带来恶劣后果的行为

sentence_examples.en: The death was ruled a suicide by the police.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方将这起死亡事件认定为自杀。

sentence_examples.en: Suicide is a major public health issue in many countries.
sentence_examples.zh: 自杀在许多国家是一个重大公共卫生问题。

sentence_examples.en: There have been several suicides in the town this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年以来，该镇发生了几起自杀事件。

sentence_examples.en: That color suits you.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个颜色适合你。

sentence_examples.en: He wore a dark suit to the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在面试时穿着一套深色西装。

sentence_examples.en: She filed a suit against her former employer.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对前雇主提起诉讼。

sentence_examples.en: This program is suitable for beginners.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个程序适合初学者。

sentence_examples.en: We need to find a suitable time for the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要找一个合适的开会时间。

sentence_examples.en: Is this shirt suitable for the interview?
sentence_examples.zh: 这件衬衫适合面试吗？

translations.translation: 套间；一套家具；套，组，系列

sentence_examples.en: We booked a deluxe suite for our anniversary.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们为纪念日预订了一个豪华套间。

sentence_examples.en: The living room came with a full suite of matching furniture.
sentence_examples.zh: 客厅配备了一整套匹配的家具。

sentence_examples.en: This suite of software helps teams manage projects more efficiently.
sentence_examples.zh: 这套办公软件有助于团队更高效地管理项目。

sentence_examples.en: Sulfur is a yellow nonmetal used in fertilizers and chemicals.
sentence_examples.zh: 硫是一种用于肥料和化学品的黄色非金属元素。

sentence_examples.en: When sulfur is heated, it releases a strong, characteristic odor.
sentence_examples.zh: 加热时，硫会释放出强烈的特征性气味。

sentence_examples.en: Pure sulfur is insoluble in water.
sentence_examples.zh: 纯硫在水中不溶。

translations.translation: 总数,和;金额;算术题;要旨

sentence_examples.en: The sum of the numbers in the column is 100.
sentence_examples.zh: 这一列数字的总和是100。

sentence_examples.en: They donated a large sum of money to the charity.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们为慈善捐赠了一大笔钱。

sentence_examples.en: A calculator can sum the numbers in seconds.
sentence_examples.zh: 计算器可以在几秒钟内把数字相加。

sentence_examples.en: Please summarize the main findings of the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 请概括报告的主要发现。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher asked us to summarize the article in one paragraph.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师让我们用一段话概括这篇文章。

sentence_examples.en: She used a few bullet points to summarize the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用几个要点对会议进行了概括。

sentence_examples.en: The summary of the report highlights the main findings.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告的摘要突出显示了主要发现。

sentence_examples.en: Please read the summary to get the key points.
sentence_examples.zh: 请阅读摘要以获取要点。

sentence_examples.en: The summary version of the document is easier to read.
sentence_examples.zh: 该文档的简要版本更易于阅读。

sentence_examples.en: Summer is my favorite season.
sentence_examples.zh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节。

sentence_examples.en: We booked a summer vacation to the mountains.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们订了一次去山里的夏季假期。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a new summer dress.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一件夏季连衣裙。

translations.translation: 顶，最高点；颠峰，高峰；最高级会议

sentence_examples.en: We reached the summit after a challenging climb.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过一次艰难的攀登，我们到达了山顶。

sentence_examples.en: The hikers rested at the summit before descending.
sentence_examples.zh: 登山者在山顶休息后继续下山。

sentence_examples.en: World leaders will attend a summit next month.
sentence_examples.zh: 世界领导人将于下个月参加一次峰会。

translations.translation: 召唤;传讯,传唤;鼓起(勇气),振作(精神)

sentence_examples.en: The principal summoned the students to the auditorium.
sentence_examples.zh: 校长把学生传唤到礼堂。

sentence_examples.en: The magician summoned a rabbit from the hat.
sentence_examples.zh: 魔术师从帽子里召唤出一只兔子。

sentence_examples.en: She summoned up the courage to speak in front of the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 她鼓起勇气在众人面前发言。

sentence_examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳从东方升起。

sentence_examples.en: The sun is a star at the center of our solar system.
sentence_examples.zh: 太阳是我们太阳系中心的一颗恒星。

sentence_examples.en: Sun Microsystems was a famous computer company.
sentence_examples.zh: Sun Microsystems 曾是知名的计算机公司。

sentence_examples.en: I usually go to church on Sunday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我通常在星期日去教堂。

sentence_examples.en: Sunday is my day off.
sentence_examples.zh: 星期日是我的休息日。

sentence_examples.en: Let's meet on Sunday afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们星期日下午见面。

sentence_examples.en: We woke up early to watch the sunrise.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们起得很早去看日出。

sentence_examples.en: The sunrise painted the sky with pink and gold.
sentence_examples.zh: 日出把天空染成粉色和金色。

sentence_examples.en: She often takes photos at sunrise.
sentence_examples.zh: 她常在日出时分拍照。

sentence_examples.en: We watched the sunset from the beach.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在海滩看日落。

sentence_examples.en: The sky turned orange at sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 日落时天空变成橙色。

sentence_examples.en: She loves to take photos at sunset.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢在日落时拍照。

sentence_examples.en: The sunshine streamed through the window.
sentence_examples.zh: 阳光透过窗户照进来。

sentence_examples.en: We enjoyed the sunshine this afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天下午我们享受着阳光。

sentence_examples.en: Sunshine can brighten a cloudy day.
sentence_examples.zh: 阳光可以照亮多云的日子。

sentence_examples.en: That new restaurant is super tasty.
sentence_examples.zh: 那家新餐厅的菜非常好吃。

sentence_examples.en: She did a super job on the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在这次演示上做得非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: It's super easy to use this app.
sentence_examples.zh: 使用这个应用程序非常简单。

sentence_examples.en: The view from the hill was superb.
sentence_examples.zh: 山坡上的景色极佳。

sentence_examples.en: She did a superb job on the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在演讲中做得非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: The restaurant serves superb meals.
sentence_examples.zh: 那家餐厅的菜肴极好。

sentence_examples.en: Her analysis was superficial and failed to consider long-term effects.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的分析很肤浅，没考虑长期影响。

sentence_examples.en: This assessment is too superficial to be useful.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个评估太肤浅，没用。

sentence_examples.en: Don't judge a book by its superficial appearance.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要只凭表面的外观来判断一本书。

sentence_examples.en: The manager removed the superfluous details from the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理把报告中多余的细节删掉了。

sentence_examples.en: In a minimalist design, any extra ornament can seem superfluous.
sentence_examples.zh: 在极简设计中，任何额外的装饰都可能显得多余。

sentence_examples.en: Please avoid including superfluous information in your presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在演讲中避免包含不必要的信息。

sentence_examples.en: The quality of this product is superior to that of its competitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 这款产品的质量优于它的竞争对手。

sentence_examples.en: Her performance was superior to that of her peers.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的表现优于同行。

sentence_examples.en: I reported the issue to my superior.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把问题向上级报告了。

translations.translation: 优越(性)，优势，优等；高傲，傲慢
