sentence_examples.zh: 她对同辈有一种优越感。

sentence_examples.en: The product's superiority over competing models makes it popular.
sentence_examples.zh: 该产品相对于竞争型号的优势使其更受欢迎。

sentence_examples.en: His remarks revealed his sense of superiority.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的言论暴露出他的优越感。

sentence_examples.en: I forgot my wallet at the supermarket.
sentence_examples.zh: 我把钱包忘在超市里了。

sentence_examples.en: The supermarket has a wide selection of fresh produce.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家超市有丰富的新鲜蔬果选择。

sentence_examples.en: We usually shop at the supermarket after work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们通常下班后去超市购物。

sentence_examples.en: The jet broke the sound barrier and reached supersonic speed.
sentence_examples.zh: 这架喷气机突破音障，达到了超音速速度。

sentence_examples.en: Modern fighters can sustain supersonic flight with advanced aerodynamics.
sentence_examples.zh: 现代战斗机凭借先进的空气动力学能够维持超音速飞行。

sentence_examples.en: A supersonic shock wave forms as the aircraft moves faster than sound.
sentence_examples.zh: 当飞行器速度超过音速时，会形成超音速冲击波。

sentence_examples.en: Many people avoid walking under ladders because of superstition.
sentence_examples.zh: 很多人因为迷信而避免从梯子下走过。

sentence_examples.en: The village has many superstitions about eclipses.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个村子有关于日食的许多迷信。

sentence_examples.en: He dismissed it as superstition and ignored it.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把它当成迷信，置之不理。

sentence_examples.en: The manager will supervise the new staff.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理将监督新员工。

sentence_examples.en: Teachers supervise the students during exams.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师在考试期间监督学生。

sentence_examples.en: Parents supervise their children when they use the internet.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母在孩子上网时监督他们的上网行为。

sentence_examples.en: They usually have supper around seven.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们通常在七点左右吃晚餐。

sentence_examples.en: My grandmother bakes a pie for supper.
sentence_examples.zh: 我奶奶会在晚餐时烤一个馅饼。

sentence_examples.en: We had leftovers from lunch for supper.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把午餐的剩菜当作晚餐吃。

sentence_examples.en: The magazine released a special supplement with extra recipes.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本杂志推出了一份特别增刊，包含额外的食谱。

sentence_examples.en: She takes a vitamin to supplement her diet.
sentence_examples.zh: 她通过吃维生素来补充日常饮食中的营养。

sentence_examples.en: The company will supplement its income with freelance work.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司将通过自由职业来增加收入。

sentence_examples.en: The store will supply fresh fruit to customers daily.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家商店将每天向顾客提供新鲜水果。

sentence_examples.en: The city faces a water supply shortage during the drought.
sentence_examples.zh: 干旱期间，城市的供水短缺。

sentence_examples.en: We will supply meals for the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们将为会议提供餐点。

sentence_examples.en: The columns support the roof.
sentence_examples.zh: 柱子支撑着屋顶。

sentence_examples.en: She offered emotional support to her friend after the breakup.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在朋友分手后提供情感支持。

sentence_examples.en: Parents work hard to support their families.
sentence_examples.zh: 父母努力工作来养家糊口。

sentence_examples.en: I suppose you're right.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想你说得对。

sentence_examples.en: Suppose we take a different route.
sentence_examples.zh: 假设我们走另一条路。

sentence_examples.en: Suppose you win the lottery, what would you do with the money?
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你中彩票了，你会用这笔钱做什么？

translations.translation: 镇压,压制;抑制,忍住;查禁

sentence_examples.en: The government moved quickly to suppress the protest before it could spread.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府迅速出手镇压抗议，以防其蔓延。

sentence_examples.en: She tried to suppress a cough during the quiet ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在安静的仪式上努力抑制咳嗽。

sentence_examples.en: The authorities suppressed the publication of the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 当局查禁了这份报告的发布。

translations.translation: 极度的,最重要的;至高的,最高的

sentence_examples.en: The supreme goal of this project is to improve patient care.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目的至高目标是改善患者护理。

sentence_examples.en: She spoke with supreme confidence about the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个计划充满极高的自信。

sentence_examples.en: This is the supreme moment of his career.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是他职业生涯中最重要的时刻。

translations.translation: 肯定的；一定会…的；有信心的，有把握的

sentence_examples.en: I'm sure you'll do well in the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 我相信你在面试中会表现很好。

sentence_examples.en: Are you sure about your plans for the weekend?
sentence_examples.zh: 你对周末的计划有信心吗？

sentence_examples.en: Sure, I can help with that.
sentence_examples.zh: 当然，我可以帮忙。

sentence_examples.en: The surface of the lake was mirror-smooth.
sentence_examples.zh: 湖面像镜子一样光滑。

sentence_examples.en: Wipe the surface of the table before you set the dishes.
sentence_examples.zh: 在摆放餐具前擦拭桌面。

sentence_examples.en: The report offered only surface explanations for the issue.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告只给出了这个问题的表面解释。

sentence_examples.en: People surged toward the stage to get a closer view.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群蜂拥向舞台，想看得更清楚。

sentence_examples.en: There was a surge in demand for electric cars.
sentence_examples.zh: 对电动汽车的需求急剧上升。

sentence_examples.en: The sea surged over the breakwater during the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨时，海水冲上了防波堤。

sentence_examples.en: The surgeon will perform the operation tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 外科医生将于明天进行手术。

sentence_examples.en: She trained for years to become a skilled surgeon.
sentence_examples.zh: 她经过多年的训练，成为了一名熟练的外科医生。

sentence_examples.en: The patient asked the surgeon to explain the risks of the procedure.
sentence_examples.zh: 患者请外科医生解释手术的风险。

translations.translation: 外科,外科学;手术室,诊疗室

sentence_examples.en: The doctor said the surgery went well.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生说手术进行得很顺利。

sentence_examples.en: He needs surgery on his knee.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的膝盖需要做手术。

sentence_examples.en: She is studying surgery at medical school.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在医学院学习外科。

sentence_examples.en: What is your surname?
sentence_examples.zh: 你姓什么？

sentence_examples.en: Please write your surname on the form.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在表格上写下你的姓氏。

sentence_examples.en: Her surname is Chen.
sentence_examples.zh: 她姓陈。

sentence_examples.en: The company's profits surpassed market expectations this quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 本季度公司的利润超过市场预期。

sentence_examples.en: She surpassed her own personal best time in the marathon.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中超越了自己的最好成绩。

sentence_examples.en: The new smartphone surpasses its rivals in battery life.
sentence_examples.zh: 新款智能手机在电池续航方面超越了竞争对手。

sentence_examples.en: The company has a surplus of inventory this quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 本季度公司库存过剩。

sentence_examples.en: We sold the surplus goods at a discount.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把多余的货物打折出售。

sentence_examples.en: There is surplus capacity in the factory.
sentence_examples.zh: 工厂仍然有剩余产能。

sentence_examples.en: Her birthday party was a pleasant surprise.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的生日派对真是一个令人愉快的惊喜。

sentence_examples.en: The plan will surprise them.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个计划会让他们感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The army launched a surprise attack at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 军队在黎明发动了一次奇袭。

sentence_examples.en: The army finally surrendered after weeks of battle.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数周的战斗后，军队最终投降。

sentence_examples.en: She surrendered her passport to the authorities.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把护照交给当局保管。

sentence_examples.en: Her surrender to the demands surprised no one.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这些要求的投降让人毫不意外。

sentence_examples.en: Tall trees surround the small clearing.
sentence_examples.zh: 高大的树木环绕着小空地。

sentence_examples.en: Police surrounded the building after the alarm went off.
sentence_examples.zh: 警报响起后，警方包围了这栋大楼。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd surrounded the musician after the show.
sentence_examples.zh: 演出结束后，人群围住了音乐家。

sentence_examples.en: I need to stay aware of my surroundings when I'm walking at night.
sentence_examples.zh: 夜间散步时，我需要留意周围的环境。

sentence_examples.en: The quiet surroundings helped me concentrate on my work.
sentence_examples.zh: 安静的周围环境帮助我专注于工作。

sentence_examples.en: During the hike, we admired the natural surroundings.
sentence_examples.zh: 在徒步时，我们欣赏周围的自然环境。

translations.translation: 俯瞰,眺望;全面审视,调查;测量图,勘定

sentence_examples.en: From the hilltop, we surveyed the valley below.
sentence_examples.zh: 从山顶，我们俯瞰下面的山谷。

sentence_examples.en: A recent survey found that most residents support the plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 最近的一项调查显示，大多数居民支持该计划。

sentence_examples.en: The engineers used a survey map to mark the property boundaries.
sentence_examples.zh: 工程师们使用测绘图标注了房产边界。

translations.translation: 幸存,生存;幸存者,残存物

sentence_examples.en: Her survival after the plane crash surprised the rescuers.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在飞机失事后的生存让救援人员感到惊讶。

sentence_examples.en: The hikers learned that survival depends on preparation and quick decisions.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些徒步者明白了生存取决于准备和快速做出决定。

sentence_examples.en: Survival skills can be taught and practiced.
sentence_examples.zh: 生存技能是可以教导和练习的。

sentence_examples.en: Only a few plants survived the winter after the freeze.
sentence_examples.zh: 在寒潮之后，只有少数植物幸存下来。

sentence_examples.en: She survived the accident with only minor injuries.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微的伤势。

sentence_examples.en: The project survived two rounds of budget cuts and continued.
sentence_examples.zh: 该项目在经历了两轮预算削减后仍然得以继续推进。

translations.translation: 易受影响的;易受感动的;易受感染的

sentence_examples.en: Children are particularly susceptible to peer pressure.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们对同伴压力特别容易受到影响。

sentence_examples.en: Older adults can be susceptible to scams.
sentence_examples.zh: 老年人容易上当受骗。

sentence_examples.en: Some plants are susceptible to frost.
sentence_examples.zh: 有些植物容易受霜冻影响。

sentence_examples.en: I suspect he forgot to lock the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 我怀疑他忘记锁门了。

sentence_examples.en: The timing of the release is suspect.
sentence_examples.zh: 发布的时机可疑。

sentence_examples.en: The police arrested a suspect.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方逮捕了一名嫌疑犯。

sentence_examples.en: The chandelier is suspended from the ceiling.
sentence_examples.zh: 吊灯悬挂在天花板上。

sentence_examples.en: The city suspended all public events due to the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 因暴风雨，市政府暂停了所有公开活动。

sentence_examples.en: The company suspended the employee for two weeks after the incident.
sentence_examples.zh: 事件发生后，公司将该员工停职两周。

sentence_examples.en: There was growing suspicion that he hadn't told the truth.
sentence_examples.zh: 人们越来越怀疑他没有说实话。

sentence_examples.en: Her suspicion about the missing funds proved unfounded.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对丢失资金的怀疑被证明是没有根据的。

sentence_examples.en: A suspicion of rain hung in the air.
sentence_examples.zh: 空气中有一丝雨意。

sentence_examples.en: The man waiting outside looked suspicious.
sentence_examples.zh: 站在外面的那名男子看起来很可疑。

sentence_examples.en: Her explanation seemed suspicious to the manager.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的解释让经理觉得可疑。

sentence_examples.en: If his story sounds suspicious, we should verify the details.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果他的说法听起来可疑，我们应该核实细节。

translations.translation: 支撑,撑住;维持,持续,经受,忍耐

sentence_examples.en: The pillars can sustain the weight of the entire building.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些柱子能够承受整座建筑的重量。

sentence_examples.en: The charity seeks to sustain the community with long-term support.
sentence_examples.zh: 慈善机构旨在通过长期援助来维持社区的稳定。

sentence_examples.en: He struggled to sustain his energy during the long hike.
sentence_examples.zh: 在漫长的徒步中，他努力维持体力。

sentence_examples.en: A swallow darted across the garden and disappeared.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园里一只燕子快速掠过，随后消失。

sentence_examples.en: She swallowed the bitter pill and accepted the news.
sentence_examples.zh: 她吞下了苦药，接受了这个消息。

sentence_examples.en: He tends to swallow everything the salesman says.
sentence_examples.zh: 他往往轻信销售员说的一切话。

sentence_examples.en: We hiked through a swamp to reach the lake.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们徒步穿过沼泽去湖边。

sentence_examples.en: A wooden boardwalk lets visitors cross the swamp safely.
sentence_examples.zh: 木板道让游客安全地穿过沼泽。

sentence_examples.en: Heavy rain can swamp low-lying streets.
sentence_examples.zh: 大雨会淹没低洼的街道。

sentence_examples.en: A swan glided across the lake at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 清晨，一只天鹅在湖面上缓缓滑行。

sentence_examples.en: We watched a swan swim gracefully near the reeds.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们看到一只天鹅在芦苇边优雅地游动。

sentence_examples.en: After the concert, people swanned about the square, taking photos.
sentence_examples.zh: 音乐会结束后，人们在广场四处闲逛，拍照留影。

translations.translation: 涌往;挤满;云集;成群移动

sentence_examples.en: A swarm of bees hovered over the fruit trees.
sentence_examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂在果树上空盘旋。

sentence_examples.en: People swarmed into the stadium as the gates opened.
sentence_examples.zh: 大门一开，人们蜂拥涌入体育场。

sentence_examples.en: The streets swarmed with people after the parade.
sentence_examples.zh: 游行结束后，街道挤满了人。

sentence_examples.en: The trees swayed in the wind.
sentence_examples.zh: 树在风中摇摆。

sentence_examples.en: Her argument swayed the voters.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的论点动摇了选民的意见。

sentence_examples.en: The flag swayed in the breeze.
sentence_examples.zh: 旗帜在微风中摇摆。

sentence_examples.en: The witness swore to tell the truth.
sentence_examples.zh: 证人发誓要说实话。

sentence_examples.en: He swore at the referee during the game.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在比赛中对裁判破口大骂。

sentence_examples.en: She swore to keep the secret.
sentence_examples.zh: 她发誓要保守秘密。

sentence_examples.en: He wiped the sweat from his brow after the sprint.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在冲刺后把额头上的汗水擦干。

sentence_examples.en: She sweats when she exercises in hot weather.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在高温下锻炼时会出汗。

sentence_examples.en: His shirt was soaked with sweat after the workout.
sentence_examples.zh: 训练后他的衬衫被汗水浸透。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a warm sweater for the winter.
sentence_examples.zh: 我买了一件保暖的毛衣来过冬。

sentence_examples.en: She wears a cozy sweater to stay comfortable.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿着一件舒适的毛衣，感觉很温暖。

sentence_examples.en: The sweater is knitted with wool.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件毛衣是用羊毛编织的。

translations.translation: 扫,打扫;席卷,冲光;扫过,掠过

sentence_examples.en: I sweep the kitchen floor every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天早上打扫厨房的地板。

sentence_examples.en: A cold wind swept across the valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 一阵冷风掠过山谷。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy swept through the country.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策席卷了全国。

sentence_examples.en: The cake is sweet.
sentence_examples.zh: 蛋糕很甜。

sentence_examples.en: She gave me a sweet smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给了我一个甜甜的笑容。

sentence_examples.en: We bought some sweets for the kids.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们给孩子们买了一些糖果。

sentence_examples.en: My ankle swelled after the long run.
sentence_examples.zh: 长跑后我的脚踝肿胀了。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd swelled to tens of thousands for the festival.
sentence_examples.zh: 节日里人群激增到数万。

sentence_examples.en: Prices are expected to swell in the coming months.
sentence_examples.zh: 未来几个月价格预计会上涨。

sentence_examples.en: A swift flew across the sky.
sentence_examples.zh: 一只雨燕在天空中飞过。

sentence_examples.en: The swift fox dashed across the field.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只敏捷的狐狸飞速穿过田野。

sentence_examples.en: We must make a swift decision to meet the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了赶上最后期限，我们必须作出迅速的决定。

sentence_examples.en: I swim laps in the pool after work.
sentence_examples.zh: 下班后我在游泳池里游几圈。

sentence_examples.en: She swam across the lake to reach the other side.
sentence_examples.zh: 她游过湖面到达对岸。

sentence_examples.en: Swimming is a good workout.
sentence_examples.zh: 游泳是一项很好的锻炼。

sentence_examples.en: The door swings open easily with a gentle push.
sentence_examples.zh: 只要轻轻一推，门就会轻松打开。

sentence_examples.en: The children are playing on the swing in the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们正在公园的秋千上玩耍。

sentence_examples.en: The tree branches swung in the wind.
sentence_examples.zh: 风中树枝在摇摆。

sentence_examples.en: Please flip the light switch to turn on the lamp.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把灯的开关拨到开启位置，点亮灯光。

sentence_examples.en: She switched careers after college.
sentence_examples.zh: 她大学毕业后换了职业。

sentence_examples.en: The trainer used a switch to guide the horse.
sentence_examples.zh: 训练师用鞭子来引导那匹马。

sentence_examples.en: The knight drew his sword as the battle began.
sentence_examples.zh: 战斗开始时，骑士拔出他的剑。

sentence_examples.en: In legends, the sword is a symbol of power and courage.
sentence_examples.zh: 传说中，剑是力量与勇气的象征。

sentence_examples.en: She learned sword fighting with a wooden practice sword.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用木剑练习剑术。

sentence_examples.en: A red rose is a symbol of love.
sentence_examples.zh: 红玫瑰是爱情的象征。

sentence_examples.en: The peace sign is a widely recognized symbol.
sentence_examples.zh: 和平符号是广为人知的象征。

sentence_examples.en: In many cultures, a dragon is a symbol of power.
sentence_examples.zh: 在许多文化中，龙是力量的象征。

sentence_examples.en: The butterfly's wings show perfect symmetry.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只蝴蝶的翅膀呈现出完美的对称。

sentence_examples.en: The designer aimed for visual symmetry in the logo.
sentence_examples.zh: 设计师在标志中追求视觉上的对称。

sentence_examples.en: In geometry, symmetry means an object looks the same after certain transformations.
sentence_examples.zh: 在几何学中，对称性指对象在某些变换后看起来相同。

sentence_examples.en: She's very sympathetic to people who have lost their jobs.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对失业的人很有同情心。

sentence_examples.en: He gave me a sympathetic smile and listened patiently.
sentence_examples.zh: 他给了我一个同情的微笑，耐心地倾听。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor was sympathetic to my concerns.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生对我的担忧表示理解和同情。

sentence_examples.en: I sympathize with you over your job loss.
sentence_examples.zh: 我对你因失业这件事表示同情。

sentence_examples.en: She sympathizes with people who are displaced by war.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对因战争而被迫流离失所的人表示同情。

sentence_examples.en: We sympathize with the victims and want to help.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们对受害者表示同情，并愿意提供帮助。

translations.translation: 同情，同情心；赞同，同感；慰问

sentence_examples.en: I felt a lot of sympathy for her after she lost her job.
sentence_examples.zh: 她失业后，我对她感到很同情。

sentence_examples.en: Her sympathy and understanding helped me cope with the situation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的同情和理解帮助我应对了这种情况。

sentence_examples.en: Please send my sympathy to the family of the deceased.
sentence_examples.zh: 请向逝者的家属致以我的慰问。

sentence_examples.en: They listened to a symphony performed by the city orchestra.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们聆听了市立管弦乐团演奏的交响曲。

sentence_examples.en: The symphony was conducted by a famous maestro.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部交响曲由一位著名的指挥家指挥。

sentence_examples.en: A composer released a new symphony last year.
sentence_examples.zh: 一位作曲家去年发行了一部新的交响曲。

translations.translation: 讨论会,专题报告会;专题论文集

sentence_examples.en: The university hosted a symposium on climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 大学举办了关于气候变化的研讨会。

sentence_examples.en: Researchers presented their papers at the symposium.
sentence_examples.zh: 研究人员在研讨会上发表了他们的论文。

sentence_examples.en: The symposium featured several keynote talks and a panel discussion.
sentence_examples.zh: 该研讨会设有多场主题演讲和一个圆桌讨论。

translations.translation: (疾病的)症状；(不好事情的)征兆,表征

sentence_examples.en: A fever is a common symptom of many infections.
sentence_examples.zh: 发烧是许多感染的常见症状。

sentence_examples.en: A persistent cough could be a symptom of allergies.
sentence_examples.zh: 持续的咳嗽可能是过敏的症状。

sentence_examples.en: Unexplained weight loss can be a symptom of a serious illness.
sentence_examples.zh: 不明原因的体重下降可能是某种严重疾病的征兆。

sentence_examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with metabolic syndrome.
sentence_examples.zh: 患者被诊断患有代谢综合征。

sentence_examples.en: A syndrome is a group of symptoms that occur together.
sentence_examples.zh: 综合征是一组同时出现的症状。

sentence_examples.en: She has a rare genetic syndrome that affects her limbs.
sentence_examples.zh: 她患有一种罕见的遗传综合征，影响肢体。

sentence_examples.en: The synthesis of new ideas often comes from combining different fields.
sentence_examples.zh: 把不同领域的知识结合起来，往往会产生新想法。

sentence_examples.en: In chemistry, the synthesis of ammonia is a well-known example.
sentence_examples.zh: 在化学中，氨的合成是一个著名的例子。

sentence_examples.en: The report presents a synthesis of data from several studies.
sentence_examples.zh: 该报告对多项研究的数据进行了综合分析。

sentence_examples.en: The jacket is made from a synthetic fiber.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件夹克是用合成纤维制成的。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists developed synthetic insulin in the lab.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家在实验室里合成了胰岛素。

sentence_examples.en: Synthetic pigments are often cheaper than natural pigments.
sentence_examples.zh: 合成颜料通常比天然颜料便宜。

translations.translation: 系统，体系；制度；方法，方式，步聚

sentence_examples.en: The new computer system crashed during the update.
sentence_examples.zh: 在更新期间，新的计算机系统崩溃了。

sentence_examples.en: We need to install a secure system to protect data.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要安装一个安全的系统来保护数据。

sentence_examples.en: The education system in this country is undergoing reform.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个国家的教育体系正在改革。

sentence_examples.en: He took a systematic approach to studying, planning each chapter in advance.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在学习时采取了系统化的方法，提前规划每一章的内容。

sentence_examples.en: The team conducted a systematic review of the data to identify patterns.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队对数据进行了系统性回顾，以识别模式。

sentence_examples.en: A systematic interview process helps ensure all important topics are covered.
sentence_examples.zh: 系统化的面试流程有助于确保覆盖所有重要主题。

sentence_examples.en: We sat around the table to discuss the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们围坐在桌子周围讨论这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: Please clear the table before you leave.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在离开前清理桌子。

sentence_examples.en: The committee decided to table the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 委员会决定搁置该提案。

sentence_examples.en: Take one tablet with water after meals.
sentence_examples.zh: 饭后请用水吞下一片药片。

sentence_examples.en: The stone tablet in the museum bears an ancient inscription.
sentence_examples.zh: 博物馆里的石碑刻着古代铭文。

sentence_examples.en: She uses a tablet to read e-books.
sentence_examples.zh: 她使用平板电脑来读电子书。

sentence_examples.en: I bought new fishing tackle for the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 这次旅行我买了新的钓具。

sentence_examples.en: The company must tackle climate risks.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司必须应对气候风险。

sentence_examples.en: The defender tackled the attacker and brought him to the ground.
sentence_examples.zh: 后卫把进攻者摔倒在地，阻止了他。

sentence_examples.en: Her tactic for winning the debate was to ask thoughtful questions.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在辩论中取胜的策略是提出有深度的问题。

sentence_examples.en: The company introduced a new marketing tactic to reach teens.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司推出了一种新的营销策略来吸引青少年。

sentence_examples.en: Their tactic was to surprise the opponent with an unexpected move.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们的战术是用出其不意的行动来让对手吃惊。

sentence_examples.en: The price tag on this shirt reads $25.
sentence_examples.zh: 这件衬衫上的价格标签写着25美元。

sentence_examples.en: She tagged her friend in the photo on social media.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在社交媒体上的照片里把朋友标记了。

sentence_examples.en: The kids tag along behind their mother as they walk home.
sentence_examples.zh: 孩子们在回家的路上紧跟在妈妈身后。

sentence_examples.en: The cat wagged its tail when it saw the bird.
sentence_examples.zh: 那只猫看到鸟时尾巴摇摆。

sentence_examples.en: The airplane's tail was damaged in the collision.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机的尾部在碰撞中受损。

sentence_examples.en: The detective tailed the suspect for hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 侦探对嫌疑人跟踪了好几个小时。

sentence_examples.en: The tailor measured my waist for a custom suit.
sentence_examples.zh: 裁缝为定制西装量了我的腰围。

sentence_examples.en: A skilled tailor can transform a plain fabric into a garment that fits perfectly.
sentence_examples.zh: 技艺高超的裁缝可以把普通布料改造成合身的衣物。

sentence_examples.en: They tailor software to meet the client's needs.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们会根据客户的需求定制软件。

translations.translation: 拿取；吃；记录；取得；花费；捕获；认为

sentence_examples.en: Please take a seat.
sentence_examples.zh: 请坐下。

sentence_examples.en: It will take about ten minutes.
sentence_examples.zh: 大约需要十分钟。

sentence_examples.en: She took the cookies from the jar.
sentence_examples.zh: 她从罐子里拿走了饼干。

sentence_examples.en: She told a tale about a brave knight who saved a village.
sentence_examples.zh: 她讲述了一个关于拯救村庄的勇敢骑士的故事。

sentence_examples.en: The tale of the lost treasure has fascinated readers for centuries.
sentence_examples.zh: 关于失落宝藏的传说已经吸引了数百年的读者。

sentence_examples.en: Don't believe every tall tale you hear.
sentence_examples.zh: 不要相信你听到的每一个夸张的故事。

sentence_examples.en: She has a natural talent for playing the piano.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在弹钢琴方面有天赋。

sentence_examples.en: His talent was recognized by the company, and they promoted him.
sentence_examples.zh: 他的才能被公司认可，他们提拔了他。

sentence_examples.en: Talent alone is not enough; hard work matters.
sentence_examples.zh: 天赋本身并不够，努力更重要。

sentence_examples.en: I need to talk to you about the project deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要和你谈谈这个项目的截止日期。

sentence_examples.en: We had a nice talk with our neighbors last night.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚我们和邻居聊得很愉快。

sentence_examples.en: She will give a talk on climate change at the conference.
sentence_examples.zh: 她将在大会上就气候变化发表演讲。

translations.translation: (身材)高的,高大的；夸大的,离谱的

sentence_examples.en: The tall man reached the top shelf.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个身材高大的男人够到了最上面的架子。

sentence_examples.en: Her tall tale about winning the race was hard to believe.
sentence_examples.zh: 她关于赢得比赛的夸张故事让人难以置信。

sentence_examples.en: The tall building dominates the city skyline.
sentence_examples.zh: 那座高大的建筑在城市天际线中占据主导地位。

translations.translation: 驯服的,温顺的;沉闷的,乏味的

sentence_examples.en: The lion cub is surprisingly tame around visitors.
sentence_examples.zh: 那头狮子幼崩在游客面前出人意料地温顺。

sentence_examples.en: The trainer tamed the wild horse after months of hard work.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过数月的艰苦训练，驯服了那匹野马。

sentence_examples.en: The movie was tame and failed to hold my attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影太乏味，没能吸引我的注意力。

sentence_examples.en: Her sandals are tan and go well with her bag.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的凉鞋是棕褐色的，和她的包很搭。

sentence_examples.en: The walls are tan.
sentence_examples.zh: 墙壁是棕褐色的。

sentence_examples.en: I spent the weekend at the beach to tan my skin.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在海边度过周末，晒黑皮肤。

sentence_examples.en: There is a tangle of wires behind the TV.
sentence_examples.zh: 电视后面的电线缠成一团。

sentence_examples.en: My headphones get tangled in the charger cord when I pack my bag.
sentence_examples.zh: 打包包时，我的耳机线会和充电线缠在一起。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to tangle the hose when you wind it up.
sentence_examples.zh: 卷起水管时要小心不要让它缠在一起。

sentence_examples.en: The water is kept in a large tank.
sentence_examples.zh: 水被储存在一个大水箱里。

sentence_examples.en: The fuel tank in my car is full.
sentence_examples.zh: 我车里的燃油箱满了。

sentence_examples.en: A tank rolled across the battlefield.
sentence_examples.zh: 坦克在战场上缓缓驶过。

sentence_examples.en: The tanker is scheduled to depart at dawn.
sentence_examples.zh: 这艘油船计划在黎明时离开。

sentence_examples.en: An oil tanker can carry thousands of barrels of crude.
sentence_examples.zh: 油轮可以运载数千桶原油。

sentence_examples.en: The tanker entered the port to start loading crude.
sentence_examples.zh: 油船进入港口开始装载原油。

sentence_examples.en: Turn on the tap and let the water flow.
sentence_examples.zh: 打开水龙头，让水流出。

sentence_examples.en: She tapped on the door to get his attention.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在门上轻敲，以引起他的注意。

sentence_examples.en: The company tapped into new markets to boost sales.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司开拓了新市场以提升销售。

sentence_examples.en: I need a roll of tape to seal the box.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要一卷胶带来封箱。

sentence_examples.en: The old cassette tape in the drawer still works.
sentence_examples.zh: 抽屉里那张旧磁带现在仍能播放。

sentence_examples.en: We will tape the interview tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们明天要把采访录下来。

sentence_examples.en: The road surface was coated with tar.
sentence_examples.zh: 路面被柏油覆盖。

sentence_examples.en: The workers tar the roof to waterproof it.
sentence_examples.zh: 工人们把屋顶涂上柏油以防水。

sentence_examples.en: Tar is a thick, sticky black liquid.
sentence_examples.zh: 柏油是一种厚而粘黑色的液体。

sentence_examples.en: The company set a sales target for this quarter.
sentence_examples.zh: 这家公司为本季度设定了销售目标。

sentence_examples.en: She was the target of their prank.
sentence_examples.zh: 她成了他们恶作剧的对象。

sentence_examples.en: The archery range has a target at 50 meters.
sentence_examples.zh: 射箭场距离50米处有一个靶子。

translations.translation: 关税,税率;(旅馆,饭店等)价目表,收费表

sentence_examples.en: The government announced a new tariff on imported cars.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府宣布对进口汽车征收新的关税。

sentence_examples.en: Tariffs on steel could rise next year, increasing production costs.
sentence_examples.zh: 明年钢铁关税可能上调，增加生产成本。

sentence_examples.en: The hotel's tariff for a double room is $150 per night.
sentence_examples.zh: 酒店双人房的价目表为每晚150美元。

sentence_examples.en: Her main task for today is to finish the report.
sentence_examples.zh: 她今天的主要任务是完成报告。

sentence_examples.en: I have three tasks to complete this afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我今天下午有三项任务要完成。

sentence_examples.en: This task will take a few hours to finish.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个任务需要花费几个小时来完成。

sentence_examples.en: I want to taste the soup to see if it needs more salt.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想尝尝这汤，看是否需要再放盐。

sentence_examples.en: The sauce has a spicy taste.
sentence_examples.zh: 这酱汁有辣味。

sentence_examples.en: Her taste in music is very refined.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在音乐方面的品味非常高雅。

sentence_examples.en: The government raised the tax on gasoline.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府提高了汽油税。

sentence_examples.en: Tax season starts in April.
sentence_examples.zh: 报税季从四月开始。

sentence_examples.en: The government taxes luxury goods to raise revenue.
sentence_examples.zh: 政府对奢侈品征税以增加收入。

sentence_examples.en: The taxi stopped to let passengers off.
sentence_examples.zh: 出租汽车停下来让乘客下车。

sentence_examples.en: We hailed a taxi and headed to the hotel.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们招手拦了一辆出租汽车去酒店。

sentence_examples.en: The plane began to taxi to the runway.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机开始在跑道上滑行。

sentence_examples.en: I drink a cup of tea every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯茶。

sentence_examples.en: Would you like some tea?
sentence_examples.zh: 你想来杯茶吗？

sentence_examples.en: Tea can be served hot or iced.
sentence_examples.zh: 茶可以热饮，也可以冰镇。

sentence_examples.en: This course will teach you a lot.
sentence_examples.zh: 这门课程会教给你很多东西。

sentence_examples.en: I want to teach you how to cook.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想教你做饭。

sentence_examples.en: Teachers teach students to think critically.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师教学生批判性思维。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher explained the homework clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师把作业讲得很清楚。

sentence_examples.en: My math teacher helps me a lot.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的数学老师帮助我很多。

sentence_examples.en: A good teacher can inspire students.
sentence_examples.zh: 好老师能激励学生。

sentence_examples.en: Our school basketball team won the championship.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们学校的篮球队赢得了冠军。

sentence_examples.en: She joined a design team to work on the new project.
sentence_examples.zh: 她加入了一个设计团队，参与新项目的工作。

sentence_examples.en: The manager asked us to team up with the marketing department.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理要求我们与市场部联手合作。

sentence_examples.en: A single tear rolled down her cheek.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的脸颊上滚落了一滴眼泪。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful not to tear the paper when you pull it.
sentence_examples.zh: 拉纸时小心不要把纸撕裂。

sentence_examples.en: The wind tore the banner.
sentence_examples.zh: 风把横幅撕裂了。

sentence_examples.en: The older kids teased him about his accent.
sentence_examples.zh: 年长的孩子取笑他的口音。

sentence_examples.en: She likes to tease her cat by waving a feather toy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喜欢用羽毛玩具逗她的猫。

sentence_examples.en: The aroma teased us with hints of vanilla.
sentence_examples.zh: 香味带着香草的气息逗引着我们。

translations.translation: 技术(性)的，工艺的；专门性的，专业性的

sentence_examples.en: The manual explains the device's technical specifications.
sentence_examples.zh: 手册解释了该设备的技术规格。

sentence_examples.en: To understand the article, you need to know some technical terms.
sentence_examples.zh: 为了理解这篇文章，你需要知道一些专业术语。

sentence_examples.en: This project requires both technical and managerial skills.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目需要技术能力和管理能力。

sentence_examples.en: The technician installed a new software update on my computer.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位技术员在我的电脑上安装了一个新的软件更新。

sentence_examples.en: We called a technician to fix the air conditioner.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们请来一位技师修理空调。

sentence_examples.en: The technician explained how the device works.
sentence_examples.zh: 那位技术员向我解释了这个设备是如何工作的。

translations.translation: 技巧，手艺，技能；技术，工艺

sentence_examples.en: She learned a new painting technique to blend colors smoothly.
sentence_examples.zh: 她学习了一种新的绘画技巧，可以把颜色混得更平滑。

sentence_examples.en: The chef demonstrated a technique for searing meat without burning it.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨师演示了一种不让肉烧焦的煎制技巧。

sentence_examples.en: He improved his technique by practicing every day.
sentence_examples.zh: 他通过每天练习来提高他的技巧。

translations.translation: 科学技术；工业技术；应用科学

sentence_examples.en: Technology has greatly changed the way we communicate.
sentence_examples.zh: 科技极大地改变了我们交流的方式。

sentence_examples.en: Information technology is a fast-growing field.
sentence_examples.zh: 信息技术是一个快速发展的领域。

sentence_examples.en: New technology can help reduce energy consumption.
sentence_examples.zh: 新技术有助于降低能源消耗。

sentence_examples.en: The lecture was tedious, with hours of slides and little interaction.
sentence_examples.zh: 这场讲座很乏味，整整几小时都是幻灯片，互动很少。

sentence_examples.en: Filing the paperwork can be tedious and repetitive.
sentence_examples.zh: 办理这些文书工作既乏味又重复。

sentence_examples.en: She grew tired of the tedious routine of her job.
sentence_examples.zh: 她厌倦了工作中那种乏味而单调的日常工作。

sentence_examples.en: The teenager asked for help with his science project.
sentence_examples.zh: 那名十几岁的青少年请求帮助他的科学项目。

sentence_examples.en: A teenager needs enough sleep and time to study.
sentence_examples.zh: 十几岁的青少年需要充足的睡眠和学习时间。

sentence_examples.en: The teacher spoke to the teenager about behavior in class.
sentence_examples.zh: 老师和这名十几岁的青少年谈论课堂上的行为。

sentence_examples.en: The telegram arrived this morning with some good news.
sentence_examples.zh: 今晨电报到了，带来了一些好消息。

sentence_examples.en: In the old days, people sent telegrams to announce important events.
sentence_examples.zh: 在过去，人们用电报来宣布重大事件。

sentence_examples.en: The secretary handed me a telegram about the meeting time.
sentence_examples.zh: 秘书递给我一份关于会议时间的电报。

sentence_examples.en: In the 19th century, people sent messages by telegraph.
sentence_examples.zh: 在19世纪，人们通过电报发送消息。

sentence_examples.en: She telegraphed her resignation to the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 她发电报向公司辞职。

sentence_examples.en: The manager telegraphed his decision to the board.
sentence_examples.zh: 经理把决定电报给董事会。

sentence_examples.en: She answered the telephone and spoke with her client.
sentence_examples.zh: 她接起电话，与客户交谈。

sentence_examples.en: The telephone rang loudly in the kitchen.
sentence_examples.zh: 厨房里的电话响得很大声。

sentence_examples.en: You can telephone us at 555-0182 if you have questions.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你有问题，可以给我们打电话，号码是555-0182。

sentence_examples.en: We set up the telescope on the hill to observe the Moon.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们把望远镜架在山坡上观测月亮。

sentence_examples.en: The telescope provides a clear view of distant galaxies.
sentence_examples.zh: 望远镜可以清晰看到遥远的星系。

sentence_examples.en: The antenna telescopes down for storage.
sentence_examples.zh: 天线收缩以便存放。

translations.translation: 告诉，讲述；告诫；吩咐，命令；辨/区别

sentence_examples.en: Please tell me what time it is.
sentence_examples.zh: 请告诉我现在几点。

sentence_examples.en: She told us a funny story about her trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给我们讲了一个关于她旅行的有趣故事。

sentence_examples.en: It's hard to tell the difference between these two.
sentence_examples.zh: 这两者之间很难分辨出差异。

sentence_examples.en: Tom has a quick temper.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤姆脾气很急躁。

sentence_examples.en: She tempered her criticism with a compliment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她用一句赞美来缓和批评。

sentence_examples.en: The blade was tempered to increase its toughness.
sentence_examples.zh: 刀片经回火后变得更坚韧。

sentence_examples.en: Her even temperament helps her stay calm in difficult situations.
sentence_examples.zh: 她平稳的性情在困难情况下能让她保持冷静。

sentence_examples.en: A person's temperament can influence how they handle stress.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个人的性情会影响他们如何应对压力。

sentence_examples.en: The horse has a gentle temperament.
sentence_examples.zh: 这匹马性情温和。

sentence_examples.en: The temperature outside is freezing this morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 今晨外面的温度很低，快要结冰了。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor said my temperature is normal.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生说我的体温正常。

sentence_examples.en: You should monitor the room temperature to keep the plants healthy.
sentence_examples.zh: 你应该监测房间温度，以让植物保持健康。

sentence_examples.en: The temple beside the river is famous for its gardens.
sentence_examples.zh: 河边的庙宇以花园闻名。

sentence_examples.en: He prayed at the temple entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在庙门口祈祷。

sentence_examples.en: Her temples ached after the long day.
sentence_examples.zh: 漫长的一天后，她的太阳穴开始疼痛。

translations.translation: 节奏,行进速度;(音乐的)速度

sentence_examples.en: The tempo of the meeting picked up as more people joined.
sentence_examples.zh: 随着更多人加入，会议的节奏加快。

sentence_examples.en: In music class, the teacher asked us to play at a steady tempo.
sentence_examples.zh: 在音乐课上，老师让我们以稳定的节奏演奏。

sentence_examples.en: City life moves at a fast tempo.
sentence_examples.zh: 城市生活的节奏很快。

sentence_examples.en: I have a temporary job until the project ends.
sentence_examples.zh: 我有一份临时工作，直到项目结束。

sentence_examples.en: This shelter is only temporary.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个避难所只是临时的。

sentence_examples.en: We need a temporary solution for now.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们现在需要一个临时的解决方案。

translations.translation: 诱惑,引诱;吸引,使感兴趣

sentence_examples.en: The scent of fresh bread tempted me to buy a loaf.
sentence_examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味让我忍不住买了一个面包。

sentence_examples.en: Advertisements can tempt people to spend more money.
sentence_examples.zh: 广告会诱使人们花更多钱。

sentence_examples.en: An irresistible offer tempted him into signing the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个不可抗拒的报价诱使他签署合同。

sentence_examples.en: She resisted the temptation to check her phone during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在会议期间克制住查看手机的诱惑。

sentence_examples.en: Advertisements often use temptation to persuade customers.
sentence_examples.zh: 广告常常利用诱惑来吸引顾客。

sentence_examples.en: He couldn't resist the temptation to take a shortcut, even though it was risky.
sentence_examples.zh: 他无法抵挡走捷径的诱惑，尽管那样做有风险。

sentence_examples.en: There are ten apples on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有十个苹果。

sentence_examples.en: She bought ten books.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了十本书。

sentence_examples.en: We have ten minutes before the show.
sentence_examples.zh: 离演出开始还有十分钟。

sentence_examples.en: The landlord welcomed the new tenant at the door.
sentence_examples.zh: 房东在门口欢迎新租户。

sentence_examples.en: The tenant signed a one-year lease and paid the security deposit.
sentence_examples.zh: 租户签署了一份为期一年的租约并支付押金。

sentence_examples.en: If the tenant falls behind on rent, the landlord may start eviction proceedings.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果租户拖欠房租，房东可能会启动驱逐程序。

sentence_examples.en: She tends to forget appointments.
sentence_examples.zh: 她往往会忘记预约。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse tends to the wounded.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士照料伤者。

sentence_examples.en: He tends the garden every morning.
sentence_examples.zh: 他每天早上照看花园。

sentence_examples.en: There is a tendency for children to imitate adults.
sentence_examples.zh: 儿童往往会模仿大人。

sentence_examples.en: Her tendency to overthink situations can hold her back.
sentence_examples.zh: 她过度思考情况的倾向可能会让她停滞不前。

sentence_examples.en: The market shows a tendency toward higher prices.
sentence_examples.zh: 市场呈现出价格上涨的趋势。

sentence_examples.en: The steak is tender.
sentence_examples.zh: 这块牛排很嫩。

sentence_examples.en: She has a tender heart.
sentence_examples.zh: 她有一颗温柔的心。

sentence_examples.en: The company tendered a bid for the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司就该项目提交了一份投标书。

sentence_examples.en: My favorite sport is tennis.
sentence_examples.zh: 我最喜欢的运动是网球。

sentence_examples.en: She plays tennis every Saturday.
sentence_examples.zh: 她每个星期六都打网球。

sentence_examples.en: We're going to watch a tennis match on TV tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们今晚要在电视上看网球比赛。

sentence_examples.en: The sentence is in the past tense.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个句子是过去时态。

sentence_examples.en: Tense the rope by pulling it tight.
sentence_examples.zh: 用力把绳子拉紧。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting was tense.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议很紧张。

sentence_examples.en: There was a lot of tension in the meeting as people argued about deadlines.
sentence_examples.zh: 会议上气氛很紧张，因为大家在讨论截止日期。

sentence_examples.en: The rope is under tension when it is stretched.
sentence_examples.zh: 绳子在被拉紧时处于张力状态。

sentence_examples.en: As the game went on, the tension between the two teams grew.
sentence_examples.zh: 比赛进行时，两队之间的紧张气氛越来越浓。

sentence_examples.en: We set up the tent before it started to rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 在下雨前，我们把帐篷搭好了。

sentence_examples.en: The tent has two rooms.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个帐篷有两个隔间。

sentence_examples.en: We packed up the tent and left.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们收起帐篷就走了。

translations.translation: 试探性的，暂时的；犹豫不决的

sentence_examples.en: We made a tentative plan to meet next week, but the date could change.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们拟定了下周见面的一个暂定计划，但日期可能会变。

sentence_examples.en: Her tentative answer suggested she hadn't decided yet.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的犹豫回答表明她还没有决定下来。

sentence_examples.en: We need to confirm the tentative budget with the client.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们需要与客户确认初步预算。

sentence_examples.en: The spring term ends in June.
sentence_examples.zh: 春季学期在六月结束。

sentence_examples.en: Please read the terms before signing the contract.
sentence_examples.zh: 在签署合同前，请阅读条款。

sentence_examples.en: In mathematics, a term is a part of an expression.
sentence_examples.zh: 在数学中，项是表达式的一部分。

sentence_examples.en: The project is in its terminal phase and will be completed soon.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个项目已进入晚期阶段，很快就会完成。

sentence_examples.en: We arrived at the terminal just in time for the flight.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们正好赶上航班，抵达了航站楼。

sentence_examples.en: She has a terminal illness and is receiving palliative care.
sentence_examples.zh: 她患有晚期疾病，正在接受姑息治疗。

sentence_examples.en: The contract will terminate at the end of the month.
sentence_examples.zh: 合同将在本月底终止。

sentence_examples.en: If you violate the policy, your account may be terminated.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果您违反政策，您的账户可能会被终止。

sentence_examples.en: The team decided to terminate the project due to lack of funds.
sentence_examples.zh: 由于资金短缺，团队决定终止该项目。

translations.translation: 很糟的;可怕的,骇人的;极度的,厉害的

sentence_examples.en: The weather today is terrible.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天天气太糟了。

sentence_examples.en: That movie was terrible.
sentence_examples.zh: 那部电影真糟糕。

sentence_examples.en: It's terrible to forget an important deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 忘记一个重要的截止日期真糟糕。

sentence_examples.en: The movie was terrific.
sentence_examples.zh: 那部电影真棒。

sentence_examples.en: You did a terrific job on the presentation.
sentence_examples.zh: 你在演示上做得非常出色。

sentence_examples.en: The weather is terrific today.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天的天气真好。

sentence_examples.en: The loud thunder terrified the children.
sentence_examples.zh: 巨响的雷声吓坏了孩子们。

sentence_examples.en: Public speaking can terrify many people.
sentence_examples.zh: 公开演讲可能会让很多人害怕。

sentence_examples.en: I don't want to terrify you with the details.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不想把细节吓到你。

sentence_examples.en: The country expanded its territory after the treaty was signed.
sentence_examples.zh: 签署条约后，该国扩大了领土。

sentence_examples.en: This forest is part of the tribe's traditional territory.
sentence_examples.zh: 这片森林是部落的传统领地。

sentence_examples.en: Soldiers guarded the border to defend their territory.
sentence_examples.zh: 士兵守卫边境，捍卫他们的领土。

sentence_examples.en: The thought of failing the exam filled me with terror.
sentence_examples.zh: 想到考试不及格，我心里充满恐惧。

sentence_examples.en: The city was in terror after the sudden attack.
sentence_examples.zh: 突发袭击后，城市陷入恐怖之中。

sentence_examples.en: That kid is a real terror in class.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个孩子在班上真是个捣蛋鬼。

sentence_examples.en: I have to take a math test tomorrow.
sentence_examples.zh: 我明天要参加一场数学考试。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists tested the new drug in clinical trials.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家在临床试验中测试了新药。

sentence_examples.en: This test is designed to assess your reading comprehension.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项测试旨在评估你的阅读理解。

sentence_examples.en: Witnesses will testify in court about what they saw.
sentence_examples.zh: 证人将在法庭上就他们所看到的事作证。

sentence_examples.en: The survey results testify to the program's effectiveness.
sentence_examples.zh: 调查结果证明了该项目的有效性。

sentence_examples.en: Her careful notes testify to her attention to detail.
sentence_examples.zh: 她细致的笔记证明了她对细节的关注。

sentence_examples.en: The witness's testimony helped convict the suspect.
sentence_examples.zh: 证人的证词帮助定罪了嫌疑人。

sentence_examples.en: Her testimony provided new details about what happened that night.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的证词提供了关于那晚发生的事情的新细节。

sentence_examples.en: The court accepted the testimony as evidence.
sentence_examples.zh: 法院接受了这份证词作为证据。

sentence_examples.en: Please quote the text from the chapter you cited.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把你在章节中引用的原文贴出来。

sentence_examples.en: The text on this page explains the process clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 这一页的文本清楚地解释了这个过程。

sentence_examples.en: I read the text aloud to practice pronunciation.
sentence_examples.zh: 我大声朗读文本来练习发音。

sentence_examples.en: I need to buy the textbook before the class starts.
sentence_examples.zh: 课程开始前我需要买这本教科书。

sentence_examples.en: The textbook explains the concepts clearly.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本教科书清楚地解释了概念。

sentence_examples.en: Our professor asked us to read a chapter from the textbook.
sentence_examples.zh: 教授让我们从教科书中读一个章节。

sentence_examples.en: This textile is woven from organic cotton.
sentence_examples.zh: 这种纺织品是用有机棉织成的。

sentence_examples.en: Textile workers organized a strike for better pay.
sentence_examples.zh: 纺织工人为争取更高的工资举行了罢工。

sentence_examples.en: The textile industry is investing in new automation technologies.
sentence_examples.zh: 纺织行业正在投资新的自动化技术。

translations.translation: (织物)质地；(材料)构造；结构；肌理

sentence_examples.en: The velvet has a soft texture that feels luxurious.
sentence_examples.zh: 天鹅绒的质地很柔软，手感很舒适。

sentence_examples.en: She picked a fabric with a smooth texture.
sentence_examples.zh: 她挑选了一种质地光滑的布料。

sentence_examples.en: The texture of the stone is rough.
sentence_examples.zh: 这块石头的质地很粗糙。

translations.translation: (用于形容词，副词的比较级之后)比

sentence_examples.en: My bike is faster than yours.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的自行车比你的快。

sentence_examples.en: This problem is easier than the previous one.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个问题比前一个更容易。

sentence_examples.en: She runs faster than he does.
sentence_examples.zh: 她跑得比他快。

sentence_examples.en: I want to thank you for your help.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想感谢你对我的帮助。

sentence_examples.en: She thanked him for the gift.
sentence_examples.zh: 她为这份礼物向他道谢。

sentence_examples.en: We would like to thank all the volunteers.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们要向所有志愿者表示感谢。

sentence_examples.en: We always decorate the house for Thanksgiving.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在感恩节总会装饰房子。

sentence_examples.en: My family will gather for Thanksgiving dinner.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的家人会在感恩节聚在一起吃晚餐。

sentence_examples.en: Thanksgiving is a time to express gratitude.
sentence_examples.zh: 感恩节是表达感激之情的时刻。

sentence_examples.en: That book is mine.
sentence_examples.zh: 那本书是我的。

sentence_examples.en: I wasn't that tired.
sentence_examples.zh: 我没有那么累。

sentence_examples.en: I think that you are right.
sentence_examples.zh: 我认为你是对的。

translations.translation: 这(那)个;这(那)些(指特定的人或物)

sentence_examples.en: The book on the table is mine.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上的那本书是我的。

sentence_examples.en: The students in the class worked hard.
sentence_examples.zh: 班上的学生都很努力。

sentence_examples.en: I saw the movie you recommended.
sentence_examples.zh: 我看了你推荐的那部电影。

sentence_examples.en: We watched a play at the theater downtown.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在市中心的戏院看了戏剧。

sentence_examples.en: She studies theater to become an actor.
sentence_examples.zh: 她学习戏剧，希望成为一名演员。

sentence_examples.en: The math class was held in a theater-style classroom.
sentence_examples.zh: 这堂课在阶梯教室里进行。

sentence_examples.en: The theft occurred last night at the gallery.
sentence_examples.zh: 昨晚在画廊发生了盗窃。

sentence_examples.en: The police arrested the suspect in connection with the theft.
sentence_examples.zh: 警方逮捕了与这起盗窃案有关的嫌疑人。

sentence_examples.en: The museum increased security after the theft.
sentence_examples.zh: 盗窃发生后，博物馆加强了安保措施。

sentence_examples.en: Their house is at the end of the street.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们的房子在这条街的尽头。

sentence_examples.en: Their cat is very friendly.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们的猫非常友好。

sentence_examples.en: I borrowed their umbrella.
sentence_examples.zh: 我借了他们的雨伞。

sentence_examples.en: The blue backpack is theirs.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个蓝色背包是他们的。

sentence_examples.en: The car in the driveway is theirs.
sentence_examples.zh: 车道上的那辆车是他们的。

sentence_examples.en: Those bags are theirs.
sentence_examples.zh: 那些包是他们的。

translations.translation: 他们/她们/它们(they的宾格形式)

sentence_examples.en: I saw them at the park.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在公园看到了他们。

sentence_examples.en: Please give them the books.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把这些书给他们。

sentence_examples.en: Do you know them?
sentence_examples.zh: 你认识他们吗？

sentence_examples.en: The theme of the festival is environmental awareness.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个节日的主题是环境意识。

sentence_examples.en: Her talk focused on the theme of resilience.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的演讲聚焦于韧性这一主题。

sentence_examples.en: The theme song plays during the opening credits.
sentence_examples.zh: 开场字幕时播放主题曲。

translations.translation: 他(她、它)们自己；他(她、它)们亲自

sentence_examples.en: They bought themselves new jackets after the sale.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们在促销后为自己买了新夹克。

sentence_examples.en: The students completed the project themselves without any help.
sentence_examples.zh: 学生们在没有任何帮助的情况下自己完成了这个项目。

sentence_examples.en: The team congratulated themselves on finishing the marathon.
sentence_examples.zh: 团队为完成马拉松而互相庆祝。

translations.translation: 当时，在那时；然后，于是；那么，因而

sentence_examples.en: First, mix the flour, then add the eggs.
sentence_examples.zh: 先把面粉混合，然后再加入鸡蛋。

sentence_examples.en: If you're not sure, ask him, and then you'll know.
sentence_examples.zh: 如果你不确定，问他，那么你就会知道。

sentence_examples.en: She was tired, then she decided to take a nap.
sentence_examples.zh: 她累了，于是决定去睡一会儿。

sentence_examples.en: Theoretical physics studies the fundamental laws of nature.
sentence_examples.zh: 理论物理研究自然界的基本规律。

sentence_examples.en: A theoretical model cannot yet explain all the observed data.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个理论模型尚不能解释所有观测数据。

sentence_examples.en: The theoretical maximum speed is not achievable in practice.
sentence_examples.zh: 理论上的最高速度在实践中无法实现。

translations.translation: 理论,原理;学说,见解,看法

sentence_examples.en: Her theory explains why planets move in ellipses.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的理论解释了为什么行星以椭圆轨道运动。

sentence_examples.en: Scientists discussed a new theory about the origin of the universe.
sentence_examples.zh: 科学家们讨论了一个关于宇宙起源的新理论。

sentence_examples.en: In class we learned about cell theory.
sentence_examples.zh: 在课堂上，我们学习了细胞理论。

translations.translation: 治疗，(不需要药物或手术的)物理疗法

sentence_examples.en: She started therapy to recover from her ankle injury.
sentence_examples.zh: 她因踝部受伤而开始进行物理治疗。

sentence_examples.en: Talk therapy helps people cope with emotional problems.
sentence_examples.zh: 谈话治疗有助于人们应对情绪问题。

sentence_examples.en: The doctor recommended physical therapy after surgery.
sentence_examples.zh: 医生在手术后建议进行物理治疗。

translations.translation: 在那儿；往那儿；[作引导词表示"存在"]

sentence_examples.en: There is a book on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有一本书。

sentence_examples.en: There are several options to choose from.
sentence_examples.zh: 有好几种选项可供选择。

sentence_examples.en: Is there a bus stop near here?
sentence_examples.zh: 这儿附近有公交车站吗？

sentence_examples.en: The couple married in 1999 and lived happily thereafter.
sentence_examples.zh: 这对夫妻于1999年结婚，此后一直过着幸福的生活。

sentence_examples.en: He promised to call me the next day, and he did not contact me thereafter.
sentence_examples.zh: 他答应第二天给我打电话，此后再也没有联系我。

sentence_examples.en: After the merger, the company expanded internationally and grew steadily thereafter.
sentence_examples.zh: 合并后，公司开始走向国际化，此后稳步增长。

sentence_examples.en: Saving your work frequently prevents data loss, thereby reducing frustration.
sentence_examples.zh: 经常保存你的工作能防止数据丢失，从而降低挫折感。

sentence_examples.en: The company implemented a new safety protocol, thereby improving the overall safety of workers.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司实施了新的安全协议，从而提高了员工的整体安全水平。

sentence_examples.en: He followed the instructions exactly, thereby avoiding errors.
sentence_examples.zh: 他严格按照指示操作，从而避免了错误。

sentence_examples.en: There was a leak in the roof; therefore we postponed the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 屋顶漏水，因此我们推迟了会议。

sentence_examples.en: The test results were inconclusive; therefore we need to run more experiments.
sentence_examples.zh: 测试结果不明确，因此我们需要进行更多实验。

sentence_examples.en: He forgot to set his alarm, therefore he was late for work.
sentence_examples.zh: 他忘记设闹钟，因此上班迟到了。

translations.translation: 热的,热力的；(小规模的)上升气流

sentence_examples.en: The house has excellent thermal insulation.
sentence_examples.zh: 这座房子的保温性能很好。

sentence_examples.en: A glider climbs by riding thermals.
sentence_examples.zh: 滑翔机通过利用上升的热气流来爬升。

sentence_examples.en: Thermal cameras help detect heat loss.
sentence_examples.zh: 热成像相机有助于发现热量损失。

sentence_examples.en: I checked the thermometer to see if I had a fever.
sentence_examples.zh: 我量了体温，看是不是发烧。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse placed a thermometer under the patient's tongue.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士把温度计放在患者的舌下。

sentence_examples.en: Digital thermometers are more common today.
sentence_examples.zh: 数字温度计现在更常见。

sentence_examples.en: These are my keys.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些是我的钥匙。

sentence_examples.en: I like these cupcakes.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢这些杯子蛋糕。

sentence_examples.en: These are the issues we need to discuss.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些是我们需要讨论的问题。

sentence_examples.en: Her thesis argues that social media shapes political opinions.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的论文认为社交媒体会影响政治观点。

sentence_examples.en: He defended his thesis successfully last week.
sentence_examples.zh: 他上周成功答辩了他的论文。

sentence_examples.en: The thesis of the study is that sleep improves memory.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项研究的论点是睡眠能提高记忆力。

translations.translation: 商店(一般人经常用复数they来指一家商店)

sentence_examples.en: The bakery on Main Street is popular; they have the best croissants.
sentence_examples.zh: 主街上的那家面包店很受欢迎，他们的羊角面包最好吃。

sentence_examples.en: If you pass by the shop, they usually stay open late.
sentence_examples.zh: 经过这家商店时，他们通常营业到很晚。

sentence_examples.en: The corner shop changed hands, but they kept the same name.
sentence_examples.zh: 拐角处的商店换了老板，但他们仍然沿用同一个名字。

sentence_examples.en: The book is thick and heavy.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书很厚，拿起来很重。

sentence_examples.en: The soup is thick and rich in flavor.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤很稠，味道很浓。

sentence_examples.en: There is a thick fog over the valley.
sentence_examples.zh: 山谷上空弥漫着浓雾。

sentence_examples.en: The thief stole my wallet yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 小偷昨天偷了我的钱包。

sentence_examples.en: A thief was seen near the store this afternoon.
sentence_examples.zh: 今天下午，在商店附近有人看见了一名小偷。

sentence_examples.en: The thief was caught by a security guard.
sentence_examples.zh: 保安把小偷抓住了。

sentence_examples.en: She pulled a muscle in her thigh while running.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在跑步时拉伤了大腿。

sentence_examples.en: The thigh bone, called the femur, is the longest bone in the human body.
sentence_examples.zh: 股骨是人体最长的骨头。

sentence_examples.en: She wore shorts to show off her thighs.
sentence_examples.zh: 她穿短裤，露出大腿。

translations.translation: 薄的,细的;稀薄的,淡的;瘦的

sentence_examples.en: The pages are thin.
sentence_examples.zh: 这些纸张很薄。

sentence_examples.en: The soup is too thin.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤太稀了。

sentence_examples.en: You can thin the paint with water.
sentence_examples.zh: 你可以用水稀释油漆。

translations.translation: 物，东西；事，事情；所有物；局面，情况

sentence_examples.en: That thing is heavy.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个东西很重。

sentence_examples.en: Please put that thing on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把那个东西放在桌子上。

sentence_examples.en: We have many things to do today.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们今天有很多事情要做。

translations.translation: 想，思索；认为，以为；想要；料想，预料

sentence_examples.en: I think it's going to rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 我觉得要下雨了。

sentence_examples.en: What do you think about this plan?
sentence_examples.zh: 你觉得这个计划怎么样？

sentence_examples.en: I'll think about your suggestion and get back to you.
sentence_examples.zh: 我会考虑你的建议，然后再回复你。

sentence_examples.en: She finished in third place.
sentence_examples.zh: 她获得了第三名。

sentence_examples.en: Take the third street on the left.
sentence_examples.zh: 走左边的第三条街。

sentence_examples.en: One third of the cake has been eaten.
sentence_examples.zh: 蛋糕已经吃掉了三分之一。

sentence_examples.en: After the workout, I felt a strong thirst.
sentence_examples.zh: 运动后我感到很口渴。

sentence_examples.en: She has a thirst for adventure.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对冒险充满渴望。

sentence_examples.en: He quenched his thirst with a glass of water.
sentence_examples.zh: 他用一杯水来解渴。

sentence_examples.en: After the hike, I was so thirsty I drank three glasses of water.
sentence_examples.zh: 徒步后，我口渴极了，喝了三杯水。

sentence_examples.en: The students were thirsty for more knowledge after the lecture.
sentence_examples.zh: 讲座结束后，学生们渴望更多的知识。

sentence_examples.en: He was thirsty for success and worked late every night.
sentence_examples.zh: 他渴望成功，每晚都工作到很晚。

sentence_examples.en: There are thirteen apples on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有十三个苹果。

sentence_examples.en: She is thirteen years old.
sentence_examples.zh: 她十三岁。

sentence_examples.en: Thirteen of us will attend the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们中有十三人将参加会议。

sentence_examples.en: There are thirty students in the class.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个班级有三十个学生。

sentence_examples.en: The price is thirty dollars.
sentence_examples.zh: 价格是三十美元。

sentence_examples.en: It takes thirty minutes to finish the assignment.
sentence_examples.zh: 完成作业需要三十分钟。

sentence_examples.en: This is my book.
sentence_examples.zh: 这是我的书。

sentence_examples.en: I like this idea.
sentence_examples.zh: 我喜欢这个主意。

sentence_examples.en: This year has been busy.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年一直很忙。

sentence_examples.en: Be careful of the thorn when you walk through the garden.
sentence_examples.zh: 走花园时要小心脚下的刺。

sentence_examples.en: The rose has a sharp thorn that can prick your finger.
sentence_examples.zh: 玫瑰有一根锋利的刺，可能扎到你的手指。

sentence_examples.en: She pulled a thorn from her finger.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把手指上的刺拔了出来。

sentence_examples.en: She did a thorough job cleaning the house.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把房子清理得很彻底。

sentence_examples.en: We need to conduct a thorough investigation before making a decision.
sentence_examples.zh: 在做出决定之前，我们需要进行一次彻底的调查。

sentence_examples.en: He is a thorough student who checks his work carefully.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是个做事很细致的学生，总是仔细检查自己的作业。

sentence_examples.en: Those are your keys on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 那些是桌子上的你的钥匙。

sentence_examples.en: Those people over there are my friends.
sentence_examples.zh: 那些在那边的人是我的朋友。

sentence_examples.en: I don't like those.
sentence_examples.zh: 我不喜欢那些。

sentence_examples.en: Though it was raining, we went hiking.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是去徒步。

sentence_examples.en: The soup tastes great, though it looks plain.
sentence_examples.zh: 汤尝起来很好，尽管看起来很平淡。

sentence_examples.en: It's late, though I'd like to stay.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在很晚了，尽管我想留下来。

translations.translation: 思想，思考，思维；意图，打算；想法

sentence_examples.en: I had a thought about how to improve our plan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我想到一个改进我们计划的想法。

sentence_examples.en: He kept his thoughts to himself during the meeting.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在会议中把自己的想法保留在心里。

sentence_examples.en: Her first thought was to call for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 她第一时间想到的是寻求帮助。

translations.translation: 认真思考的,沉思的;体贴的,关心的

sentence_examples.en: She gave me a thoughtful gift and wrote a kind note.
sentence_examples.zh: 她给了我一份体贴的礼物并写了一张温暖的便条。

sentence_examples.en: He is a thoughtful friend who always considers how others feel.
sentence_examples.zh: 他是一个体贴的朋友，总是考虑到别人的感受。

sentence_examples.en: Her thoughtful approach to the project impressed the team.
sentence_examples.zh: 她对这个项目的周到做法让团队印象深刻。

sentence_examples.en: A thousand people attended the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 有一千人参加了音乐会。

sentence_examples.en: It costs about a thousand dollars.
sentence_examples.zh: 大约需要一千美元。

sentence_examples.en: There are thousands of stars visible in the night sky.
sentence_examples.zh: 夜空中可以看到成千上万颗星星。

sentence_examples.en: I need a spool of thread to mend the seam.
sentence_examples.zh: 我需要一卷线来缝补接缝。

sentence_examples.en: There was a thread on the forum about climate change.
sentence_examples.zh: 论坛上有一条关于气候变化的讨论串。

sentence_examples.en: She threaded the needle and began sewing.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把针线穿过针眼后开始缝衣。

translations.translation: 恐吓,威胁;坏兆头,危险迹象

sentence_examples.en: The threat of rain forced the picnic to be canceled.
sentence_examples.zh: 下雨的威胁迫使野餐取消。

sentence_examples.en: There is a real threat of layoffs in the company.
sentence_examples.zh: 公司确实存在裁员的威胁。

sentence_examples.en: The report identifies a threat to national security.
sentence_examples.zh: 报道指出对国家安全的威胁。

translations.translation: 恐吓,威胁;有…危险,快要来临

sentence_examples.en: The dark clouds threaten rain.
sentence_examples.zh: 乌云聚集，似乎要下雨。

sentence_examples.en: The policy threatens to reduce funding for schools.
sentence_examples.zh: 这项政策可能削减对学校的资助。

sentence_examples.en: Budget cuts threaten to derail the project.
sentence_examples.zh: 预算削减可能导致项目推迟。

sentence_examples.en: There are three apples on the table.
sentence_examples.zh: 桌子上有三个苹果。

sentence_examples.en: She bought three new books yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 她昨天买了三本新书。

sentence_examples.en: The movie lasts about three hours.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影大约持续三个小时。

sentence_examples.en: She stepped over the threshold and entered the room.
sentence_examples.zh: 她跨过门槛走进房间。

sentence_examples.en: The new policy lowers the hiring threshold for applicants.
sentence_examples.zh: 新政策降低了应聘者的招聘门槛。

sentence_examples.en: Her pain threshold is high.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的痛觉阈值很高。

sentence_examples.en: Her thrift helped her save enough for a down payment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的节俭帮助她攒下了首付的钱。

sentence_examples.en: The family’s thrift was evident in their careful budgeting and the way they reused leftovers.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个家庭的节俭在他们精打细算和把剩饭再利用的做法中十分明显。

sentence_examples.en: Despite the luxury appeal, he valued thrift over display.
sentence_examples.zh: 尽管外表看起来奢华，他更看重节俭而不是炫耀。

sentence_examples.en: The roller coaster ride gave me a thrill.
sentence_examples.zh: 坐过山车的经历让我感到一阵激动。

sentence_examples.en: The ghost story thrilled the audience.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个鬼故事让观众兴奋不已。

sentence_examples.en: She was thrilled to receive the invitation.
sentence_examples.zh: 她收到邀请时感到非常兴奋。

sentence_examples.en: Children thrive when they have supportive teachers.
sentence_examples.zh: 在有支持的老师时，孩子们会茁壮成长。

sentence_examples.en: Small businesses can thrive even during tough times.
sentence_examples.zh: 即使在艰难时期，小企业也能兴旺。

sentence_examples.en: The garden thrives in warm, sunny afternoons.
sentence_examples.zh: 花园在温暖、阳光充足的午后茁壮成长。

sentence_examples.en: Her throat felt dry after the long hike.
sentence_examples.zh: 长途跋涉后，她的喉咙感到干燥。

sentence_examples.en: I cleared my throat before speaking.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在说话前清了清喉咙。

sentence_examples.en: She has a sore throat and can't sleep.
sentence_examples.zh: 她喉咙痛，睡不着。

sentence_examples.en: The king sat on the throne and waved to the crowd.
sentence_examples.zh: 国王坐在宝座上向人群致意。

sentence_examples.en: She was crowned and ascended to the throne after years in public service.
sentence_examples.zh: 在多年公共服务之后，她被加冕并登上王位。

sentence_examples.en: The throne room was lavishly decorated for the ceremony.
sentence_examples.zh: 王座大厅为典礼进行了华丽的装饰。

sentence_examples.en: We walked through the park to reach the river.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们穿过公园走到河边。

sentence_examples.en: I heard about it through a friend.
sentence_examples.zh: 我是通过一个朋友听说的这个消息。

sentence_examples.en: The train is a through service from Paris to Rome.
sentence_examples.zh: 这趟列车是从巴黎到罗马的直达列车。

sentence_examples.en: The festival was held throughout the city.
sentence_examples.zh: 节日活动在全城举行。

sentence_examples.en: There was rain throughout the day.
sentence_examples.zh: 整日都在下雨。

sentence_examples.en: The film was entertaining throughout.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都很有趣。

sentence_examples.en: Please throw the ball to me.
sentence_examples.zh: 请把球扔给我。

sentence_examples.en: The announcement threw him into a panic.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条消息让他突然慌乱起来。

sentence_examples.en: The longest throw was 60 meters.
sentence_examples.zh: 最长的投掷距离是60米。

sentence_examples.en: The knight thrust his sword forward.
sentence_examples.zh: 骑士把剑往前刺去。

sentence_examples.en: The plane's thrust increased as it accelerated.
sentence_examples.zh: 飞机在加速时推力增大。

sentence_examples.en: The thrust of her argument was that we needed to act now.
sentence_examples.zh: 她论点的核心是我们现在需要采取行动。

translations.translation: 示意要求搭车；迅速翻阅

sentence_examples.en: I burned my thumb on the hot pan.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在热锅上烫伤了拇指。

sentence_examples.en: We thumbed a ride to the concert.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在路边用拇指拦车去音乐会。

sentence_examples.en: She thumbed through the notebook to memorize the list.
sentence_examples.zh: 她翻阅笔记本，想把清单记住。

sentence_examples.en: Thunder rolled across the valley after the storm.
sentence_examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，雷声在山谷间回响。

sentence_examples.en: The crowd thundered in approval.
sentence_examples.zh: 人群如雷鸣般表示赞同。

sentence_examples.en: The coach thundered at the players.
sentence_examples.zh: 教练对球员大声训斥。

sentence_examples.en: Our meeting is on Thursday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们的会议在星期四。

sentence_examples.en: I have a class every Thursday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我每周四都有课。

sentence_examples.en: Thursday afternoon is busy for me.
sentence_examples.zh: 我星期四下午很忙。

sentence_examples.en: The weather improved, thus we decided to go for a walk.
sentence_examples.zh: 天气好转，因此我们决定去散步。

sentence_examples.en: He explained the formula clearly, thus everyone understood.
sentence_examples.zh: 他清楚地讲解了公式，因此大家都明白了。

sentence_examples.en: Thus far, we have completed three chapters.
sentence_examples.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经完成了三章。

sentence_examples.en: The clock ticks loudly in the quiet room.
sentence_examples.zh: 安静的房间里钟表滴答声很响。

sentence_examples.en: Please tick the box to indicate your approval.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在方框中打勾以表示你的同意。

sentence_examples.en: She ticked off the items on the checklist.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把清单上的项目一个个勾选完毕。

translations.translation: 票,入场券;票签;(交通违章)罚款传票

sentence_examples.en: I bought a train ticket online.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在网上买了一张火车票。

sentence_examples.en: Please show your ticket at the entrance.
sentence_examples.zh: 请在入口处出示你的票。

sentence_examples.en: The driver received a speeding ticket.
sentence_examples.zh: 司机因超速被开罚单。

sentence_examples.en: The tide is high tonight.
sentence_examples.zh: 今晚的潮水很高。

sentence_examples.en: We walked along the beach at low tide.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在退潮时沿着海滩散步。

sentence_examples.en: There has been a tide of public opinion against the proposal.
sentence_examples.zh: 公众舆论的浪潮开始转向反对该提案。

sentence_examples.en: She keeps her desk tidy.
sentence_examples.zh: 她的书桌总是很整洁。

sentence_examples.en: I need to tidy up the living room before guests arrive.
sentence_examples.zh: 客人来之前，我需要把客厅打扫整齐。

sentence_examples.en: A tidy room helps you focus.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个整洁的房间有助于专注。

translations.translation: 领带;联系,关系,纽带;束缚

sentence_examples.en: He wore a blue tie to the interview.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在面试时系着一条蓝色领带。

sentence_examples.en: There is a strong tie between the two families.
sentence_examples.zh: 两家人之间有着紧密的纽带。

sentence_examples.en: She tied the ribbon around the gift.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把丝带系在礼物上。

sentence_examples.en: A tiger is a large cat.
sentence_examples.zh: 老虎是一种大型的猫科动物。

sentence_examples.en: Tigers live in forests in Asia.
sentence_examples.zh: 老虎生活在亚洲的森林里。

sentence_examples.en: The tiger roars loudly at night.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只老虎在夜里发出响亮的吼声。

translations.translation: 紧的;紧身的,装紧的;密封的

sentence_examples.en: The lid is tight; you need to twist it harder.
sentence_examples.zh: 盖子很紧，你需要再用力拧。

sentence_examples.en: Those jeans are tight on me.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条牛仔裤对我来说太紧了。

sentence_examples.en: We have a tight deadline this week.
sentence_examples.zh: 本周我们有一个紧迫的截止日期。

sentence_examples.en: He painted a tile with a small pattern.
sentence_examples.zh: 他在一块瓷砖上画了一个小图案。

sentence_examples.en: The floor tile cracked after the drop.
sentence_examples.zh: 地板瓷砖摔落后裂开了。

sentence_examples.en: They will tile the kitchen floor this weekend.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们这个周末将为厨房地板贴瓷砖。

translations.translation: 直到，直到…为止，与until意思相同

sentence_examples.en: I'll wait till five o'clock.
sentence_examples.zh: 我会等到五点。

sentence_examples.en: She stayed till the last moment.
sentence_examples.zh: 她一直待到最后一刻。

sentence_examples.en: We can't start till the meeting ends.
sentence_examples.zh: 在会议结束前，我们不能开始。

sentence_examples.en: The picture on the wall tilts to one side.
sentence_examples.zh: 墙上的画往一边倾斜。

sentence_examples.en: She tilted her head to listen more carefully.
sentence_examples.zh: 她歪着头以便更仔细地听。

sentence_examples.en: The tilt of the Earth's axis affects the seasons.
sentence_examples.zh: 地球自转轴的倾斜会影响季节。

sentence_examples.en: The builders ordered more timber for the new deck.
sentence_examples.zh: 施工方为新甲板订购了更多木材。

sentence_examples.en: We cut the timber to size in the workshop.
sentence_examples.zh: 我们在车间把木材切割成合适的尺寸。

sentence_examples.en: Timber prices have risen this year.
sentence_examples.zh: 今年木材价格上涨。

translations.translation: 时间，时刻；次，回；时代，时期；倍，乘

sentence_examples.en: What time is it?
sentence_examples.zh: 现在几点？

sentence_examples.en: It's time to go.
sentence_examples.zh: 现在该走了。

sentence_examples.en: I called him three times yesterday.
sentence_examples.zh: 我昨天给他打了三次电话。

sentence_examples.en: Her timely advice saved us from a costly mistake.
sentence_examples.zh: 她及时的建议让我们避免了一个代价高昂的错误。

sentence_examples.en: The nurse arrived in a timely manner and checked his vitals.
sentence_examples.zh: 护士及时赶到并检查了他的生命体征。

sentence_examples.en: The report was completed in a timely fashion, helping the team meet the deadline.
sentence_examples.zh: 报告按时完成，帮助团队赶上了截止日期。

sentence_examples.en: She felt timid about speaking in public.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在公开场合说话时感到胆怯。

sentence_examples.en: The timid child hid behind his mother's skirt.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个胆怯的孩子躲在妈妈的裙子后面。

sentence_examples.en: He was too timid to ask for help.
sentence_examples.zh: 他太胆怯，连寻求帮助都不敢。

sentence_examples.en: I bought a tin of beans at the store.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在商店买了一罐豆子。

sentence_examples.en: She bought a tin box.
sentence_examples.zh: 她买了一个锡制的盒子。

sentence_examples.en: They tin the steel parts to prevent rust.
sentence_examples.zh: 他们给钢件镀锡以防锈。

sentence_examples.en: The tiny insect crawled across the leaf.
sentence_examples.zh: 这只极小的昆虫爬过叶子。

sentence_examples.en: She gave me a tiny smile.
sentence_examples.zh: 她向我露出一个小小的笑容。

sentence_examples.en: The box was tiny, but it held a ring.
sentence_examples.zh: 那个盒子很小，但里面装着一枚戒指。

sentence_examples.en: The tip of the pencil broke off.
sentence_examples.zh: 铅笔尖断了。

sentence_examples.en: Please leave a tip for the waiter.
sentence_examples.zh: 请给服务员留小费。

sentence_examples.en: She tipped the bottle to pour the last drop.
sentence_examples.zh: 她把瓶子倾斜，倒出最后一滴。

sentence_examples.en: The long hike tired me out.
sentence_examples.zh: 漫长的徒步把我累坏了。

sentence_examples.en: The constant noise is starting to tire me.
sentence_examples.zh: 持续的噪音开始让我感到厌倦。

sentence_examples.en: My car has a flat tire.
sentence_examples.zh: 我的车轮胎瘪了。

sentence_examples.en: I'm tired after a long day at work.
sentence_examples.zh: 我在工作了一整天后很累。

sentence_examples.en: She's tired of waiting and wants to go home.
sentence_examples.zh: 她已经厌倦等待，想回家。

sentence_examples.en: He looked tired after the trip.
sentence_examples.zh: 他旅途结束后看起来很累。

sentence_examples.en: The meeting dragged on for hours and became tiresome.
sentence_examples.zh: 这个会议拖了好几个小时，变得让人厌烦。

sentence_examples.en: He gave tiresome, repetitive explanations that bored everyone.
sentence_examples.zh: 他给出了冗长且重复的解释，让每个人都感到无聊。

sentence_examples.en: Dealing with the paperwork is tiresome but unavoidable.
sentence_examples.zh: 处理文书工作很乏味，但这是不可避免的。

translations.translation: 织物,薄绢,纸巾;(动,植物的)组织

sentence_examples.en: Could you pass me a tissue?
sentence_examples.zh: 请把一张纸巾递给我。

sentence_examples.en: A tissue sample was examined under a microscope.
sentence_examples.zh: 一个组织样本在显微镜下被检查。

sentence_examples.en: This scarf is made of tissue silk.
sentence_examples.zh: 这条围巾是用薄绢做的。

sentence_examples.en: The book's title is printed in large letters on the cover.
sentence_examples.zh: 这本书的书名在封面上用大字印着。

sentence_examples.en: She earned the title of champion after the race.
sentence_examples.zh: 她在比赛后获得了冠军头衔。

sentence_examples.en: The film's English title is 'The Lost City'.
sentence_examples.zh: 这部电影的英文标题是《The Lost City》。

translations.translation: (表示方向)到；向；(表示间接关系)给.

sentence_examples.en: I am going to the library.
sentence_examples.zh: 我正去图书馆。

sentence_examples.en: Please send the report to me by email.
sentence_examples.zh: 请通过电子邮件把报告发给我。

sentence_examples.en: He handed the money to the cashier.
sentence_examples.zh: 他把钱递给收银员。

sentence_examples.en: I had a piece of toast with jam for breakfast.
sentence_examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一片抹着果酱的吐司。
